# Fort Knox Authentication System

Enterprise-grade, multi-tenant authentication platform built with NestJS, TypeORM, PostgreSQL, and Redis.

---

## What is Fort Knox?

Fort Knox is a self-hosted authentication service and SDK. It handles everything from basic email/password login to OAuth2 server, passkeys, TOTP, social login, RBAC, and multi-tenant isolation — so your applications do not have to.

---

## Current State

### Implemented and production-ready

| System | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Email/password auth | Done | Argon2id, brute-force protection, password history |
| JWT + refresh tokens | Done | 15m access / 30d refresh, token rotation, reuse detection |
| Session management | Done | Redis cache + PostgreSQL, device tracking, 15m cleanup cron |
| Magic link login | Done | Token-based, single-use, 15m TTL |
| Multi-tenancy | Done | Full row-level isolation by `tenant_id` on every table |
| TOTP MFA | Done | QR code setup, 10 backup codes, 2-window time step |
| WebAuthn / passkeys | Done | Registration + authentication via `@simplewebauthn/server` v13 |
| Email OTP MFA | Done | Request + verify endpoints, 10m TTL |
| Backup codes | Done | SHA-256 hashed, 10 per user, one-time use |
| Social login | Done | Google, GitHub, Microsoft via Passport.js |
| Social account linking | Done | Link/unlink with email-collision detection |
| OAuth2 server | Done | Authorization code (+ PKCE), refresh token, client credentials |
| OIDC | Done | Discovery, JWKS, UserInfo, ID tokens, introspection, revocation |
| RBAC | Done | Roles, permissions, user-role assignments with expiry |
| Admin portal | Done | Next.js 15 dashboard — profile, security, sessions, passkeys, social connections |
| fortknox-sdk | Done | React hooks, Next.js SSR helpers, Node M2M client, Web helpers |
| Tenant branding | Done | Per-tenant logo, colors, company name, support links |
| Security event log | Done | 37 event types across all flows |
| Email delivery | Done | SMTP (Nodemailer) + AWS SES, auto-detected by config |

### Known gaps / planned work

| Gap | Detail |
|---|---|
| SMS OTP | Entity fields exist, no implementation |
| Tenant admin dashboard metrics | Shows hardcoded mock values — no real DB queries behind them |
| WebAuthn challenge storage | In-memory Map — must move to Redis before multi-instance deploy |
| SAML 2.0 | Not started |
| SCIM provisioning | Not started |

---

## Monorepo Layout

```
my-auth/
├── apps/
│   ├── auth-service/          # NestJS backend — all auth logic
│   └── admin-portal/          # Next.js 15 frontend dashboard
├── packages/
│   ├── database/              # TypeORM entities + migrations
│   ├── security/              # Argon2, AES-256-GCM, rate limiter
│   ├── fortknox-sdk/          # Multi-platform client SDK
│   ├── shared/                # Shared types, DTOs, constants
│   └── ui/                    # shadcn/ui component library
├── docs/
│   ├── plans/                 # Implementation plans
│   └── fortknox/              # Developer guides
├── turbo.json
└── package.json
```

---

## Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| Backend framework | NestJS 11, TypeScript 5.7 |
| Database | PostgreSQL 16, TypeORM 0.3 |
| Cache | Redis 7, ioredis 5 |
| Scheduling | @nestjs/schedule (cron) |
| Password hashing | Argon2id |
| Token format | JWT (access) + opaque random hex (refresh) |
| Encryption | AES-256-GCM |
| WebAuthn | @simplewebauthn/server v13.2.2 |
| Social auth | Passport.js (google-oauth20, github, microsoft) |
| Frontend | Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui |
| Build | Turborepo, tsup |
| Package manager | Yarn workspaces |

---

## Quick Start

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 20+
- PostgreSQL 16
- Redis 7
- Yarn

### 1. Install

```bash
git clone <repo>
cd my-auth
yarn install
```

### 2. Configure auth-service

```bash
cp apps/auth-service/.env.example apps/auth-service/.env
```

Minimum required variables:

```env
# Database
DB_HOST=localhost
DB_PORT=5432
DB_USERNAME=postgres
DB_PASSWORD=postgres
DB_DATABASE=fort_knox

# Redis
REDIS_HOST=localhost
REDIS_PORT=6379

# JWT — change in production
JWT_SECRET=change-me-in-production

# URLs
FRONTEND_URL=http://localhost:3000
PORTAL_URL=http://localhost:3000
AUTH_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4000
BASE_URL=http://localhost:4000

# WebAuthn
WEBAUTHN_RP_ID=localhost
WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3000

# Email (SMTP or SES — at least one required)
SMTP_HOST=localhost
SMTP_PORT=1025
EMAIL_FROM=noreply@fortknox.local
```

### 3. Run migrations

```bash
cd apps/auth-service
yarn db:migrate
```

### 4. Start

```bash
# All apps
yarn dev

# Auth service only
yarn dev --filter=auth-service

# Admin portal only
yarn dev --filter=admin-portal
```

Auth service runs on `http://localhost:4000`.
Admin portal runs on `http://localhost:3000`.

## API Overview

Full documentation in [docs/fortknox/](docs/fortknox/).

### Authentication

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/auth/register` | — | Create account |
| POST | `/auth/login` | — | Email/password login |
| POST | `/auth/login-intent` | — | Check auth methods for email |
| POST | `/auth/logout` | JWT | Revoke session |
| POST | `/auth/refresh` | Cookie | Rotate refresh token |
| GET | `/auth/me` | JWT | Current user + session |
| POST | `/auth/forgot-password` | — | Send reset OTP |
| POST | `/auth/reset-password` | — | Apply new password |
| POST | `/auth/verify-email` | — | Verify email address |
| POST | `/auth/magic-link/send` | — | Send magic link |
| POST | `/auth/magic-link/verify` | — | Login via magic link |
| POST | `/auth/mfa/verify` | — | Complete MFA (TOTP) |
| POST | `/auth/mfa/verify-backup` | — | Complete MFA (backup code) |
| POST | `/auth/webauthn/login/start` | — | WebAuthn challenge |
| POST | `/auth/webauthn/login/finish` | — | WebAuthn verify + login |

### MFA (all require JWT)

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/mfa/status` | Current MFA configuration |
| POST | `/mfa/setup/totp` | Generate TOTP QR + backup codes |
| POST | `/mfa/verify/totp` | Enable TOTP |
| DELETE | `/mfa/totp` | Disable TOTP |
| POST | `/mfa/backup-codes/regenerate` | New backup codes |
| POST | `/mfa/request-email-otp` | Send OTP email |
| POST | `/mfa/verify-email-otp` | Verify OTP email |
| POST | `/mfa/webauthn/register/start` | Passkey registration challenge |
| POST | `/mfa/webauthn/register/finish` | Complete passkey registration |
| GET | `/mfa/webauthn/credentials` | List registered passkeys |
| DELETE | `/mfa/webauthn/credentials/:id` | Remove passkey |

### OAuth2 / OIDC

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/.well-known/openid-configuration` | OIDC discovery |
| GET | `/oauth/jwks` | Public keys |
| GET | `/oauth/authorize` | Authorization code flow |
| POST | `/oauth/token` | Token exchange (code, refresh, client_credentials) |
| GET | `/oauth/userinfo` | OIDC user claims |
| POST | `/oauth/introspect` | Token introspection |
| POST | `/oauth/revoke` | Token revocation |
| POST | `/oauth/clients` | Create OAuth client |

### Social Auth

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/auth/social/google/login` | Google login redirect |
| GET | `/auth/social/github/login` | GitHub login redirect |
| GET | `/auth/social/microsoft/login` | Microsoft login redirect |
| POST | `/auth/social/claim-session` | Claim token after redirect |
| GET | `/auth/social/connections` | Linked accounts |
| DELETE | `/auth/social/connections/:provider` | Unlink account |

### Sessions (all require JWT)

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/sessions/active` | Active devices |
| DELETE | `/sessions/:id` | Revoke session |
| DELETE | `/sessions/all/other` | Logout other devices |
| DELETE | `/sessions/all` | Logout all devices |

```bash

yarn db:migrate:show     # show status
yarn db:migrate:generate MigrationName  # generate from entity diff
```

Migrations live in `packages/database/src/migrations/`.

## SDK Usage

```typescript
import { createWebClient } from '@fortknox/sdk/web';
import { FortKnoxProvider, useAuth } from '@fortknox/sdk/react';

const client = createWebClient({
  baseURL: 'https://auth.yourapp.com',
  tenant: 'your-tenant-slug',
});

function App() {
  return (
    <FortKnoxProvider client={client}>
      <YourApp />
    </FortKnoxProvider>
  );
}

function LoginButton() {
  const { login, user, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();

  return isAuthenticated
    ? <p>Hello {user?.firstName}</p>
    : <button onClick={() => login({ email, password })}>Login</button>;
}
```

Full SDK reference: [docs/fortknox/09-sdk.md](docs/fortknox/09-sdk.md)

## Recent Changes

**2026-03-16 — Session Management Hardening**
- Added `application_id` FK column to sessions table (nullable, references `oauth_clients`)
- Added partial index on `(expires_at) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL`
- Implemented `cleanupExpiredSessions()` — single transaction soft-deletes expired sessions and revokes their refresh tokens
- Added 15-minute cron job in `TokenCleanupService`
- Hardened `revokeSession()` to null `refreshTokenHash` on logout
- Same null applied to both `revokeAllUserSessions()` paths
- 5 regression tests

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { PublicLayout } from "@/components/layouts/public-layout";
import { Button } from "@repo/ui";

export default function CallbackPage() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<"loading" | "success" | "error">(
    "loading",
  );
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    // Simulate OAuth callback processing
    const processCallback = async () => {
      const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const code = searchParams.get("code");
      const state = searchParams.get("state");

      if (!code) {
        setStatus("error");
        setMessage("No authorization code received");
        return;
      }

      try {
        // Simulate API call to exchange code for token
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
        setStatus("success");
        setMessage("Authentication successful! Redirecting...");

        // In a real app, would redirect to dashboard
        setTimeout(() => {
          window.location.href = "/t/acme-corp/dashboard";
        }, 2000);
      } catch (error) {
        setStatus("error");
        setMessage("Failed to complete authentication");
      }
    };

    processCallback();
  }, []);

  return (
    <PublicLayout showNav={false}>
      <div className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center px-6 py-12">
        <div className="max-w-md text-center">
          {status === "loading" && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex justify-center">
                <div className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent" />
              </div>
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                Processing your login
              </h1>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                Please wait while we complete your authentication...
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {status === "success" && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex justify-center">
                <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-900/30">
                  <svg
                    className="h-6 w-6 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  >
                    <path
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"
                    />
                  </svg>
                </div>
              </div>
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                Authentication successful!
              </h1>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">{message}</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {status === "error" && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex justify-center">
                <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/30">
                  <svg
                    className="h-6 w-6 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  >
                    <path
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"
                    />
                  </svg>
                </div>
              </div>
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                Authentication failed
              </h1>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">{message}</p>
              <div className="pt-4">
                <Button onClick={() => (window.location.href = "/u/login")}>
                  Back to login
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </PublicLayout>
  );
}

"use client"

import { useEffect } from "react"
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation"
import { useAuth } from "@fortknox/sdk"
import { Skeleton } from "@repo/ui"

export default function DashboardLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const { user, isLoading } = useAuth()

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoading && !user) {
      router.replace("/u/login")
    }
  }, [user, isLoading, router])

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-screen bg-background">
        <div className="w-64 border-r border-border bg-card p-4 space-y-4">
          <Skeleton className="h-8 w-32" />
          <Skeleton className="h-5 w-40" />
          <div className="space-y-1 pt-6">
            {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, i) => (
              <Skeleton key={i} className="h-9 w-full rounded-lg" />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col">
          <div className="border-b border-border px-8 py-4 bg-card">
            <Skeleton className="h-6 w-40" />
          </div>
          <div className="p-8 space-y-6">
            <Skeleton className="h-16 w-full rounded-xl" />
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (
                <Skeleton key={i} className="h-28 rounded-xl" />
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              <Skeleton className="h-72 rounded-xl" />
              <Skeleton className="h-72 rounded-xl" />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (!user) return null

  return <>{children}</>
}

"use client"

import { useAuth } from "@fortknox/sdk"
import { Skeleton } from "@repo/ui"
import { DashboardSidebar } from "@/components/dashboard/dashboard-sidebar"
import { useDashboard } from "@/lib/queries"
import { ShieldAlert, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react"
import Link from "next/link"
import { formatDistanceToNow } from "date-fns"

export default function DashboardPage() {
  const { user } = useAuth()
  const { data, isLoading, isError } = useDashboard()

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen bg-background overflow-hidden">
      <DashboardSidebar />

              {/* MFA Banner */}

                  <ShieldCheck className="h-5 w-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                  <p className="text-sm text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 font-medium">
                    Your account is protected with multi-factor authentication.
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 dark:border-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/30 px-5 py-4">
                  <ShieldAlert className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0" />

"use client"

import { useState } from "react"
import { Button, Skeleton } from "@repo/ui"
import { DashboardSidebar } from "@/components/dashboard/dashboard-sidebar"
import { useMfaStatus, useSetupTotp, useVerifyTotp, useDisableTotp } from "@/lib/queries"
import type { TotpSetupData } from "@/lib/types"
import { ShieldCheck, ShieldOff, QrCode, Key } from "lucide-react"

export default function SecurityPage() {
  const { data: mfaStatus, isLoading } = useMfaStatus()
  const setupTotp = useSetupTotp()
  const verifyTotp = useVerifyTotp()
  const disableTotp = useDisableTotp()

  const [stage, setStage] = useState<"status" | "setup" | "verify" | "done">("status")
  const [setupData, setSetupData] = useState<TotpSetupData | null>(null)
  const [verifyCode, setVerifyCode] = useState("")

  const handleStartSetup = async () => {
    const data = await setupTotp.mutateAsync()
    setSetupData(data)
    setStage("setup")
  }

  const handleVerify = async () => {
    await verifyTotp.mutateAsync(verifyCode)
    setStage("done")
  }

  const handleDisable = async () => {
    if (!confirm("Are you sure you want to disable MFA? Your account will be less secure.")) return
    await disableTotp.mutateAsync()
    setStage("status")
    setSetupData(null)
    setVerifyCode("")
  }

  const error =
    setupTotp.error?.message ??
    verifyTotp.error?.message ??
    disableTotp.error?.message ??
    null

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen bg-background overflow-hidden">
      <DashboardSidebar />
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col overflow-hidden">
        <header className="flex items-center border-b border-border bg-card px-8 py-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">Security</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Manage your account security settings</p>
          </div>
        </header>

        <main className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-8">
          <div className="max-w-2xl space-y-6">
            {isLoading ? (
              <Skeleton className="h-48 w-full rounded-xl" />
            ) : (
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-6 space-y-4">
                {/* Header */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    {mfaStatus?.enabled ? (
                      <ShieldCheck className="h-5 w-5 text-emerald-500" />
                    ) : (
                      <ShieldOff className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-500" />
                    )}
                    <div>
                      <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">
                        Multi-Factor Authentication
                      </h2>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {mfaStatus?.enabled
                          ? `Active via: ${mfaStatus.methods.join(", ")}`
                          : "Not configured — your account is less secure"}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span
                    className={`text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full ${
                      mfaStatus?.enabled
                        ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/40 dark:text-emerald-400"
                        : "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/40 dark:text-amber-400"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {mfaStatus?.enabled ? "Active" : "Not configured"}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Error */}
                {error && (
                  <div className="rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 border border-destructive/20 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-destructive">
                    {error}
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Stage: not enabled */}
                {stage === "status" && !mfaStatus?.enabled && (
                  <Button
                    onClick={handleStartSetup}
                    disabled={setupTotp.isPending}
                    className="w-full"
                  >
                    <QrCode className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                    {setupTotp.isPending ? "Preparing..." : "Set up Authenticator App"}
                  </Button>
                )}

                {/* Stage: enabled */}
                {stage === "status" && mfaStatus?.enabled && (
                  <div className="flex gap-3">
                    <div className="flex flex-1 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-border px-4 py-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      <Key className="h-4 w-4" />
                      {mfaStatus.backupCodesRemaining} backup codes remaining
                    </div>
                    <Button
                      variant="destructive"
                      onClick={handleDisable}
                      disabled={disableTotp.isPending}
                    >
                      {disableTotp.isPending ? "Disabling..." : "Disable"}
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Stage: show QR */}
                {stage === "setup" && setupData && (
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy,
                      1Password, etc.)
                    </p>
                    <div className="flex justify-center">
                      <img
                        src={setupData.qrCode}
                        alt="TOTP QR Code"
                        className="h-48 w-48 rounded-lg border border-border"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-center text-muted-foreground">
                      Can't scan? Enter this key manually:{" "}
                      <code className="font-mono bg-muted px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-xs">
                        {setupData.secret}
                      </code>
                    </p>
                    <Button onClick={() => setStage("verify")} className="w-full">
                      I've scanned the code →
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Stage: verify */}
                {stage === "verify" && (
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to confirm setup.
                    </p>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      inputMode="numeric"
                      maxLength={6}
                      placeholder="000000"
                      value={verifyCode}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setVerifyCode(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 6))
                      }
                      className="w-full rounded-lg border border-border bg-background px-4 py-3 text-center text-2xl font-mono tracking-[0.5em] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary"
                      autoFocus
                    />
                    <Button
                      onClick={handleVerify}
                      disabled={verifyCode.length !== 6 || verifyTotp.isPending}
                      className="w-full"
                    >
                      {verifyTotp.isPending ? "Verifying..." : "Verify & Enable MFA"}
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Stage: done */}
                {stage === "done" && (
                  <div className="rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-900/20 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 p-4 space-y-2">
                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300">
                      MFA enabled successfully!
                    </p>
                    {setupData?.backupCodes && setupData.backupCodes.length > 0 && (
                      <>
                        <p className="text-xs text-emerald-700/80 dark:text-emerald-400/80">
                          Save these backup codes in a safe place. Each can only be used once.
                        </p>
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 font-mono text-xs bg-white dark:bg-black/20 rounded border p-3">
                          {setupData.backupCodes.map((code) => (
                            <span key={code} className="text-muted-foreground">
                              {code}
                            </span>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

"use client"

import { useState } from "react"
import { Button, Skeleton } from "@repo/ui"
import { DashboardSidebar } from "@/components/dashboard/dashboard-sidebar"
import {
  useTenantSettings,
  useUpdateTenantSettings,
  useUpdateSocialProvider,
} from "@/lib/queries"
import { Key, Mail, Lock, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Save } from "lucide-react"

const METHOD_FLAGS = [
  {
    key: "magicLinkEnabled",
    label: "Magic Link",
    description: "Let users sign in with a one-time link sent to their email",
    icon: Mail,
  },
  {
    key: "passkeyEnabled",
    label: "Passkey",
    description: "Let users sign in with biometrics or device PIN (WebAuthn)",
    icon: Key,
  },
]

const SOCIAL_PROVIDERS = [
  { id: "google",    label: "Google",    icon: "G" },
  { id: "github",    label: "GitHub",    icon: "GH" },
  { id: "microsoft", label: "Microsoft", icon: "M" },
]

export default function SettingsPage() {
  const { data: settings, isLoading } = useTenantSettings()
  const updateSettings = useUpdateTenantSettings()
  const updateSocial = useUpdateSocialProvider()

  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [credentials, setCredentials] = useState<Record<string, { clientId: string; clientSecret: string }>>({})

  const toggleFlag = async (key: string, current: boolean) => {
    await updateSettings.mutateAsync({ featureFlags: { [key]: !current } })
  }

  const toggleSocial = async (provider: string, current: boolean) => {
    await updateSocial.mutateAsync({ provider, enabled: !current })
  }

  const saveSocialCredentials = async (provider: string) => {
    const creds = credentials[provider]
    if (!creds) return
    await updateSocial.mutateAsync({
      provider,
      enabled: true,
      clientId: creds.clientId,
      clientSecret: creds.clientSecret || undefined,
    })
    setExpanded(null)
  }

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-screen">
        <DashboardSidebar />
        <main className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-8 space-y-6">
          <Skeleton className="h-8 w-48" />
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => <Skeleton key={i} className="h-20 rounded-xl" />)}
          </div>
        </main>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const flags = settings?.featureFlags || {}
  const socialProviders = settings?.socialProviders || []

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen bg-background overflow-hidden">
      <DashboardSidebar />
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col overflow-hidden">
        <header className="flex items-center border-b border-border bg-card px-8 py-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">Login Settings</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Control which authentication methods are available to your users
            </p>
          </div>
        </header>

        <main className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-8">
          <div className="max-w-2xl space-y-8">

            {/* Password — always on */}
            <section>
              <h2 className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">
                Core Methods
              </h2>
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-muted">
                    <Lock className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium">Password</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Always enabled — cannot be turned off</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs bg-primary/10 text-primary px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full font-medium">
                  Always on
                </span>
              </div>
            </section>

            {/* Feature flag methods */}
            <section>
              <h2 className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">
                Passwordless Methods
              </h2>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {METHOD_FLAGS.map(({ key, label, description, icon: Icon }) => {
                  const enabled = flags[key] ?? false
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={key}
                      className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-4 flex items-center justify-between"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className={`flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg ${enabled ? "bg-primary/10" : "bg-muted"}`}>
                          <Icon className={`h-4 w-4 ${enabled ? "text-primary" : "text-muted-foreground"}`} />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-sm font-medium">{label}</p>
                          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => toggleFlag(key, enabled)}
                        disabled={updateSettings.isPending}
                        className={`relative inline-flex h-6 w-11 items-center rounded-full transition-colors ${enabled ? "bg-primary" : "bg-muted-foreground/30"}`}
                      >
                        <span
                          className={`inline-block h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-transform ${enabled ? "translate-x-6" : "translate-x-1"}`}
                        />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  )
                })}
              </div>
            </section>

            {/* Social providers */}
            <section>
              <h2 className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">
                Social Providers
              </h2>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {SOCIAL_PROVIDERS.map(({ id, label, icon }) => {
                  const providerConfig = socialProviders.find((p) => p.provider === id)
                  const enabled = providerConfig?.enabled ?? false
                  const isExpanded = expanded === id

                  return (
                    <div key={id} className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card overflow-hidden">
                      <div className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <div className={`flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg font-semibold text-sm ${enabled ? "bg-primary/10 text-primary" : "bg-muted text-muted-foreground"}`}>
                            {icon}
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <p className="text-sm font-medium">{label}</p>
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                              {providerConfig?.clientId ? "Custom credentials" : "Shared app"}
                              {providerConfig?.hasSecret ? " · Secret configured" : ""}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => setExpanded(isExpanded ? null : id)}
                            className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
                          >
                            {isExpanded ? <ChevronUp className="h-4 w-4" /> : <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4" />}
                          </button>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => toggleSocial(id, enabled)}
                            disabled={updateSocial.isPending}
                            className={`relative inline-flex h-6 w-11 items-center rounded-full transition-colors ${enabled ? "bg-primary" : "bg-muted-foreground/30"}`}
                          >
                            <span
                              className={`inline-block h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-transform ${enabled ? "translate-x-6" : "translate-x-1"}`}
                            />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {isExpanded && (
                        <div className="border-t border-border p-4 bg-muted/30 space-y-3">
                          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            Optional: override with your own OAuth app credentials. Leave blank to use the shared Fort Knox app.
                          </p>
                          <div className="space-y-2">
                            <label className="text-xs font-medium">Client ID</label>
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              placeholder={providerConfig?.clientId || "Leave blank for shared app"}
                              defaultValue={providerConfig?.clientId || ""}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                setCredentials((prev) => ({
                                  ...prev,
                                  [id]: { ...prev[id], clientId: e.target.value, clientSecret: prev[id]?.clientSecret ?? "" },
                                }))
                              }
                              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-border bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary"
                            />
                          </div>
                          <div className="space-y-2">
                            <label className="text-xs font-medium">Client Secret</label>
                            <input
                              type="password"
                              placeholder={providerConfig?.hasSecret ? "••••••••••••" : "Leave blank for shared app"}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                setCredentials((prev) => ({
                                  ...prev,
                                  [id]: { ...prev[id], clientSecret: e.target.value, clientId: prev[id]?.clientId ?? "" },
                                }))
                              }
                              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-border bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary"
                            />
                          </div>
                          <Button
                            size="sm"
                            onClick={() => saveSocialCredentials(id)}
                            disabled={updateSocial.isPending}
                          >
                            <Save className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                            Save credentials
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )
                })}
              </div>
            </section>
          </div>
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Shield, Key, Smartphone, Loader2, CheckCircle, XCircle, Globe, LogOut } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@repo/ui";
import { useMfaStatus, useListPasskeys, useDeletePasskey, useActiveSessions, useRevokeSession, useRevokeAllOtherSessions } from "@/lib/queries";
import type { PasskeyCredential, ActiveSessionDto } from "@/lib/types";
import { PasskeyRegisterModal } from "@/components/auth/passkey-register-modal";
import { formatRelativeTime } from "@/lib/utils";

function formatDate(dateStr: string): string {
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
      month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric',
    }).format(new Date(dateStr));
  } catch {
    return dateStr;
  }
}

function formatRelativeTime(dateStr: string): string {
  try {
    const date = new Date(dateStr);
    const now = new Date();
    const diffMs = now.getTime() - date.getTime();
    const diffSec = Math.floor(diffMs / 1000);
    const diffMin = Math.floor(diffSec / 60);
    const diffHr = Math.floor(diffMin / 60);
    const diffDay = Math.floor(diffHr / 24);

    if (diffSec < 60) return 'Just now';
    if (diffMin < 60) return `${diffMin} minute${diffMin !== 1 ? 's' : ''} ago`;
    if (diffHr < 24) return `${diffHr} hour${diffHr !== 1 ? 's' : ''} ago`;
    if (diffDay < 30) return `${diffDay} day${diffDay !== 1 ? 's' : ''} ago`;
    return formatDate(dateStr);
  } catch {
    return dateStr;
  }
}

export default function SecuritySettingsPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { data: mfaData, isLoading: mfaLoading } = useMfaStatus();
  const { data: passkeys = [], isLoading: passkeysLoading, refetch: refetchPasskeys } = useListPasskeys();
  const { data: sessions = [], isLoading: sessionsLoading, isError: sessionsError } = useActiveSessions();
  const revokeSessionMutation = useRevokeSession();
  const revokeAllOtherMutation = useRevokeAllOtherSessions();
  const deletePasskeyMutation = useDeletePasskey();

  const [showPasskeyModal, setShowPasskeyModal] = useState(false);
  const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [revokingId, setRevokingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMsg, setSuccessMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const flash = (msg: string, isError = false) => {
    if (isError) setError(msg);
    else setSuccessMsg(msg);
    setTimeout(() => { setSuccessMsg(null); setError(null); }, 3000);
  };

  const handleRevokeSession = async (sessionId: string) => {
    try {
      setRevokingId(sessionId);
      await revokeSessionMutation.mutateAsync(sessionId);
      flash("Session revoked");
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      flash((err as Error)?.message || "Failed to revoke session", true);
    } finally {
      setRevokingId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleRevokeAllOther = async () => {
    try {
      await revokeAllOtherMutation.mutateAsync();
      flash("All other sessions revoked");
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      flash((err as Error)?.message || "Failed to revoke sessions", true);
    }
  };

  const handleDeletePasskey = async (credentialId: string) => {
    try {
      setDeletingId(credentialId);
      await deletePasskeyMutation.mutateAsync(credentialId);
      flash("Passkey removed");
    } catch (err: any) {
      flash(err?.message || "Failed to remove passkey", true);
    } finally {
      setDeletingId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleManageTotp = () => router.push("/u/mfa/setup");

  const totpEnabled = mfaData?.methods?.includes("totp") ?? false;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 max-w-2xl">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">Security</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
          Manage two-factor authentication and passkeys
        </p>
      </div>

      {successMsg && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-green-200 bg-green-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-green-700 dark:border-green-800 dark:bg-green-950 dark:text-green-300">
          <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
          {successMsg}
        </div>
      )}

      {error && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-destructive">
          <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
          {error}
          <button className="ml-auto text-xs underline" onClick={() => setError(null)}>
            Dismiss
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TOTP Section */}
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-border p-6 space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10">
            <Smartphone className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1">
            <h2 className="font-semibold text-foreground">Authenticator App (TOTP)</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Time-based one-time passwords via Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.
            </p>
          </div>
          {!mfaLoading && (
            <span
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium ${
                totpEnabled
                  ? "bg-green-100 text-green-700 dark:bg-green-900 dark:text-green-300"
                  : "bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
              }`}
            >
              <CheckCircle className="h-3 w-3" />
              {totpEnabled ? "Enabled" : "Not enabled"}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {totpEnabled
              ? "Your account is protected with an authenticator app"
              : "Add extra protection to your account"}
          </p>
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={handleManageTotp}>
            {totpEnabled ? "Manage" : "Enable"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Passkeys Section */}
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-border p-6 space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10">
            <Key className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="font-semibold text-foreground">Passkeys</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Sign in with Face ID, Touch ID, or a security key — no password needed
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {passkeysLoading ? (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {[1, 2].map((i) => (
              <div key={i} className="h-14 rounded-lg bg-muted animate-pulse" />
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : passkeys.length > 0 ? (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-border rounded-lg border border-border overflow-hidden">
            {(passkeys as PasskeyCredential[]).map((pk) => (
              <li
                key={pk.id}
                className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 bg-background"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <Shield className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                      {pk.deviceName ?? "Unknown device"}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      Added {formatDate(pk.createdAt)}
                      {" · "}
                      {pk.lastUsedAt ? `Last used ${formatRelativeTime(pk.lastUsedAt)}` : "Never used"}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <Button
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => handleDeletePasskey(pk.id)}
                  disabled={deletingId === pk.id}
                  className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive transition-colors text-xs"
                  aria-label={`Remove passkey ${pk.deviceName ?? pk.id}`}
                >
                  {deletingId === pk.id ? (
                    <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />
                  ) : (
                    "Remove"
                  )}
                </Button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground py-1">
            No passkeys registered yet.

        )}

        <Button

          Add passkey
        </Button>
      </section>

      {/* Sessions Section */}
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-border p-6 space-y-4">

"use client";

import { use, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

// ── Minimal toast ─────────────────────────────────────────────
type ToastKind = "success" | "error";
function Toast({ message, kind }: { message: string; kind: ToastKind }) {
  return (
    <div
      role="alert"
      className={`fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white shadow-lg ${
        kind === "success" ? "bg-green-600" : "bg-red-600"
      }`}
    >
      {kind === "success" ? "✓" : "✕"} {message}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function BrandingPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
}) {
  const { slug } = use(params);
  const { data: branding, isLoading } = useBranding();
  const updateBranding = useUpdateBranding();
  const uploadLogo = useUploadLogo();

  const [form, setForm] = useState<Partial<BrandingConfig>>({});
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{
    message: string;
    kind: ToastKind;
  } | null>(null);
  const logoInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // Populate form once data arrives
  useEffect(() => {
    if (branding && Object.keys(form).length === 0) {
      setForm(branding);
    }
  }, [branding]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  function showToast(message: string, kind: ToastKind) {
    setToast({ message, kind });
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 4000);
  }

  async function handleSave() {
    try {
      await updateBranding.mutateAsync(form);
      showToast("Branding saved successfully", "success");
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showToast(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to save branding",
        "error",
      );
    }
  }

  async function handleLogoChange(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    try {
      const { logoUrl } = await uploadLogo.mutateAsync(file);
      setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, logoUrl }));
      showToast("Logo uploaded", "success");
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showToast(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Logo upload failed",
        "error",
      );
    }
  }

  const isSaving = updateBranding.isPending;
  const primaryColor = form.primaryColor ?? "#6366f1";

  return (
    <PortalLayout
      tenantSlug={slug}
      pageTitle="Branding"
      pageSubtitle="Customize the look and feel of your auth screens"
      currentPath={`/t/${slug}/branding`}
      primaryAction={{
        label: isSaving ? "Saving…" : "Save Changes",
        onClick: handleSave,
      }}
    >
      {toast && <Toast message={toast.message} kind={toast.kind} />}

      <div className="space-y-6">
        {/* Logo & Colors */}
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card p-6">
          <h3 className="mb-6 text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">
            Logo &amp; Colors
          </h3>

          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="space-y-4 animate-pulse">
              <div className="h-10 rounded bg-muted" />
              <div className="h-10 rounded bg-muted" />
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
              {/* Logo */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>Logo</Label>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <Input
                    placeholder="https://example.com/logo.png"
                    value={form.logoUrl ?? ""}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setForm((p) => ({ ...p, logoUrl: e.target.value }))
                    }
                  />
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={() => logoInputRef.current?.click()}
                    disabled={uploadLogo.isPending}
                  >
                    {uploadLogo.isPending ? "Uploading…" : "Upload"}
                  </Button>
                  <input
                    ref={logoInputRef}
                    type="file"
                    accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/svg+xml"
                    className="hidden"
                    onChange={handleLogoChange}
                  />
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  PNG, JPG, or SVG · max 500 KB
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Primary Color */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="primary">Primary Color</Label>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <Input
                    id="primary"
                    type="color"
                    value={primaryColor}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setForm((p) => ({ ...p, primaryColor: e.target.value }))
                    }
                    className="h-10 w-20"
                  />
                  <Input

                    pattern="^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$"

              {/* Font Family */}
              <div className="space-y-2">

"use client";

import { PortalLayout } from "@/components/layouts/portal-layout";
import { Skeleton, Button } from "@repo/ui";
import {
  useTenantMetrics,
  useTenantActivity,
  useApiCallTrend,
} from "@/lib/queries";
import { formatDistanceToNow } from "date-fns";
import type { TrendPoint } from "@/lib/types";
import { useParams } from "next/navigation";

// ── Chart helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────

const CHART_W = 700;
const CHART_H = 200;
const CHART_PADDING = 10;

function computeChartPaths(points: TrendPoint[]): {
  line: string;
  area: string;
} {
  if (points.length === 0) {
    return { line: "", area: "" };
  }

  const maxCount = Math.max(1, ...points.map((p) => p.count));
  const n = points.length;

  const coords = points.map((p, i) => {
    const x = n === 1 ? CHART_W / 2 : (i / (n - 1)) * CHART_W;
    const y =
      CHART_PADDING + (CHART_H - CHART_PADDING * 2) * (1 - p.count / maxCount);
    return { x, y };
  });

  const lineParts = coords.map(
    (c, i) => `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"} ${c.x.toFixed(1)},${c.y.toFixed(1)}`,
  );
  const line = lineParts.join(" ");
  const area =
    line +
    ` L ${coords[coords.length - 1]!.x.toFixed(1)},${CHART_H} L ${coords[0]!.x.toFixed(1)},${CHART_H} Z`;

  return { line, area };
}

// ── Severity colour ────────────────────────────────────────────

function severityClass(severity: string) {
  if (severity === "critical")
    return "bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400";
  if (severity === "warning")
    return "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400";
  return "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400";
}

function eventInitial(eventType: string): string {
  return eventType.split(".")[0]?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() ?? "E";
}

// ── Page ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function DashboardPage() {
  const {
    data: metrics,
    isLoading: metricsLoading,
    isError: metricsError,
  } = useTenantMetrics();

  const params = useParams();

  const {
    data: activity,
    isLoading: activityLoading,
    isError: activityError,
  } = useTenantActivity(10);

  const { data: trend, isLoading: trendLoading } = useApiCallTrend(7);

  const { line: trendLine, area: trendArea } = computeChartPaths(trend ?? []);

  const stats = [
    {
      label: "Total Users",
      value: metricsLoading
        ? null
        : (metrics?.totalUsers.toLocaleString() ?? "—"),
      change: null,
    },
    {
      label: "Active Sessions",
      value: metricsLoading
        ? null
        : (metrics?.activeSessions.toLocaleString() ?? "—"),
      change: null,
    },
    {
      label: "Applications",
      value: metricsLoading
        ? null
        : (metrics?.totalApplications.toLocaleString() ?? "—"),
      change: null,
    },
    {
      label: "MFA Adoption",
      value: metricsLoading
        ? null
        : metrics != null
          ? `${Math.round(metrics.mfaAdoptionRate * 100)}%`
          : "—",
      change: null,
    },
  ];

  return (
    <PortalLayout
      tenantSlug={params.slug as string}
      pageTitle="Dashboard"
      pageSubtitle="Overview of your Fort Knox tenant"
      currentPath={`/t/${params.slug}/dashboard`}
    >
      <div className="space-y-8">
        {/* ── Stat cards ── */}
        {metricsError ? (
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-4 text-sm text-destructive">
            Failed to load metrics. Please refresh the page.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-4">
            {stats.map((stat) => (
              <div
                key={stat.label}
                className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card p-6"
              >
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{stat.label}</p>
                {stat.value === null ? (
                  <Skeleton className="mt-2 h-9 w-24 rounded" />
                ) : (
                  <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">
                    {stat.value}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ── API call trend chart ── */}
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card p-6">
          <h3 className="mb-4 text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">
            API Call Trend (last 7 days)
          </h3>
          {trendLoading ? (
            <Skeleton className="h-[200px] w-full rounded" />
          ) : (
            <svg
              viewBox={`0 0 ${CHART_W} ${CHART_H}`}
              preserveAspectRatio="none"
              className="w-full h-[200px]"
              aria-hidden="true"
            >
              <defs>
                <linearGradient id="trendGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                  <stop
                    offset="0%"
                    stopColor="rgb(99,102,241)"

              {trendArea && <path d={trendArea} fill="url(#trendGradient)" />}
              {trendLine && (

              {(!trend || trend.every((p) => p.count === 0)) && (

                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : activity && activity.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {activity.map((event) => (
                  <div
                    key={event.id}
                    className="flex gap-4 border-b border-border pb-4 last:border-0 last:pb-0"
                  >
                    <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary text-sm font-bold shrink-0">
                      {eventInitial(event.eventType)}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">

      [s.location?.city, s.location?.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ") ||
      "Unknown location",
    ipAddress: s.ipAddress ?? "Unknown",
    lastActive: formatRelativeTime(s.lastActivity),
    isCurrent: s.isCurrent,
  }));

  // Map MFA status to MFASettings method list
  const mfaMethods = mfaData
    ? [
        {
          id: "totp",
          name: "Authenticator App",
          type: "totp" as const,
          enabled: mfaData.methods.includes("totp"),
          verified: mfaData.methods.includes("totp"),
        },
        {
          id: "email-otp",
          name: "Email Code",
          type: "email-otp" as const,
          enabled:
            mfaData.methods.includes("email_otp") ||
            mfaData.methods.includes("email-otp"),
          verified:
            mfaData.methods.includes("email_otp") ||
            mfaData.methods.includes("email-otp"),
        },
        {
          id: "backup-codes",
          name: "Backup Codes",
          type: "backup-codes" as const,
          enabled: (mfaData.backupCodesRemaining ?? 0) > 0,
          verified: (mfaData.backupCodesRemaining ?? 0) > 0,
        },
        {
          id: "passkey",
          name: "Passkey",
          type: "passkey" as const,
          enabled:
            mfaData.methods.includes("passkey") ||
            mfaData.methods.includes("webauthn"),
          verified:
            mfaData.methods.includes("passkey") ||
            mfaData.methods.includes("webauthn"),
        },
      ]
    : [];

  // Map ActivityEvent → AuditEvent for AuditLogList component
  const auditEvents: AuditEvent[] = activity.map((e) => ({
    id: e.id,
    // Map eventType to closest AuditEvent type union; fall back to device_login
    type: (() => {
      if (e.eventType.includes("mfa")) return "mfa_challenge" as const;
      if (e.eventType.includes("passkey")) return "passkey_used" as const;
      if (e.eventType.includes("password")) return "password_changed" as const;
      if (e.eventType.includes("revoke")) return "token_revoked" as const;
      if (e.eventType.includes("magic_link")) return "magic_link_sent" as const;
      return "device_login" as const;
    })(),
    title: formatEventDescription(e.eventType),
    description: formatEventDescription(e.eventType),
    timestamp: formatRelativeTime(e.createdAt),
    location: e.location ?? "Unknown",
    ipAddress: e.ipAddress ?? "Unknown",
    device: "Unknown",
    status: (() => {
      if (e.severity === "critical") return "suspicious" as const;
      if (e.eventType.includes("failed") || e.eventType.includes("locked"))
        return "failed" as const;
      return "success" as const;
    })(),
  }));

  const handleRemoveDevice = (deviceId: string) => {
    setRemovedDevices([...removedDevices, deviceId]);
  };

  const handleRevokeSession = (sessionId: string) => {
    revokeSessionMutation.mutate(sessionId);
  };

  const handleRevokeAllSessions = () => {
    revokeAllOtherMutation.mutate();
  };

  const activeTrustedDevices = TRUSTED_DEVICES.filter(
    (d) => !removedDevices.includes(d.id),
  );

  return (
    <PortalLayout
      tenantSlug={params.slug}
      pageTitle="Security"
      pageSubtitle="Manage your account security and authentication methods"
      currentPath={`/t/${params.slug}/security`}
      primaryAction={{
        label: "Save Settings",
        onClick: () => console.log("Save security"),
      }}
    >
      <div className="space-y-8">
        {/* Multi-Factor Authentication */}
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-4">
            Multi-Factor Authentication
          </h3>
          {mfaLoading ? (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
                <div
                  key={i}
                  className="h-16 rounded-lg bg-muted animate-pulse"
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : mfaData ? (
            <MFASettings
              methods={mfaMethods}
              primaryColor="#6366f1"
              onToggle={(methodId, enabled) =>
                console.log("Toggle MFA:", { methodId, enabled })
              }
              onRegenerateCodes={() => console.log("Regenerate backup codes")}
            />
          ) : (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Failed to load MFA settings.
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Trusted Devices */}
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-4">Trusted Devices</h3>
          {activeTrustedDevices.length > 0 ? (

              {activeTrustedDevices.map((device) => (

          ) : sessions.length === 0 ? (

"use client"

import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation"
import { useAuth } from "@fortknox/sdk"

export default function AuthCallbackPage() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()
  const { claimSocialSession } = useAuth()
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    const ct = searchParams.get("ct")
    const errorParam = searchParams.get("error")

    if (errorParam) {
      setError(decodeURIComponent(errorParam))
      return
    }

    if (!ct) {
      setError("Missing completion token")
      return
    }

    claimSocialSession(ct)
      .then(() => router.replace("/dashboard"))
      .catch((err) => setError(err?.message || "Authentication failed"))
  }, []) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center">
        <div className="text-center space-y-4 max-w-sm">
          <p className="text-destructive font-medium">Authentication failed</p>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{error}</p>
          <a href="/u/login" className="text-primary text-sm underline">
            Back to sign in
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center">
      <div className="text-center space-y-3">
        <div className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent mx-auto" />
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Completing sign in...</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { StepBasedAuthFlow } from "@/components/auth/step-based-auth-flow";
import { UniversalAuthLayout } from "@/components/layouts/universal-auth-layout";
import { useAuth } from "@fortknox/sdk";
import type { BrandingConfig } from "@/lib/types";
import { authClient } from "@/app/layout";

const DEFAULT_BRANDING: BrandingConfig = {
  primaryColor: "#6366f1",
  fontFamily: "Inter",
  headerWeight: "bold",
  backgroundStyle: "solid",
};

async function fetchPublicBranding(slug: string): Promise<BrandingConfig> {
  const url = `${authClient.getBaseURL()}/tenants/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/branding/public`;
  const res = await fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" });
  if (!res.ok) return DEFAULT_BRANDING;
  const json = await res.json();
  return (json?.data ?? json) as BrandingConfig;
}

export default function LoginPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const tenantSlug = searchParams.get("tenant") ?? null;
  const { user, isLoading } = useAuth();

  const [branding, setBranding] = useState<BrandingConfig>(DEFAULT_BRANDING);
  const [brandingLoaded, setBrandingLoaded] = useState(false);

  // Fetch tenant branding (client-side, public endpoint – no auth needed)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!tenantSlug) {
      setBrandingLoaded(true);
      return;
    }
    fetchPublicBranding(tenantSlug)
      .then((b) => {
        setBranding(b ?? DEFAULT_BRANDING);
      })
      .catch(() => setBranding(DEFAULT_BRANDING))
      .finally(() => setBrandingLoaded(true));
  }, [tenantSlug]);

  // Apply branding as CSS custom properties on <html> so all child components
  // can reference var(--brand-primary), var(--brand-font), etc.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.style.setProperty("--brand-primary", branding.primaryColor);
    root.style.setProperty("--brand-font", branding.fontFamily);
    root.style.setProperty(
      "--brand-header-weight",
      branding.headerWeight === "bold" ? "700" : "400",
    );
    return () => {
      root.style.removeProperty("--brand-primary");
      root.style.removeProperty("--brand-font");
      root.style.removeProperty("--brand-header-weight");
    };
  }, [branding]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoading && user) {
      router.replace("/dashboard");
    }
  }, [user, isLoading, router]);

  if (isLoading || !brandingLoaded) {
    return (
      <UniversalAuthLayout
        heroTitle="Welcome back"
        heroSubtitle="Sign in to continue"
        primaryColor={branding.primaryColor}
        fontFamily={branding.fontFamily}
        backgroundStyle={branding.backgroundStyle}
      >
        <div className="space-y-4 animate-pulse">
          <div className="h-10 bg-muted rounded-lg" />
          <div className="h-10 bg-muted rounded-lg" />
          <div className="h-10 bg-muted rounded-lg" />
        </div>
      </UniversalAuthLayout>
    );
  }

  if (user) return null; // redirect in progress

  return (
    <UniversalAuthLayout
      heroTitle="Welcome back"
      heroSubtitle="Sign in to continue"
      primaryColor={branding.primaryColor}
      logoUrl={branding.logoUrl}
      fontFamily={branding.fontFamily}
      backgroundStyle={branding.backgroundStyle}
    >
      <StepBasedAuthFlow primaryColor={branding.primaryColor} />
    </UniversalAuthLayout>
  );
}

"use client"

import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation"
import { useAuth } from "@fortknox/sdk"

export default function MagicLinkPage() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()
  const { verifyMagicLink } = useAuth()
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<"verifying" | "success" | "error">("verifying")
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState("")

  useEffect(() => {
    const token = searchParams.get("token")

    if (!token) {
      setStatus("error")
      setErrorMsg("Missing token in link")
      return
    }

    verifyMagicLink(token)
      .then(() => {
        setStatus("success")
        setTimeout(() => router.replace("/dashboard"), 1500)
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        setStatus("error")
        setErrorMsg(err?.message || "This magic link has expired or already been used.")
      })
  }, []) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center">
      <div className="text-center space-y-4 max-w-sm px-4">
        {status === "verifying" && (
          <>
            <div className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent mx-auto" />
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Signing you in...</p>
          </>
        )}

        {status === "success" && (
          <>
            <div className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-900/30 mx-auto">
              <svg className="h-7 w-7 text-green-600" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <p className="font-medium">Signed in successfully!</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Redirecting to your dashboard...</p>
          </>
        )}

        {status === "error" && (
          <>
            <div className="rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-4">
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-destructive">Link invalid or expired</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">{errorMsg}</p>
            </div>
            <a href="/u/login" className="text-primary text-sm underline block">
              Request a new magic link
            </a>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: apps/admin-portal/app/u/mfa/page.tsx

"use client"

import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from "react"
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation"
import { motion } from "framer-motion"
import { Button } from "@repo/ui"
import { UniversalAuthLayout } from "@/components/layouts/universal-auth-layout"
import { useAuth } from "@fortknox/sdk"
import { ShieldCheck, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react"

export default function MFAPage() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const { verifyMfaLogin } = useAuth()
  const [digits, setDigits] = useState<string[]>(["", "", "", "", "", ""])
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const inputRefs = useRef<Array<HTMLInputElement | null>>([])

  const code = digits.join("")

  const handleChange = (index: number, value: string) => {
    // Handle paste of full code
    if (value.length > 1) {
      const cleaned = value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 6)
      const next = [...digits]
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) next[i] = cleaned[i] ?? ""
      setDigits(next)
      inputRefs.current[Math.min(cleaned.length, 5)]?.focus()
      return
    }
    const digit = value.replace(/\D/g, "")
    const next = [...digits]
    next[index] = digit
    setDigits(next)
    if (digit && index < 5) inputRefs.current[index + 1]?.focus()
  }

  const handleKeyDown = (index: number, e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "Backspace" && !digits[index] && index > 0) {
      inputRefs.current[index - 1]?.focus()
    }
  }

  const handleSubmit = useCallback(async () => {
    if (code.length !== 6 || loading) return
    const tempToken = sessionStorage.getItem("_fk_mfa_temp_token")
    if (!tempToken) {
      setError("Session expired. Please sign in again.")
      return
    }
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)
    try {
      await verifyMfaLogin(tempToken, code)
      sessionStorage.removeItem("_fk_mfa_temp_token")
      router.push("/dashboard")
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.message || "Invalid code. Please try again.")
      setDigits(["", "", "", "", "", ""])
      inputRefs.current[0]?.focus()
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }, [code, loading, verifyMfaLogin, router])

  // Auto-submit when all 6 digits are filled
  useEffect(() => {
    if (code.length === 6) handleSubmit()
  }, [code, handleSubmit])

  return (
    <UniversalAuthLayout
      heroTitle="Two-factor authentication"
      heroSubtitle="Secure your account with a second factor"
      primaryColor="#6366f1"
    >
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">Verify your identity</h2>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/30 p-4">
          <ShieldCheck className="h-5 w-5 text-primary shrink-0" />
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-medium">Authenticator App</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Use an app like Google Authenticator or Authy</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* 6-box OTP input */}
          <div className="flex gap-2 justify-center">
            {digits.map((digit, i) => (
              <motion.input
                key={i}
                ref={(el) => { inputRefs.current[i] = el }}
                type="text"
                inputMode="numeric"
                maxLength={6}
                value={digit}
                onChange={(e) => handleChange(i, e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => handleKeyDown(i, e)}
                onFocus={(e) => e.target.select()}
                disabled={loading}
                initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }}
                animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
                transition={{ delay: i * 0.04 }}
                className={`
                  h-14 w-12 rounded-xl border text-center text-xl font-semibold
                  bg-background transition-all outline-none
                  ${digit ? "border-primary text-foreground" : "border-border text-muted-foreground"}
                  ${loading ? "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed" : "focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20"}
                `}
              />
            ))}
          </div>

          {error && (
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -6 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-destructive"
            >
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
              {error}
            </motion.div>
          )}

          <Button
            className="w-full"
            disabled={code.length !== 6 || loading}
            style={{ backgroundColor: "#6366f1" }}
            onClick={handleSubmit}
          >
            {loading ? "Verifying..." : "Verify"}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Wrong account?{" "}
          <a href="/u/login" className="text-primary hover:underline">
            Back to login
          </a>
        </p>
      </div>
    </UniversalAuthLayout>
  )
}

"use client"

import { ResetPasswordForm } from "@/components/auth/reset-password-form"
import { UniversalAuthLayout } from "@/components/layouts/universal-auth-layout"

export default function ResetPasswordPage() {
  return (
    <UniversalAuthLayout

FILE: apps/admin-portal/components/auth/advanced-mfa-challenge.tsx
