"use client"

import type React from "react"

import { useState, useEffect } from "react"
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion"
import { Button, Input, Label, Card, Alert, AlertDescription } from "@repo/ui"
import { MFAMethodSelector } from "./mfa-method-selector"
import { AlertCircle, Clock } from "lucide-react"
import type { MFAMethod } from "../../lib/auth-config"

interface AdvancedMFAChallengeProps {
  availableMethods: MFAMethod[]
  onSubmit?: (methodId: string, code: string) => void
  onMethodChange?: (methodId: string) => void
  primaryColor?: string
  maxAttempts?: number
}

export function AdvancedMFAChallenge({
  availableMethods,
  onSubmit,
  onMethodChange,
  primaryColor = "#6366f1",
  maxAttempts = 5,
}: AdvancedMFAChallengeProps) {
  const [selectedMethod, setSelectedMethod] = useState(availableMethods[0]?.id)
  const [code, setCode] = useState("")
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [attempts, setAttempts] = useState(0)
  const [showMethodSelector, setShowMethodSelector] = useState(false)
  const [resendCountdown, setResendCountdown] = useState(0)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (resendCountdown > 0) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setResendCountdown(resendCountdown - 1), 1000)
      return () => clearTimeout(timer)
    }
  }, [resendCountdown])

  const currentMethod = availableMethods.find((m) => m.id === selectedMethod)
  const remainingAttempts = maxAttempts - attempts
  const isLocked = remainingAttempts <= 0

  const handleMethodSelect = (methodId: string) => {
    setSelectedMethod(methodId)
    setCode("")
    setShowMethodSelector(false)
    if (onMethodChange) {
      onMethodChange(methodId)
    }
  }

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!selectedMethod || code.length < 6 || isLocked) return

    setLoading(true)
    try {
      if (onSubmit) {
        await onSubmit(selectedMethod, code)
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
      setAttempts(attempts + 1)
    }
  }

  const handleResend = () => {
    setResendCountdown(30)
    setCode("")
  }

  if (isLocked) {
    return (
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
      >
        <Alert variant="destructive" className="bg-destructive/10 border-destructive/30">
          <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
          <AlertDescription>Too many failed attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      </motion.div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
        {!showMethodSelector ? (
          <motion.div
            key="challenge"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
            className="space-y-6"
          >
            <Card className="p-4 bg-muted/30 border-0">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium">{currentMethod?.name}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{currentMethod?.description}</p>
                </div>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setShowMethodSelector(true)}
                  className="text-xs"
                >
                  Change method
                </Button>
              </div>
            </Card>

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="mfa-code">
                  {currentMethod?.type === "time-based-otp"
                    ? "6-digit code"
                    : currentMethod?.type === "email-otp"
                      ? "Email code"
                      : "Code"}
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="mfa-code"
                  type="text"
                  inputMode="numeric"
                  placeholder="000000"
                  value={code}
                  onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 6))}
                  maxLength={6}
                  disabled={loading}
                  className="text-center text-3xl tracking-widest font-mono"
                  autoFocus
                />
              </div>

              {attempts > 0 && (
                <motion.div
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  className="text-xs text-muted-foreground"
                >
                  Attempt {attempts} of {maxAttempts}
                </motion.div>
              )}

              <Button
                type="submit"
                className="w-full"
                disabled={loading || code.length !== 6}
                style={primaryColor ? { backgroundColor: primaryColor } : undefined}
              >
                {loading ? "Verifying..." : "Verify"}
              </Button>
            </form>

            {/* Resend / Remember device options */}
            {currentMethod?.type === "email-otp" && (
              <motion.div
                initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
                transition={{ delay: 0.3, duration: 0.3 }}
                className="text-center"
              >
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={handleResend}
                  disabled={resendCountdown > 0}
                  className="text-xs"
                >
                  {resendCountdown > 0 ? (
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Clock className="h-3 w-3" />
                      Resend in {resendCountdown}s
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    "Resend code"
                  )}
                </Button>
              </motion.div>
            )}

            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm cursor-pointer">
              <input type="checkbox" defaultChecked className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Remember this device for 30 days</span>
            </label>
          </motion.div>
        ) : (
          <motion.div
            key="selector"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
            className="space-y-4"
          >
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-medium mb-4">Choose verification method</h3>
              <MFAMethodSelector
                methods={availableMethods}
                selectedMethod={selectedMethod}
                onSelect={handleMethodSelect}
                primaryColor={primaryColor}
              />
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  )
}

import type React from "react"

import { useState } from "react"
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion"

interface CredentialsStepProps {
  email: string
  method: string
  onSubmit: (email: string, password?: string) => Promise<void>
  onBack: () => void
  loading?: boolean
  error?: string | null
  passwordPolicy?: PasswordPolicy
  primaryColor?: string
}

function MagicLinkFormWrapper({ email, primaryColor }: { email: string; primaryColor: string }) {
  const { sendMagicLink } = useAuth()
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<"request" | "sent" | "expired">("request")

  const handleSubmit = async (inputEmail: string) => {
    await sendMagicLink(inputEmail)
    setStage("sent")
  }

  const handleResend = async () => {
    await sendMagicLink(email)
  }

  return (
    <MagicLinkForm
      stage={stage}
      email={email}
      onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      onResend={handleResend}
      primaryColor={primaryColor}
    />
  )
}

export function CredentialsStep({
  email,
  method,
  onSubmit,
  onBack,
  loading = false,
  error,
  passwordPolicy,
  primaryColor = "#6366f1",
}: CredentialsStepProps) {
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("")
  const { initiateSocialLogin } = useAuth()

  const handlePasswordSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    await onSubmit(email, password)
  }

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
      className="space-y-6"
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
            {method === "password" ? "Enter password" : method === "magicLink" ? "Magic link" : "Use passkey"}
          </h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{email}</p>
        </div>
        <motion.button
          type="button"
          onClick={onBack}
          disabled={loading}
          className="text-xs text-primary hover:underline disabled:opacity-50"
          whileHover={{ scale: 1.05 }}
          whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
        >
          Change method
        </motion.button>
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
        {method === "password" && (
          <motion.form
            key="password"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
            onSubmit={handlePasswordSubmit}
            className="space-y-6"
          >
            <EnhancedPasswordInput
              value={password}
              onChange={setPassword}
              policy={passwordPolicy}
              primaryColor={primaryColor}
              showStrength={false}
              required
            />

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                <input type="checkbox" className="w-4 h-4" defaultChecked />
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Remember this device</span>
              </label>
              <a href="/u/reset-password" className="text-primary hover:underline">
                Forgot password?
              </a>
            </div>

            <Button
              type="submit"
              className="w-full"
              disabled={loading || !password}
              style={primaryColor ? { backgroundColor: primaryColor } : undefined}
            >
              {loading ? "Signing in..." : "Sign in"}
            </Button>
          </motion.form>
        )}

        {method === "magicLink" && (
          <motion.div
            key="magicLink"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
          >
            <MagicLinkFormWrapper email={email} primaryColor={primaryColor} />
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {method === "passkey" && (
          <motion.div
            key="passkey"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}

          >
            <div className="p-4 rounded-lg bg-muted/50 border border-muted text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Use your registered passkey (fingerprint, face ID, or device PIN) to sign in
            </div>

            <PasskeyLoginButton email={email} primaryColor={primaryColor} />
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {method.startsWith("social-") && (
          <motion.div
            key="social"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}

            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}

"use client"

import { useState } from "react"
import { motion } from "framer-motion"
import { Input, Label } from "@repo/ui"
import { Eye, EyeOff, CheckCircle2, Circle } from "lucide-react"

interface EnhancedPasswordInputProps {
  label?: string
  placeholder?: string
  value: string
  onChange: (value: string) => void
  error?: string
  required?: boolean
  showStrength?: boolean
  policy?: {
    minLength?: number
    requireUppercase?: boolean
    requireNumbers?: boolean
    requireSpecialChars?: boolean
  }
  primaryColor?: string
}

export function EnhancedPasswordInput({
  label = "Password",
  placeholder = "Enter password",
  value,
  onChange,
  error,
  required,
  showStrength = true,
  policy = {
    minLength: 8,
    requireUppercase: true,
    requireNumbers: true,
    requireSpecialChars: true,
  },
  primaryColor = "#6366f1",
}: EnhancedPasswordInputProps) {
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false)

  const getStrength = () => {
    let strength = 0
    if (value.length >= (policy.minLength || 8)) strength++
    if (policy.requireUppercase && /[A-Z]/.test(value)) strength++
    if (policy.requireNumbers && /\d/.test(value)) strength++
    if (policy.requireSpecialChars && /[^a-zA-Z\d]/.test(value)) strength++
    return strength
  }

  const validatePolicy = () => {
    const checks = {
      length: value.length >= (policy.minLength || 8),
      uppercase: !policy.requireUppercase || /[A-Z]/.test(value),
      numbers: !policy.requireNumbers || /\d/.test(value),
      special: !policy.requireSpecialChars || /[^a-zA-Z\d]/.test(value),
    }
    return checks
  }

  const strength = getStrength()
  const checks = validatePolicy()
  const strengthLabels = ["Weak", "Fair", "Good", "Strong", "Very Strong"]
  const strengthColors = ["bg-red-500", "bg-yellow-500", "bg-blue-500", "bg-green-500", "bg-emerald-500"]

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <Label>{label}</Label>
        <motion.button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setShow(!show)}
          className="h-auto p-0 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
          whileHover={{ scale: 1.05 }}
          whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
        >
          {show ? (
            <motion.div
              key="hide"
              initial={{ opacity: 0, rotate: -180 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, rotate: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, rotate: 180 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
            >
              <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" />
            </motion.div>
          ) : (
            <motion.div
              key="show"
              initial={{ opacity: 0, rotate: -180 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, rotate: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, rotate: 180 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
            >
              <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </motion.button>
      </div>

      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -4 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}>
        <Input
          type={show ? "text" : "password"}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          value={value}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
          required={required}
          className={error ? "border-destructive" : ""}
        />
      </motion.div>

      {showStrength && value && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, height: "auto" }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
          className="space-y-2"
        >
          <div className="flex gap-1">
            {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
              <motion.div
                key={i}
                className={`h-1.5 flex-1 rounded-full transition-colors ${
                  i <= strength ? strengthColors[strength - 1] : "bg-muted"
                }`}
                initial={{ scaleX: 0 }}
                animate={{ scaleX: 1 }}
                transition={{ delay: i * 0.05, duration: 0.3 }}
              />
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Strength:{" "}
              <span className={`font-semibold text-${strength > 2 ? "green" : strength > 1 ? "yellow" : "red"}-500`}>
                {strengthLabels[strength - 1]}
              </span>
            </p>
          </div>

          {policy && (
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -4 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.3, delay: 0.1 }}
              className="space-y-1 rounded-md bg-muted/30 p-3"
            >
              {policy.minLength && (
                <PolicyCheck met={checks.length} label={`At least ${policy.minLength} characters`} />
              )}
              {policy.requireUppercase && <PolicyCheck met={checks.uppercase} label="One uppercase letter" />}
              {policy.requireNumbers && <PolicyCheck met={checks.numbers} label="One number" />}
              {policy.requireSpecialChars && <PolicyCheck met={checks.special} label="One special character" />}
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </motion.div>
      )}

      {error && (
        <motion.p
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -4 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
          className="text-sm text-destructive"
        >
          {error}
        </motion.p>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

interface PolicyCheckProps {
  met: boolean
  label: string
}

function PolicyCheck({ met, label }: PolicyCheckProps) {
  return (
    <motion.div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs" initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }}>
      <motion.div
        initial={{ scale: 0 }}
        animate={{ scale: 1 }}
        transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 400, damping: 40 }}
      >
        {met ? (
          <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-green-500" />
        ) : (
          <Circle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
        )}
      </motion.div>
      <span className={met ? "text-muted-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground"}>{label}</span>
    </motion.div>
  )
}

FILE: apps/admin-portal/components/auth/login-form.tsx
SIZE: 5 KB | LINES: 112
================================================================================

"use client"

import type React from "react"

import { useState } from "react"

"use client"

import type React from "react"

import { useState } from "react"
import { motion } from "framer-motion"
import { Button, Input, Label } from "@repo/ui"
import { Mail, ArrowRight, CheckCircle } from "lucide-react"

interface MagicLinkFormProps {
  stage?: "request" | "sent" | "expired"
  email?: string
  onSubmit?: (email: string) => void
  onResend?: () => void
  primaryColor?: string
}

export function MagicLinkForm({
  stage = "request",
  email = "",
  onSubmit,
  onResend,
  primaryColor = "#6366f1",
}: MagicLinkFormProps) {
  const [inputEmail, setInputEmail] = useState(email)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [resendCount, setResendCount] = useState(0)

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      if (onSubmit) {
        await onSubmit(inputEmail)
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleResend = async () => {
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      if (onResend) {
        await onResend()
      }
      setResendCount(resendCount + 1)
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  if (stage === "sent") {
    return (
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
        className="space-y-6"
      >
        <div className="flex justify-center">
          <motion.div
            initial={{ scale: 0 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 200, damping: 20 }}
          >
            <div className="flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-900/30">
              <CheckCircle className="h-8 w-8 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400" />
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-2 text-center">
          <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">Check your email</h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            We've sent a magic link to <strong>{inputEmail}</strong>. Click the link to sign in.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-lg bg-muted/50 p-4 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Link expires in 15 minutes
        </div>

        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
          transition={{ delay: 0.3, duration: 0.3 }}
          className="space-y-2"
        >
          <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">Didn't receive it?</p>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={handleResend}
            disabled={loading || resendCount >= 3}
            className="w-full"
          >
            {loading ? "Sending..." : "Resend link"}
          </Button>
        </motion.div>

        <Button variant="ghost" className="w-full">
          Back to sign in
        </Button>
      </motion.div>
    )
  }

  if (stage === "expired") {
    return (
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
        className="space-y-6"
      >
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-4 text-center">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-destructive">Link expired</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">The magic link has expired. Please request a new one.</p>
        </div>

        <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => {}} className="w-full">
          Request new link
        </Button>

        <Button variant="ghost" className="w-full">
          Back to sign in
        </Button>
      </motion.div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="magic-email">Email address</Label>
        <div className="relative">
          <Mail className="absolute left-3 top-3 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground pointer-events-none" />
          <Input
            id="magic-email"
            type="email"
            placeholder="you@example.com"
            value={inputEmail}
            onChange={(e) => setInputEmail(e.target.value)}
            required
            className="pl-10"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <Button
        type="submit"
        className="w-full group"
        disabled={loading}
        style={primaryColor ? { backgroundColor: primaryColor } : undefined}
      >
        {loading ? "Sending..." : "Send magic link"}
        <motion.div animate={{ x: loading ? 0 : 4 }} transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}>
          <ArrowRight className="ml-2 h-4 w-4" />
        </motion.div>
      </Button>

      <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        We'll send you a secure link to sign in. No password needed.
      </p>
    </form>
  )
}

"use client"

import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion"
import { Card } from "@repo/ui"
import { Lock, Mail, Fingerprint, Chrome } from "lucide-react"
import type { LoginIntentResponse } from "@/hooks/use-email-auth-flow"

interface MethodSelectionStepProps {
  loginIntent: LoginIntentResponse
  onSelectMethod: (method: string) => void
  onChangeEmail: () => void
  loading?: boolean
  primaryColor?: string
}

export function MethodSelectionStep({
  loginIntent,
  onSelectMethod,
  onChangeEmail,
  loading = false,
  primaryColor = "#6366f1",
}: MethodSelectionStepProps) {
  const { methods, preferredMethod, branding } = loginIntent

  const methodOptions = [
    {
      id: "password",
      label: "Password",
      description: "Sign in with your password",
      icon: Lock,
      enabled: methods.password,
    },
    {
      id: "magicLink",
      label: "Magic Link",
      description: "We'll send you a link",
      icon: Mail,
      enabled: methods.magicLink,
    },
    {
      id: "passkey",
      label: "Passkey",
      description: "Use your fingerprint or face",
      icon: Fingerprint,
      enabled: methods.passkey,
    },
  ]

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
      className="space-y-6"
    >
      <div className="space-y-1">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">Welcome back</h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{loginIntent.email}</p>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-3">
        <AnimatePresence>
          {methodOptions.map((option, index) => {
            if (!option.enabled) return null

            const Icon = option.icon
            const isPreferred = option.id === preferredMethod

            return (
              <motion.div
                key={option.id}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
                transition={{ delay: index * 0.05, duration: 0.3 }}
              >
                <button onClick={() => onSelectMethod(option.id)} disabled={loading} className="w-full text-left">
                  <Card
                    className={`p-4 cursor-pointer transition-all border-2 ${
                      isPreferred ? "ring-2 ring-offset-2 dark:ring-offset-slate-950" : "hover:border-primary/50"
                    }`}
                    style={
                      isPreferred
                        ? {
                            borderColor: primaryColor,
                            backgroundColor: `${primaryColor}08`,
                          }
                        : {}
                    }
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <Icon className="h-5 w-5" style={isPreferred ? { color: primaryColor } : {}} />
                        <div>
                          <p className="font-medium text-foreground">{option.label}</p>
                          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{option.description}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      {isPreferred && (
                        <motion.div
                          initial={{ scale: 0 }}
                          animate={{ scale: 1 }}
                          transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 400, damping: 30 }}
                          className="text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-white"
                          style={{ backgroundColor: primaryColor }}
                        >
                          Recommended
                        </motion.div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </Card>
                </button>
              </motion.div>
            )
          })}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </div>

      {methods.social && methods.social.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <div className="relative">
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center">
              <div className="w-full border-t border-border" />
            </div>
            <div className="relative flex justify-center text-xs uppercase">
              <span className="bg-background px-2 text-muted-foreground">Or continue with</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {methods.social.map((provider) => (
              <motion.button
                key={provider}
                type="button"
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }}
                whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}
                onClick={() => onSelectMethod(`social-${provider}`)}
                disabled={loading}
                className="border border-border rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors hover:bg-muted disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <Chrome className="inline h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                {provider === "google" ? "Google" : provider === "github" ? "GitHub" : provider}
              </motion.button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      <motion.button
        type="button"
        onClick={onChangeEmail}
        disabled={loading}
        className="w-full text-sm text-primary hover:underline disabled:opacity-50"
        initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
        transition={{ delay: 0.3 }}
      >
        Use a different email
      </motion.button>
    </motion.div>
  )
}

"use client"

import type React from "react"

import { useState } from "react"
import { Button, Input, Label } from "@repo/ui"


interface MFAChallengeProps {
  method: "sms" | "email" | "totp"
  onSubmit?: (code: string) => void
  onResend?: () => void
  primaryColor?: string
}

export function MFAChallenge({ method, onSubmit, onResend, primaryColor }: MFAChallengeProps) {
  const [code, setCode] = useState("")
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      if (onSubmit) {
        await onSubmit(code)
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const methodLabels = {
    sms: "SMS code",
    email: "Email code",
    totp: "Authenticator code",
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="code">{methodLabels[method]}</Label>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {method === "sms" && "We sent a code to your phone"}
          {method === "email" && "We sent a code to your email"}
          {method === "totp" && "Enter the code from your authenticator app"}
        </p>
        <Input
          id="code"
          type="text"
          placeholder="000000"
          value={code}
          onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 6))}
          required
          maxLength={6}
          className="text-center text-2xl tracking-widest"
        />
      </div>

      <Button
        type="submit"
        className="w-full"
        disabled={loading || code.length !== 6}
        style={primaryColor ? { backgroundColor: primaryColor } : undefined}
      >
        {loading ? "Verifying..." : "Verify"}
      </Button>

      <div className="text-center">
        <button type="button" onClick={onResend} className="text-sm text-primary hover:underline">
          Didn't receive the code? Resend
        </button>
      </div>
    </form>
  )
}

"use client"

import { motion } from "framer-motion"
import { Card } from "@repo/ui"
import { Smartphone, Mail, Key, Shield } from "lucide-react"
import type { MFAMethod } from "../../lib/auth-config"

interface MFAMethodSelectorProps {
  methods: MFAMethod[]
  selectedMethod?: string
  onSelect: (methodId: string) => void
  primaryColor?: string
}

export function MFAMethodSelector({
  methods,
  selectedMethod,
  onSelect,
  primaryColor = "#6366f1",
}: MFAMethodSelectorProps) {
  const getIcon = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case "time-based-otp":
        return <Smartphone className="h-6 w-6" />
      case "email-otp":
        return <Mail className="h-6 w-6" />
      case "backup-codes":
        return <Key className="h-6 w-6" />
      case "passkey":
        return <Shield className="h-6 w-6" />
      default:
        return null
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="grid gap-3">
        {methods.map((method, index) => (
          <motion.div
            key={method.id}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            transition={{ delay: index * 0.05, duration: 0.3 }}
          >
            <button type="button" onClick={() => onSelect(method.id)} className="w-full">
              <Card
                className={`p-4 cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                  selectedMethod === method.id ? "ring-2 bg-primary/5 dark:bg-primary/10" : "hover:border-primary/50"
                }`}
                style={selectedMethod === method.id ? { borderColor: primaryColor } : {}}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div
                    className="rounded-lg p-2"
                    style={selectedMethod === method.id ? { backgroundColor: `${primaryColor}20` } : {}}
                  >
                    <div style={selectedMethod === method.id ? { color: primaryColor } : {}}>
                      {getIcon(method.type)}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 text-left">
                    <p className="font-medium text-sm">{method.name}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{method.description}</p>
                  </div>
                  <motion.div initial={false} animate={selectedMethod === method.id ? { scale: 1 } : { scale: 0 }}>
                    <div className="rounded-full w-5 h-5" style={{ backgroundColor: primaryColor }} />
                  </motion.div>
                </div>
              </Card>
            </button>
          </motion.div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

"use client"

import type React from "react"

import { MagicLinkForm } from "./magic-link-form"
import { PasskeyLoginButton } from "./passkey-login-button"
import type { LoginOption, PasswordPolicy } from "../../lib/auth-config"

interface MultiOptionLoginProps {
  loginOptions: LoginOption[]
  onEmailPasswordSubmit?: (email: string, password: string) => void
  onMagicLinkSubmit?: (email: string) => void
  onPasskeySubmit?: (credential: any) => void
  onSocialClick?: (provider: string) => void
  passwordPolicy?: PasswordPolicy
  primaryColor?: string
}

export function MultiOptionLogin({
  loginOptions,
  onEmailPasswordSubmit,
  onMagicLinkSubmit,
  onPasskeySubmit,
  onSocialClick,
  passwordPolicy,
  primaryColor = "#6366f1",
}: MultiOptionLoginProps) {
  const [selectedMethod, setSelectedMethod] = useState<string | null>(loginOptions[0]?.id || null)
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("")
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("")
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  const currentMethod = loginOptions.find((opt) => opt.id === selectedMethod)

  const handleEmailPasswordSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      if (onEmailPasswordSubmit) {
        await onEmailPasswordSubmit(email, password)
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleMagicLinkSubmit = async (magicEmail: string) => {
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      if (onMagicLinkSubmit) {
        await onMagicLinkSubmit(magicEmail)
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Login method selector - only show if multiple options */}
      {loginOptions.length > 1 && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
          className="grid gap-2"
        >
          {loginOptions.map((option) => (
            <button
              key={option.id}
              onClick={() => {
                setSelectedMethod(option.id)
                setEmail("")
                setPassword("")
              }}
              type="button"
              className="w-full"
            >
              <Card
                className={`p-3 cursor-pointer transition-all text-left ${
                  selectedMethod === option.id ? "ring-2 bg-primary/5 dark:bg-primary/10" : "hover:border-primary/50"
                }`}
                style={selectedMethod === option.id ? {  borderColor: primaryColor } : {}}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium">{option.label}</p>
                  <motion.div
                    initial={false}
                    animate={selectedMethod === option.id ? { scale: 1, opacity: 1 } : { scale: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                    transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 300, damping: 30 }}
                    className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full"
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor: selectedMethod === option.id ? primaryColor : "transparent",
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
              </Card>
            </button>
          ))}
        </motion.div>
      )}

      {/* Content based on selected method */}
      <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
        {selectedMethod === "email-password" && (
          <motion.form
            key="email-password"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
            onSubmit={handleEmailPasswordSubmit}
            className="space-y-6"
          >
            <EmailInput value={email} onChange={setEmail} required />

            <EnhancedPasswordInput
              value={password}
              onChange={setPassword}
              policy={passwordPolicy}
              primaryColor={primaryColor}
              required
            />

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                <input type="checkbox" className="w-4 h-4" defaultChecked />
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Remember this device</span>
              </label>
              <a href="/u/reset-password" className="text-primary hover:underline">
                Forgot password?
              </a>
            </div>

            <Button
              type="submit"
              className="w-full"
              disabled={loading}
              style={primaryColor ? { backgroundColor: primaryColor } : undefined}
            >
              {loading ? "Signing in..." : "Sign in"}
            </Button>
          </motion.form>
        )}

        {selectedMethod === "magic-link" && (
          <motion.div
            key="magic-link"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
          >
            <MagicLinkForm email={email} onSubmit={handleMagicLinkSubmit} primaryColor={primaryColor} />
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {selectedMethod === "passkey" && (
          <motion.div
            key="passkey"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
            className="space-y-6"
          >
            <div className="p-4 rounded-lg bg-muted/50 border border-muted text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Use your registered passkey (fingerprint, face ID, or device PIN) to sign in
            </div>

            <PasskeyLoginButton email={email} primaryColor={primaryColor} />

            {email && <input type="hidden" value={email} />}
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* Divider */}
      <div className="relative">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center">
          <div className="w-full border-t border-border" />
        </div>
        <div className="relative flex justify-center text-xs uppercase">
          <span className="bg-background px-2 text-muted-foreground">Or continue with</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Social login */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.1 }}>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            type="button"
            className="w-full bg-transparent"
            onClick={() => onSocialClick?.("google")}
          >
            <svg className="h-4 w-4" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
              <path d="M22.56 12.25c0-.78-.07-1.53-.2-2.25H12v4.26h5.92c-.26 1.37-1.04 2.53-2.21 3.31v2.77h3.57c2.08-1.92 3.28-4.74 3.28-8.09z" />
              <path d="M12 23c2.97 0 5.46-.98 7.28-2.66l-3.57-2.77c-.98.66-2.23 1.06-3.71 1.06-2.86 0-5.29-1.93-6.16-4.53H2.18v2.84C3.99 20.53 7.7 23 12 23z" />
              <path d="M5.84 14.09c-.22-.66-.35-1.36-.35-2.09s.13-1.43.35-2.09V7.07H2.18C1.43 8.55 1 10.22 1 12s.43 3.45 1.18 4.93l2.85-2.22.81-.62z" />
              <path d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15C17.45 2.09 14.97 1 12 1 7.7 1 3.99 3.47 2.18 7.07l3.66 2.84c.87-2.6 3.3-4.53 6.16-4.53z" />

"use client"

import { useState } from "react"
import { motion } from "framer-motion"
import { Button, Alert, AlertDescription } from "@repo/ui"
import { Key, Loader2 } from "lucide-react"
import { useAuth } from "@fortknox/sdk"

type LoginStatus =
  | 'idle'
  | 'requesting_options'
  | 'waiting_for_device'
  | 'verifying'
  | 'success'
  | 'error'

interface PasskeyLoginButtonProps {
  email: string
  primaryColor?: string
}

export function PasskeyLoginButton({ email, primaryColor = "#6366f1" }: PasskeyLoginButtonProps) {
  const { startPasskeyLogin, finishPasskeyLogin } = useAuth()
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<LoginStatus>('idle')
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const handlePasskeyLogin = async () => {
    if (!window.PublicKeyCredential) {
      setStatus('error')
      setErrorMessage('Passkeys are not supported on this device or browser')
      return
    }

    setErrorMessage(null)

    // Step 1: get options from server
    setStatus('requesting_options')
    let serverData: any
    try {
      serverData = await startPasskeyLogin(email)
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatus('error')
      setErrorMessage(err?.message || 'Failed to start passkey login')
      return
    }

    const { sessionNonce, ...optionsJSON } = serverData

    // Step 2: invoke browser authenticator
    setStatus('waiting_for_device')
    let assertion: any
    try {
      const { startAuthentication } = await import('@simplewebauthn/browser')
      assertion = await startAuthentication({ optionsJSON })
    } catch (err: any) {
      // User cancelled the WebAuthn prompt — don't show error
      if (err?.name === 'NotAllowedError') {
        setStatus('idle')
        return
      }
      setStatus('error')
      if (err?.name === 'NotSupportedError') {
        setErrorMessage('Your device does not support passkeys.')
      } else {
        setErrorMessage(err?.message || 'Something went wrong. Please try again.')
      }
      return
    }

    // Step 3: verify with server
    setStatus('verifying')
    try {
      await finishPasskeyLogin(email, assertion, sessionNonce)
      setStatus('success')
      window.location.href = '/dashboard'
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatus('error')
      setErrorMessage(err?.message || 'Failed to authenticate with passkey')
    }
  }

  const isLoading = status === 'requesting_options' || status === 'waiting_for_device' || status === 'verifying'

  const loadingLabel = {
    requesting_options: 'Contacting server...',
    waiting_for_device: 'Waiting for passkey...',
    verifying: 'Verifying...',
  }[status as 'requesting_options' | 'waiting_for_device' | 'verifying'] ?? 'Sign in with Passkey'

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}>
        <Button
          type="button"
          onClick={handlePasskeyLogin}
          disabled={isLoading || status === 'success'}
          className="w-full"
          variant="outline"
          style={primaryColor ? { borderColor: primaryColor, color: primaryColor } : undefined}
        >
          {isLoading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
              {loadingLabel}
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Key className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
              Sign in with Passkey
            </>
          )}
        </Button>
      </motion.div>

      {status === 'error' && errorMessage && (
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}>
          <Alert variant="destructive" className="bg-destructive/10 border-destructive/30">
            <AlertDescription className="text-xs">{errorMessage}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

"use client"

import type React from "react"

import { useState } from "react"
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion"
import { Button, Input, Label, Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@repo/ui"
import { Key, CheckCircle2, Loader2, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react"
import { useAuth } from "@fortknox/sdk"

type RegistrationStatus =
  | 'idle'
  | 'requesting_options'
  | 'waiting_for_device'
  | 'verifying'
  | 'success'
  | 'error'

interface PasskeyRegisterModalProps {
  open: boolean
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void
  onSuccess?: () => void
  primaryColor?: string
}

export function PasskeyRegisterModal({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  onSuccess,
  primaryColor = "#6366f1",
}: PasskeyRegisterModalProps) {
  const { client } = useAuth()
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<RegistrationStatus>('idle')
  const [deviceName, setDeviceName] = useState("")
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const isInProgress = status === 'requesting_options' || status === 'waiting_for_device' || status === 'verifying'

  const handleNameSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    handleRegister()
  }

  async function handleRegister() {
    // Step 1: get options from server via SDK client
    // Calls POST /mfa/webauthn/register/start internally
    setStatus('requesting_options')
    let options: any
    try {
      const res = await client.request({
        url: `${client.getBaseURL()}/mfa/webauthn/register/start`,
        method: 'POST',
      })
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(res.data?.message || 'Failed to contact server')
      }
      options = res.data?.data || res.data
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatus('error')
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Failed to start registration')
      return
    }

    // Step 2: browser credential API — THIS IS THE LINE THAT WAS MISSING
    setStatus('waiting_for_device')
    let registrationResponse: any
    try {
      const { startRegistration } = await import('@simplewebauthn/browser')
      registrationResponse = await startRegistration({ optionsJSON: options })
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatus('error')
      if (err.name === 'NotAllowedError') {
        setErrorMessage('Registration was cancelled.')
      } else if (err.name === 'NotSupportedError') {
        setErrorMessage('Your device does not support passkeys.')
      } else {
        setErrorMessage('Something went wrong. Please try again.')
      }
      return
    }

    // Step 3: verify with server via SDK
    setStatus('verifying')
    try {
      await client.finishPasskeyRegistration(registrationResponse, deviceName.trim() || undefined)
      setStatus('success')
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatus('error')
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Verification failed. Please try again.')
    }
  }

  const handleClose = () => {
    if (!isInProgress) {
      onOpenChange(false)
      setStatus('idle')
      setDeviceName("")
      setErrorMessage(null)
    }
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={handleClose}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
          {status === 'idle' && (
            <motion.div
              key="idle"
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
            >
              <DialogHeader>
                <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Key className="h-5 w-5" />
                  Register Passkey
                </DialogTitle>
                <DialogDescription>Give your passkey a name to identify it later</DialogDescription>
              </DialogHeader>

              <form onSubmit={handleNameSubmit} className="space-y-4 mt-6">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label htmlFor="device-name">Device Name (optional)</Label>
                  <Input
                    id="device-name"
                    placeholder="e.g., iPhone 14 Pro, MacBook Pro"
                    value={deviceName}
                    onChange={(e) => setDeviceName(e.target.value)}
                    autoFocus
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="flex gap-2 pt-4">
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={handleClose}
                    className="flex-1"
                  >
                    Cancel
                  </Button>
                  <Button type="submit" className="flex-1">
                    Continue
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </form>
            </motion.div>
          )}

          {isInProgress && (
            <motion.div
              key="in-progress"
              initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
              className="space-y-6 py-8"
            >
              <div className="flex justify-center">
                <div className="p-4 rounded-full bg-primary/10">
                  <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 text-primary animate-spin" />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center space-y-2">
                <p className="font-medium">
                  {status === 'requesting_options' && 'Contacting server...'}
                  {status === 'waiting_for_device' && 'Check your device or browser prompt...'}
                  {status === 'verifying' && 'Verifying with server...'}
                </p>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          )}

          {status === 'success' && (
            <motion.div
              key="success"
              initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
              className="space-y-6 py-8"
            >
              <div className="flex justify-center">
                <motion.div
                  initial={{ scale: 0 }}
                  animate={{ scale: 1 }}
                  transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 200, damping: 20 }}
                >
                  <div className="p-4 rounded-full bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-900/30">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-8 w-8 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400" />
                  </div>
                </motion.div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center space-y-4">
                <p className="font-medium">Passkey added successfully!</p>
                <Button
                  onClick={() => {
                    onSuccess?.()
                    onOpenChange(false)
                    setStatus('idle')
                    setDeviceName("")
                  }}
                  className="w-full"
                >
                  Close
                </Button>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          )}

          {status === 'error' && (
            <motion.div
              key="error"
              initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
              className="space-y-6 py-8"
            >
              <div className="flex justify-center">
                <div className="p-4 rounded-full bg-destructive/10">
                  <AlertCircle className="h-8 w-8 text-destructive" />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center space-y-4">
                <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{errorMessage}</p>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setStatus('idle')
                    setErrorMessage(null)
                  }}
                  className="w-full"
                >
                  Try again
                </Button>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  )
}

"use client"

import type React from "react"
import { useState } from "react"
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation"
import { Button, Input, Label, InputOTP, InputOTPGroup, InputOTPSlot } from "@repo/ui"
import { useAuth } from "@fortknox/sdk"

interface ResetPasswordFormProps {
  primaryColor?: string
}

export function ResetPasswordForm({ primaryColor }: ResetPasswordFormProps) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const { forgotPassword, resetPassword } = useAuth()

  const [stage, setStage] = useState<"request" | "otp" | "reset">("request")
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("")
  const [otp, setOtp] = useState("")
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("")
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("")
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const btnStyle = primaryColor ? { backgroundColor: primaryColor } : undefined

  const handleRequestReset = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setError(null)
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      await forgotPassword(email)
      setStage("otp")
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.message || "Failed to send reset code. Please try again.")
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleOtpChange = (value: string) => {
    setOtp(value)
    if (value.length === 6) {
      setStage("reset")
    }
  }

  const handleResetPassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setError(null)
    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      setError("Passwords do not match")
      return
    }
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      await resetPassword(otp, password)
      router.push("/u/login?reset=success")
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.message || "Invalid or expired code. Please try again.")
      setStage("otp")
      setOtp("")
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  if (stage === "request") {
    return (
      <form onSubmit={handleRequestReset} className="space-y-6">
        {error && (
          <div className="rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 border border-destructive/20 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-destructive">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="email">Email address</Label>
          <Input
            id="email"
            type="email"
            placeholder="you@example.com"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            required
            autoFocus
          />
        </div>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          We'll send a 6-digit code to this email address.
        </p>
        <Button type="submit" className="w-full" disabled={loading} style={btnStyle}>
          {loading ? "Sending code..." : "Send reset code"}
        </Button>
        <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Remember your password?{" "}
          <a href="/u/login" className="text-primary hover:underline font-medium">
            Sign in
          </a>
        </p>
      </form>
    )
  }

  if (stage === "otp") {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        {error && (
          <div className="rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 border border-destructive/20 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-destructive">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Enter the 6-digit code sent to{" "}
          <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{email}</span>
        </p>
        <div className="flex justify-center">
          <InputOTP maxLength={6} value={otp} onChange={handleOtpChange}>
            <InputOTPGroup>
              <InputOTPSlot index={0} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={1} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={2} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={3} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={4} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={5} />
            </InputOTPGroup>
          </InputOTP>
        </div>
        <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Didn't receive the code?{" "}
          <button
            type="button"
            className="text-primary hover:underline font-medium"
            onClick={() => { setStage("request"); setOtp(""); setError(null); }}
          >
            Resend
          </button>
        </p>
      </div>
    )
  }

  // stage === "reset"
  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleResetPassword} className="space-y-6">
      {error && (
        <div className="rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 border border-destructive/20 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-destructive">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="password">New password</Label>
        <Input
          id="password"
          type="password"
          placeholder="Minimum 8 characters"
          value={password}
          onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          required
          minLength={8}
          autoFocus
        />
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="confirmPassword">Confirm password</Label>
        <Input
          id="confirmPassword"
          type="password"
          placeholder="Confirm your new password"
          value={confirmPassword}
          onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
          required
        />
      </div>
      <Button type="submit" className="w-full" disabled={loading} style={btnStyle}>
        {loading ? "Resetting password..." : "Reset password"}
      </Button>
    </form>
  )
}

"use client"

import type React from "react"

import { useState } from "react"
import { Button, Input, Label, Checkbox } from "@repo/ui"


interface SignupFormProps {
  onSubmit?: (data: SignupData) => void
  primaryColor?: string
}

interface SignupData {
  email: string
  password: string
  name: string
  agreedToTerms: boolean
}

export function SignupForm({ onSubmit, primaryColor }: SignupFormProps) {
  const [name, setName] = useState("")
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("")
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("")
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("")
  const [agreed, setAgreed] = useState(false)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      alert("Passwords do not match")
      return
    }
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      if (onSubmit) {
        await onSubmit({ email, password, name, agreedToTerms: agreed })
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="name">Full name</Label>
        <Input
          id="name"
          type="text"
          placeholder="John Doe"
          value={name}
          onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
          required
        />
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
        <Input
          id="email"
          type="email"
          placeholder="you@example.com"
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          required
        />
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="password">Password</Label>
        <Input
          id="password"
          type="password"
          placeholder="Minimum 8 characters"
          value={password}
          onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          required
          minLength={8}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="confirmPassword">Confirm password</Label>
        <Input
          id="confirmPassword"
          type="password"
          placeholder="Confirm your password"
          value={confirmPassword}
          onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
          required
        />
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
        <Checkbox id="terms" checked={agreed} onCheckedChange={(checked) => setAgreed(checked as boolean)} />
        <Label htmlFor="terms" className="text-sm font-normal cursor-pointer">
          I agree to the{" "}
          <a href="#" className="text-primary hover:underline">
            Terms of Service
          </a>{" "}
          and{" "}
          <a href="#" className="text-primary hover:underline">
            Privacy Policy
          </a>
        </Label>
      </div>

      <Button
        type="submit"
        className="w-full"
        disabled={loading || !agreed}
        style={primaryColor ? { backgroundColor: primaryColor } : undefined}
      >
        {loading ? "Creating account..." : "Create account"}
      </Button>

      <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Already have an account?{" "}
        <a href="/u/login" className="text-primary hover:underline">
          Sign in
        </a>
      </p>
    </form>
  )
}

FILE: apps/admin-portal/components/auth/step-based-auth-flow.tsx

"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "framer-motion";
import { useEmailAuthFlow } from "@/hooks/use-email-auth-flow";
import { EmailStep } from "./email-step";
import { MethodSelectionStep } from "./method-selection-step";
import { CredentialsStep } from "./credentials-step";
import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "@fortknox/sdk";
import { Button } from "@repo/ui";
import { ShieldCheck, AlertCircle, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

type LoginScreen =
  | 'email'
  | 'credentials'
  | 'mfa_totp'
  | 'mfa_email_otp'
  | 'magic_link_sent'

interface StepBasedAuthFlowProps {
  primaryColor?: string;
}

export function StepBasedAuthFlow({
  primaryColor = "#6366f1",
}: StepBasedAuthFlowProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const flow = useEmailAuthFlow();
  const { client, verifyMfaLogin } = useAuth();
  const [passwordPolicy] = useState<any>({
    minLength: 8,
    requireUppercase: true,
    requireNumbers: true,
    requireSpecialChars: true,
  });

  // MFA inline state — tempToken is kept in React state only (not localStorage/cookie)
  const [mfaTempToken, setMfaTempToken] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [mfaScreen, setMfaScreen] = useState<'totp' | 'email_otp' | null>(null);
  const [mfaDigits, setMfaDigits] = useState<string[]>(["", "", "", "", "", ""]);
  const [mfaLoading, setMfaLoading] = useState(false);
  const [mfaError, setMfaError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const inputRefs = useRef<Array<HTMLInputElement | null>>([]);

  const mfaCode = mfaDigits.join("");

  // Determine which top-level screen we are on
  const activeLoginScreen: LoginScreen = (() => {
    if (mfaScreen === 'totp') return 'mfa_totp';
    if (mfaScreen === 'email_otp') return 'mfa_email_otp';
    if (flow.step === 'email') return 'email';
    return 'credentials'; // method-selection or credentials
  })();

  const handleEmailSubmit = async (email: string) => {
    try {
      await flow.submitEmail(email);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("[StepBasedAuthFlow] Email submission error:", err);
    }
  };

  const handleCredentialsSubmit = async (email: string, password?: string) => {
    try {
      const result = await client.login({ email, password: password as string });

      if (result.mfaRequired) {
        // Store tempToken in local React state only — never in localStorage or cookie
        const tempToken = (result as any).tempToken ?? null;
        setMfaTempToken(tempToken);
        const mfaMethod = (result as any).mfaMethod;
        setMfaScreen(mfaMethod === 'email_otp' ? 'email_otp' : 'totp');
        setMfaDigits(["", "", "", "", "", ""]);
        setMfaError(null);
        return;
      }

      router.push("/dashboard");
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("[StepBasedAuthFlow] Login error:", err);
    }
  };

  const handleMfaChange = (index: number, value: string) => {
    // Handle paste of full code
    if (value.length > 1) {
      const cleaned = value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 6);
      const next = [...mfaDigits];
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) next[i] = cleaned[i] ?? "";
      setMfaDigits(next);
      inputRefs.current[Math.min(cleaned.length, 5)]?.focus();
      return;
    }
    const digit = value.replace(/\D/g, "");
    const next = [...mfaDigits];
    next[index] = digit;
    setMfaDigits(next);
    if (digit && index < 5) inputRefs.current[index + 1]?.focus();
  };

  const handleMfaKeyDown = (index: number, e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "Backspace" && !mfaDigits[index] && index > 0) {
      inputRefs.current[index - 1]?.focus();
    }
  };

  const handleMfaSubmit = useCallback(async () => {
    if (mfaCode.length !== 6 || mfaLoading || !mfaTempToken) return;
    setMfaLoading(true);
    setMfaError(null);
    try {
      await verifyMfaLogin(mfaTempToken, mfaCode);
      router.push("/dashboard");
    } catch (err: any) {
      setMfaError(err?.message || "Invalid code. Please try again.");
      setMfaDigits(["", "", "", "", "", ""]);
      inputRefs.current[0]?.focus();
    } finally {
      setMfaLoading(false);
    }
  }, [mfaCode, mfaLoading, mfaTempToken, verifyMfaLogin, router]);

  // Auto-submit when all 6 digits are filled
  useEffect(() => {
    if (mfaCode.length === 6 && mfaScreen) handleMfaSubmit();
  }, [mfaCode, mfaScreen, handleMfaSubmit]);

  // MFA TOTP screen
  if (activeLoginScreen === 'mfa_totp') {
    return (
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
        className="space-y-6"
      >
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">Verify your identity</h2>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/30 p-4">
          <ShieldCheck className="h-5 w-5 text-primary shrink-0" />
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-medium">Authenticator App</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Use an app like Google Authenticator or Authy</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex gap-2 justify-center">
            {mfaDigits.map((digit, i) => (
              <input
                key={i}
                ref={(el) => { inputRefs.current[i] = el; }}
                type="text"
                inputMode="numeric"
                maxLength={6}
                value={digit}
                onChange={(e) => handleMfaChange(i, e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => handleMfaKeyDown(i, e)}
                onFocus={(e) => e.target.select()}
                onPaste={(e) => {
                  if (i === 0) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const pasted = e.clipboardData.getData('text').replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 6);
                    const next = [...mfaDigits];
                    for (let j = 0; j < 6; j++) next[j] = pasted[j] ?? '';
                    setMfaDigits(next);
                    inputRefs.current[Math.min(pasted.length - 1, 5)]?.focus();
                  }
                }}
                disabled={mfaLoading}
                className={`
                  h-14 w-12 rounded-xl border text-center text-xl font-semibold
                  bg-background transition-all outline-none
                  ${digit ? "border-primary text-foreground" : "border-border text-muted-foreground"}
                  ${mfaLoading ? "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed" : "focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20"}
                `}
              />
            ))}
          </div>

          {mfaError && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-destructive">
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
              {mfaError}
            </div>
          )}

          <Button
            className="w-full"
            disabled={mfaCode.length !== 6 || mfaLoading}
            style={{ backgroundColor: primaryColor }}
            onClick={handleMfaSubmit}
          >
            {mfaLoading ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                Verifying...
              </>
            ) : (
              "Verify"
            )}
          </Button>

          <button
            type="button"
            className="w-full text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground underline"
            onClick={() => {
              setMfaScreen(null);
              setMfaTempToken(null);
              setMfaDigits(["", "", "", "", "", ""]);
              setMfaError(null);
              flow.reset?.();
            }}
          >
            Back to sign in
          </button>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    );
  }

  // MFA Email OTP screen
  if (activeLoginScreen === 'mfa_email_otp') {
    return (
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
        className="space-y-6"
      >
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">Check your email</h2>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Enter the 6-digit code sent to {flow.email}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex gap-2 justify-center">
            {mfaDigits.map((digit, i) => (
              <input
                key={i}
                ref={(el) => { inputRefs.current[i] = el; }}
                type="text"
                inputMode="numeric"
                maxLength={6}
                value={digit}
                onChange={(e) => handleMfaChange(i, e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => handleMfaKeyDown(i, e)}
                onFocus={(e) => e.target.select()}
                disabled={mfaLoading}
                className={`
                  h-14 w-12 rounded-xl border text-center text-xl font-semibold
                  bg-background transition-all outline-none
                  ${digit ? "border-primary text-foreground" : "border-border text-muted-foreground"}
                  ${mfaLoading ? "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed" : "focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20"}
                `}
              />
            ))}
          </div>

          {mfaError && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-destructive">
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
              {mfaError}
            </div>
          )}

          <Button
            className="w-full"
            disabled={mfaCode.length !== 6 || mfaLoading}
            style={{ backgroundColor: primaryColor }}
            onClick={handleMfaSubmit}
          >
            {mfaLoading ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                Verifying...
              </>
            ) : (
              "Verify"
            )}
          </Button>

          <button
            type="button"
            className="w-full text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground underline"
            onClick={() => {
              setMfaScreen(null);
              setMfaTempToken(null);
              setMfaDigits(["", "", "", "", "", ""]);
              setMfaError(null);
              flow.reset?.();
            }}
          >
            Back to sign in
          </button>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    );
  }

  // Normal login flow (email → method selection → credentials)
  return (
    <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
      {flow.step === "email" && (
        <EmailStep
          key="email"
          onSubmit={handleEmailSubmit}
          loading={flow.loading}
          error={flow.error}
          primaryColor={primaryColor}
        />
      )}

      {flow.step === "method-selection" && flow.loginIntent && (
        <MethodSelectionStep
          key="methods"
          loginIntent={flow.loginIntent}
          onSelectMethod={flow.selectMethod}
          onChangeEmail={flow.goBack}
          loading={flow.loading}
          primaryColor={primaryColor}
        />
      )}

      {flow.step === "credentials" &&
        flow.selectedMethod &&
        flow.loginIntent && (
          <CredentialsStep
            key="credentials"
            email={flow.email}
            method={flow.selectedMethod}
            onSubmit={handleCredentialsSubmit}
            onBack={flow.goBack}
            loading={flow.loading}
            error={flow.error}
            passwordPolicy={passwordPolicy}
            primaryColor={primaryColor}
          />
        )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

"use client"

import type React from "react"

import { useState } from "react"
import { motion } from "framer-motion"
import { Button, Input, Label, Card } from "@repo/ui"
import { Copy, Check } from "lucide-react"

interface TOTPSetupProps {
  email: string
  secret: string
  qrCodeUrl: string
  onVerify: (code: string) => void
  primaryColor?: string
}

export function TOTPSetup({ email, secret, qrCodeUrl, onVerify, primaryColor = "#6366f1" }: TOTPSetupProps) {
  const [code, setCode] = useState("")
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  const handleCopy = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(secret)
    setCopied(true)
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000)
  }

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      await onVerify(code)
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
        className="flex justify-center"
      >
        <Card className="p-4">
          <div
            className="w-48 h-48 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center"
            style={{
              backgroundImage: `url(${qrCodeUrl})`,
              backgroundSize: "cover",
            }}
          />
        </Card>
      </motion.div>

      <div className="space-y-3">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center">
          Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, etc.)
        </p>

        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label className="text-xs">Can't scan? Enter this key manually:</Label>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <code className="flex-1 bg-muted px-3 py-2 rounded text-sm font-mono break-all">{secret}</code>
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleCopy}
              className="shrink-0 bg-transparent"
            >
              {copied ? <Check className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Copy className="h-4 w-4" />}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="totp-code">Enter the 6-digit code</Label>
        <Input
          id="totp-code"
          type="text"
          inputMode="numeric"
          placeholder="000000"
          value={code}
          onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 6))}
          maxLength={6}
          className="text-center text-2xl tracking-widest"
        />
      </div>

      <Button
        type="submit"
        className="w-full"
        disabled={loading || code.length !== 6}
        style={primaryColor ? { backgroundColor: primaryColor } : undefined}
      >
        {loading ? "Verifying..." : "Verify & Enable"}
      </Button>

      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center">
        Save these codes in a safe place. You'll need them if you lose access to your authenticator.
      </p>
    </form>
  )
}

interface BrandLogoProps {

import type React from "react"
interface ThemedCardProps {
  children: React.ReactNode
  className?: string
  primaryColor?: string
  variant?: "default" | "outlined" | "filled"
}

export function ThemedCard({ children, className = "", variant = "default" }: ThemedCardProps) {
  const variants = {
    default: "bg-card border border-border",
    outlined: "border-2 border-primary/20 bg-transparent",
    filled: "bg-primary/10 border border-primary/20",
  }

  return <div className={`rounded-lg p-6 ${variants[variant]} ${className}`}>{children}</div>
}
