"use client"

import { useState } from "react"
import { motion } from "framer-motion"
import { Button, Input, Label } from "@repo/ui"
import { Eye, EyeOff, CheckCircle2, Circle } from "lucide-react"

interface EnhancedPasswordInputProps {
  label?: string
  placeholder?: string
  value: string
  onChange: (value: string) => void
  error?: string
  required?: boolean
  showStrength?: boolean
  policy?: {
    minLength?: number
    requireUppercase?: boolean
    requireNumbers?: boolean
    requireSpecialChars?: boolean
  }
  primaryColor?: string
}

export function EnhancedPasswordInput({
  label = "Password",
  placeholder = "Enter password",
  value,
  onChange,
  error,
  required,
  showStrength = true,
  policy = {
    minLength: 8,
    requireUppercase: true,
    requireNumbers: true,
    requireSpecialChars: true,
  },
  primaryColor = "#6366f1",
}: EnhancedPasswordInputProps) {
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false)

  // Calculate strength
  const getStrength = () => {
    let strength = 0
    if (value.length >= (policy.minLength || 8)) strength++
    if (policy.requireUppercase && /[A-Z]/.test(value)) strength++
    if (policy.requireNumbers && /\d/.test(value)) strength++
    if (policy.requireSpecialChars && /[^a-zA-Z\d]/.test(value)) strength++
    return strength
  }

  // Validate policy requirements
  const validatePolicy = () => {
    const checks = {
      length: value.length >= (policy.minLength || 8),
      uppercase: !policy.requireUppercase || /[A-Z]/.test(value),
      numbers: !policy.requireNumbers || /\d/.test(value),
      special: !policy.requireSpecialChars || /[^a-zA-Z\d]/.test(value),
    }
    return checks
  }

  const strength = getStrength()
  const checks = validatePolicy()
  const strengthLabels = ["Weak", "Fair", "Good", "Strong", "Very Strong"]
  const strengthColors = ["bg-red-500", "bg-yellow-500", "bg-blue-500", "bg-green-500", "bg-emerald-500"]

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <Label>{label}</Label>
        <motion.button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setShow(!show)}
          className="h-auto p-0 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
          whileHover={{ scale: 1.05 }}
          whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
        >
          {show ? (
            <motion.div
              key="hide"
              initial={{ opacity: 0, rotate: -180 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, rotate: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, rotate: 180 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
            >
              <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" />
            </motion.div>
          ) : (
            <motion.div
              key="show"
              initial={{ opacity: 0, rotate: -180 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, rotate: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, rotate: 180 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
            >
              <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </motion.button>
      </div>

      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -4 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}>
        <Input
          type={show ? "text" : "password"}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          value={value}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
          required={required}
          className={error ? "border-destructive" : ""}
        />
      </motion.div>

      {showStrength && value && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, height: "auto" }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
          className="space-y-2"
        >
          {/* Strength meter */}
          <div className="flex gap-1">
            {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
              <motion.div
                key={i}
                className={`h-1.5 flex-1 rounded-full transition-colors ${
                  i <= strength ? strengthColors[strength - 1] : "bg-muted"
                }`}
                initial={{ scaleX: 0 }}
                animate={{ scaleX: 1 }}
                transition={{ delay: i * 0.05, duration: 0.3 }}
              />
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Strength label */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Strength:{" "}
              <span className={`font-semibold text-${strength > 2 ? "green" : strength > 1 ? "yellow" : "red"}-500`}>
                {strengthLabels[strength - 1]}
              </span>
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Policy requirements */}
          {policy && (
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -4 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.3, delay: 0.1 }}
              className="space-y-1 rounded-md bg-muted/30 p-3"
            >
              {policy.minLength && (
                <PolicyCheck met={checks.length} label={`At least ${policy.minLength} characters`} />
              )}
              {policy.requireUppercase && <PolicyCheck met={checks.uppercase} label="One uppercase letter" />}
              {policy.requireNumbers && <PolicyCheck met={checks.numbers} label="One number" />}
              {policy.requireSpecialChars && <PolicyCheck met={checks.special} label="One special character" />}
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </motion.div>
      )}

      {error && (
        <motion.p
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -4 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
          className="text-sm text-destructive"
        >
          {error}
        </motion.p>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

interface PolicyCheckProps {
  met: boolean
  label: string
}

function PolicyCheck({ met, label }: PolicyCheckProps) {
  return (
    <motion.div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs" initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }}>
      <motion.div
        initial={{ scale: 0 }}
        animate={{ scale: 1 }}
        transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 400, damping: 40 }}
      >
        {met ? (
          <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-green-500" />
        ) : (
          <Circle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
        )}
      </motion.div>
      <span className={met ? "text-muted-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground"}>{label}</span>
    </motion.div>
  )
}

"use client"

import type React from "react"

import { useState } from "react"
import { motion } from "framer-motion"
import { Button, Input, Label } from "@repo/ui"
import { Mail, ArrowRight, CheckCircle } from "lucide-react"

interface MagicLinkFormProps {
  stage?: "request" | "sent" | "expired"
  email?: string
  onSubmit?: (email: string) => void
  onResend?: () => void
  primaryColor?: string
}

export function MagicLinkForm({
  stage = "request",
  email = "",
  onSubmit,
  onResend,
  primaryColor = "#6366f1",
}: MagicLinkFormProps) {
  const [inputEmail, setInputEmail] = useState(email)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [resendCount, setResendCount] = useState(0)

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      if (onSubmit) {
        await onSubmit(inputEmail)
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleResend = async () => {
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      if (onResend) {
        await onResend()
      }
      setResendCount(resendCount + 1)
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  if (stage === "sent") {
    return (
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
        className="space-y-6"
      >
        <div className="flex justify-center">
          <motion.div
            initial={{ scale: 0 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 200, damping: 20 }}
          >
            <div className="flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-900/30">
              <CheckCircle className="h-8 w-8 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400" />
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-2 text-center">
          <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">Check your email</h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            We've sent a magic link to <strong>{inputEmail}</strong>. Click the link to sign in.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-lg bg-muted/50 p-4 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Link expires in 15 minutes
        </div>

        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
          transition={{ delay: 0.3, duration: 0.3 }}
          className="space-y-2"
        >
          <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">Didn't receive it?</p>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={handleResend}
            disabled={loading || resendCount >= 3}
            className="w-full"
          >
            {loading ? "Sending..." : "Resend link"}
          </Button>
        </motion.div>

        <Button variant="ghost" className="w-full">
          Back to sign in
        </Button>
      </motion.div>
    )
  }

  if (stage === "expired") {
    return (
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
        className="space-y-6"
      >
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-4 text-center">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-destructive">Link expired</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">The magic link has expired. Please request a new one.</p>
        </div>

        <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => {}} className="w-full">
          Request new link
        </Button>

        <Button variant="ghost" className="w-full">
          Back to sign in
        </Button>
      </motion.div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="magic-email">Email address</Label>
        <div className="relative">
          <Mail className="absolute left-3 top-3 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground pointer-events-none" />
          <Input
            id="magic-email"
            type="email"
            placeholder="you@example.com"
            value={inputEmail}
            onChange={(e) => setInputEmail(e.target.value)}
            required
            className="pl-10"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <Button
        type="submit"
        className="w-full group"
        disabled={loading}
        style={primaryColor ? { backgroundColor: primaryColor } : undefined}
      >
        {loading ? "Sending..." : "Send magic link"}
        <motion.div animate={{ x: loading ? 0 : 4 }} transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}>
          <ArrowRight className="ml-2 h-4 w-4" />
        </motion.div>
      </Button>

      <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        We'll send you a secure link to sign in. No password needed.
      </p>
    </form>
  )
}

"use client"

import { useState } from "react"
import { Button, Input, Label } from "@repo/ui"


interface PasswordInputProps {
  label?: string
  placeholder?: string
  value: string
  onChange: (value: string) => void
  error?: string
  required?: boolean
  showStrength?: boolean
}

export function PasswordInput({
  label = "Password",
  placeholder = "Enter password",
  value,
  onChange,
  error,
  required,
  showStrength,
}: PasswordInputProps) {
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false)

  const getStrength = () => {
    let strength = 0
    if (value.length >= 8) strength++
    if (/[a-z]/.test(value) && /[A-Z]/.test(value)) strength++
    if (/\d/.test(value)) strength++
    if (/[^a-zA-Z\d]/.test(value)) strength++
    return strength
  }

  const strength = getStrength()
  const strengthColor =
    strength === 0
      ? "bg-gray-300"
      : strength === 1
        ? "bg-red-500"
        : strength === 2
          ? "bg-yellow-500"
          : strength === 3
            ? "bg-blue-500"
            : "bg-green-500"

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <Label>{label}</Label>
        {show && (
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setShow(!show)} className="h-auto p-0 text-xs">
            {show ? "Hide" : "Show"}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
      <Input
        type={show ? "text" : "password"}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        value={value}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
        required={required}
        className={error ? "border-destructive" : ""}
      />
      {showStrength && (
        <div className="flex gap-1">
          {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              className={`h-1 flex-1 rounded-full ${i <= strength ? strengthColor : "bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700"}`}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      {error && <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}
    </div>
  )
}

"use client"

import { useState } from "react"
import { Button, Input, Label } from "@repo/ui"


interface CountrySelectorProps {
  onSelect?: (country: string) => void
}

const countries = [
  "United States",
  "Canada",
  "United Kingdom",
  "Germany",
  "France",
  "Spain",
  "Australia",
  "Japan",
  "Singapore",
  "India",
]

export function CountrySelector({ onSelect }: CountrySelectorProps) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("")
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const filtered = countries.filter((c) => c.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Input
        placeholder="Search country..."
        value={search}
        onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
        className="mb-4"
      />
      <div className="grid gap-2 max-h-72 overflow-y-auto">
        {filtered.map((country) => (
          <button
            key={country}
            onClick={() => setSelected(country)}
            className={`rounded-lg border-2 p-3 text-left transition-colors ${
              selected === country
                ? "border-primary bg-primary/5 text-foreground font-medium"
                : "border-border bg-card text-foreground hover:border-border/50"
            }`}
          >
            {country}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <Button className="w-full" onClick={() => onSelect?.(selected || "")} disabled={!selected}>
        Continue
      </Button>
    </div>
  )
}

"use client"

import type React from "react"

import { useState } from "react"
import { Button, Input, Label } from "@repo/ui"


interface CreateTenantFormProps {
  onSubmit?: (data: TenantData) => void
}

interface TenantData {
  name: string
  slug: string
  description: string
}

export function CreateTenantForm({ onSubmit }: CreateTenantFormProps) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<TenantData>({
    name: "",
    slug: "",
    description: "",
  })
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      if (onSubmit) {
        await onSubmit(formData)
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const generateSlug = (name: string) => {
    return name
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, "")
      .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
      .replace(/-+/g, "-")
  }

  const handleNameChange = (name: string) => {
    setFormData({
      ...formData,
      name,
      slug: generateSlug(name),
    })
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="name">Tenant name</Label>
        <Input
          id="name"
          type="text"
          placeholder="My Company"
          value={formData.name}
          onChange={(e) => handleNameChange(e.target.value)}
          required
        />
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">This is your organization's display name</p>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="slug">Tenant slug</Label>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">https://app.fortknox.io/</span>
          <Input
            id="slug"
            type="text"
            placeholder="my-company"
            value={formData.slug}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, slug: e.target.value })}
            required
            className="flex-1"
          />
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Used in your tenant URL</p>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="description">Description (optional)</Label>
        <textarea
          id="description"
          placeholder="What does your organization do?"
          value={formData.description}
          onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
          className="w-full rounded-lg border border-border bg-card px-3 py-2 text-foreground placeholder-muted-foreground"
          rows={4}
        />
      </div>

      <Button type="submit" className="w-full" disabled={loading || !formData.name}>
        {loading ? "Creating tenant..." : "Create tenant"}
      </Button>
    </form>
  )
}

"use client"

import { useState } from "react"
import { motion } from "framer-motion"
import { Button, Card, Alert, AlertDescription } from "@repo/ui"

import { Globe, LogOut, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react"

export interface Session {
  id: string
  device: string
  location: string
  ipAddress: string
  browser: string
  lastActive: string
  isCurrent: boolean
}

interface ActiveSessionsProps {
  sessions: Session[]
  onRevoke?: (sessionId: string) => void
  onRevokeAll?: () => void
}

export function ActiveSessions({ sessions, onRevoke, onRevokeAll }: ActiveSessionsProps) {
  const [revokedSessions, setRevokedSessions] = useState<string[]>([])

  const handleRevoke = (sessionId: string) => {
    setRevokedSessions([...revokedSessions, sessionId])
    onRevoke?.(sessionId)
  }

  const unusualSessions = sessions.filter((s) => !s.isCurrent && revokedSessions.length === 0)

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {unusualSessions.length > 0 && (
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}>
          <Alert className="bg-amber-100/50 dark:bg-amber-900/20 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-500" />
            <AlertDescription className="text-sm text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300">
              You have {unusualSessions.length} active session{unusualSessions.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""} from other
              devices
            </AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        </motion.div>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-3">
        {sessions.map((session, index) => (
          <motion.div
            key={session.id}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            transition={{ delay: index * 0.05, duration: 0.3 }}
          >
            <Card className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3 flex-1">
                  <div className="mt-1 p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary">
                    <Globe className="h-5 w-5" />
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <p className="font-medium text-sm">{session.browser}</p>
                      {session.isCurrent && (
                        <span className="text-xs bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-900/30 text-green-700 dark:text-green-400 px-2 py-1 rounded">
                          Current session
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">{session.device}</p>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      <div>
                        <p className="font-medium text-foreground text-xs mb-1">Location</p>
                        <p>{session.location}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <p className="font-medium text-foreground text-xs mb-1">IP Address</p>
                        <p>{session.ipAddress}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="col-span-2">
                        <p className="font-medium text-foreground text-xs mb-1">Last active</p>
                        <p>{session.lastActive}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {!session.isCurrent && (
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={() => handleRevoke(session.id)}
                    className="text-destructive hover:text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10"
                  >
                    <LogOut className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                    Revoke
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </Card>
          </motion.div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {sessions.length > 1 && (
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          onClick={onRevokeAll}
          className="w-full text-destructive hover:text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10 bg-transparent"
        >
          Revoke all other sessions
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

"use client"

import { motion } from "framer-motion"
import { Card, Badge} from "@repo/ui"
import { Lock, Smartphone, Mail, Key, RotateCcw, AlertCircle, MapPin, Clock } from "lucide-react"

export interface AuditEvent {
  id: string
  type:
    | "device_login"
    | "mfa_challenge"
    | "magic_link_sent"
    | "passkey_used"
    | "password_changed"
    | "token_revoked"
    | "mfa_enabled"
    | "mfa_disabled"
  title: string
  description: string
  timestamp: string
  location: string
  ipAddress: string
  device: string
  status: "success" | "failed" | "suspicious"
}

interface AuditLogListProps {
  events: AuditEvent[]
  onFilter?: (type: string) => void
}

export function AuditLogList({ events, onFilter }: AuditLogListProps) {
  const getIcon = (type: AuditEvent["type"]) => {
    const iconClass = "h-4 w-4"
    switch (type) {
      case "device_login":
        return <Smartphone className={iconClass} />
      case "mfa_challenge":
        return <Lock className={iconClass} />
      case "magic_link_sent":
        return <Mail className={iconClass} />
      case "passkey_used":
        return <Key className={iconClass} />
      case "password_changed":
        return <RotateCcw className={iconClass} />
      case "token_revoked":
        return <AlertCircle className={iconClass} />
      default:
        return null
    }
  }

  const getStatusColor = (status: AuditEvent["status"]) => {
    switch (status) {
      case "success":
        return "bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-900/30 text-green-700 dark:text-green-400"
      case "failed":
        return "bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/30 text-red-700 dark:text-red-400"
      case "suspicious":
        return "bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-900/30 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400"
      default:
        return "bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-900/30"
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      {events.map((event, index) => (
        <motion.div
          key={event.id}
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ delay: index * 0.05, duration: 0.3 }}
        >
          <Card className="p-4 hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors">
            <div className="flex gap-3">
              <div className={`mt-1 p-2 rounded-lg ${getStatusColor(event.status)} flex items-center justify-center`}>
                {getIcon(event.type)}
              </div>

              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <div>
                    <p className="font-medium text-sm">{event.title}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{event.description}</p>
                  </div>

                  <Badge
                    variant="secondary"
                    className={`text-xs flex-shrink-0 ${getStatusColor(event.status)} border-0`}
                  >
                    {event.status}
                  </Badge>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Clock className="h-3 w-3" />
                    {event.timestamp}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <MapPin className="h-3 w-3" />
                    {event.location}
                  </div>
                  <div className="col-span-2 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span className="text-xs">IP: {event.ipAddress}</span>
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">({event.device})</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

import { useState } from "react"
import { motion } from "framer-motion"
import { Button, Card, Input, Label, Badge, Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from "@repo/ui"
import { AlertCircle, RefreshCw, Smartphone, Mail, Key, Lock } from "lucide-react"
import { TOTPSetup } from "../../components/auth/totp-setup"

export interface MFAMethod {
  id: string
  name: string
  type: "totp" | "email-otp" | "backup-codes" | "passkey"
  enabled: boolean
  verified: boolean
  lastUpdated?: string
}

interface MFASettingsProps {
  methods: MFAMethod[]
  primaryColor?: string
  onToggle?: (methodId: string, enabled: boolean) => void
  onRegenerateCodes?: () => void
}

export function MFASettings({ methods, primaryColor = "#6366f1", onToggle, onRegenerateCodes }: MFASettingsProps) {
  const [setupOpen, setSetupOpen] = useState(false)
  const [selectedMethod, setSelectedMethod] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const getIcon = (type: string) => {
    const iconClass = "h-5 w-5"
    switch (type) {
      case "totp":
        return <Smartphone className={iconClass} />
      case "email-otp":
        return <Mail className={iconClass} />
      case "backup-codes":
        return <Key className={iconClass} />
      case "passkey":
        return <Lock className={iconClass} />
      default:
        return null
    }
  }

  const handleSetupMethod = (methodId: string) => {
    setSelectedMethod(methodId)
    setSetupOpen(true)
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="space-y-3">
        {methods.map((method, index) => (
          <motion.div
            key={method.id}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            transition={{ delay: index * 0.05, duration: 0.3 }}
          >
            <Card className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3 flex-1">
                  <div className="mt-1 p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary">{getIcon(method.type)}</div>

                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <p className="font-medium">{method.name}</p>
                      {method.verified && (
                        <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
                          Verified
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    {method.lastUpdated && (
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">Last updated: {method.lastUpdated}</p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                          className="text-xs bg-transparent"

                      )}

                        size="sm"
                        variant="outline"

                        className="text-destructive hover:text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10 bg-transparent"
                      >
                        Remove
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  ) : (

interface StatusBadgeProps {
  status: "active" | "inactive" | "pending" | "error"
  label?: string
}

export function StatusBadge({ status, label }: StatusBadgeProps) {
  const statusConfig = {
    active: {
      bg: "bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-900/30",
      text: "text-green-800 dark:text-green-400",
      dot: "bg-green-600",
    },
    inactive: { bg: "bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-900/30", text: "text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-400", dot: "bg-gray-600" },
    pending: {
      bg: "bg-yellow-100 dark:bg-yellow-900/30",
      text: "text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-400",
      dot: "bg-yellow-600",
    },
    error: { bg: "bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/30", text: "text-red-800 dark:text-red-400", dot: "bg-red-600" },
  }

  const config = statusConfig[status]
  const statusLabel = label || status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + status.slice(1)

  return (
    <div
      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium ${config.bg} ${config.text}`}
    >
      <div className={`h-2 w-2 rounded-full ${config.dot}`} />
      {statusLabel}
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: apps/admin-portal/hooks/use-email-auth-flow.ts
SIZE: 2.43 KB | LINES: 104

"use client"

import { useAuth } from "@fortknox/sdk"
import { useState } from "react"

export interface LoginIntentResponse {
  exists: boolean
  email: string
  methods: {
    password: boolean
    magicLink: boolean
    passkey: boolean
    mfa: boolean
    social: string[]
  }
  preferredMethod: "password" | "magicLink" | "passkey"
  branding: {
    logo: string
    primaryColor: string
    companyName: string
  }
}

export type AuthStep = "email" | "method-selection" | "credentials" | "mfa"

export interface UseEmailAuthFlowReturn {
  step: AuthStep
  email: string
  selectedMethod: string | null
  loading: boolean
  error: string | null
  loginIntent: LoginIntentResponse | null
  submitEmail: (email: string) => Promise<void>
  selectMethod: (method: string) => void
  goBack: () => void
  reset: () => void
}

export function useEmailAuthFlow(): UseEmailAuthFlowReturn {
  const { loginIntent: loginIntentHandler} = useAuth();
  const [step, setStep] = useState<AuthStep>("email")
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("")
  const [selectedMethod, setSelectedMethod] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loginIntent, setLoginIntent] = useState<LoginIntentResponse | null>(null)

  const submitEmail = async (inputEmail: string) => {
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)
    try {
      const response:LoginIntentResponse = await loginIntentHandler({ email: inputEmail });

      setLoginIntent(response)
      setEmail(inputEmail)
      setSelectedMethod(response.preferredMethod)
      setStep("method-selection")
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "An error occurred")
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const selectMethod = (method: string) => {
    setSelectedMethod(method)
    setStep("credentials")
  }

  const goBack = () => {
    if (step === "credentials") {
      setSelectedMethod(null)
      setStep("method-selection")
    } else if (step === "method-selection") {
      setEmail("")
      setLoginIntent(null)
      setSelectedMethod(null)
      setStep("email")
    }
  }

  const reset = () => {
    setStep("email")
    setEmail("")
    setSelectedMethod(null)
    setLoading(false)
    setError(null)
    setLoginIntent(null)
  }

  return {
    step,
    email,
    selectedMethod,
    loading,
    error,
    loginIntent,
    submitEmail,
    selectMethod,
    goBack,
    reset,
  }
}

import * as React from 'react'

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean | undefined>(undefined)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`)
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    }
    mql.addEventListener('change', onChange)
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    return () => mql.removeEventListener('change', onChange)
  }, [])

  return !!isMobile
}

import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { authClient } from "@/app/layout";
import type { DashboardData, MfaStatus, TotpSetupData, TenantSettings, PasskeyCredential, SocialConnection, TenantMetrics, ActivityEvent, TrendPoint, AuthBreakdown, BrandingConfig, ActiveSessionDto } from "./types";

function apiUrl(path: string): string {
  return `${authClient.getBaseURL()}${path}`;
}

// ─── Dashboard ───────────────────────────────────────────────

export function useDashboard() {
  return useQuery<DashboardData>({
    queryKey: ["dashboard"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await authClient.request({ url: apiUrl("/dashboard"), method: "GET" });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch dashboard");
      return res.data.data;
    },
  });
}

// ─── MFA ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function useMfaStatus() {
  return useQuery<MfaStatus>({
    queryKey: ["mfa", "status"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await authClient.request({ url: apiUrl("/mfa/status"), method: "GET" });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch MFA status");
      return res.data.data;
    },
  });
}

export function useSetupTotp() {
  return useMutation<TotpSetupData>({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      const res = await authClient.request({ url: apiUrl("/mfa/setup/totp"), method: "POST" });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to start TOTP setup");
      return res.data.data;
    },
  });
}

export function useVerifyTotp() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation<void, Error, string>({
    mutationFn: async (token: string) => {
      const res = await authClient.request({
        url: apiUrl("/mfa/verify/totp"),
        method: "POST",
        body: { token },
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Invalid code. Please try again.");
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["mfa", "status"] });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] });
    },
  });
}

export function useDisableTotp() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation<void>({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      const res = await authClient.request({ url: apiUrl("/mfa/totp"), method: "DELETE" });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to disable TOTP");
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["mfa", "status"] });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] });
    },
  });
}

export function useUpdateBranding() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation<BrandingConfig, Error, Partial<BrandingConfig>>({
    mutationFn: async (body) => {
      const res = await authClient.request({
        url: apiUrl("/tenants/current/branding"),
        method: "PUT",
        body,
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const msg =
          res.data?.message ??
          res.data?.error ??
          "Failed to save branding";
        throw new Error(Array.isArray(msg) ? msg.join("; ") : msg);
      }
      return res.data.data;
    },
    onSuccess: () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["tenant", "branding"] }),
  });
}

export function useUploadLogo() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation<{ logoUrl: string }, Error, File>({
    mutationFn: async (file: File) => {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("logo", file);
      const res = await fetch(
        `${authClient.getBaseURL()}/tenants/current/branding/logo`,
        {
          method: "POST",
          body: formData,
          credentials: "include",
        },
      );
      const json = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(json?.message ?? "Logo upload failed");
      }
      return json.data;
    },
    onSuccess: () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["tenant", "branding"] }),
  });
}

export function formatRelativeTime(isoString: string): string {
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(isoString).getTime()
  if (diff < 60_000) return 'just now'
  if (diff < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60_000)}m ago`
  if (diff < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(diff / 3_600_000)}h ago`
  if (diff < 2_592_000_000) return `${Math.floor(diff / 86_400_000)}d ago`
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric'
  }).format(new Date(isoString))
}

export function formatEventDescription(
  eventType: string,
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>
): string {
  const descriptions: Record<string, string> = {
    'auth.login_success': 'Signed in successfully',
    'auth.login_failed': 'Sign-in attempt failed',
    'auth.logout': 'Signed out',
    'auth.token_refreshed': 'Session token refreshed',
    'auth.mfa_challenge_sent': 'MFA challenge sent',
    'user.registered': 'Account created',
    'user.updated': 'Profile updated',
    'user.locked': 'Account locked',
    'user.deleted': 'Account deleted',
    'password.changed': 'Password changed',
    'password.reset_requested': 'Password reset requested',
    'password.reset_completed': 'Password reset completed',
    'session.revoked': 'Session revoked',
    'session.all_revoked': 'All sessions revoked',
    'session.expired_cleanup': 'Expired sessions cleaned up',
    'passkey.registered': 'Passkey added',
    'passkey.removed': 'Passkey removed',
    'passkey.auth_success': 'Signed in with passkey',
    'passkey.auth_failed': 'Passkey authentication failed',
    'mfa.totp_enabled': 'Two-factor authentication enabled',
    'mfa.totp_disabled': 'Two-factor authentication disabled',
    'social.login_success': 'Signed in with social provider',
    'social.account_linked': 'Social account linked',
    'social.account_unlinked': 'Social account unlinked',
    'security.brute_force_threshold': 'Brute force threshold reached',
    'api_key.created': 'API key created',
    'api_key.revoked': 'API key revoked',
    'api_key.rotated': 'API key rotated',
    'branding.updated': 'Branding configuration updated',
  }

  if (descriptions[eventType]) return descriptions[eventType]

  // Fallback: convert 'some.event_type' → 'Some event type'
  return eventType
    .replace(/\./g, ' ')
    .replace(/_/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\b\w/, c => c.toUpperCase())
}

export function getEventColor(eventType: string): string {
  if (eventType.includes('failed') || eventType.includes('locked') ||
      eventType.includes('brute_force')) return 'text-destructive'
  if (eventType.includes('api_key') || eventType.includes('rotated'))
    return 'text-amber-500'
  if (eventType.includes('logout') || eventType.includes('revoked'))
    return 'text-muted-foreground'
  if (eventType.includes('passkey')) return 'text-purple-500'
  return 'text-primary'
}

## Description

[Nest](https://github.com/nestjs/nest) framework TypeScript starter repository.

## Project setup

```bash
$ yarn install
```

## Compile and run the project

```bash
# development
$ yarn run start

# watch mode
$ yarn run start:dev

# production mode
$ yarn run start:prod
```

## Run tests

```bash
# unit tests
$ yarn run test

# e2e tests
$ yarn run test:e2e

# test coverage
$ yarn run test:cov
```

## Deployment

When you're ready to deploy your NestJS application to production, there are some key steps you can take to ensure it runs as efficiently as possible. Check out the [deployment documentation](https://docs.nestjs.com/deployment) for more information.

If you are looking for a cloud-based platform to deploy your NestJS application, check out [Mau](https://mau.nestjs.com), our official platform for deploying NestJS applications on AWS. Mau makes deployment straightforward and fast, requiring just a few simple steps:

```bash
$ yarn install -g @nestjs/mau
$ mau deploy
```

With Mau, you can deploy your application in just a few clicks, allowing you to focus on building features rather than managing infrastructure.

## Resources

Check out a few resources that may come in handy when working with NestJS:

- Visit the [NestJS Documentation](https://docs.nestjs.com) to learn more about the framework.
- For questions and support, please visit our [Discord channel](https://discord.gg/G7Qnnhy).
- To dive deeper and get more hands-on experience, check out our official video [courses](https://courses.nestjs.com/).
- Deploy your application to AWS with the help of [NestJS Mau](https://mau.nestjs.com) in just a few clicks.
- Visualize your application graph and interact with the NestJS application in real-time using [NestJS Devtools](https://devtools.nestjs.com).
- Need help with your project (part-time to full-time)? Check out our official [enterprise support](https://enterprise.nestjs.com).
- To stay in the loop and get updates, follow us on [X](https://x.com/nestframework) and [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/company/nestjs).
- Looking for a job, or have a job to offer? Check out our official [Jobs board](https://jobs.nestjs.com).

#!/usr/bin/env node

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

/**
 * Code Consolidator Script
 * Recursively scans directories and consolidates all code files into a single text file
 */

class CodeConsolidator {
  constructor() {
    // Common code file extensions
    this.codeExtensions = new Set([
      '.js',
      '.jsx',
      '.ts',
      '.tsx',
      '.py',
      '.java',
      '.c',
      '.cpp',
      '.cc',
      '.cxx',
      '.cs',
      '.php',
      '.rb',
      '.go',
      '.rs',
      '.swift',
      '.kt',
      '.scala',
      '.r',
      '.m',
      '.mm',
      '.html',
      '.htm',
      '.css',
      '.scss',
      '.sass',
      '.less',
      '.xml',
      '.json',
      '.yaml',
      '.yml',
      '.toml',
      '.sh',
      '.bash',
      '.zsh',
      '.fish',
      '.ps1',
      '.bat',
      '.sql',
      '.graphql',
      '.proto',
      '.thrift',
      '.dockerfile',
      '.makefile',
      '.cmake',
      '.vue',
      '.svelte',
      '.dart',
      '.lua',
      '.pl',
      '.pm',
    ]);

    // Files to exclude
    this.excludeFiles = new Set([
      'package-lock.json',
      'yarn.lock',
      '.DS_Store',
      'Thumbs.db',
      '.env',
      '.env.local',
      '.env.production',
      '.env.development',
    ]);

    // Directories to exclude
    this.excludeDirs = new Set([
      'node_modules',
      '.git',
      '.svn',
      '.hg',
      'dist',
      'build',
      'target',
      'bin',
      'obj',
      '__pycache__',
      '.pytest_cache',
      'venv',
      'env',
      '.venv',
      '.env',
      'vendor',
      '.idea',
      '.vscode',
      '.vs',
      'coverage',
      '.nyc_output',
      '.cache',
    ]);

    this.stats = {
      filesProcessed: 0,
      totalLines: 0,
      skippedFiles: 0,
      errors: 0,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Check if file should be processed based on extension
   */
  isCodeFile(filePath) {
    const ext = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
    const basename = path.basename(filePath).toLowerCase();

    // Special files without extensions
    const specialFiles = [
      'dockerfile',
      'makefile',
      'jenkinsfile',
      'readme',
      'license',
      'changelog',
    ];
    if (specialFiles.some((name) => basename.includes(name))) {
      return true;
    }

    return this.codeExtensions.has(ext);
  }

  /**
   * Check if file/directory should be excluded
   */
  shouldExclude(itemPath, isDirectory = false) {
    const basename = path.basename(itemPath);

    if (isDirectory) {
      return this.excludeDirs.has(basename) || basename.startsWith('.');
    }

    return (
      this.excludeFiles.has(basename) ||
      (basename.startsWith('.') && !this.isCodeFile(itemPath))
    );
  }

  /**
   * Get file size in a readable format
   */
  getFileSize(filePath) {
    try {
      const stats = fs.statSync(filePath);
      const bytes = stats.size;

      if (bytes === 0) return '0 B';
      const k = 1024;
      const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
      const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
      return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2)) + ' ' + sizes[i];
    } catch (error) {
      return 'Unknown';
    }
  }

  /**
   * Process a single file and add its content to the output
   */
  processFile(filePath, outputStream) {
    try {
      const relativePath = path.relative(process.cwd(), filePath);
      const fileSize = this.getFileSize(filePath);
      const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8');
      const lineCount = content.split('\n').length;

      // Write file header
      outputStream.write('\n' + '='.repeat(80) + '\n');
      outputStream.write(`FILE: ${relativePath}\n`);
      outputStream.write(`SIZE: ${fileSize} | LINES: ${lineCount}\n`);
      outputStream.write('='.repeat(80) + '\n\n');

      // Write file content
      outputStream.write(content);
      outputStream.write('\n\n');

      this.stats.filesProcessed++;
      this.stats.totalLines += lineCount;

      console.log(`✓ Processed: ${relativePath} (${lineCount} lines)`);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`✗ Error processing ${filePath}: ${error.message}`);
      this.stats.errors++;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Recursively scan directory and process all code files
   */
  scanDirectory(dirPath, outputStream) {
    try {
      const items = fs.readdirSync(dirPath);

      for (const item of items) {
        const itemPath = path.join(dirPath, item);
        const stats = fs.statSync(itemPath);

        if (stats.isDirectory()) {
          if (!this.shouldExclude(itemPath, true)) {
            this.scanDirectory(itemPath, outputStream);
          } else {
            console.log(
              `⏭ Skipping directory: ${path.relative(process.cwd(), itemPath)}`,
            );
          }
        } else if (stats.isFile()) {
          if (
            this.isCodeFile(itemPath) &&
            !this.shouldExclude(itemPath, false)
          ) {
            this.processFile(itemPath, outputStream);
          } else {
            this.stats.skippedFiles++;
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`✗ Error scanning directory ${dirPath}: ${error.message}`);
      this.stats.errors++;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Main consolidation function
   */
  consolidate(inputPath = '.', outputPath = 'consolidated-code.txt') {
    console.log('🚀 Starting code consolidation...\n');
    console.log(`Input: ${path.resolve(inputPath)}`);
    console.log(`Output: ${path.resolve(outputPath)}\n`);

    const outputStream = fs.createWriteStream(outputPath);

    // Write header
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    outputStream.write(`CODE CONSOLIDATION REPORT\n`);
    outputStream.write(`Generated: ${timestamp}\n`);
    outputStream.write(`Input Directory: ${path.resolve(inputPath)}\n`);
    outputStream.write(`${'='.repeat(80)}\n\n`);

    try {
      const inputStats = fs.statSync(inputPath);

      if (inputStats.isDirectory()) {
        this.scanDirectory(inputPath, outputStream);
      } else if (inputStats.isFile()) {
        this.processFile(inputPath, outputStream);
      } else {
        throw new Error('Input path is neither a file nor a directory');
      }

      // Write footer with statistics
      outputStream.write('\n' + '='.repeat(80) + '\n');
      outputStream.write('CONSOLIDATION SUMMARY\n');
      outputStream.write('='.repeat(80) + '\n');
      outputStream.write(`Files Processed: ${this.stats.filesProcessed}\n`);
      outputStream.write(
        `Total Lines: ${this.stats.totalLines.toLocaleString()}\n`,
      );
      outputStream.write(`Files Skipped: ${this.stats.skippedFiles}\n`);
      outputStream.write(`Errors: ${this.stats.errors}\n`);
      outputStream.write(`Generated: ${timestamp}\n`);

      outputStream.end();

      console.log('\n✅ Consolidation completed successfully!');
      console.log(`📊 Statistics:`);
      console.log(`   • Files processed: ${this.stats.filesProcessed}`);
      console.log(
        `   • Total lines: ${this.stats.totalLines.toLocaleString()}`,
      );
      console.log(`   • Files skipped: ${this.stats.skippedFiles}`);
      console.log(`   • Errors: ${this.stats.errors}`);
      console.log(`📁 Output saved to: ${path.resolve(outputPath)}`);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`💥 Fatal error: ${error.message}`);
      outputStream.destroy();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Add custom file extensions
   */
  addExtensions(extensions) {
    extensions.forEach((ext) => {
      if (!ext.startsWith('.')) ext = '.' + ext;
      this.codeExtensions.add(ext.toLowerCase());
    });
  }

  /**
   * Add custom exclude patterns
   */
  addExcludes(files = [], dirs = []) {
    files.forEach((file) => this.excludeFiles.add(file));
    dirs.forEach((dir) => this.excludeDirs.add(dir));
  }
}

// CLI Usage
if (require.main === module) {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
  const consolidator = new CodeConsolidator();

  // Parse command line arguments
  let inputPath = '.';
  let outputPath = 'consolidated-code.txt';
  let customExtensions = [];
  let excludeFiles = [];
  let excludeDirs = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
    switch (args[i]) {
      case '--input':
      case '-i':
        inputPath = args[++i];
        break;
      case '--output':
      case '-o':
        outputPath = args[++i];
        break;
      case '--extensions':
      case '-e':
        customExtensions = args[++i].split(',');
        break;
      case '--exclude-files':
        excludeFiles = args[++i].split(',');
        break;
      case '--exclude-dirs':
        excludeDirs = args[++i].split(',');
        break;
      case '--help':
      case '-h':
        console.log(`
Code Consolidator - Merge all code files into one text file

Usage: node consolidate.js [options]

Options:
  -i, --input <path>          Input directory or file (default: current directory)
  -o, --output <path>         Output file path (default: consolidated-code.txt)
  -e, --extensions <list>     Additional file extensions (comma-separated)
  --exclude-files <list>      Additional files to exclude (comma-separated)
  --exclude-dirs <list>       Additional directories to exclude (comma-separated)
  -h, --help                  Show this help

Examples:
  node consolidate.js
  node consolidate.js -i ./src -o output.txt
  node consolidate.js -e "md,txt" --exclude-dirs "temp,cache"
                `);
        process.exit(0);
    }
  }

  // Apply custom settings
  if (customExtensions.length) consolidator.addExtensions(customExtensions);
  if (excludeFiles.length || excludeDirs.length)
    consolidator.addExcludes(excludeFiles, excludeDirs);

  // Run consolidation
  consolidator.consolidate(inputPath, outputPath);
}

module.exports = CodeConsolidator;

export function PaginationMetadata(): MethodDecorator {
  return function (
    target: any,
    propertyKey: string | symbol,
    descriptor: PropertyDescriptor,
  ) {
    const originalMethod = descriptor.value;

    descriptor.value = async function (...args: any[]) {
      const { page = '1', size: pageSize = '10' } = args[0];

      const result = await originalMethod.apply(this, args);

      const startIndex = (page - 1) * pageSize;
      const endIndex = startIndex + pageSize;

      const paginatedResults = result.data.slice(startIndex, endIndex);

      const metadata = {
        page,
        pageSize,
        totalPages: Math.ceil(result.data.length / pageSize),
        totalRecords: result.data.length,
      };

      return { metadata, results: paginatedResults };
    };

    return descriptor;
  };
}

export function PaginationMetadataUsers(): MethodDecorator {
  return function (
    target: any,
    propertyKey: string | symbol,
    descriptor: PropertyDescriptor,
  ) {
    const originalMethod = descriptor.value;

    descriptor.value = async function (...args: any[]) {
      const { page = '1', size: pageSize = '10' } = args[0];

      const result = await originalMethod.apply(this, args);

      const metadata = {
        page,
        pageSize,
        totalPages: Math.ceil(result.data.length / pageSize),
        totalRecords: result.data.length,
      };

      return { metadata, result };
    };

    return descriptor;
  };
}

import { applyDecorators, UseGuards } from "@nestjs/common";
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiCookieAuth } from "@nestjs/swagger";
import { TenantBindingGuard } from "../guards/tenant-binding.guard";
import { SessionGuard } from "../guards/session.guard";
import { JwtAuthGuard } from "@/common/guards";
import { PermissionsGuard } from "@/modules/rbac/guards/permissions.guard";
import {
  RequirePermissions,
  RequireRoles,
} from "@/modules/rbac/decorators/rbac.decorator";
import { RolesGuard } from "@/modules/rbac/guards/roles.guard";

/**
 * Standard protection for authenticated routes
 *
 * Applies in order:
 * 1. JwtAuthGuard - validates JWT signature
 * 2. TenantBindingGuard - ensures token tenant == request tenant
 * 3. SessionGuard - validates session active
 *
 * Usage:
 * @Protected()
 * @Get('profile')
 * async getProfile(@Req() req) { ... }
 */
export function Protected() {
  return applyDecorators(
    UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, TenantBindingGuard, SessionGuard),
    ApiBearerAuth(),
    ApiCookieAuth(),
  );
}

/**
 * Protected with permissions check
 *
 * Usage:
 * @ProtectedWithPermissions('users:read', 'users:write')
 * @Get('users')
 * async listUsers() { ... }
 */
export function ProtectedWithPermissions(...permissions: string[]) {
  return applyDecorators(
    UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, TenantBindingGuard, SessionGuard, PermissionsGuard),
    RequirePermissions(...permissions),
    ApiBearerAuth(),
    ApiCookieAuth(),
  );
}

/**
 * Protected with roles check
 *
 * Usage:
 * @ProtectedWithRoles('admin', 'owner')
 * @Delete('users/:id')
 * async deleteUser() { ... }
 */
export function ProtectedWithRoles(...roles: string[]) {
  return applyDecorators(
    UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, TenantBindingGuard, SessionGuard, RolesGuard),
    RequireRoles(...roles),
    ApiBearerAuth(),
    ApiCookieAuth(),
  );
}

import {
  ExceptionFilter,
  Catch,
  ArgumentsHost,
  HttpException,
  HttpStatus,
} from '@nestjs/common';

@Catch(HttpException)
export class HttpExceptionFilter implements ExceptionFilter {
  catch(exception: HttpException, host: ArgumentsHost) {
    const ctx = host.switchToHttp();
    const response = ctx.getResponse();
    const status = exception.getStatus();
    const res = exception.getResponse() as
      | string
      | { message?: string | string[]; [key: string]: any };

    const message =
      typeof res === 'string'
        ? res
        : Array.isArray(res.message)
        ? res.message.join(', ')
        : res.message || 'Unexpected error';

    let code = 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR';
    switch (status) {
      case HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST:
        code = 'BAD_REQUEST';
        break;
      case HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED:
        code = 'UNAUTHORIZED';
        break;
      case HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN:
        code = 'FORBIDDEN';
        break;
      case HttpStatus.CONFLICT:
        code = 'CONFLICT';
        break;
    }

    response.status(status).json({
      error: {
        code,
        message,
      },
    });
  }
}

// apps/auth-service/src/common/guards/fortknox-protected.guard.ts

import { Injectable, CanActivate, ExecutionContext } from "@nestjs/common";
import { Reflector } from "@nestjs/core";
import { TenantBindingGuard } from "./tenant-binding.guard";
import { JwtAuthGuard } from "@/common/guards/jwt-auth-guard";
import { PermissionsGuard } from "@/modules/rbac/guards/permissions.guard";
import { SessionGuard } from "@/common/guards/session.guard";

/**
 * FortKnoxProtectedGuard
 *
 * Composite guard that enforces complete auth boundary:
 * 1. JWT validation (token is valid)
 * 2. Tenant binding (token tenant == request tenant)
 * 3. Session validity (session exists, not revoked, not expired)
 * 4. Permissions (optional, only if @RequirePermissions decorator present)
 *
 * This is the "one guard to rule them all" approach.
 *
 * Usage:
 * @UseGuards(FortKnoxProtectedGuard)
 * @RequirePermissions('users:read') // Optional
 * async myProtectedRoute() { ... }
 *
 * Benefits:
 * - Single decorator
 * - Guaranteed correct order
 * - Easier to maintain
 * - Less error-prone
 */
@Injectable()
export class FortKnoxProtectedGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(
    private readonly reflector: Reflector,
    private readonly jwtAuthGuard: JwtAuthGuard,
    private readonly tenantBindingGuard: TenantBindingGuard,
    private readonly sessionGuard: SessionGuard,
    private readonly permissionsGuard: PermissionsGuard,
  ) {}

  async canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): Promise<boolean> {
    // Step 1: JWT Authentication
    const jwtResult = await this.jwtAuthGuard.canActivate(context);
    if (!jwtResult) {
      return false;
    }

    // Step 2: Tenant Binding
    const tenantResult = this.tenantBindingGuard.canActivate(context);
    if (!tenantResult) {
      return false;
    }

    // Step 3: Session Validation
    const sessionResult = await this.sessionGuard.canActivate(context);
    if (!sessionResult) {
      return false;
    }

    // Step 4: Permissions (only if decorator present)
    const permissions = this.reflector.get<string[]>(
      "permissions",
      context.getHandler(),
    );

    if (permissions && permissions.length > 0) {
      const permissionsResult =
        await this.permissionsGuard.canActivate(context);
      if (!permissionsResult) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    return true;
  }
}

import {
  Injectable,
  ExecutionContext,
  UnauthorizedException,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { AuthGuard } from "@nestjs/passport";
import { Observable } from "rxjs";

/**
 * JWT Authentication Guard
 *
 * Protects routes by validating JWT tokens
 */
@Injectable()
export class JwtAuthGuard extends AuthGuard("jwt") {
  handleRequest(err: any, user: any, info: any, context: ExecutionContext) {
    if (err || !user) {
      throw err || new UnauthorizedException("Invalid or expired token");
    }

    const req = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();

    // 1️⃣ Tenant binding
    const tokenTenant = user.tenantId;
    const requestTenant = req.tenant?.id;

    if (!tokenTenant || !requestTenant) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Tenant missing");
    }

    if (tokenTenant !== requestTenant) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Cross-tenant token");
    }

    return user;
  }
}

import { Injectable, UnauthorizedException } from "@nestjs/common";
import { PassportStrategy } from "@nestjs/passport";
import { ExtractJwt, Strategy } from "passport-jwt";
import { ConfigService } from "@nestjs/config";
import { Request } from "express";

/**
 * Cookie extractor for browser clients
 */
const cookieExtractor = (req: Request): string | null => {
  if (req && req.cookies) {
    return req.cookies["access_token"] || null;
  }
  return null;
};

/**
 * JWT Strategy - ONLY validates token signature and expiry
 *
 * Does NOT validate:
 * - Session (SessionGuard does this)
 * - Tenant (TenantBindingGuard does this)
 * - Permissions (PermissionsGuard does this)
 *
 * Supports:
 * - Bearer token (Authorization: Bearer <token>)
 * - HttpOnly cookie (access_token)
 */
@Injectable()
export class JwtStrategy extends PassportStrategy(Strategy) {
  constructor(private configService: ConfigService) {
    super({
      jwtFromRequest: ExtractJwt.fromExtractors([
        ExtractJwt.fromAuthHeaderAsBearerToken(), // Bearer token first
        cookieExtractor, // Cookie fallback
      ]),
      ignoreExpiration: false,
      secretOrKey: configService.getOrThrow("JWT_SECRET"),
    });
  }

  /**
   * Validate JWT payload
   *
   * This runs AFTER signature verification
   * ONLY checks payload structure, NOT business logic
   */
  async validate(payload: any) {
    // Basic payload validation
    if (!payload.sub || !payload.tenantId) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid token payload");
    }

    // Return payload to be attached to request.user
    // Other guards will do additional validation
    return {
      sub: payload.sub,
      email: payload.email,
      tenantId: payload.tenantId,
      sessionId: payload.sessionId,
      iat: payload.iat,
      exp: payload.exp,
    };
  }
}

SIZE: 2.79 KB | LINES: 108

import {
  Injectable,
  CanActivate,
  ExecutionContext,
  UnauthorizedException,
  Logger,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository } from "typeorm";
import { Session } from "@repo/database";

/**
 * SessionGuard
 *
 * ONLY validates session (no tenant checks - TenantBindingGuard does that)
 *
 * Runs AFTER:
 * - JwtAuthGuard (sets req.user)
 * - TenantBindingGuard (validates tenant match)
 */
@Injectable()
export class SessionGuard implements CanActivate {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(SessionGuard.name);

  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Session)
    private readonly sessionRepository: Repository<Session>,
  ) {}

  async canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): Promise<boolean> {
    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();
    const user = request.user;
    const sessionId = user?.sessionId;

    if (!sessionId) {
      this.logger.error("SessionGuard: No sessionId in token payload");
      throw new UnauthorizedException(
        "Invalid token: missing session reference",
      );
    }

    // Fetch session from database
    const session = await this.sessionRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: sessionId },
      select: {
        id: true,
        userId: true,
        tenantId: true,
        revokedAt: true,
        expiresAt: true,
        lastActivity: true,
        ipAddress: true,
        userAgent: true,
        deviceId: true,
        createdAt: true,
      },
    });

    if (!session) {
      this.logger.warn("SessionGuard: Session not found", { sessionId });
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Session not found. Please login again.");
    }

    // Check if session is revoked
    if (session.revokedAt) {
      this.logger.warn("SessionGuard: Session revoked", {
        sessionId,
        revokedAt: session.revokedAt,
      });
      throw new UnauthorizedException(
        "Session has been revoked. Please login again.",
      );
    }

    // Check if session is expired
    if (session.expiresAt && session.expiresAt < new Date()) {
      this.logger.warn("SessionGuard: Session expired", {
        sessionId,
        expiresAt: session.expiresAt,
      });
      throw new UnauthorizedException(
        "Session has expired. Please login again.",
      );
    }

    // Attach session to request
    request.fortknoxSession = session;

    // Update last activity (non-blocking)
    this.updateLastActivity(sessionId).catch((err) => {
      this.logger.error("Failed to update last activity", {
        sessionId,
        error: err.message,
      });
    });

    this.logger.debug("Session validated", { sessionId });

    return true;
  }

  private async updateLastActivity(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.sessionRepository.update(sessionId, {
      lastActivity: new Date(),
    });
  }
}

import {
  Injectable,
  CanActivate,
  ExecutionContext,
  ForbiddenException,
  UnauthorizedException,
  Logger,
} from "@nestjs/common";

/**
 * TenantBindingGuard
 *
 * Enforces that the tenant in the JWT token matches the tenant resolved from the request.
 * This prevents token reuse across tenants (critical for multi-tenant security).
 *
 * MUST run AFTER:
 * - TenantResolverMiddleware (sets req.tenantId)
 * - JwtAuthGuard (validates JWT and sets req.user)
 *
 * Usage:
 * @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, TenantBindingGuard)
 */
@Injectable()
export class TenantBindingGuard implements CanActivate {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(TenantBindingGuard.name);

  canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): boolean {
    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();

    // Step 1: Verify prerequisites
    const requestTenantId = request.tenantId;
    const user = request.user;

    if (!requestTenantId) {
      // This means TenantResolverMiddleware didn't run or failed
      this.logger.error("TenantBindingGuard: No tenantId on request");
      throw new ForbiddenException(
        "Tenant context not found. This route requires tenant resolution.",
      );
    }

    if (!user) {
      // This means JwtAuthGuard didn't run or token is invalid
      this.logger.error("TenantBindingGuard: No user on request");
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Authentication required");
    }

    // Step 2: Extract tenant from token payload
    const tokenTenantId = user.tenantId;

    if (!tokenTenantId) {
      // Token doesn't have tenantId (shouldn't happen with proper token generation)
      this.logger.error("TenantBindingGuard: Token missing tenantId", {
        userId: user.sub,
        email: user.email,
      });
      throw new ForbiddenException("Invalid token: missing tenant context");
    }

    // Step 3: Enforce tenant binding
    if (tokenTenantId !== requestTenantId) {
      this.logger.warn("Tenant binding violation detected", {
        userId: user.sub,
        email: user.email,
        tokenTenant: tokenTenantId,
        requestTenant: requestTenantId,
        ip: request.ip,
        path: request.path,
      });

      throw new ForbiddenException(
        "Token is not valid for this tenant. Please authenticate with the correct tenant.",
      );
    }

    // Step 4: Success - tenant binding is valid
    this.logger.debug("Tenant binding verified", {
      userId: user.sub,
      tenantId: tokenTenantId,
      path: request.path,
    });

    return true;
  }
}

import { CanActivate, ExecutionContext, Injectable } from "@nestjs/common";
import { JwtService } from "@nestjs/jwt";
import { logger } from "../logger";

/**
 * TokenVerificationGuard
 *
 * ⚠️ WARNING: DO NOT USE FOR PROTECTED ROUTES!
 *
 * This guard is ONLY for "optional auth" scenarios where:
 * - Route can work without auth
 * - If token present, validate it
 * - If token missing/invalid, continue without user
 *
 * For PROTECTED routes, use: @UseGuards(FortKnoxProtectedGuard)
 *
 * @deprecated Use FortKnoxProtectedGuard for protected routes
 */
@Injectable()
export class TokenVerificationGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(private readonly jwtService: JwtService) {}

  canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): boolean {
    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();
    const token =
      request.cookies.accessToken ??
      request.headers["x-authorization"] ??
      request.headers["authorization"];

    if (!token) {
      return false;
    }

    try {
      const decoded = this.jwtService.verify(token, {
        secret: process.env.JWT_SECRET,
      });
      if (!decoded) {
        return false;
      }
      request.user = decoded;
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      return false;
    }
  }
}

@Injectable()
/**
 * Add Request User to the request object if present.
 * This guard is used to check if the user is authenticated.
 * If the user is authenticated, the user object is added to the request object.
 * If the user is not authenticated, the request object is not modified.
 * This will NOT block or PROTECT the route.
 *
 * If Protection is required, please use one of the above two Guards.
 */
export class RequestUserGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(private readonly jwtService: JwtService) {}

  canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): boolean {
    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();
    const token =
      request.cookies.accessToken ??
      request.headers["x-authorization"] ??
      request.headers["authorization"];

    try {
      if (token) {
        const decoded = this.jwtService.verify(token, {
          secret: process.env.JWT_SECRET,
        });
        if (decoded) request.user = decoded;
      }
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error({
        message: "Failed to verify token",
        error,
      });
      return true;
    }
  }
}

import {
  Injectable,
  NestInterceptor,
  ExecutionContext,
  CallHandler,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { Observable } from "rxjs";
import { tap } from "rxjs/operators";
import { RedisService } from "@/common/service/redis.service";

const THIRTY_FIVE_DAYS_SECONDS = 35 * 24 * 60 * 60;

/**
 * Increments a per-tenant, per-day API call counter in Redis on every
 * successful request.  Key format (via RedisService.buildKey):
 *   fortknox:t:{tenantId}:api_calls:{YYYY-MM-DD}
 * TTL is set to 35 days from the current date so old keys self-expire.
 */
@Injectable()
export class ApiCallInterceptor implements NestInterceptor {
  constructor(private readonly redisService: RedisService) {}

  intercept(context: ExecutionContext, next: CallHandler): Observable<any> {
    return next.handle().pipe(
      tap(() => {
        const req = context.switchToHttp().getRequest<any>();
        const tenantId: string | undefined = req.tenantId;
        if (!tenantId) return;

        const date = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0] as string;
        const expireAt =
          Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + THIRTY_FIVE_DAYS_SECONDS;

        // Fire-and-forget — counter failures must not affect the response
        this.redisService
          .incr(tenantId, "api_calls", date)
          .then(() =>
            this.redisService.expireAtTimestamp(
              tenantId,
              "api_calls",
              date,
              expireAt,
            ),
          )
          .catch(() => {
            /* swallow */
          });
      }),
    );
  }
}

// apps/auth-service/src/common/middleware/tenant-resolver.middleware.ts
import {
  Injectable,
  NestMiddleware,
  NotFoundException,
  Logger,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from "express";
import { TenantService } from "../../modules/tenant/tenant.service";
import { Tenant } from "@repo/database";

// Extend Express Request to include tenant
declare global {
  namespace Express {
    interface Request {
      tenant?: Tenant;
      tenantId?: string;
    }
  }
}

@Injectable()
export class TenantResolverMiddleware implements NestMiddleware {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(TenantResolverMiddleware.name);

  constructor(private tenantService: TenantService) {}

  async use(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) {
    try {
      const tenant = await this.resolveTenant(req);

      if (!tenant) {
        // Public endpoints (health, metrics) can proceed
        if (this.isPublicEndpoint(req.path)) {
          return next();
        }

        throw new NotFoundException(
          "Tenant not found. Please check your domain or tenant ID.",
        );
      }

      // Attach tenant to request
      req.tenant = tenant;
      req.tenantId = tenant.id;

      // Log for debugging (remove in production)
      this.logger.debug(
        `Resolved tenant: ${tenant.slug} (${tenant.id}) from ${req.hostname}`,
      );

      next();
    } catch (error) {
      next(error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Resolve tenant from request
   * Priority:
   * 1. Custom domain (auth.acme.com)
   * 2. Subdomain (acme.fortknox.io)
   * 3. X-Tenant-ID header (fallback)
   */
  private async resolveTenant(req: Request): Promise<Tenant | null> {
    const hostname = req.hostname;

    // Strategy 1: Custom domain lookup
    // auth.acme.com → check if any tenant has this custom domain
    const customDomainTenant =
      await this.tenantService.findByCustomDomain(hostname);

    if (customDomainTenant) {
      return customDomainTenant;
    }

    // Strategy 2: Subdomain extraction
    // acme.fortknox.io → extract "acme"
    const subdomain = this.extractSubdomain(hostname);

    if (subdomain && subdomain !== "www" && subdomain !== "api") {
      const subdomainTenant = await this.tenantService.findBySlug(subdomain);

      if (subdomainTenant) {
        return subdomainTenant;
      }
    }

    // Strategy 3: X-Tenant-ID header (for development/testing)
    const tenantIdHeader = req.headers["x-tenant-id"] as string;

    if (tenantIdHeader) {
      // Try as ID first
      let tenant = await this.tenantService.findById(tenantIdHeader);

      // Try as slug if ID lookup fails
      if (!tenant) {
        tenant = await this.tenantService.findBySlug(tenantIdHeader);
      }

      if (tenant) {
        return tenant;
      }
    }

    return null;
  }

  /**
   * Extract subdomain from hostname
   * Examples:
   * - acme.fortknox.io → "acme"
   * - auth.acme.com → "auth"
   * - localhost:4000 → null
   */
  private extractSubdomain(hostname: string): string | null {
    // Remove port if present
    const host: string = hostname.split(":")[0] as string;

    // Localhost or IP address
    if (host === "localhost" || /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(host)) {
      return null;
    }

    const parts = host.split(".");

    // Need at least 3 parts for subdomain (sub.domain.tld)
    if (parts.length < 3) {
      return null;
    }

    // Return first part as subdomain
    return parts[0] as string;
  }

  /**
   * Check if endpoint is public (doesn't require tenant)
   */
  private isPublicEndpoint(path: string): boolean {
    const publicPaths = ["/health", "/metrics", "/.well-known", "/favicon.ico"];

    return publicPaths.some((publicPath) => path.startsWith(publicPath));
  }
}

import { Injectable, OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy } from "@nestjs/common";
import { ConfigService } from "@nestjs/config";
import Redis from "ioredis";

@Injectable()
export class RedisService implements OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy {
  private client: Redis;
  private keyPrefix: string;

  constructor(private configService: ConfigService) {
    this.keyPrefix =
      this.configService.get("REDIS_KEY_PREFIX", "fortknox") + ":";
  }

  async onModuleInit() {
    this.client = new Redis({
      host: this.configService.get("REDIS_HOST", "localhost"),
      port: this.configService.get("REDIS_PORT", 6379),
      password: this.configService.get("REDIS_PASSWORD") || undefined,
      db: this.configService.get("REDIS_DB", 0),
      retryStrategy: (times) => {
        const delay = Math.min(times * 50, 2000);
        return delay;
      },
      maxRetriesPerRequest: 3,
    });

    this.client.on("connect", () => {
      console.log("✅ Redis connected");
    });

    this.client.on("error", (err) => {
      console.error("❌ Redis error:", err);
    });
  }

  async onModuleDestroy() {
    await this.client.quit();
  }

  /**
   * Build tenant-scoped key
   * Format: fortknox:t:{tenantId}:{resource}:{identifier}
   */
  private buildKey(
    tenantId: string,
    resource: string,
    identifier: string,
  ): string {
    return `${this.keyPrefix}t:${tenantId}:${resource}:${identifier}`;
  }

  /**
   * Set value with optional TTL
   */
  async set(
    tenantId: string,
    resource: string,
    identifier: string,
    value: any,
    ttl?: number,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const key = this.buildKey(tenantId, resource, identifier);
    const serialized = JSON.stringify(value);

    if (ttl) {
      await this.client.setex(key, ttl, serialized);
    } else {
      await this.client.set(key, serialized);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get value
   */
  async get<T>(
    tenantId: string,
    resource: string,
    identifier: string,
  ): Promise<T | null> {
    const key = this.buildKey(tenantId, resource, identifier);
    const value = await this.client.get(key);

    if (!value) return null;

    try {
      return JSON.parse(value) as T;
    } catch {
      return value as any;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Delete value
   */
  async delete(
    tenantId: string,
    resource: string,
    identifier: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const key = this.buildKey(tenantId, resource, identifier);
    await this.client.del(key);
  }

  /**
   * Delete multiple keys by pattern
   */
  async deletePattern(tenantId: string, pattern: string): Promise<number> {
    const fullPattern = `${this.keyPrefix}t:${tenantId}:${pattern}`;
    const keys = await this.client.keys(fullPattern);

    if (keys.length === 0) return 0;

    return await this.client.del(...keys);
  }

  /**
   * Check if key exists
   */
  async exists(
    tenantId: string,
    resource: string,
    identifier: string,
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const key = this.buildKey(tenantId, resource, identifier);
    const result = await this.client.exists(key);
    return result === 1;
  }

  /**
   * Get TTL (time to live) in seconds
   */
  async getTTL(
    tenantId: string,
    resource: string,
    identifier: string,
  ): Promise<number> {
    const key = this.buildKey(tenantId, resource, identifier);
    return await this.client.ttl(key);
  }

  /**
   * Extend TTL
   */
  async extendTTL(
    tenantId: string,
    resource: string,
    identifier: string,
    ttl: number,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const key = this.buildKey(tenantId, resource, identifier);
    await this.client.expire(key, ttl);
  }

  /**
   * Increment integer counter and return new value
   */
  async incr(
    tenantId: string,
    resource: string,
    identifier: string,
  ): Promise<number> {
    const key = this.buildKey(tenantId, resource, identifier);
    return this.client.incr(key);
  }

  /**
   * Set expiry as an absolute Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch)
   */
  async expireAtTimestamp(
    tenantId: string,
    resource: string,
    identifier: string,
    unixTimestamp: number,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const key = this.buildKey(tenantId, resource, identifier);
    await this.client.expireat(key, unixTimestamp);
  }

  /**
   * Read multiple daily api_call counters for a tenant.
   * Returns counts in the same order as the provided dates array.
   */
  async getDailyApiCallCounts(
    tenantId: string,
    dates: string[],
  ): Promise<number[]> {
    if (dates.length === 0) return [];
    const keys = dates.map((date) =>
      this.buildKey(tenantId, "api_calls", date),
    );
    const values = await this.client.mget(...keys);
    return values.map((v) => (v ? parseInt(v, 10) : 0));
  }
}
