import { SecurityEventService } from "./security-event.service";

const { sanitizeMetadata } = SecurityEventService;

describe("SecurityEventService.sanitizeMetadata", () => {
  // ── Identity / pass-through ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  it("returns the same keys when no sensitive key is present", () => {
    const input = { userId: "abc", reason: "test", count: 3 };
    expect(sanitizeMetadata(input)).toEqual(input);
  });

  it("preserves boolean, number, null and array values", () => {
    const input = { ok: true, n: 42, nil: null, arr: [1, 2, 3] };
    expect(sanitizeMetadata(input)).toEqual(input);
  });

  // ── Exact sensitive key names ────────────────────────────────────────────

  it("strips a key named exactly 'password'", () => {
    const result = sanitizeMetadata({ password: "s3cr3t", email: "x@y.com" });
    expect(result).not.toHaveProperty("password");
    expect(result).toHaveProperty("email", "x@y.com");
  });

  it("strips a key named exactly 'secret'", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata({ secret: "abc" })).toEqual({});
  });

  it("strips a key named exactly 'token'", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata({ token: "jwt...." })).toEqual({});
  });

  it("strips a key named exactly 'hash'", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata({ hash: "sha256..." })).toEqual({});
  });

  it("strips a key named exactly 'key'", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata({ key: "apikey123" })).toEqual({});
  });

  it("strips a key named exactly 'credential'", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata({ credential: "cred" })).toEqual({});
  });

  it("strips a key named exactly 'private'", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata({ private: "data" })).toEqual({});
  });

  // ── Substring / compound key names ─────────────────────────────────────

  it("strips 'passwordHash' (contains 'password')", () => {
    const result = sanitizeMetadata({ passwordHash: "argon2...", id: "1" });
    expect(result).not.toHaveProperty("passwordHash");
    expect(result).toHaveProperty("id", "1");
  });

  it("strips 'refreshToken' (contains 'token')", () => {
    const result = sanitizeMetadata({ refreshToken: "rt...", userId: "u1" });
    expect(result).not.toHaveProperty("refreshToken");
    expect(result).toHaveProperty("userId", "u1");
  });

  it("strips 'apiKey' (contains 'key')", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata({ apiKey: "key123" })).toEqual({});
  });

  it("strips 'clientSecret' (contains 'secret')", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata({ clientSecret: "s" })).toEqual({});
  });

  it("strips 'privateKey' (contains 'private' AND 'key')", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata({ privateKey: "pk..." })).toEqual({});
  });

  it("strips 'credentials' (contains 'credential')", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata({ credentials: {} })).toEqual({});
  });

  // ── Case-insensitive matching ─────────────────────────────────────────

  it("strips 'PASSWORD' (upper-case)", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata({ PASSWORD: "X" })).toEqual({});
  });

  it("strips 'Token' (mixed case)", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata({ Token: "X" })).toEqual({});
  });

  it("strips 'ACCESS_TOKEN' (snake-case upper)", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata({ ACCESS_TOKEN: "X", ok: 1 })).toEqual({ ok: 1 });
  });

  // ── Recursive / nested objects ────────────────────────────────────────

  it("strips sensitive keys inside a nested object", () => {
    const input = {
      meta: {
        password: "hidden",
        sessionId: "s1",
      },
      outer: "ok",
    };
    expect(sanitizeMetadata(input)).toEqual({
      meta: { sessionId: "s1" },
      outer: "ok",
    });
  });

  it("strips deeply nested sensitive keys", () => {
    const input = {
      level1: {
        level2: {
          apiKey: "secret",
          allowed: true,
        },
      },
    };
    expect(sanitizeMetadata(input)).toEqual({
      level1: { level2: { allowed: true } },
    });
  });

  it("keeps arrays inside nested objects without inspecting their elements", () => {
    const input = {
      items: [{ password: "should not be stripped" }],
      safe: "yes",
    };
    const result = sanitizeMetadata(input);
    expect(result).toHaveProperty("safe", "yes");
    // Arrays are preserved as-is
    expect(result.items).toEqual([{ password: "should not be stripped" }]);
  });

  // ── Edge cases ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  it("returns {} for null input", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata(null)).toEqual({});
  });

  it("returns {} for a primitive string input", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata("string")).toEqual({});
  });

  it("returns {} for a number input", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata(42)).toEqual({});
  });

  it("returns {} for an array input (not an object)", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata([1, 2, 3])).toEqual({});
  });

  it("returns {} for an empty object", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata({})).toEqual({});
  });

  it("returns {} for undefined input", () => {
    expect(sanitizeMetadata(undefined)).toEqual({});
  });

  it("does not mutate the original object", () => {
    const original = { password: "secret", safe: "value" };
    const copy = { ...original };
    sanitizeMetadata(original);
    expect(original).toEqual(copy);
  });

  // ── Real-world payload examples ───────────────────────────────────────

  it("sanitizes a real login-failed metadata payload that leaks password", () => {
    const payload = {
      email: "user@example.com",
      reason: "invalid_password",
      password: "SuperSecret123!",       // leaked — must be stripped
      passwordHash: "argon2...",          // leaked — must be stripped
    };
    const result = sanitizeMetadata(payload);
    expect(result).toEqual({
      email: "user@example.com",
      reason: "invalid_password",
    });
  });

  it("sanitizes OAuth metadata that contains tokens", () => {
    const payload = {
      provider: "google",
      accessToken: "ya29.xxx",
      refreshToken: "1//xxx",
      tokenExpiry: 3600,
      userId: "u123",
    };
    const result = sanitizeMetadata(payload);
    expect(result).toEqual({
      provider: "google",
      tokenExpiry: 3600,
      userId: "u123",
    });
  });

  it("sanitizes email-sent metadata (no sensitive fields expected)", () => {
    const payload = {
      emailType: "password_reset",
      recipient: "user@example.com",
      provider: "ses",
      success: true,
      duration: 120,
    };
    // None of these keys are sensitive; all should pass through
    expect(sanitizeMetadata(payload)).toEqual(payload);
  });

import { Injectable, Logger } from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository } from "typeorm";
import { SecurityEvent, SecurityEventType } from "@repo/database";

export interface LogSecurityEventDto {
  tenantId: string;
  eventType: SecurityEventType;
  severity: "info" | "warning" | "critical";
  ipAddress: string;
  userAgent: string;
  userId?: string;
  /** Denormalized copy of the actor email at event time (survives user deletion). */
  actorEmail?: string;
  /** OAuth client that triggered this event. */
  applicationId?: string;
  /** ID of the affected entity (sessionId, apiKeyId, userId being modified, …). */
  resourceId?: string;
  /** Type of the affected entity: 'session', 'user', 'api_key', … */
  resourceType?: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

/**
 * SecurityEventService
 *
 * Single write-layer for all security audit events.
 *
 * Key guarantees:
 * 1. log() is **fire-and-forget** — it never throws to the caller.
 *    A DB failure emits a structured WARN log instead of propagating.
 * 2. sanitizeMetadata() recursively strips any key whose name
 *    (case-insensitive) contains: password | secret | token | hash | key |
 *    credential | private — so raw sensitive values never reach the DB.
 */
@Injectable()
export class SecurityEventService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(SecurityEventService.name);

  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(SecurityEvent)
    private readonly securityEventRepository: Repository<SecurityEvent>,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Fire-and-forget security event log.
   * Returns void; DB failures are swallowed and emitted as warnings.
   */
  log(data: LogSecurityEventDto): void {
    this.persist(data).catch((err: unknown) => {
      this.logger.warn("[SecurityEvent] Failed to persist audit event", {
        eventType: data.eventType,
        tenantId: data.tenantId,
        userId: data.userId,
        error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
      });
    });
  }

  private async persist(data: LogSecurityEventDto): Promise<void> {
    await this.securityEventRepository.save({
      tenantId: data.tenantId,
      userId: data.userId,
      eventType: data.eventType,
      severity: data.severity,
      ipAddress: data.ipAddress || "0.0.0.0",
      userAgent: data.userAgent || "unknown",
      metadata: SecurityEventService.sanitizeMetadata(data.metadata ?? {}),
      actorEmail: data.actorEmail,
      applicationId: data.applicationId,
      resourceId: data.resourceId,
      resourceType: data.resourceType,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Recursively strips object keys whose name (case-insensitive) contains any
   * of the following substrings:
   *   password · secret · token · hash · key · credential · private
   *
   * Arrays are preserved as-is (their elements are not inspected).
   * Non-object inputs return an empty object.
   *
   * This is a pure function — no side effects.
   */
  static sanitizeMetadata(obj: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
    if (typeof obj !== "object" || obj === null || Array.isArray(obj)) {
      return {};
    }

    const SENSITIVE = /password|secret|token|hash|key|credential|private/i;
    const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};

    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj as Record<string, unknown>)) {
      if (SENSITIVE.test(k)) {
        continue;
      }

      if (typeof v === "object" && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v)) {
        result[k] = SecurityEventService.sanitizeMetadata(v);
      } else {
        result[k] = v;
      }
    }

    return result;
  }
}

import { Injectable } from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository, IsNull } from "typeorm";
import { Session } from "@repo/database";
import { RedisService } from "./redis.service";
import { ConfigService } from "@nestjs/config";

export interface SessionData {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  tenantId: string;
  email: string;
  refreshTokenFamilyId: string;
  ipAddress?: string;
  userAgent?: string;
  deviceId?: string;
  createdAt: Date;
  expiresAt: Date;
}

@Injectable()
export class SessionService {
  private sessionTTL: number;

  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Session)
    private sessionRepository: Repository<Session>,
    private redisService: RedisService,
    private configService: ConfigService,
  ) {
    this.sessionTTL = this.configService.get("SESSION_TTL", 604800); // 7 days
  }

  /**
   * Create session (PostgreSQL + Redis)
   */
  async createSession(data: {
    userId: string;
    tenantId: string;
    email: string;
    refreshTokenFamilyId?: string;
    refreshTokenHash?: string;
    ipAddress?: string;
    userAgent?: string;
    deviceId?: string;
  }): Promise<Session> {
    // 1. Create in PostgreSQL (permanent record)
    const session = await this.sessionRepository.save({
      userId: data.userId,
      tenantId: data.tenantId,
      refreshTokenFamilyId: data.refreshTokenFamilyId,
      refreshTokenHash: data.refreshTokenHash,
      ipAddress: data.ipAddress,
      userAgent: data.userAgent,
      deviceId: data.deviceId,
      lastActivity: new Date(),
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + this.sessionTTL * 1000),
    });

    // 2. Store in Redis (fast lookup)
    const sessionData: SessionData = {
      id: session.id,
      userId: session.userId,
      tenantId: session.tenantId,
      email: data.email,
      refreshTokenFamilyId: session.refreshTokenFamilyId!,
      ipAddress: session.ipAddress,
      userAgent: session.userAgent,
      deviceId: session.deviceId,
      createdAt: session.createdAt,
      expiresAt: session.expiresAt!,
    };

    await this.redisService.set(
      data.tenantId,
      "session",
      session.id,
      sessionData,
      this.sessionTTL,
    );

    console.log(`✅ Session created: ${session.id} (PostgreSQL + Redis)`);

    return session;
  }

  /**
   * Validate session (Redis first, PostgreSQL fallback)
   */
  async validateSession(
    tenantId: string,
    sessionId: string,
  ): Promise<SessionData | null> {
    // 1. Try Redis first (fast path)
    const cached = await this.redisService.get<SessionData>(
      tenantId,
      "session",
      sessionId,
    );

    if (cached) {
      // Check expiry
      if (new Date(cached.expiresAt) < new Date()) {
        // Expired - remove from Redis
        await this.redisService.delete(tenantId, "session", sessionId);
        return null;
      }

      // Extend activity (update TTL)
      await this.redisService.extendTTL(
        tenantId,
        "session",
        sessionId,
        this.sessionTTL,
      );

      return cached;
    }

    // 2. Fallback to PostgreSQL (cache miss)
    const session = await this.sessionRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        id: sessionId,
        tenantId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
      relations: ["user"],
    });

    if (!session) {
      return null;
    }

    // Check expiry
    if (session.expiresAt && session.expiresAt < new Date()) {
      return null;
    }

    // Rebuild cache
    const sessionData: SessionData = {
      id: session.id,
      userId: session.userId,
      tenantId: session.tenantId,
      email: session.user.email,
      refreshTokenFamilyId: session.refreshTokenFamilyId!,
      ipAddress: session.ipAddress,
      userAgent: session.userAgent,
      deviceId: session.deviceId,
      createdAt: session.createdAt,
      expiresAt: session.expiresAt!,
    };

    // Cache it
    await this.redisService.set(
      tenantId,
      "session",
      sessionId,
      sessionData,
      this.sessionTTL,
    );

    // Update last activity in DB (async, don't wait)
    this.sessionRepository
      .update(sessionId, { lastActivity: new Date() })
      .catch(console.error);

    return sessionData;
  }

  /**
   * Revoke session (PostgreSQL + Redis)
   */
  async revokeSession(
    tenantId: string,
    sessionId: string,
    reason: string = "user_logout",
  ): Promise<void> {
    // 1. Update PostgreSQL
    await this.sessionRepository.update(
      { id: sessionId, tenantId },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: reason,
        refreshTokenHash: null as unknown as string,
      },
    );

    // 2. Remove from Redis
    await this.redisService.delete(tenantId, "session", sessionId);

    console.log(`🔒 Session revoked: ${sessionId} (${reason})`);
  }

  /**
   * Revoke all user sessions (PostgreSQL + Redis)
   */
  async revokeAllUserSessions(
    tenantId: string,
    userId: string,
    reason: string = "user_logout_all",
  ): Promise<void> {
    // 1. Get all active sessions
    const sessions = await this.sessionRepository.find({
      where: {
        userId,
        tenantId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
    });

    // 2. Revoke in PostgreSQL
    await this.sessionRepository.update(
      { userId, tenantId, revokedAt: IsNull() },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: reason,
        refreshTokenHash: null as unknown as string,
      },
    );

    // 3. Remove from Redis
    for (const session of sessions) {
      await this.redisService.delete(tenantId, "session", session.id);
    }

    console.log(`🔒 All sessions revoked for user: ${userId}`);
  }

  /**
   * Revoke session family (token reuse detected)
   */
  async revokeSessionFamily(tenantId: string, familyId: string): Promise<void> {
    // 1. Get all sessions in family
    const sessions = await this.sessionRepository.find({
      where: {
        refreshTokenFamilyId: familyId,
        tenantId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
    });

    // 2. Revoke in PostgreSQL
    await this.sessionRepository.update(
      { refreshTokenFamilyId: familyId, tenantId },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: "token_reuse_detected",
      },
    );

    // 3. Remove from Redis
    for (const session of sessions) {
      await this.redisService.delete(tenantId, "session", session.id);
    }

    console.log(`🚨 Session family revoked: ${familyId}`);
  }

  /**
   * Update refresh token (rotation)
   */
  async updateRefreshToken(
    tenantId: string,
    sessionId: string,
    newRefreshTokenHash: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    // 1. Update PostgreSQL
    await this.sessionRepository.update(
      { id: sessionId, tenantId },
      {
        refreshTokenHash: newRefreshTokenHash,
        lastRefreshAt: new Date(),
        lastActivity: new Date(),
      },
    );

    // 2. Extend Redis TTL (session is being used)
    await this.redisService.extendTTL(
      tenantId,
      "session",
      sessionId,
      this.sessionTTL,
    );

    console.log(`🔄 Refresh token rotated: ${sessionId}`);
  }

  /**
   * Get active sessions for user
   */
  async getUserSessions(tenantId: string, userId: string): Promise<Session[]> {
    return this.sessionRepository.find({
      where: {
        userId,
        tenantId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
      order: {
        lastActivity: "DESC",
      },
    });
  }
}

export const validationSchema = Joi.object({

    .valid('development', 'test', 'production')
    .default('development'),
  PORT: Joi.number().port().default(4000),

  ISSUER_BASE_URL: Joi.string()
    .uri({ scheme: ['http', 'https'] })
    .required(),
  TENANT_RESOLUTION: Joi.string().valid('path', 'subdomain').default('path'),

  JWT_ALG: Joi.string().valid('RS256', 'EdDSA').default('RS256'),
  JWKS_CACHE_SECONDS: Joi.number().integer().min(0).default(300),

  KEYRING_MASTER_KEY: Joi.string().base64().length(44).required(), // 32 bytes (base64 => 44 chars)

  DB_URL: Joi.string()
    .uri({ scheme: ['postgres', 'postgresql'] })
    .required(),
  DB_SSL: Joi.string()
    .valid('true', 'false', '1', '0', 'yes', 'no', 'on', 'off')
    .default('false'),
  DB_LOGGING: Joi.string()
    .valid('true', 'false', '1', '0', 'yes', 'no', 'on', 'off')
    .default('false'),

  REDIS_HOST: Joi.string().default('localhost'),
  REDIS_PORT: Joi.number().integer().min(1).default(6379),
  REDIS_USERNAME: Joi.string().allow(''),
  REDIS_PASSWORD: Joi.string().allow(''),
});

import { Module, ValidationPipe } from "@nestjs/common";
import { NestFactory } from "@nestjs/core";
import { AppApiModule } from "./modules/app-module";
import { DocumentBuilder, SwaggerModule } from "@nestjs/swagger";
import { logger } from "src/common/logger";
import { ResponseInterceptor } from "src/common/interceptors/response.interceptors";
import { saveApiDoc } from "./services/utility/utility.service";
import { ALLOWED_URLS } from "../common/constants";
import cookieParser from "cookie-parser";
import session from "express-session";

@Module({
  imports: [],
})
export class AppModule {
  static async startApp(): Promise<void> {
    const app = await NestFactory.create(AppApiModule, { bufferLogs: true });
    app.enableCors({
      origin: (origin: any, cb: any) => {
        // allow non-browser calls (curl/postman/server-to-server)
        if (!origin) return cb(null, true);

        const allowed = ALLOWED_URLS.includes(origin);
        return allowed
          ? cb(null, true)
          : cb(new Error(`CORS blocked for origin: ${origin}`), false);
      },
      credentials: true,
      methods: "GET,HEAD,PUT,PATCH,POST,DELETE,OPTIONS",
      allowedHeaders: [
        "Content-Type",
        "Authorization",
        "X-Requested-With",
        "x-tenant-id",
        "x-authorization",
        "x-csrf-token",
      ],
      exposedHeaders: ["set-cookie"],
      optionsSuccessStatus: 204,
    });

    app.use((req: any, _res: any, next: any) => {
      if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
        console.log("Preflight:", {
          origin: req.headers.origin,
          acrm: req.headers["access-control-request-method"],
          acrh: req.headers["access-control-request-headers"],
          path: req.path,
        });
      }
      next();
    });
    
    app.useGlobalPipes(
      new ValidationPipe({
        whitelist: true,
        transform: true,
      }),
    );

    const config = new DocumentBuilder()
      .setTitle("identity-server")
      .setDescription("API for Identity Server")
      .setVersion("1.0")
      .setExternalDoc("Sample", "https://id.sample.com")
      .addBearerAuth()
      .build();

    const documentForGeneralApis = SwaggerModule.createDocument(app, config);

    SwaggerModule.setup("api-docs", app, documentForGeneralApis);
    saveApiDoc("api-docs", documentForGeneralApis, "nest-be");

    if (app) {
      logger.info("Application started successfully");
      logger.info(`Application is running on: ${process.env.PORT}`);
      app.useGlobalInterceptors(new ResponseInterceptor());
      app.use(cookieParser());
      // app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
      app.use(
        session({
          secret: "nest-session-secret",
          resave: false,
          saveUninitialized: false,
        }),
      );
      await app.listen(process.env.PORT || 4000);
    }
  }
}

import { Injectable } from "@nestjs/common";
import Redis from "ioredis";
import { CacheTTL } from "@/common/constants/cache";

type RedisConfig = {
  host: string;
  port: number;
  username?: string;
  password?: string;
};

@Injectable()
export class RedisCacheService {
  private readonly redis: Redis;

  constructor() {
    this.redis = new Redis(RedisCacheService.getConfig());
  }

  static getConfig() {
    const config: RedisConfig = {
      host: process.env.REDIS_HOST || "localhost",
      port: parseInt(process.env.REDIS_PORT || "6379", 10),
    };
    if (process.env.REDIS_USERNAME) {
      config.username = process.env.REDIS_USERNAME;
    }

    if (process.env.REDIS_PASSWORD) {
      config.password = process.env.REDIS_PASSWORD;
    }

    return config;
  }

  async get<T>(key: string): Promise<T | null> {
    const value = await this.redis.get(key);
    return value ? JSON.parse(value) : null;
  }

  async set(key: string, value: unknown, ttlSeconds = CacheTTL.threeDays) {
    await this.redis.set(key, JSON.stringify(value), "EX", ttlSeconds);
  }

  async update(key: string, value: unknown) {
    await this.redis.set(key, JSON.stringify(value), "KEEPTTL");
  }

  async del(key: string) {
    await this.redis.del(key);
  }

  async flush() {
    await this.redis.flushall();
  }

  async deleteByPattern(pattern: string): Promise<string[]> {
    const keys = await this.redis.keys(pattern);
    if (keys.length) await this.redis.del(...keys);
    return keys;
  }
}

      isGlobal: true,
      envFilePath: [".env"],
      validationSchema,

    TenantModule,

    // Cache (Redis)

      imports: [ConfigModule],

            ? { rejectUnauthorized: false }

      }),

import { Injectable } from "@nestjs/common";
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "fs";

@Injectable()
export class UtilityService {}

export function saveApiDoc(
  fileName: string,
  document: any,
  folderName: string,
) {
  const dir = `./api-management/${folderName}`;
  if (!existsSync(dir)) {
    mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  }
  writeFileSync(`${dir}/${fileName}.yaml`, JSON.stringify(document, null, 2));
}

// apps/auth-service/src/modules/oauth/scripts/seed-oauth-client.ts

import { NestFactory } from "@nestjs/core";
import { AppModule } from "@/core/app.module";
import { OAuthClientService } from "@/modules/oauth/services/oauth-client.service";

/**
 * Seed first-party OAuth client for Fort Knox Admin Portal
 */
async function seedOAuthClient() {
  const app = await NestFactory.createApplicationContext(AppModule);

  const clientService = app.get(OAuthClientService);

  // Get default tenant ID (you may need to query this)
  const tenantId = "your-tenant-id-here"; // TODO: Get from database

  try {
    // Create Fort Knox Admin Portal client
    const { client, clientSecret } = await clientService.createClient({
      tenantId,
      name: "Fort Knox Admin Portal",
      description: "First-party admin portal for Fort Knox",
      clientType: "public", // SPA doesn't have server
      grantTypes: ["authorization_code", "refresh_token"],
      redirectUris: [
        "http://localhost:3000/callback",
        "http://localhost:3000/auth/callback",
        "https://admin.fortknox.io/callback",
      ],
      postLogoutRedirectUris: [
        "http://localhost:3000",
        "https://admin.fortknox.io",
      ],
      allowedOrigins: ["http://localhost:3000", "https://admin.fortknox.io"],
      allowedScopes: ["openid", "profile", "email", "offline_access"],
      defaultScopes: ["openid", "profile", "email"],
      requirePkce: true, // MUST for public clients
      requireConsent: false, // First-party app
      isFirstParty: true,
      accessTokenTtl: 900, // 15 minutes
      refreshTokenTtl: 604800, // 7 days
      idTokenTtl: 3600, // 1 hour
    });

    console.log("✅ Created Fort Knox Admin Portal client:");
    console.log("   Client ID:", client.clientId);
    console.log("   Client Type:", client.clientType);
    console.log("   Grant Types:", client.grantTypes);
    console.log("   Redirect URIs:", client.redirectUris);
    console.log("   Require PKCE:", client.requirePkce);

    // Create a confidential client for testing
    const { client: backendClient, clientSecret: backendSecret } =
      await clientService.createClient({
        tenantId,
        name: "Fort Knox Backend Service",
        description: "Backend service for machine-to-machine auth",
        clientType: "confidential",
        grantTypes: ["client_credentials"],
        redirectUris: [], // Not needed for M2M
        allowedScopes: ["users:read", "users:write", "api:read", "api:write"],
        defaultScopes: ["users:read", "api:read"],
        requirePkce: false,
        requireConsent: false,
        isFirstParty: true,
        accessTokenTtl: 3600, // 1 hour for M2M
      });

    console.log("\n✅ Created Fort Knox Backend Service client:");
    console.log("   Client ID:", backendClient.clientId);
    console.log("   Client Secret:", backendSecret);
    console.log("   ⚠️  SAVE THIS SECRET - IT WILL NOT BE SHOWN AGAIN!");
    console.log("   Client Type:", backendClient.clientType);
    console.log("   Grant Types:", backendClient.grantTypes);

    // Create a third-party client example
    const { client: thirdPartyClient, clientSecret: thirdPartySecret } =
      await clientService.createClient({
        tenantId,
        name: "Example Third-Party App",
        description: "Example third-party application",
        logoUrl: "https://example.com/logo.png",
        websiteUrl: "https://example.com",
        privacyPolicyUrl: "https://example.com/privacy",
        termsOfServiceUrl: "https://example.com/terms",
        clientType: "confidential",
        grantTypes: ["authorization_code", "refresh_token"],
        redirectUris: ["https://example.com/callback"],
        allowedScopes: ["openid", "profile", "email"],
        requirePkce: false,
        requireConsent: true, // Third-party MUST show consent
        isFirstParty: false,
        accessTokenTtl: 900,
        refreshTokenTtl: 604800,
      });

    console.log("\n✅ Created Example Third-Party App client:");
    console.log("   Client ID:", thirdPartyClient.clientId);
    console.log("   Client Secret:", thirdPartySecret);
    console.log("   Client Type:", thirdPartyClient.clientType);
    console.log("   Require Consent:", thirdPartyClient.requireConsent);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("❌ Error seeding OAuth clients:", error);
  }

  await app.close();
}

// Run seed
seedOAuthClient()
  .then(() => {
    console.log("\n✅ OAuth client seeding complete");
    process.exit(0);
  })
  .catch((error) => {
    console.error("❌ Fatal error:", error);
    process.exit(1);
  });

WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE slug = 'nexatech')

import { DataSource } from "typeorm";
import { Tenant, Role, Permission } from "@repo/database";
import * as crypto from "crypto";

export async function seed() {
  // Connect to database
  const dataSource = new DataSource({
    type: "postgres",
    url: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
    entities: [Tenant, Role, Permission],
    ssl:
      process.env.DATABASE_SSL === "true"
        ? { rejectUnauthorized: false }
        : false,
  });

  await dataSource.initialize();
  console.log("🔌 Connected to database");

  try {
    // ==================================================
    // 1. Seed Tenants
    // ==================================================
    console.log("🏢 Seeding tenants...");

    const tenants = [
      {
        name: "Default Organization",
        slug: "default",
        subdomain: "default",
        status: "active",
        plan: "free",
        settings: {},
        featureFlags: {
          mfaRequired: false,
          passwordlessEnabled: true,
          socialProvidersEnabled: true,
        },
        isActive: true,
        environment: "production",
      },
      {
        name: "Acme Corporation",
        slug: "acme",
        subdomain: "acme",
        customDomain: "auth.acme.com",
        customDomainVerified: false,
        status: "active",
        plan: "professional",
        settings: {
          branding: {
            logo: "https://acme.com/logo.png",
            primaryColor: "#FF6B35",
          },
        },
        featureFlags: {
          mfaRequired: true,
          passwordlessEnabled: true,
          socialProvidersEnabled: true,
          samlEnabled: true,
        },
        isActive: true,
        environment: "production",
      },
      {
        name: "Startup Inc",
        slug: "startup",
        subdomain: "startup",
        status: "trial",
        plan: "starter",
        settings: {
          allowSignup: true,
          requireEmailVerification: true,
          mfaRequired: true,
        },
        featureFlags: {
          mfaRequired: false,
          passwordlessEnabled: false,
          socialProvidersEnabled: true,
        },
        isActive: true,
        environment: "production",
        trialEndsAt: new Date(Date.now() + 14 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000), // 14 days
      },
    ];

    const tenantRepo = dataSource.getRepository(Tenant);

    for (const tenantData of tenants) {
      const existing = await tenantRepo.findOne({
        where: { slug: tenantData.slug },
      });
      if (!existing) {
        const tenant = tenantRepo.create(tenantData);
        await tenantRepo.save(tenant);
        console.log(`  ✅ Created tenant: ${tenant.name} (${tenant.slug})`);
      } else {
        console.log(`  ⏭️  Tenant exists: ${existing.name}`);
      }
    }

    // ==================================================
    // 2. Seed Roles (per tenant)
    // ==================================================
    console.log("👥 Seeding roles...");

    const allTenants = await tenantRepo.find();
    const roleRepo = dataSource.getRepository(Role);

    const systemRoles = [
      {
        name: "Owner",
        description: "Full access to everything in the organization",
        isSystem: true,
      },
      {
        name: "Admin",
        description: "Administrative access with some limitations",
        isSystem: true,
      },
      {
        name: "Member",
        description: "Basic member access",
        isSystem: true,
      },
      {
        name: "Developer",
        description: "Access to API keys and developer tools",
        isSystem: false,
      },
      {
        name: "Viewer",
        description: "Read-only access",
        isSystem: false,
      },
    ];

    for (const tenant of allTenants) {
      for (const roleData of systemRoles) {
        const existing = await roleRepo.findOne({
          where: { name: roleData.name, tenantId: tenant.id },
        });

        if (!existing) {
          const role = roleRepo.create({
            ...roleData,
            tenantId: tenant.id,
          });
          await roleRepo.save(role);
          console.log(`  ✅ Created role: ${tenant.slug}/${role.name}`);
        }
      }
    }

    // ==================================================
    // 3. Seed Permissions (per tenant)
    // ==================================================
    console.log("🔐 Seeding permissions...");

    const permissionRepo = dataSource.getRepository(Permission);

    const basePermissions = [
      // User management
      { resource: "user", action: "create", description: "Create users" },
      { resource: "user", action: "read", description: "View users" },
      { resource: "user", action: "update", description: "Update users" },
      { resource: "user", action: "delete", description: "Delete users" },
      {
        resource: "user",
        action: "impersonate",
        description: "Impersonate users",
      },

      // Role management
      { resource: "role", action: "create", description: "Create roles" },
      { resource: "role", action: "read", description: "View roles" },
      { resource: "role", action: "update", description: "Update roles" },
      { resource: "role", action: "delete", description: "Delete roles" },
      {
        resource: "role",
        action: "assign",
        description: "Assign roles to users",
      },

      // Permission management
      {
        resource: "permission",
        action: "read",
        description: "View permissions",
      },
      {
        resource: "permission",
        action: "assign",
        description: "Assign permissions to roles",
      },

      // Tenant management
      {
        resource: "tenant",
        action: "read",
        description: "View tenant settings",
      },
      {
        resource: "tenant",
        action: "update",
        description: "Update tenant settings",
      },
      { resource: "tenant", action: "delete", description: "Delete tenant" },

      // OAuth client management
      {
        resource: "oauth_client",
        action: "create",
        description: "Create OAuth clients",
      },
      {
        resource: "oauth_client",
        action: "read",
        description: "View OAuth clients",
      },
      {
        resource: "oauth_client",
        action: "update",
        description: "Update OAuth clients",
      },
      {
        resource: "oauth_client",
        action: "delete",
        description: "Delete OAuth clients",
      },

      // Provider management
      {
        resource: "provider",
        action: "create",
        description: "Add identity providers",
      },
      {
        resource: "provider",
        action: "read",
        description: "View identity providers",
      },
      {
        resource: "provider",
        action: "update",
        description: "Update identity providers",
      },
      {
        resource: "provider",
        action: "delete",
        description: "Remove identity providers",
      },

      // Audit logs
      { resource: "audit", action: "read", description: "View audit logs" },
      { resource: "audit", action: "export", description: "Export audit logs" },

      // Settings
      { resource: "settings", action: "read", description: "View settings" },
      {
        resource: "settings",
        action: "update",
        description: "Update settings",
      },
    ];

    for (const tenant of allTenants) {
      for (const permData of basePermissions) {
        const existing = await permissionRepo.findOne({
          where: {
            tenantId: tenant.id,
            resource: permData.resource,
            action: permData.action,
          },
        });

        if (!existing) {
          const permission = permissionRepo.create({
            ...permData,
            tenantId: tenant.id,
          });
          await permissionRepo.save(permission);
          console.log(
            `  ✅ Created permission: ${tenant.slug}/${permission.resource}:${permission.action}`,
          );
        }
      }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("✅ Seeding complete!");
    console.log("");
    console.log("📊 Summary:");
    console.log(`   Tenants: ${allTenants.length}`);
    console.log(`   Roles per tenant: ${systemRoles.length}`);
    console.log(`   Permissions per tenant: ${basePermissions.length}`);
    console.log("");
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("❌ Seeding failed:", error);
    throw error;
  } finally {
    await dataSource.destroy();
  }
}

// Run seed
seed()
  .then(() => {
    console.log("✅ Done");
    process.exit(0);
  })
  .catch((error) => {
    console.error("❌ Error:", error);
    process.exit(1);
  });

import { logger } from "./common/logger";
import { AppModule } from "./core/app.module";

async function bootstrap() {
  try {
    await AppModule.startApp();
  } catch (err: any) {
    logger.error("Error starting the application: ", err);
    logger.error(err);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

bootstrap();

import {
  Controller,
  Post,
  Get,
  Query,
  UseGuards,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { ApiTags, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiQuery } from "@nestjs/swagger";
import { TokenCleanupService } from "../auth/token-cleanup.service";
import { Protected } from "@/common/decorators/protected.decorator";
import { RequireRoles } from "@/common/decorators/permission.decorator";

@ApiTags("Admin - Token Cleanup")
@Controller("admin/cleanup")
@Protected()
@RequireRoles("admin", "superadmin")
export class AdminCleanupController {
  constructor(private readonly tokenCleanupService: TokenCleanupService) {}

  /**
   * Trigger manual token cleanup
   */
  @Post("tokens")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: "Trigger token cleanup",
    description: "Manually trigger token cleanup job (admin only)",
  })
  @ApiQuery({
    name: "tenantId",
    required: false,
    description: "Cleanup tokens for specific tenant (optional)",
  })
  async triggerCleanup(@Query("tenantId") tenantId?: string) {
    const result = await this.tokenCleanupService.manualCleanup(tenantId);

    return {
      message: "Token cleanup completed",
      ...result,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get cleanup statistics
   */
  @Get("stats")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Get cleanup statistics" })
  @ApiQuery({
    name: "tenantId",
    required: false,
    description: "Get stats for specific tenant (optional)",
  })
  async getCleanupStats(@Query("tenantId") tenantId?: string) {
    return this.tokenCleanupService.getCleanupStats(tenantId);
  }
}

import {
  Controller,
  Post,
  Body,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
  Ip,
  Headers,
  Get,
  UseGuards,
  Req,
  UnauthorizedException,
  Res,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import {
  ApiTags,
  ApiOperation,
  ApiResponse,
  ApiBearerAuth,
  ApiBody,
} from "@nestjs/swagger";
import { AuthService } from "./auth.service";
import {
  RegisterDto,
  LoginDto,
  ForgotPasswordDto,
  ResetPasswordDto,
  VerifyMfaDto,
  RefreshTokenDto,
  LoginIntentRequestDto,
  LoginIntentResponseDto,
  SendMagicLinkDto,
  VerifyMagicLinkDto,
} from "./auth.dto";
import { JwtAuthGuard } from "@/common/guards";
import { type Request, type Response } from "express";
import { FortKnoxProtectedGuard } from "@/common/guards/fortknox-protected-route.guard";
import { Protected } from "@/common/decorators/protected.decorator";
import { access } from "fs";

/**
 * Authentication Controller
 *
 * Handles all authentication-related endpoints:
 * - Registration
 * - Login
 * - Logout
 * - Password reset
 * - Email verification
 */
@ApiTags("Authentication")
@Controller("auth")
export class AuthController {
  constructor(private readonly authService: AuthService) {}

  /**
   * Register a new user
   */
  @Post("register")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.CREATED)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Register a new user" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: "User successfully registered" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 400, description: "Bad request - validation failed" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 409, description: "User already exists" })
  async register(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Body() registerDto: RegisterDto,
    @Ip() ip: string,
    @Headers("user-agent") userAgent: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    return this.authService.register({
      ...registerDto,
      tenantId,
      ip,
      userAgent: userAgent || "unknown",
    });
  }

  /**
   * Login with email and password
   */
  @Post("login")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Login with email and password" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: "Login successful" })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 401,
    description: "Unauthorized - invalid credentials",
  })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 423, description: "Account locked" })
  async login(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Res({passthrough: true}) res: Response,
    @Body() loginDto: LoginDto,
    @Ip() ip: string,
    @Headers("user-agent") userAgent: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    const response = await this.authService.login({
      ...loginDto,
      ip,
      tenantId,
      userAgent: userAgent || "unknown",
    });

    if ('mfaRequired' in response) {
      return response;
    }

    if ('accessToken' in response && 'refreshToken' in response && 'user' in response) {
      res.cookie('refreshToken', response.refreshToken, {
        httpOnly: true,
        secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
        // sameSite: 'none',
        sameSite: 'strict',
        domain: req.hostname,
        maxAge: 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000, // 30 days
        path: '/',
      });  
    }

    return {...response, refreshToken: null};

  }

  /**
   * Logout - revoke session
   */
  @Post("logout")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @Protected()
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Logout and revoke session" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: "Logout successful" })
  async logout(
    @Req() req: any,
    @Res({passthrough: true}) res: Response,
    @Ip() ip: string,
    @Headers("user-agent") userAgent: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    const userId = req.user.sub;
    const sessionId = req.user.sessionId;
    await this.authService.logout(tenantId, userId, sessionId, userAgent, ip);

    res.clearCookie("refreshToken", {
      httpOnly: true,
      secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
      // sameSite: 'none',
      sameSite: 'strict',
      domain: req.hostname,
    });

    return { message: "Logged out successfully" };
  }

  /**
   * Request password reset
   */
  @Post("forgot-password")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Request password reset email" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: "Password reset email sent" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 404, description: "User not found" })
  async forgotPassword(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Body() forgotPasswordDto: ForgotPasswordDto,
    @Ip() ip: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    await this.authService.forgotPassword(
      tenantId,
      forgotPasswordDto.email,
      ip,
    );
    return {
      message:
        "If an account exists with this email, a password reset link has been sent",
    };
  }

  /**
   * Reset password with token
   */
  @Post("reset-password")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Reset password using token" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: "Password reset successful" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 400, description: "Invalid or expired token" })
  async resetPassword(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Body() resetPasswordDto: ResetPasswordDto,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;

    await this.authService.resetPassword(
      tenantId,
      resetPasswordDto.otp,
      resetPasswordDto.password,
    );
    return { message: "Password reset successfully" };
  }

  /**
   * Verify email address
   */
  @Post("verify-email")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Verify email address" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: "Email verified successfully" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 400, description: "Invalid or expired token" })
  async verifyEmail(@Req() req: Request, @Body("token") token: string) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    await this.authService.verifyEmail(tenantId, token);
    return { message: "Email verified successfully" };
  }

  /**
   * Resend verification email
   */
  @Post("resend-verification")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Resend email verification" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: "Verification email sent" })
  async resendVerification(@Req() req: Request, @Body("email") email: string) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    await this.authService.resendVerification(tenantId, email);
    return { message: "Verification email sent" };
  }

  /**
   * Refresh access token
   */
  @Post("refresh")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Refresh access token" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: "Token refreshed successfully" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 401, description: "Invalid refresh token" })
  async refresh(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Res({passthrough: true}) res: Response,
    @Ip() ip: string,
    @Headers("user-agent") userAgent: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    const refreshToken = req.cookies.refreshToken;

    const response = await this.authService.refreshToken(tenantId, refreshToken, ip, userAgent);

    if ('accessToken' in response && 'refreshToken' in response) {
      res.cookie('refreshToken', response.refreshToken, {
        httpOnly: true,
        secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
        sameSite: 'strict',
        maxAge: 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000, // 30 days

      });
    }

    return { ...response, refreshToken: null};
  }

  /**
   * Get current authenticated user context
   *
   * This endpoint is critical for:
   * 1. Testing auth boundary works correctly
   * 2. Debugging token/session issues
   * 3. Frontend to get current user info
   *
   * Returns complete auth context:
   * - User info from JWT
   * - Tenant info
   * - Session info
   * - Permissions/roles (if loaded)
   */
  @Get("me")
  @Protected()
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: "Get current authenticated user",
    description:
      "Returns complete authentication context for debugging and user info display",
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: "Current user context",
    schema: {
      type: "object",
      properties: {
        user: {
          type: "object",
          properties: {
            id: { type: "string" },
            email: { type: "string" },
            firstName: { type: "string" },
            lastName: { type: "string" },
          },
        },
        tenant: {
          type: "object",
          properties: {
            id: { type: "string" },
            name: { type: "string" },
            slug: { type: "string" },
          },
        },
        session: {
          type: "object",
          properties: {
            id: { type: "string" },
            createdAt: { type: "string" },
            lastActivity: { type: "string" },
            expiresAt: { type: "string" },
            ipAddress: { type: "string" },
            userAgent: { type: "string" },
          },
        },
        auth: {
          type: "object",
          properties: {
            method: { type: "string" },
            issuedAt: { type: "string" },
            expiresAt: { type: "string" },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 401,
    description: "Unauthorized - Invalid token or session",
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 403,
    description: "Forbidden - Tenant mismatch",
  })
  async getCurrentUser(@Req() req: any) {
    const user = req.user; // From JWT payload
    const session = req.fortknoxSession;
    const tenant = req.tenant; // From TenantResolverMiddleware

    // Fetch full user details
    const fullUser = await this.authService.getCurrentUser(
      tenant?.id!,
      user.sub,
    );

    if (!fullUser) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("User not found");
    }

    return {
      user: {
        id: fullUser.id,
        email: fullUser.email,
        firstName: fullUser.firstName,
        lastName: fullUser.lastName,
        emailVerified: fullUser.emailVerified,
        lastLoginAt: fullUser.lastLoginAt,
        lastLoginIp: fullUser.lastLoginIp,
      },
      tenant: {
        id: tenant?.id,
        name: tenant?.name,
        slug: tenant?.slug,
        customDomain: tenant?.customDomain,
      },
      session: {
        id: session.id,
        createdAt: session.createdAt,
        lastActivity: session.lastActivity,
        expiresAt: session.expiresAt,
        ipAddress: session.ipAddress,
        userAgent: session.userAgent,
        deviceId: session.deviceId,
      },
      auth: {
        method: "jwt",
        // issuedAt: new Date(user.iat * 1000).toISOString(),
        // expiresAt: new Date(user.exp * 1000).toISOString(),
        tokenTenant: user.tenantId,
        requestTenant: req.tenantId,
        tenantMatch: user.tenantId === req.tenantId,
      },
      debug: {
        guards: {
          jwtAuth: true,
          tenantBinding: true,
          session: true,
        },
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Verify MFA code and complete login
   */
  @Post("mfa/verify")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: "Verify MFA code and complete login",
    description:
      "After receiving mfaRequired=true from login, use this endpoint to verify the TOTP code",
  })
  @ApiBody({
    schema: {
      type: "object",
      properties: {
        tempToken: {
          type: "string",
          description: "Temporary token from login response",
        },
        code: {
          type: "string",
          description: "6-digit TOTP code from authenticator app",
          pattern: "^\\d{6}$",
          example: "123456",
        },
      },
      required: ["tempToken", "code"],
    },
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: "MFA verified successfully, tokens issued",
    schema: {
      type: "object",
      properties: {
        accessToken: { type: "string" },
        refreshToken: { type: "string" },
        message: { type: "string" },
      },
    },
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 401,
    description: "Invalid MFA code or expired token",
  })
  async verifyMfa(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response,
    @Body() dto: VerifyMfaDto,
    @Ip() ip: string,
    @Headers("user-agent") userAgent: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;

    try {
      const result = await this.authService.verifyMfa(
        tenantId,
        dto.tempToken,
        dto.code,
        ip,
        userAgent,
      );

      res.cookie("refreshToken", result.refreshToken, {
        httpOnly: true,
        secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
        sameSite: "strict",
        domain: req.hostname,
        maxAge: 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
        path: "/",
      });

      return { status: 200, data: { accessToken: result.accessToken, message: result.message } };
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error("❌ MFA verification failed:", error.message);

      if (error instanceof UnauthorizedException) {
        throw error;
      }

      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid or expired token");
    }
  }

  /**
   * Verify MFA using backup code
   */
  @Post("mfa/verify-backup")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({

  @ApiBody({

          type: "string",

          type: "string",
          description: "Backup code in format XXXX-XXXX",
          pattern: "^[A-Z0-9]{4}-[A-Z0-9]{4}$",
          example: "ABCD-1234",
        },
      },
      required: ["tempToken", "code"],
    },
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,

    schema: {

        accessToken: { type: "string" },
        refreshToken: { type: "string" },
        message: { type: "string" },
        warning: {
          type: "string",
          description: "Warning about remaining backup codes",
        },
      },
    },
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 401,
    description: "Invalid backup code",
  })
  async verifyMfaBackup(
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Body() dto: VerifyMfaDto,
    @Ip() ip: string,
    @Headers("user-agent") userAgent: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;

    try {
      return await this.authService.verifyMfaBackup(
        tenantId,
        dto.tempToken,
        dto.code,
        ip,
        userAgent,
      );
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error("❌ Backup code verification failed:", error.message);

      if (error instanceof UnauthorizedException) {
        throw error;
      }

      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid backup code");
    }
  }

  })
  async loginIntent(
    @Body() body: LoginIntentRequestDto,
    @Req() req: any,
  ): Promise<LoginIntentResponseDto> {
    const { email } = body;
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!; // From TenantResolverMiddleware

    console.log('🔍 Login intent check:', { email, tenantId });

    const result = await this.authService.getLoginIntent(email, tenantId);

    console.log('✅ Login intent result:', {
      email,
      exists: result.exists,
      methods: result.methods,
      preferredMethod: result.preferredMethod,
    });

    return result;
  }
}
