import {
  Injectable,
  UnauthorizedException,
  BadRequestException,
  NotFoundException,
  ConflictException,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository, MoreThan, IsNull } from "typeorm";
import { JwtService } from "@nestjs/jwt";
import { ConfigService } from "@nestjs/config";
import {
  User,
  Session,
  Tenant,
  OAuthRefreshToken,
  UserSocialConnection,
  SecurityEventType,
} from "@repo/database";
import {
  SecurityEventService,
} from "@/common/service/security-event.service";
import { PasswordService } from "@repo/security";
import { EmailService } from "../email/email.service";
import * as crypto from "crypto";
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from "uuid";
import { SessionService } from "@/common/service/session.service";
import { BruteForceService } from "@/modules/auth/brute-force.service";
import { MfaService } from "@/modules/mfa/mfa.service";
import { WebAuthnService } from "@/modules/mfa/webauthn.service";
import { OAuthRefreshTokenService } from "@/modules/oauth/services/oauth-refresh-token.service";
import { LoginIntentResponseDto } from "./auth.dto";
/**
 * Authentication Service (Updated for Multi-Tenant)
 *
 * Handles all authentication business logic with tenant scoping:
 * - User registration (tenant-scoped)
 * - Login/logout (tenant-scoped)
 * - Password reset (tenant-scoped)
 * - Email verification (tenant-scoped)
 * - Session management (tenant-scoped)
 * - Security event logging (tenant-scoped)
 */
@Injectable()
export class AuthService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private readonly userRepository: Repository<User>,
    @InjectRepository(Session)
    private readonly sessionRepository: Repository<Session>,
    @InjectRepository(Tenant)
    private readonly tenantRepository: Repository<Tenant>,
    @InjectRepository(OAuthRefreshToken)
    private readonly oauthRefreshTokenRepository: Repository<OAuthRefreshToken>,
    @InjectRepository(UserSocialConnection)
    private readonly socialConnectionRepository: Repository<UserSocialConnection>,
    private readonly jwtService: JwtService,
    private readonly configService: ConfigService,
    private readonly passwordService: PasswordService,
    private readonly emailService: EmailService,
    private readonly sessionService: SessionService,
    private readonly bruteForceService: BruteForceService,
    private readonly mfaService: MfaService,
    private readonly webauthnService: WebAuthnService,
    private readonly oauthRefreshTokenService: OAuthRefreshTokenService,
    private readonly securityEventService: SecurityEventService,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Register a new user (TENANT REQUIRED)
   */
  async register(data: {
    tenantId: string; // ← Now REQUIRED!
    email: string;
    password: string;
    firstName?: string;
    lastName?: string;
    ip: string;
    userAgent: string;
  }) {
    // Validate tenant exists and is active
    const tenant = await this.tenantRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: data.tenantId, active: true },
    });

    if (!tenant) {
      throw new BadRequestException("Invalid or inactive tenant");
    }

    // Validate password strength
    const validation = PasswordService.validateStrength(data.password);

    if (!validation.isValid) {
      throw new BadRequestException({
        message: "Password does not meet security requirements",
        errors: validation.errors,
        score: validation.score,
      });
    }

    // Check if user already exists IN THIS TENANT
    const existingUser = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        email: data.email,
        tenantId: data.tenantId, // ← Tenant-scoped lookup
      },
    });

    if (existingUser) {
      // Log failed registration attempt (tenant-scoped)
      this.securityEventService.log({
        tenantId: data.tenantId,
        eventType: SecurityEventType.REGISTRATION_FAILED,
        severity: "warning",
        ipAddress: data.ip,
        userAgent: data.userAgent,
        metadata: { reason: "email_exists", email: data.email },
      });

      throw new ConflictException(
        "User with this email already exists in this tenant",
      );
    }

    // Hash password with Argon2id
    const passwordHash = await PasswordService.hash(data.password);

    // Generate email verification token
    const emailVerificationToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex");

    // Create user with tenantId
    const user = this.userRepository.create({
      tenantId: data.tenantId, // ← Always set tenant
      email: data.email,
      passwordHash,
      firstName: data.firstName,
      lastName: data.lastName,
      emailVerificationToken,
      emailVerificationExpiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000), // 24 hours
    });

    const savedUser = await this.userRepository.save(user);

    // Log successful registration (tenant-scoped)
    this.securityEventService.log({
      userId: savedUser.id,
      tenantId: savedUser.tenantId,
      actorEmail: savedUser.email,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.USER_REGISTERED,
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: data.ip,
      userAgent: data.userAgent,
      metadata: { email: savedUser.email },
    });

    // Send welcome and verification email
    await this.emailService.sendWelcomeEmail(savedUser, emailVerificationToken);

    return {
      id: savedUser.id,
      email: savedUser.email,
      firstName: savedUser.firstName,
      lastName: savedUser.lastName,
      message:
        "Registration successful. Please check your email to verify your account.",
    };
  }

  /**
   * Login with email and password (TENANT REQUIRED)
   */
  async login(data: {
    tenantId: string;
    email: string;
    password: string;
    ip: string;
    userAgent: string;
    deviceId?: string;
  }): Promise<
    | { accessToken: string; refreshToken: string; user: any }
    | {
        mfaRequired: boolean;
        tempToken: string;
        message: string;
        availableMethods: string[];
        preferredMethod: string;
      }
  > {
    const { tenantId, email, password, ip, userAgent } = data;

    // Find user — use QueryBuilder to avoid TypeORM 0.3.x DISTINCT pagination bug
    // with findOne+select(object form)+relations that causes pg "insufficient data" errors
    const user = await this.userRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("user")
      .addSelect("user.passwordHash") // Force-select the hidden field
      .leftJoinAndSelect("user.tenant", "tenant")
      .where("user.email = :email", { email })
      .andWhere("user.tenantId = :tenantId", { tenantId })
      .getOne();

    console.log("🔍 Login attempt:", { email, tenantId, userFound: !!user }); // ← ADD

    if (!user) {
      this.securityEventService.log({
        tenantId,
        eventType: SecurityEventType.LOGIN_FAILED,
        severity: "critical",
        ipAddress: ip,
        userAgent,
        metadata: { reason: "user_not_found" },
      });
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid email or password");
    }

    await this.bruteForceService.checkAccountLock(user);

    console.log("🔍 User found:", {
      userId: user.id,
      user,
      hasPassword: !!user.passwordHash,
    }); // ← ADD

    if (!user.passwordHash) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        "Social Provider was used to login. Please use the same or link to this account.",
      );
    }

    // Verify password
    const isValid = await PasswordService.verify(user.passwordHash, password);

    console.log("🔍 Password check:", { isValid }); // ← ADD

    if (!isValid) {
      await this.bruteForceService.recordFailedAttempt(user, tenantId, ip);
      this.securityEventService.log({
        tenantId,
        userId: user.id,
        actorEmail: user.email,
        eventType: SecurityEventType.LOGIN_FAILED,
        severity: "critical",
        ipAddress: ip,
        userAgent,
        // NOTE: `password` is intentionally omitted — sanitizeMetadata strips it
        // anyway, but we never pass sensitive values in the first place.
        metadata: { reason: "invalid_password" },
      });
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid email or password");
    }

    await this.bruteForceService.resetFailedAttempts(user);

    // Check if email verified (if required)
    if (
      !user.emailVerified &&
      user.tenant.featureFlags?.emailVerificationRequired
    ) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Please verify your email first");
    }

    // Check if account is active
    if (
      !user.emailVerified &&
      user.tenant.featureFlags?.emailVerificationRequired
    ) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Please verify your email first");
    }

    const mfaStatus = await this.mfaService.getMfaStatus(user.id, tenantId);

    if (mfaStatus.enabled) {
      // Generate temporary token for MFA verification
      const tempToken = this.jwtService.sign(
        {
          sub: user.id,
          email: user.email,
          tenantId,
          type: "mfa_pending",
        },
        {
          secret: this.configService.get("JWT_SECRET"),
          expiresIn: "5m", // Short-lived
        },
      );

      console.log(`🔐 MFA required for user ${user.email}`);

      // Log MFA challenge
      this.securityEventService.log({
        tenantId,
        userId: user.id,
        actorEmail: user.email,
        eventType: SecurityEventType.MFA_CHALLENGE_SENT,
        severity: "info",
        ipAddress: ip,
        userAgent,
      });

      return {
        mfaRequired: true,
        tempToken,
        availableMethods: mfaStatus.methods,
        preferredMethod: mfaStatus.preferredMethod || "totp",
        message: "MFA verification required",
      };
    }

    // === REFRESH TOKEN ROTATION LOGIC ===

    // Step 1: Create session
    const session = await this.sessionService.createSession({
      userId: user.id,
      tenantId: data.tenantId,
      email: user.email,
      ipAddress: data.ip,
      userAgent: data.userAgent,
      deviceId: data.deviceId,
    });

    console.log("✅ Session created:", session.id);

    // Step 2: Create refresh token using OAuthRefreshTokenService
    const { token: refreshToken } =
      await this.oauthRefreshTokenService.createRefreshToken({
        tenantId: data.tenantId,
        userId: user.id,
        sessionId: session.id,
        clientId: undefined, // No client for password login
        ipAddress: data.ip,
        userAgent: data.userAgent,
        deviceId: data.deviceId,
        expiresInDays: 30,
      });

    console.log("✅ Refresh token created");

    // Step 3: Generate access token (NOW we have sessionId!)
    const accessToken = this.jwtService.sign(
      {
        sub: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        tenantId: data.tenantId,
        sessionId: session.id,
      },
      {
        secret: this.configService.get("JWT_SECRET"),
        expiresIn: "15m",
      },
    );

    console.log("✅ Access token generated");

    // Step 4: Log successful login
    this.securityEventService.log({
      tenantId: data.tenantId,
      userId: user.id,
      actorEmail: user.email,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.LOGIN_SUCCESS,
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: data.ip,
      userAgent: data.userAgent,
      resourceId: session.id,
      resourceType: "session",
      metadata: {
        sessionId: session.id,
        authMethod: "password",
      },
    });

    return {
      accessToken,
      refreshToken,
      user: {
        email: user.email,
        firstName: user.firstName,
        lastName: user.lastName,
        emailVerified: user.emailVerified,
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Logout - revoke current session (TENANT SCOPED)
   */
  async logout(
    tenantId: string,
    userId: string,
    sessionId: string,
    userAgent: string,
    ip: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    // Revoke session and invalidate refresh token hash so it can never be reused
    await this.sessionRepository.update(
      { id: sessionId, tenantId },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: "user_logout",
        refreshTokenHash: null as unknown as string,
      },
    );

    // Revoke all refresh tokens for this session
    await this.oauthRefreshTokenService.revokeSessionTokens(
      sessionId,
      tenantId,
      "user_logout",
    );

    // Log logout
    this.securityEventService.log({
      tenantId,
      userId,
      userAgent,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.LOGOUT,
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: ip,
      resourceId: sessionId,
      resourceType: "session",
      metadata: { sessionId },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Request password reset (TENANT SCOPED)
   */
  async forgotPassword(tenantId: string, email: string, ip: string) {
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        email,
        tenantId, // ← Tenant filter
      },
    });

    // Don't reveal if user exists or not (security best practice)
    if (!user) {
      return;
    }

    // Generate OTP
    const otp = Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString();
    const otpHash = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(otp).digest("hex");

    await this.userRepository.update(
      { id: user.id, tenantId }, // ← Tenant-scoped update
      {
        passwordResetToken: otpHash,
        passwordResetExpiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1000), // 15 minutes
      },
    );

    // Log password reset request
    this.securityEventService.log({
      userId: user.id,
      tenantId: user.tenantId,
      actorEmail: user.email,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.PASSWORD_RESET_REQUESTED,
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: ip,
      userAgent: "system",
    });

    // Send password reset OTP email
    await this.emailService.sendPasswordResetOtpEmail(user, otp);

    console.log("Password reset OTP:", otp); // For development
  }

  /**
   * Send magic link sign-in email (TENANT SCOPED)
   */
  async sendMagicLink(tenantId: string, email: string): Promise<void> {
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({ where: { email, tenantId } });

    // Don't reveal if user exists
    if (!user) return;

    const rawToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
    const tokenHash = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(rawToken).digest("hex");

    await this.userRepository.update(
      { id: user.id, tenantId },
      {
        magicLinkToken: tokenHash,
        magicLinkExpiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000), // 10 minutes
      },
    );

    await this.emailService.sendMagicLinkEmail(user, rawToken);

    console.log("Magic link token (dev):", rawToken);
  }

  /**
   * Verify magic link token and create session (TENANT SCOPED)
   */
  async verifyMagicLink(
    tenantId: string,
    rawToken: string,
    ip: string,
    userAgent: string,
  ): Promise<{ accessToken: string; refreshToken: string }> {
    const tokenHash = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(rawToken).digest("hex");

    const user = await this.userRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("user")
      .addSelect("user.magicLinkToken")
      .where("user.magicLinkToken = :tokenHash", { tokenHash })
      .andWhere("user.tenantId = :tenantId", { tenantId })
      .andWhere("user.magicLinkExpiresAt > :now", { now: new Date() })
      .getOne();

    if (!user) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid or expired magic link");
    }

    // Clear the token (one-time use)
    await this.userRepository.update(
      { id: user.id, tenantId },
      { magicLinkToken: undefined, magicLinkExpiresAt: undefined },
    );

    const session = await this.sessionService.createSession({
      userId: user.id,
      tenantId,
      email: user.email,
      ipAddress: ip,
      userAgent,
    });

    const { token: refreshToken } = await this.oauthRefreshTokenService.createRefreshToken({
      tenantId,
      userId: user.id,
      sessionId: session.id,
      clientId: undefined,
      ipAddress: ip,
      userAgent,
      expiresInDays: 30,
    });

    const accessToken = this.jwtService.sign(
      { sub: user.id, email: user.email, tenantId, sessionId: session.id },
      { secret: this.configService.get("JWT_SECRET"), expiresIn: "15m" },
    );

    this.securityEventService.log({
      tenantId,
      userId: user.id,
      actorEmail: user.email,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.LOGIN_SUCCESS,
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: ip,
      userAgent,
      resourceId: session.id,
      resourceType: "session",
      metadata: { authMethod: "magic_link", sessionId: session.id },
    });

    return { accessToken, refreshToken };
  }

  /**
   * Reset password with token (TENANT SCOPED)
   */
  async resetPassword(tenantId: string, otp: string, newPassword: string) {
    const tokenHash = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(otp).digest("hex");

    const user = await this.userRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("user")
      .addSelect("user.passwordResetToken")
      .addSelect("user.passwordHash")
      .addSelect("user.passwordHistory")
      .where("user.passwordResetToken = :tokenHash", { tokenHash })
      .andWhere("user.tenantId = :tenantId", { tenantId }) // ← Tenant filter
      .andWhere("user.passwordResetExpiresAt > :now", { now: new Date() })
      .getOne();

    if (!user) {
      throw new BadRequestException("Invalid or expired password reset token");
    }

    // Validate new password
    const validation = PasswordService.validateStrength(newPassword);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      throw new BadRequestException({
        message: "Password does not meet security requirements",
        errors: validation.errors,
      });
    }

    // Check password history
    const passwordHistory = user.passwordHistory || [];
    for (const oldHash of passwordHistory) {
      const isReused = await PasswordService.verify(oldHash, newPassword);
      if (isReused) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          "Password has been used recently. Please choose a different password.",
        );
      }
    }

    // Hash new password
    const newPasswordHash = await PasswordService.hash(newPassword);

    // Update password and history
    const updatedHistory = [
      ...(user.passwordHash ? [user.passwordHash] : []),
      ...passwordHistory,
    ].slice(0, 5);

    await this.userRepository.update(
      { id: user.id, tenantId }, // ← Tenant-scoped update
      {
        passwordHash: newPasswordHash,
        passwordHistory: updatedHistory,
        passwordResetToken: undefined,
        passwordResetExpiresAt: undefined,
      },
    );

    // Log password reset
    this.securityEventService.log({
      userId: user.id,
      tenantId: user.tenantId,
      actorEmail: user.email,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.PASSWORD_RESET_COMPLETED,
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
      userAgent: "system",
    });

    // Send password changed confirmation email
    await this.emailService.sendPasswordChangedEmail(user);

    // Revoke all sessions IN THIS TENANT (force re-login)
    await this.sessionRepository.update(
      {
        userId: user.id,
        tenantId, // ← Tenant filter
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: "password_reset",
      },
    );
  }

  /**
   * Verify email address (TENANT SCOPED)
   */
  async verifyEmail(tenantId: string, token: string) {
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        tenantId, // ← Tenant filter
        emailVerificationToken: token,
        emailVerificationExpiresAt: MoreThan(new Date()),
      },
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw new BadRequestException("Invalid or expired verification token");
    }

    await this.userRepository.update(
      { id: user.id, tenantId }, // ← Tenant-scoped update
      {
        emailVerified: true,
        emailVerificationToken: undefined,
        emailVerificationExpiresAt: undefined,
      },
    );

    this.securityEventService.log({
      userId: user.id,
      tenantId: user.tenantId,
      actorEmail: user.email,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.EMAIL_VERIFIED,
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
      userAgent: "system",
    });
  }

  /**
   * Resend verification email (TENANT SCOPED)
   */
  async resendVerification(tenantId: string, email: string) {
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        email,
        tenantId, // ← Tenant filter
      },
    });

    if (!user) {
      // Don't reveal if user exists
      return;
    }

    if (user.emailVerified) {
      throw new BadRequestException("Email is already verified");
    }

    // Generate new token
    const emailVerificationToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex");

    await this.userRepository.update(
      { id: user.id, tenantId }, // ← Tenant-scoped update
      {
        emailVerificationToken,
        emailVerificationExpiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
      },
    );

    // Send verification email
    await this.emailService.sendVerificationEmail(user, emailVerificationToken);

    console.log("Verification token:", emailVerificationToken); // For development
  }

  /**
   * Refresh access token (TENANT SCOPED)
   */
  async refreshToken(
    tenantId: string,
    refreshToken: string,
    ip: string,
    userAgent: string,
  ): Promise<{ accessToken: string; refreshToken: string }> {
    // Use OAuthRefreshTokenService for rotation
    let accessTokenPayload: any;
    let newToken: string;

    try {
      ({ accessTokenPayload, newToken } =
        await this.oauthRefreshTokenService.rotateRefreshToken({
          tenantId,
          token: refreshToken,
          ipAddress: ip,
          userAgent,
        }));
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      this.securityEventService.log({
        tenantId,
        eventType: SecurityEventType.TOKEN_ROTATION_FAILED,
        severity: "warning",
        ipAddress: ip,
        userAgent,
        metadata: {
          reason: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "unknown",
        },
      });
      throw err;
    }

    // Generate new access token
    const accessToken = this.jwtService.sign(accessTokenPayload, {
      secret: this.configService.get("JWT_SECRET"),
      expiresIn: "15m",
    });

    // Update session: new refresh token hash + expiry + lastUsedAt
    if (accessTokenPayload.sessionId) {
      const newRefreshExpiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
      const newRefreshTokenHash = crypto
        .createHash("sha256")
        .update(newToken)
        .digest("hex");
      await this.sessionRepository.update(
        { id: accessTokenPayload.sessionId, tenantId },
        {
          refreshTokenHash: newRefreshTokenHash,
          refreshExpiresAt: newRefreshExpiresAt,
          lastUsedAt: new Date(),
          lastActivity: new Date(),
        },
      );
    }

    // Log token refresh
    this.securityEventService.log({
      tenantId,
      userId: accessTokenPayload.sub,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.TOKEN_REFRESHED,
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: ip,
      userAgent,
      resourceId: accessTokenPayload.sessionId,
      resourceType: "session",
      metadata: {
        sessionId: accessTokenPayload.sessionId,
      },
    });

    console.log("Token refresh successful", {
      userId: accessTokenPayload.sub,
      sessionId: accessTokenPayload.sessionId,
    });

    return {
      accessToken,
      refreshToken: newToken, // NEW token to client
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get current user (TENANT SCOPED)
   */
  async getCurrentUser(tenantId: string, userId: string) {
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        id: userId,
        tenantId, // ← Tenant filter
      },
      relations: ["tenant"],
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw new NotFoundException("User not found");
    }

    return {
      id: user.id,
      email: user.email,
      firstName: user.firstName,
      lastName: user.lastName,
      displayName: user.displayName,
      emailVerified: user.emailVerified,
      phoneVerified: user.phoneVerified,
      lastLoginAt: user.lastLoginAt,
      lastLoginIp: user.lastLoginIp,
      tenant: {
        id: user.tenant.id,
        name: user.tenant.name,
        slug: user.tenant.slug, // ← Use 'slug' not 'subdomain'
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Create session (TENANT SCOPED) - PRIVATE METHOD
   */
  private async createSession(data: {
    tenantId: string;
    userId: string;
    ipAddress?: string;
    userAgent?: string;
  }): Promise<Session> {
    const refreshTokenFamilyId = crypto.randomUUID();
    const deviceId = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString("hex");

    const session = this.sessionRepository.create({
      tenantId: data.tenantId, // ← Always set tenant
      userId: data.userId,
      refreshTokenFamilyId,
      deviceId,
      ipAddress: data.ipAddress,
      userAgent: data.userAgent,
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000), // 7 days
    });

    return this.sessionRepository.save(session);
  }

  /**
   * Increment failed login attempts (TENANT SCOPED) - PRIVATE METHOD
   */
  private async incrementFailedAttempts(tenantId: string, userId: string) {
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        id: userId,
        tenantId, // ← Tenant filter
      },
    });

    if (!user) return;

    const newAttempts = user.failedLoginAttempts + 1;

    // Lock account after 5 failed attempts
    const update: any = {
      failedLoginAttempts: newAttempts,
    };

    if (newAttempts >= 5) {
      update.lockedUntil = new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1000); // 15 minutes
    }

    await this.userRepository.update(
      { id: userId, tenantId }, // ← Tenant-scoped update
      update,
    );
  }

  /**
   * Revoke all sessions in a token family
   * Used when token reuse is detected
   */
  private async revokeSessionFamily(familyId: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.sessionRepository.update(
      {
        refreshTokenFamilyId: familyId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: "token_reuse_detected",
      },
    );

    console.log(`🔒 Revoked all sessions in family: ${familyId}`);
  }

  /**
   * Verify MFA code and complete login
   */
  async verifyMfa(
    tenantId: string,
    tempToken: string,
    code: string,
    ip: string,
    userAgent: string,
  ) {
    // Step 1: Verify temporary token
    const payload = this.jwtService.verify(tempToken, {
      secret: this.configService.get("JWT_SECRET"),
    });

    if (payload.type !== "mfa_pending") {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid token type");
    }

    console.log(`🔐 Verifying MFA for user ${payload.email}`);

    // Step 2: Verify TOTP code
    const verified = await this.mfaService.verifyTotp(
      payload.sub,
      tenantId,
      code,
    );

    if (!verified) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid MFA code");
    }

    // Step 3: Generate real session and tokens
    const familyId = uuidv4();
    const refreshToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
    const refreshTokenHash = crypto
      .createHash("sha256")
      .update(refreshToken)
      .digest("hex");

    const session = await this.sessionService.createSession({
      userId: payload.sub,
      tenantId,
      email: payload.email,
      refreshTokenFamilyId: familyId,
      refreshTokenHash,
      ipAddress: ip,
      userAgent: userAgent || "unknown",
    });

    const accessToken = this.jwtService.sign(
      {
        sub: payload.sub,
        email: payload.email,
        tenantId,
        sessionId: session.id,
      },
      {
        secret: this.configService.get("JWT_SECRET"),
        expiresIn: "15m",
      },
    );

    console.log(`✅ MFA verified successfully for ${payload.email}`);

    return {
      accessToken,
      refreshToken,
      message: "MFA verified successfully",
    };
  }

  /**
   * Verify MFA using backup code
   */
  async verifyMfaBackup(
    tenantId: string,
    tempToken: string,
    code: string,
    ip: string,
    userAgent: string,
  ) {
    // Step 1: Verify temporary token
    const payload = this.jwtService.verify(tempToken, {
      secret: this.configService.get("JWT_SECRET"),
    });

    if (payload.type !== "mfa_pending") {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid token type");
    }

    console.log(`🔐 Verifying backup code for user ${payload.email}`);

    // Step 2: Verify backup code
    const verified = await this.mfaService.verifyBackupCode(
      payload.sub,
      tenantId,
      code,
    );

    if (!verified) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid backup code");
    }

    // Step 3: Generate real session and tokens
    const familyId = uuidv4();
    const refreshToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
    const refreshTokenHash = crypto
      .createHash("sha256")
      .update(refreshToken)
      .digest("hex");

    const session = await this.sessionService.createSession({
      userId: payload.sub,
      tenantId,
      email: payload.email,
      refreshTokenFamilyId: familyId,
      refreshTokenHash,
      ipAddress: ip,
      userAgent: userAgent || "unknown",
    });

    const accessToken = this.jwtService.sign(
      {
        sub: payload.sub,
        email: payload.email,
        tenantId,
        sessionId: session.id,
      },
      {
        secret: this.configService.get("JWT_SECRET"),
        expiresIn: "15m",
      },
    );

    console.log(`✅ Backup code verified for ${payload.email}`);

    // Check remaining backup codes
    const mfaStatus = await this.mfaService.getMfaStatus(payload.sub, tenantId);
    const remaining = mfaStatus.backupCodesRemaining as number;

    return {
      accessToken,
      refreshToken,
      message: "Backup code verified successfully",
      warning:
        remaining <= 2
          ? `⚠️ Only ${remaining} backup codes remaining. Please regenerate new codes.`
          : undefined,
    };
  }

  // apps/auth-service/src/modules/auth/auth.service.ts
  // ADD THESE METHODS TO AuthService

  /**
   * Start WebAuthn authentication (passwordless login).
   *
   * Returns WebAuthn options AND an opaque sessionNonce. The client must echo
   * the nonce back when calling finishWebAuthnLogin so the server can retrieve
   * the single-use challenge from Redis.
   */
  async startWebAuthnLogin(
    tenantId: string,
    email: string,
  ): Promise<{ sessionNonce: string; [key: string]: any }> {
    // Find user
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: { email, tenantId },
    });

    if (!user) {
      // Don't reveal if user exists
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid credentials");
    }

    // Generate authentication options via WebAuthnService (returns options + nonce)
    const { options, sessionNonce } = await this.webauthnService.startAuthentication(
      user.id,
      tenantId,
    );

    console.log(`🔑 WebAuthn login started for ${email}`);

    // Spread options so the response shape is flat: { sessionNonce, challenge, ... }
    return { ...options, sessionNonce };
  }

  /**
   * Finish WebAuthn authentication and create session.
   *
   * @param data.sessionNonce - Opaque nonce returned by startWebAuthnLogin();
   *                            required to retrieve the single-use challenge.
   */
  async finishWebAuthnLogin(data: {
    tenantId: string;
    email: string;
    webauthnResponse: any;
    sessionNonce: string;
    ip: string;
    userAgent: string;
    deviceId?: string;
  }): Promise<{ accessToken: string; refreshToken: string; user: any }> {
    const { tenantId, email, webauthnResponse, sessionNonce, ip, userAgent, deviceId } = data;

    // Find user
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: { email, tenantId },
      relations: ["tenant"],
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid credentials");
    }

    // Verify WebAuthn response (passes nonce so service can look up challenge)
    const verified = await this.webauthnService.finishAuthentication(
      user.id,
      tenantId,
      webauthnResponse,
      sessionNonce,
    );

    if (!verified) {
      this.securityEventService.log({
        tenantId,
        userId: user.id,
        actorEmail: user.email,
        eventType: SecurityEventType.PASSKEY_AUTH_FAILED,
        severity: "warning",
        ipAddress: ip,
        userAgent,
        metadata: { reason: "webauthn_verification_failed" },
      });

      throw new UnauthorizedException("WebAuthn verification failed");
    }

    // Check if account is active
    if (!user.isActive) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Account is disabled");
    }

    // Create session using SessionService (consistent with password login)
    const session = await this.sessionService.createSession({
      userId: user.id,
      tenantId,
      email: user.email,
      ipAddress: ip,
      userAgent,
      deviceId,
    });

    const { token: refreshToken } = await this.oauthRefreshTokenService.createRefreshToken({
      tenantId,
      userId: user.id,
      sessionId: session.id,
      clientId: undefined,
      ipAddress: ip,
      userAgent,
      deviceId,
      expiresInDays: 30,
    });

    const accessToken = this.jwtService.sign(
      { sub: user.id, email: user.email, tenantId, sessionId: session.id },
      { secret: this.configService.get("JWT_SECRET"), expiresIn: "15m" },
    );

    // Log successful passkey login
    this.securityEventService.log({
      tenantId,
      userId: user.id,
      actorEmail: user.email,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.PASSKEY_AUTH_SUCCESS,
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: ip,
      userAgent,
      resourceId: session.id,
      resourceType: "session",
      metadata: { sessionId: session.id, authMethod: "webauthn" },
    });

    console.log(`✅ WebAuthn login successful for ${user.email}`);

    return {
      accessToken,
      refreshToken,
      user: {
        email: user.email,
        firstName: user.firstName,
        lastName: user.lastName,
        emailVerified: user.emailVerified,
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get login intent - what auth methods are available for this email
   */
  async getLoginIntent(
    email: string,
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<LoginIntentResponseDto> {
    // Get tenant first
    const tenant = await this.tenantRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: tenantId },
    });

    if (!tenant) {
      throw new Error('Tenant not found');
    }

    // Find user
    const user = await this.userRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("user")
      .leftJoinAndSelect('user.mfaSettings', 'mfa')
      .where("user.email = :email", { email })
      .andWhere("user.tenantId = :tenantId", { tenantId })
      .select([
        "user.id",
        "user.email",
        "user.passwordHash",
        "user.emailVerified",
        "user.mfaEnabled",
        "user.preferredAuthMethod",
        "user.primaryAuthMethod",

        // everything from MFA
        "mfa",
      ])
      .getOne();

    // User doesn't exist - return signup options
    if (!user) {
      return this.getSignupIntent(email, tenant);
    }

    // User exists - return login options
    return this.getUserLoginIntent(user, tenant, tenantId);
  }

  /**
   * Get signup intent for new users
   */
  private getSignupIntent(email: string, tenant: Tenant): LoginIntentResponseDto {
    const allowSignup = tenant.settings?.allowSignup ?? true;

    if (!allowSignup) {
      return {
        exists: false,
        email,
        methods: {
          password: false,
          magicLink: false,
          passkey: false,
          mfa: false,
          social: [],
        },
      };
    }

    // Signup allowed
    return {
      exists: false,
      email,
      methods: {
        password: true, // Always allow password signup
        magicLink: tenant.featureFlags?.['magicLinkEnabled'] ?? false,
        passkey: tenant.featureFlags?.['passkeyEnabled'] ?? false,
        mfa: false, // No MFA for new users
        social: this.getEnabledSocialProviders(tenant),
      },
      preferredMethod: 'password', // Default for signup
      branding: tenant.branding,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get login intent for existing user
   */
  private async getUserLoginIntent(
    user: User,
    tenant: Tenant,
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<LoginIntentResponseDto> {
    // Get user's linked social accounts
    const socialConnections = await this.socialConnectionRepository.find({
      where: { userId: user.id, tenantId },
      select: ['provider'],
    });

    const linkedProviders = socialConnections.map((sc) => sc.provider);

    const methods = {
      // Password: User has set a password
      password: !!user.passwordHash,

      // Magic Link: Tenant enabled + email verified (or verification not required)
      magicLink:
        (tenant.featureFlags?.['magicLinkEnabled'] ?? false) &&
        (user.emailVerified || !(tenant.settings?.requireEmailVerification ?? false)),

      // Passkey: Would need to check webauthn_credentials table (not in current schema)
      // For now, set to false
      passkey: tenant.featureFlags?.['passkeyEnabled'] ?? false,

      // MFA: User has enabled MFA
      mfa: user.mfaEnabled ?? false,

      // Social: Providers that are both enabled AND linked
      social: this.getAvailableSocialProviders(tenant, linkedProviders),
    };

    const preferredMethod =
      (user.preferredAuthMethod as any) ||
      this.determineDefaultMethod(methods);

    return {
      exists: true,
      email: user.email,
      methods,
      preferredMethod,
      branding: tenant.branding,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get social providers enabled by tenant
   */
  private getEnabledSocialProviders(tenant: Tenant): string[] {
    // Check feature flags for individual providers
    const providers: string[] = [];

    if (tenant.featureFlags?.['googleEnabled']) providers.push('google');
    if (tenant.featureFlags?.['githubEnabled']) providers.push('github');
    if (tenant.featureFlags?.['microsoftEnabled']) providers.push('microsoft');
    if (tenant.featureFlags?.['appleEnabled']) providers.push('apple');
    if (tenant.featureFlags?.['linkedinEnabled']) providers.push('linkedin');
    if (tenant.featureFlags?.['facebookEnabled']) providers.push('facebook');

    return providers;
  }

  /**
   * Get social providers available for user
   * (Must be both enabled by tenant AND linked to user)
   */
  private getAvailableSocialProviders(
    tenant: Tenant,
    linkedProviders: string[],
  ): string[] {
    const enabledProviders = this.getEnabledSocialProviders(tenant);

    // Return intersection of enabled and linked
    return enabledProviders.filter((provider) =>
      linkedProviders.includes(provider),
    );
  }

  /**
   * Determine smart default method
   * Priority: Passkey > Magic Link > Social > Password
   */
  private determineDefaultMethod(methods: {
    password: boolean;
    magicLink: boolean;
    passkey: boolean;
    social: string[];
  }): 'password' | 'magicLink' | 'passkey' | 'social' {
    if (methods.passkey) return 'passkey';
    if (methods.magicLink) return 'magicLink';
    if (methods.social.length > 0) return 'social';
    return 'password';
  }

  /**
   * Check if method requires MFA
   * Only password-based login requires additional MFA
   */
  requiresMFA(method: string, user: User): boolean {
    // Magic link = email access (inherently 2FA)
    if (method === 'magicLink') return false;

    // Passkey = biometric + device (inherently 2FA)
    if (method === 'passkey') return false;

    // Social = trusted provider (verified identity)
    if (method === 'social') return false;

    // Password = only if user has MFA enabled
    if (method === 'password') {
      return user.mfaEnabled ?? false;
    }

    return false;
  }

}

import { Injectable, UnauthorizedException } from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { IsNull, Repository } from "typeorm";
import { User, SecurityEventType } from "@repo/database";
import { SecurityEventService } from "@/common/service/security-event.service";

@Injectable()
export class BruteForceService {
  private readonly MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
  private readonly LOCKOUT_DURATION = 15 * 60 * 1000; // 15 minutes in ms
  private readonly PROGRESSIVE_DELAYS = [0, 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000]; // Delays in ms

  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private userRepository: Repository<User>,
    private readonly securityEventService: SecurityEventService,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Check if account is currently locked
   * @throws UnauthorizedException if account is locked
   */
  async checkAccountLock(user: User): Promise<void> {
    if (user.lockedUntil && user.lockedUntil > new Date()) {
      const minutesLeft = Math.ceil(
        (user.lockedUntil.getTime() - Date.now()) / 60000,
      );

      console.log(
        `🔒 Account locked for user ${user.email} - ${minutesLeft} minutes remaining`,
      );

      throw new UnauthorizedException({
        message: `Account temporarily locked due to too many failed login attempts`,
        lockedUntil: user.lockedUntil,
        minutesRemaining: minutesLeft,
        statusCode: 423, // 423 Locked
      });
    }

    // Clear lock if expired
    if (user.lockedUntil && user.lockedUntil <= new Date()) {
      user.lockedUntil = undefined;
      user.failedLoginAttempts = 0;
      await this.userRepository.save(user);
      console.log(`🔓 Lock expired for user ${user.email}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Record a failed login attempt
   * Implements progressive delays and account lockout
   */
  async recordFailedAttempt(
    user: User,
    tenantId: string,
    ipAddress?: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    user.failedLoginAttempts = (user.failedLoginAttempts || 0) + 1;
    user.lastFailedLogin = new Date();

    console.log(
      `❌ Failed login attempt ${user.failedLoginAttempts}/${this.MAX_ATTEMPTS} for ${user.email}`,
    );

    // Emit brute-force threshold event when approaching the lockout limit
    // (fires one attempt before the final lock so analysts see the build-up)
    if (user.failedLoginAttempts === this.MAX_ATTEMPTS - 1) {
      this.securityEventService.log({
        userId: user.id,
        tenantId,
        actorEmail: user.email,
        eventType: SecurityEventType.BRUTE_FORCE_THRESHOLD,
        severity: "warning",
        ipAddress: ipAddress ?? "0.0.0.0",
        userAgent: "system",
        metadata: {
          attempts: user.failedLoginAttempts,
          maxAttempts: this.MAX_ATTEMPTS,
          attemptsUntilLock: 1,
        },
      });
    }

    // Lock account after max attempts
    if (user.failedLoginAttempts >= this.MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
      user.lockedUntil = new Date(Date.now() + this.LOCKOUT_DURATION);
      await this.userRepository.save(user);

      console.log(
        `🔒 Account locked for user ${user.email} until ${user.lockedUntil}`,
      );

      this.securityEventService.log({
        userId: user.id,
        tenantId,
        actorEmail: user.email,
        eventType: SecurityEventType.USER_LOCKED,
        severity: "critical",
        ipAddress: ipAddress ?? "0.0.0.0",
        userAgent: "system",
        metadata: {
          attempts: user.failedLoginAttempts,
          lockedUntil: user.lockedUntil,
        },
      });

      // TODO: Send email notification about account lock
      // await this.emailService.sendAccountLockedEmail(user);

      throw new UnauthorizedException({
        message: `Account locked due to too many failed login attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.`,
        lockedUntil: user.lockedUntil,
        statusCode: 423,
      });
    }

    // Save failed attempt count
    await this.userRepository.save(user);

    // Apply progressive delay (prevents brute force timing attacks)
    const delayIndex = Math.min(
      user.failedLoginAttempts - 1,
      this.PROGRESSIVE_DELAYS.length - 1,
    );
    const delay = this.PROGRESSIVE_DELAYS[delayIndex] as number;

    if (delay > 0) {
      console.log(`⏱️  Applying ${delay}ms delay for failed attempt`);
      await this.sleep(delay);
    }

    // Throw error after delay
    const attemptsLeft = this.MAX_ATTEMPTS - user.failedLoginAttempts;
    throw new UnauthorizedException({
      message: "Invalid email or password",
      attemptsRemaining: attemptsLeft,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Reset failed login attempts on successful login
   */
  async resetFailedAttempts(user: User): Promise<void> {
    if (user.failedLoginAttempts > 0 || user.lockedUntil) {
      console.log(`✅ Resetting failed attempts for ${user.email}`);

      user.failedLoginAttempts = 0;
      user.lockedUntil = null;
      user.lastFailedLogin = null;

      await this.userRepository.save(user);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Manually unlock account (admin function)
   */
  async unlockAccount(userId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<void> {
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: userId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw new Error("User not found");
    }

    user.lockedUntil = null;
    user.failedLoginAttempts = 0;
    user.lastFailedLogin = null;

    await this.userRepository.save(user);

    console.log(`🔓 Account manually unlocked for ${user.email}`);
  }

  /**
   * Get account status
   */
  async getAccountStatus(userId: string, tenantId: string) {
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: userId, tenantId },
      select: [
        "id",
        "email",
        "failedLoginAttempts",
        "lockedUntil",
        "lastFailedLogin",
      ],
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw new Error("User not found");
    }

    const isLocked = user.lockedUntil && user.lockedUntil > new Date();
    const minutesUntilUnlock = isLocked
      ? Math.ceil((user.lockedUntil!.getTime() - Date.now()) / 60000)
      : 0;

    return {
      isLocked,
      failedAttempts: user.failedLoginAttempts || 0,
      maxAttempts: this.MAX_ATTEMPTS,
      attemptsRemaining: Math.max(
        0,
        this.MAX_ATTEMPTS - (user.failedLoginAttempts || 0),
      ),
      lockedUntil: user.lockedUntil,
      minutesUntilUnlock,
      lastFailedLogin: user.lastFailedLogin,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Helper: Sleep for specified milliseconds
   */
  private sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  }
}

import { Injectable, Logger } from "@nestjs/common";
import { ConfigService } from "@nestjs/config";
import * as crypto from "crypto";

/**
 * TokenEncryptionService
 *
 * Encrypts/decrypts OAuth tokens before storing in database
 *
 * Uses AES-256-GCM for authenticated encryption
 *
 * Why encrypt tokens?
 * - Security: If DB is compromised, tokens can't be used
 * - Compliance: GDPR, SOC2, ISO 27001 require encryption at rest
 * - Best practice: Never store sensitive tokens in plaintext
 */
@Injectable()
export class TokenEncryptionService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(TokenEncryptionService.name);
  private readonly algorithm = "aes-256-gcm";
  private readonly key: Buffer;

  constructor(private configService: ConfigService) {
    // Get encryption key from environment
    const keyHex = this.configService.get<string>("TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY");

    if (!keyHex) {
      throw new Error("TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY not configured");
    }

    // Convert hex string to buffer (must be 32 bytes for AES-256)
    this.key = Buffer.from(keyHex, "hex");

    if (this.key.length !== 32) {
      throw new Error(
        "TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY must be 32 bytes (64 hex characters)",
      );
    }

    this.logger.log("TokenEncryptionService initialized");
  }

  /**
   * Encrypt a token
   *
   * Format: iv:authTag:encryptedData
   * All parts are hex-encoded
   *
   * @param plaintext Token to encrypt
   * @returns Encrypted token string
   */
  encrypt(plaintext: string): string {
    if (!plaintext) {
      throw new Error("Cannot encrypt empty token");
    }

    try {
      // Generate random IV (initialization vector)
      const iv = crypto.randomBytes(16);

      // Create cipher
      const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv(this.algorithm, this.key, iv);

      // Encrypt
      let encrypted = cipher.update(plaintext, "utf8", "hex");
      encrypted += cipher.final("hex");

      // Get authentication tag (GCM mode)
      const authTag = cipher.getAuthTag();

      // Combine: iv:authTag:encrypted
      const result = `${iv.toString("hex")}:${authTag.toString("hex")}:${encrypted}`;

      this.logger.debug("Token encrypted successfully");

      return result;
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error("Failed to encrypt token", {
        error: error.message,
        stack: error.stack,
      });
      throw new Error("Token encryption failed");
    }
  }

  /**
   * Decrypt a token
   *
   * @param encryptedData Encrypted token string (iv:authTag:encrypted)
   * @returns Decrypted token
   */
  decrypt(encryptedData: string): string {
    if (!encryptedData) {
      throw new Error("Cannot decrypt empty data");
    }

    try {
      // Split into parts
      const parts = encryptedData.split(":");

      if (parts.length !== 3) {
        throw new Error("Invalid encrypted data format");
      }

      const [ivHex, authTagHex, encrypted] = parts;

      // Convert from hex
      const iv = Buffer.from(ivHex!, "hex");
      const authTag = Buffer.from(authTagHex!, "hex");

      // Create decipher
      const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv(this.algorithm, this.key, iv);
      decipher.setAuthTag(authTag);

      // Decrypt
      let decrypted = decipher.update(encrypted!, "hex", "utf8");
      decrypted += decipher.final("utf8");

      this.logger.debug("Token decrypted successfully");

      return decrypted;
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error("Failed to decrypt token", {
        error: error.message,
      });
      throw new Error("Token decryption failed");
    }
  }

  /**
   * Encrypt multiple tokens at once
   */
  encryptTokens(tokens: {
    accessToken?: string;
    refreshToken?: string;
    idToken?: string;
  }): {
    accessToken?: string;
    refreshToken?: string;
    idToken?: string;
  } {
    return {
      accessToken: tokens.accessToken
        ? this.encrypt(tokens.accessToken)
        : undefined,
      refreshToken: tokens.refreshToken
        ? this.encrypt(tokens.refreshToken)
        : undefined,
      idToken: tokens.idToken ? this.encrypt(tokens.idToken) : undefined,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Decrypt multiple tokens at once
   */
  decryptTokens(tokens: {
    accessToken?: string;
    refreshToken?: string;
    idToken?: string;
  }): {
    accessToken?: string;
    refreshToken?: string;
    idToken?: string;
  } {
    return {
      accessToken: tokens.accessToken
        ? this.decrypt(tokens.accessToken)
        : undefined,
      refreshToken: tokens.refreshToken
        ? this.decrypt(tokens.refreshToken)
        : undefined,
      idToken: tokens.idToken ? this.decrypt(tokens.idToken) : undefined,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Generate a secure encryption key
   *
   * Run this once to generate key, then store in env
   *
   * Usage:
   * node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"
   */
  static generateKey(): string {
    return crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
  }
}

import { Injectable, Logger } from "@nestjs/common";
import { Cron, CronExpression } from "@nestjs/schedule";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository } from "typeorm";
import { Tenant } from "@repo/database";
import { OAuthRefreshTokenService } from "@/modules/oauth/services/oauth-refresh-token.service";
import { SessionManagementService } from "@/modules/session/session-management.service";

/**
 * TokenCleanupService
 *
 * Handles scheduled cleanup of expired/used tokens
 *
 * Runs:
 * - Daily at 2 AM: Full cleanup
 * - Hourly: Quick cleanup of expired tokens
 */
@Injectable()
export class TokenCleanupService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(TokenCleanupService.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly oauthRefreshTokenService: OAuthRefreshTokenService,
    private readonly sessionManagementService: SessionManagementService,
    @InjectRepository(Tenant)
    private readonly tenantRepository: Repository<Tenant>,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Daily cleanup (2 AM)
   *
   * Comprehensive cleanup:
   * - Expired tokens
   * - Used tokens (rotation)
   * - Old revoked tokens (>30 days)
   */
  @Cron(CronExpression.EVERY_DAY_AT_2AM, {
    name: "token-cleanup-daily",
    timeZone: "UTC",
  })
  async dailyCleanup() {
    this.logger.log("🧹 Starting daily token cleanup...");

    const startTime = Date.now();
    let totalDeleted = 0;

    try {
      // Get all active tenants
      const tenants = await this.tenantRepository.find({
        where: { active: true },
        select: ["id", "name"],
      });

      this.logger.log(`Processing ${tenants.length} tenants...`);

      // Cleanup tokens for each tenant
      for (const tenant of tenants) {
        try {
          const deleted =
            await this.oauthRefreshTokenService.cleanupExpiredTokens(tenant.id);

          if (deleted > 0) {
            this.logger.log(
              `Cleaned up ${deleted} tokens for tenant ${tenant.name}`,
            );
            totalDeleted += deleted;
          }
        } catch (error: any) {
          this.logger.error(
            `Failed to cleanup tokens for tenant ${tenant.name}`,
            {
              error: error.message,
              tenantId: tenant.id,
            },
          );
        }
      }

      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;

      this.logger.log("✅ Daily token cleanup completed", {
        totalDeleted,
        tenantsProcessed: tenants.length,
        durationMs: duration,
      });

      // Store metrics (optional)
      await this.recordCleanupMetrics({
        totalDeleted,
        tenantsProcessed: tenants.length,
        durationMs: duration,
        timestamp: new Date(),
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error("❌ Daily token cleanup failed", {
        error: error.message,
        stack: error.stack,
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Hourly quick cleanup
   *
   * Only deletes clearly expired tokens
   * Faster than daily cleanup
   */
  @Cron(CronExpression.EVERY_HOUR, {
    name: "token-cleanup-hourly",
    timeZone: "UTC",
  })
  async hourlyCleanup() {
    this.logger.debug("🧹 Starting hourly token cleanup...");

    try {
      // Quick cleanup without tenant iteration
      const deleted =
        await this.oauthRefreshTokenService.cleanupExpiredTokens();

      if (deleted > 0) {
        this.logger.log(`Hourly cleanup: deleted ${deleted} expired tokens`);
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error("❌ Hourly token cleanup failed", {
        error: error.message,
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * 15-minute session cleanup
   *
   * Soft-deletes expired sessions and revokes their refresh tokens.
   */
  @Cron("*/15 * * * *", {
    name: "session-cleanup-15m",
    timeZone: "UTC",
  })
  async fifteenMinuteSessionCleanup() {
    this.logger.debug("🧹 Starting 15-minute session cleanup...");

    try {
      const { sessionsCleanedUp, tokensRevoked } =
        await this.sessionManagementService.cleanupExpiredSessions();

      if (sessionsCleanedUp > 0) {
        this.logger.log(
          `15m session cleanup: removed ${sessionsCleanedUp} sessions, revoked ${tokensRevoked} tokens`,
        );
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error("❌ 15-minute session cleanup failed", {
        error: error.message,
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Manual cleanup trigger (admin endpoint)
   */
  async manualCleanup(tenantId?: string): Promise<{
    deleted: number;
    durationMs: number;
  }> {
    this.logger.log("🧹 Starting manual token cleanup...", { tenantId });

    const startTime = Date.now();

    const deleted =
      await this.oauthRefreshTokenService.cleanupExpiredTokens(tenantId);

    const durationMs = Date.now() - startTime;

    this.logger.log("✅ Manual cleanup completed", {
      deleted,
      durationMs,
      tenantId,
    });

    return { deleted, durationMs };
  }

  /**
   * Get cleanup statistics
   */
  async getCleanupStats(tenantId?: string): Promise<{
    expiredTokens: number;
    usedTokens: number;
    revokedTokens: number;
    totalToCleanup: number;
  }> {
    // Implementation depends on your metrics storage
    // Could query database directly or read from metrics table
    return {
      expiredTokens: 0,
      usedTokens: 0,
      revokedTokens: 0,
      totalToCleanup: 0,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Record cleanup metrics for monitoring
   */
  private async recordCleanupMetrics(metrics: {
    totalDeleted: number;
    tenantsProcessed: number;
    durationMs: number;
    timestamp: Date;
  }): Promise<void> {
    // Store in metrics table or send to monitoring service
    // Example: CloudWatch, Datadog, Prometheus, etc.

    this.logger.debug("Cleanup metrics recorded", metrics);

    // TODO: Store in your metrics system
    // await this.metricsService.record('token.cleanup', metrics);
  }
}

import { Controller, Get, Patch, Param, Body, Request, Query } from "@nestjs/common";
import { ApiTags, ApiOperation } from "@nestjs/swagger";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository, IsNull } from "typeorm";
import { User, Session, Tenant, TenantSocialProvider } from "@repo/database";
import { Protected } from "@/common/decorators/protected.decorator";
import { MfaService } from "@/modules/mfa/mfa.service";
import { DashboardService } from "./dashboard.service";

@ApiTags("Dashboard")
@Controller("dashboard")
@Protected()
export class DashboardController {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private readonly userRepository: Repository<User>,
    @InjectRepository(Session)
    private readonly sessionRepository: Repository<Session>,
    @InjectRepository(Tenant)
    private readonly tenantRepository: Repository<Tenant>,
    @InjectRepository(TenantSocialProvider)
    private readonly tenantSocialProviderRepository: Repository<TenantSocialProvider>,
    private readonly mfaService: MfaService,
    private readonly dashboardService: DashboardService,
  ) {}

  @Get()
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Get dashboard overview for current user" })
  async getOverview(@Request() req: any) {
    const userId = req.user.sub;
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;

    const [user, mfaStatus, activeSessions] = await Promise.all([
      this.userRepository.findOne({ where: { id: userId, tenantId } }),
      this.mfaService.getMfaStatus(userId, tenantId),
      this.sessionRepository.count({
        where: { userId, tenantId, revokedAt: IsNull() },
      }),
    ]);

    return {
      user: {
        id: user?.id,
        email: user?.email,
        firstName: user?.firstName,
        lastName: user?.lastName,
        displayName: user?.displayName,
        avatarUrl: user?.avatarUrl,
        emailVerified: user?.emailVerified,
        lastLoginAt: user?.lastLoginAt,
        createdAt: user?.createdAt,
        primaryAuthMethod: user?.primaryAuthMethod,
        status: user?.status,
      },
      mfa: mfaStatus,
      stats: {
        activeSessions,
        lastLoginAt: user?.lastLoginAt,
      },
    };
  }

  @Get("tenant-settings")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Get tenant login method settings" })
  async getTenantSettings(@Request() req: any) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;

    const [tenant, socialProviders] = await Promise.all([
      this.tenantRepository.findOne({ where: { id: tenantId } }),
      this.tenantSocialProviderRepository.find({ where: { tenantId } }),
    ]);

    return {
      featureFlags: tenant?.featureFlags || {},
      socialProviders: socialProviders.map((sp) => ({
        provider: sp.provider,
        enabled: sp.enabled,
        clientId: sp.clientId || null,
        hasSecret: !!sp.clientSecret,
      })),
    };
  }

  @Patch("tenant-settings")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Update tenant feature flags for login methods" })
  async updateTenantSettings(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Body() body: { featureFlags: Record<string, boolean> },
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    const tenant = await this.tenantRepository.findOne({ where: { id: tenantId } });
    if (!tenant) throw new Error("Tenant not found");

    await this.tenantRepository.update(
      { id: tenantId },
      { featureFlags: { ...(tenant.featureFlags || {}), ...body.featureFlags } },
    );

    return { message: "Settings updated" };
  }

  @Get("tenant-metrics")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Get aggregate metrics for this tenant" })
  async getTenantMetrics(@Request() req: any) {
    return this.dashboardService.getTenantMetrics(req.tenantId!);
  }

  @Get("tenant-activity")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Get recent security events for this tenant" })
  async getTenantActivity(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Query("limit") limitStr?: string,
  ) {
    const limit = limitStr ? Math.min(parseInt(limitStr, 10) || 20, 100) : 20;
    return this.dashboardService.getTenantActivity(req.tenantId!, limit);
  }

  @Get("api-call-trend")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Get daily API call counts for this tenant" })
  async getApiCallTrend(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Query("days") daysStr?: string,
  ) {
    const raw = parseInt(daysStr ?? "7", 10);
    const days = ([7, 14, 30].includes(raw) ? raw : 7) as 7 | 14 | 30;
    return this.dashboardService.getApiCallTrend(req.tenantId!, days);
  }

  @Get("auth-breakdown")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Get authentication method breakdown for this tenant" })
  async getAuthBreakdown(@Request() req: any) {
    return this.dashboardService.getAuthMethodBreakdown(req.tenantId!);
  }

  @Patch("tenant-settings/social/:provider")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Enable/disable and configure a social provider for this tenant" })
  async updateSocialProvider(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Param("provider") provider: string,
    @Body() body: { enabled: boolean; clientId?: string; clientSecret?: string },
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;

    const existing = await this.tenantSocialProviderRepository.findOne({
      where: { tenantId, provider: provider as any },
    });

    if (existing) {
      await this.tenantSocialProviderRepository.update(existing.id, {
        enabled: body.enabled,
        ...(body.clientId !== undefined && { clientId: body.clientId }),
        ...(body.clientSecret !== undefined && { clientSecret: body.clientSecret }),
      });
    } else {
      await this.tenantSocialProviderRepository.save({
        tenantId,
        provider: provider as any,
        enabled: body.enabled,
        clientId: body.clientId,
        clientSecret: body.clientSecret,
        useSharedApp: !body.clientId,
      });
    }

    return { message: "Social provider updated" };
  }
}

import { Injectable } from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository, IsNull, MoreThan } from "typeorm";
import {
  User,
  Session,
  OAuthClient,
  SecurityEvent,
  UserSocialConnection,
  WebAuthnCredential,
} from "@repo/database";
import { RedisService } from "@/common/service/redis.service";

export interface TenantMetricsDto {
  totalUsers: number;
  activeSessions: number;
  totalApplications: number;
  mfaAdoptionRate: number;
  activeApiKeys: number;
}

export interface ActivityEventDto {
  id: string;
  eventType: string;
  actorEmail?: string;
  ipAddress: string;
  location?: string;
  createdAt: Date;
  severity: string;
  resourceType?: string;
  resourceId?: string;
}

export interface TrendPointDto {
  date: string;
  count: number;
}

export interface AuthBreakdownDto {
  emailPassword: number;
  google: number;
  github: number;
  microsoft: number;
  apple: number;
  passkey: number;
}

@Injectable()
export class DashboardService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private readonly userRepository: Repository<User>,
    @InjectRepository(Session)
    private readonly sessionRepository: Repository<Session>,
    @InjectRepository(OAuthClient)
    private readonly oauthClientRepository: Repository<OAuthClient>,
    @InjectRepository(SecurityEvent)
    private readonly securityEventRepository: Repository<SecurityEvent>,
    @InjectRepository(UserSocialConnection)
    private readonly socialConnectionRepository: Repository<UserSocialConnection>,
    @InjectRepository(WebAuthnCredential)
    private readonly webAuthnRepository: Repository<WebAuthnCredential>,
    private readonly redisService: RedisService,
  ) {}

  async getTenantMetrics(tenantId: string): Promise<TenantMetricsDto> {
    const [totalUsers, mfaUsers, activeSessions, totalApplications] =
      await Promise.all([
        this.userRepository.count({ where: { tenantId } }),
        this.userRepository.count({ where: { tenantId, mfaEnabled: true } }),
        this.sessionRepository.count({
          where: {
            tenantId,
            expiresAt: MoreThan(new Date()),
            revokedAt: IsNull(),
          },
        }),
        this.oauthClientRepository.count({ where: { tenantId } }),
      ]);

    const mfaAdoptionRate = totalUsers > 0 ? mfaUsers / totalUsers : 0;

    return {
      totalUsers,
      activeSessions,
      totalApplications,
      mfaAdoptionRate,
      activeApiKeys: 0, // no api_keys table yet
    };
  }

  async getTenantActivity(
    tenantId: string,
    limit = 20,
  ): Promise<ActivityEventDto[]> {
    const events = await this.securityEventRepository.find({
      where: { tenantId },
      order: { createdAt: "DESC" },
      take: limit,
    });

    return events.map((e) => ({
      id: e.id,
      eventType: e.eventType,
      actorEmail: e.actorEmail,
      ipAddress: e.ipAddress,
      location: e.location,
      createdAt: e.createdAt,
      severity: e.severity,
      resourceType: e.resourceType,
      resourceId: e.resourceId,
    }));
  }

  async getApiCallTrend(
    tenantId: string,
    days: 7 | 14 | 30 = 7,
  ): Promise<TrendPointDto[]> {
    const dates: string[] = [];
    for (let i = days - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = new Date();
      d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
      dates.push(d.toISOString().split("T")[0] as string);
    }

    const counts = await this.redisService.getDailyApiCallCounts(
      tenantId,
      dates,
    );

    return dates.map((date, i) => ({ date, count: counts[i] ?? 0 }));
  }

  async getAuthMethodBreakdown(tenantId: string): Promise<AuthBreakdownDto> {
    const [socialRows, passkeyCount, emailPasswordCount] = await Promise.all([
      this.socialConnectionRepository
        .createQueryBuilder("sc")
        .select("sc.provider", "provider")
        .addSelect("COUNT(*)", "count")
        .where("sc.tenantId = :tenantId", { tenantId })
        .groupBy("sc.provider")
        .getRawMany<{ provider: string; count: string }>(),

      this.webAuthnRepository.count({ where: { tenantId } }),

      this.userRepository
        .createQueryBuilder("u")
        .where("u.tenantId = :tenantId", { tenantId })
        .andWhere(
          `u.id NOT IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT usc.user_id
            FROM user_social_connections usc
            WHERE usc.tenant_id = :tenantId
          )`,
          { tenantId },
        )
        .getCount(),
    ]);

    const providerMap: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const row of socialRows) {
      providerMap[row.provider] = parseInt(row.count, 10);
    }

    return {
      emailPassword: emailPasswordCount,
      google: providerMap["google"] ?? 0,
      github: providerMap["github"] ?? 0,
      microsoft: providerMap["microsoft"] ?? 0,
      apple: providerMap["apple"] ?? 0,
      passkey: passkeyCount,
    };
  }
}

/**

import { Controller, Get, Query, BadRequestException } from "@nestjs/common";
import { ConfigService } from "@nestjs/config";

import { EmailService } from "./email.service";

@ApiTags("Email (Development)")
@Controller("email")
export class EmailController {
  constructor(
    private readonly emailService: EmailService,
    private readonly configService: ConfigService,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Test email sending (development only)
   */
  @Get("test")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Test email sending (development only)" })
  @ApiQuery({ name: "type", required: true, description: "Email type to test" })
  @ApiQuery({ name: "to", required: true, description: "Recipient email" })
  async testEmail(
    @Query("type") type: string,
    @Query("to") to: string,
  ): Promise<any> {
    // Only allow in development
    const nodeEnv = this.configService.get<string>("NODE_ENV");
    if (nodeEnv === "production") {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        "Email testing is not available in production",
      );
    }

    // Mock user data for testing
    const mockUser = {
      id: "test-user-id",
      tenantId: "test-tenant-id",
      email: to,
      firstName: "Test",
      lastName: "User",
      emailVerified: false,
      passwordHash: "",
      createdAt: new Date(),
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    } as any;

    let result: boolean;

    switch (type) {
      case "welcome":
        result = await this.emailService.sendWelcomeEmail(
          mockUser,
          "test-verification-token-123",
        );
        break;

      case "verification":
        result = await this.emailService.sendVerificationEmail(
          mockUser,
          "test-verification-token-123",
        );
        break;

      case "password-reset":
        result = await this.emailService.sendPasswordResetEmail(
          mockUser,
          "test-reset-token-123",
        );
        break;

      case "password-changed":
        result = await this.emailService.sendPasswordChangedEmail(mockUser);
        break;

      case "magic-link":
        result = await this.emailService.sendMagicLinkEmail(
          mockUser,
          "test-magic-link-token-123",
        );
        break;

      case "otp":
        result = await this.emailService.sendOTPEmail(mockUser, "123456");
        break;

      case "account-deleted":
        result = await this.emailService.sendAccountDeletedEmail(mockUser);
        break;

      default:
        throw new BadRequestException(
          `Invalid email type. Valid types: welcome, verification, password-reset, password-changed, magic-link, otp, account-deleted`,
        );
    }

    return {
      success: result,
      type,
      recipient: to,
      message: result
        ? "Email sent successfully (check console if in development mode)"
        : "Email failed to send",
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Email Service
 *
 * Main email service that:
 * - Auto-detects which provider to use (SES > SMTP > Console)
 * - Handles email templating with Handlebars
 * - Logs all email attempts to security_events
 * - Supports multi-tenant branding
 */

import { Injectable, Logger } from "@nestjs/common";
import { ConfigService } from "@nestjs/config";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository } from "typeorm";
import { User, Tenant, SecurityEventType } from "@repo/database";
import { SecurityEventService } from "@/common/service/security-event.service";
import * as Handlebars from "handlebars";
import * as fs from "fs";
import * as path from "path";
import { EmailProvider } from "./providers/email-provider.interface";
import { NodeMailerProvider } from "./providers/nodemailer.provider";
import { SESProvider } from "./providers/ses.provider";

@Injectable()
export class EmailService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(EmailService.name);
  private provider: EmailProvider | null = null;
  private templateCache: Map<string, HandlebarsTemplateDelegate> = new Map();

  constructor(
    private readonly configService: ConfigService,
    private readonly securityEventService: SecurityEventService,
    @InjectRepository(Tenant)
    private readonly tenantRepository: Repository<Tenant>,
  ) {
    this.initializeProvider();
  }

  /**
   * Auto-detect and initialize email provider
   * Priority: SES > SMTP > Console (development)
   */
  private initializeProvider(): void {
    const awsSesAccessKey = this.configService.get<string>(
      "AWS_SES_ACCESS_KEY_ID",
    );
    const awsSesSecretKey = this.configService.get<string>(
      "AWS_SES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY",
    );
    const smtpHost = this.configService.get<string>("SMTP_HOST");

    if (awsSesAccessKey && awsSesSecretKey) {
      // Use SES
      this.provider = new SESProvider(this.configService);
      this.logger.log("📧 Email provider: AWS SES");
    } else if (smtpHost) {
      // Use SMTP (NodeMailer)
      this.provider = new NodeMailerProvider(this.configService);
      this.logger.log("📧 Email provider: SMTP (NodeMailer)");
    } else {
      // Development mode - log to console
      this.provider = null;
      this.logger.warn(
        "📧 Email provider: CONSOLE (Development) - No email provider configured",
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Send email using the configured provider
   */
  async sendEmail(options: {
    to: string;
    subject: string;
    html: string;
    text?: string;
    tenantId: string;
    userId?: string;
    emailType: string;
  }): Promise<boolean> {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    let success = false;

    console.log(this.provider);

    try {
      if (this.provider) {
        // Use configured provider (SES or SMTP)
        await this.provider.sendEmail({
          to: options.to,
          subject: options.subject,
          html: options.html,
          text: options.text,
        });
        success = true;
        this.logger.log(
          `✅ Email sent to ${options.to} via ${this.provider.getProviderName()}`,
        );
      } else {
        // Development mode - log to console
        console.log("\n========== EMAIL (DEVELOPMENT MODE) ==========");
        console.log(`To: ${options.to}`);
        console.log(`Subject: ${options.subject}`);
        console.log(`Type: ${options.emailType}`);
        console.log(`HTML Length: ${options.html.length} chars`);
        console.log("==============================================\n");
        success = true;
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(
        `❌ Failed to send email to ${options.to}: ${error.message}`,
        error.stack,
      );
      success = false;
    }

    // Log to security events
    await this.logEmailEvent({
      tenantId: options.tenantId,
      userId: options.userId,
      emailType: options.emailType,
      recipient: options.to,
      provider: this.provider?.getProviderName() || "console",
      success,
      duration: Date.now() - startTime,
    });

    return success;
  }

  /**
   * Load and compile template
   */
  private async loadTemplate(
    templateName: string,
  ): Promise<HandlebarsTemplateDelegate> {
    // Check cache first
    if (this.templateCache.has(templateName)) {
      return this.templateCache.get(templateName)!;
    }

    const templatePath = path.join(
      __dirname,
      "../../../",
      "templates",
      `${templateName}.html`,
    );

    try {
      const templateContent = fs.readFileSync(templatePath, "utf-8");
      const compiledTemplate = Handlebars.compile(templateContent);
      this.templateCache.set(templateName, compiledTemplate);
      return compiledTemplate;
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(
        `Failed to load template ${templateName}: ${error.message}`,
      );
      throw new Error(`Template ${templateName} not found`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Render template with data
   */
  private async renderTemplate(
    templateName: string,
    data: Record<string, any>,
  ): Promise<string> {
    const template = await this.loadTemplate(templateName);
    return template({
      ...data,
      currentYear: new Date().getFullYear(),
    });
  }

  /**
   * Get tenant branding information
   */
  private async getTenantBranding(tenantId: string): Promise<{
    tenantName: string;
    tenantLogo: string;
  }> {
    try {
      const tenant = await this.tenantRepository.findOne({
        where: { id: tenantId },
      });

      return {
        tenantName: tenant?.name || "Fort Knox",
        tenantLogo:
          // TODO Tenant Logo URL
          // tenant?.metadata?.logoUrl ||
          "https://via.placeholder.com/150x50?text=Fort+Knox",
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.warn(
        `Failed to load tenant branding for ${tenantId}, using defaults`,
      );
      return {
        tenantName: "Fort Knox",
        tenantLogo: "https://via.placeholder.com/150x50?text=Fort+Knox",
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Send welcome email after registration
   */
  async sendWelcomeEmail(
    user: User,
    verificationToken: string,
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const branding = await this.getTenantBranding(user.tenantId);
    const verificationUrl = `${this.configService.get<string>("FRONTEND_URL")}/verify-email?token=${verificationToken}`;

    const html = await this.renderTemplate("welcome", {
      userName: user.firstName || user.email.split("@")[0],
      userEmail: user.email,
      actionUrl: verificationUrl,
      expiresIn: "24 hours",
      ...branding,
    });

    return this.sendEmail({
      to: user.email,
      subject: `Welcome to ${branding.tenantName}!`,
      html,
      tenantId: user.tenantId,
      userId: user.id,
      emailType: "welcome",
    });
  }

  /**
   * Send email verification
   */
  async sendVerificationEmail(
    user: User,
    verificationToken: string,
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const branding = await this.getTenantBranding(user.tenantId);

    const html = await this.renderTemplate("verify-email", {

      actionUrl: verificationUrl,

    });
  }

  /**
   * Send password reset email

  async sendPasswordResetEmail(

  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const branding = await this.getTenantBranding(user.tenantId);

  async sendPasswordResetOtpEmail(

  private logEmailEvent(data: {
    tenantId: string;
    userId?: string;
    emailType: string;
    recipient: string;
    provider: string;
    success: boolean;
    duration: number;
  }): void {
    this.securityEventService.log({
      tenantId: data.tenantId,
      userId: data.userId,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.EMAIL_SENT,
      severity: data.success ? "info" : "warning",
      ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
      userAgent: "email-service",
      metadata: {
        emailType: data.emailType,
        // recipient email is retained for audit traceability — not a secret
        recipient: data.recipient,
        provider: data.provider,
        success: data.success,
        duration: data.duration,
      },
    });
  }

/**
 * Email Provider Interface
 *
 * Abstract interface that all email providers must implement.
 * This allows easy switching between NodeMailer, SES, or other providers.
 */

export interface EmailOptions {
  to: string | string[];
  subject: string;
  html: string;
  text?: string;
  from?: string;
  replyTo?: string;
  cc?: string | string[];
  bcc?: string | string[];
  attachments?: Array<{
    filename: string;
    content?: string | Buffer;
    path?: string;
  }>;
}

export interface EmailProvider {
  /**
   * Send an email
   * @param options Email options
   * @returns Promise that resolves when email is sent
   */
  sendEmail(options: EmailOptions): Promise<void>;

  /**
   * Verify connection/credentials
   * @returns Promise that resolves to true if connection is valid
   */
  verify(): Promise<boolean>;

  /**
   * Get provider name
   * @returns Name of the provider (e.g., "smtp", "ses", "console")
   */
  getProviderName(): string;
}
