// Test suite 2 — revokeSession logout hardening
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

import { SessionService } from "@/common/service/session.service";
import { RedisService } from "@/common/service/redis.service";
import { ConfigService } from "@nestjs/config";

describe("SessionService.revokeSession() logout hardening", () => {
  let sessionService: SessionService;

  const mockSessionRepo = {
    update: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({ affected: 1 }),
  };

  const mockRedis = {
    delete: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
  };

  const mockConfig = {
    get: jest.fn().mockReturnValue(604800),
  };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        SessionService,
        { provide: getRepositoryToken(Session), useValue: mockSessionRepo },
        { provide: RedisService, useValue: mockRedis },
        { provide: ConfigService, useValue: mockConfig },
      ],
    }).compile();

    sessionService = module.get(SessionService);
  });

  it("sets revokedAt, nulls refreshTokenHash, and deletes the Redis key", async () => {
    await sessionService.revokeSession("tenant-1", "sess-1", "user_logout");

    expect(mockSessionRepo.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      { id: "sess-1", tenantId: "tenant-1" },
      expect.objectContaining({
        revokedAt: expect.any(Date),
        revokedReason: "user_logout",
        refreshTokenHash: null,
      }),
    );

    expect(mockRedis.delete).toHaveBeenCalledWith("tenant-1", "session", "sess-1");
  });
});

// Test suite 3 — refresh token double-use rejection

import { UnauthorizedException } from "@nestjs/common";

describe("OAuthRefreshTokenService — double-use of refresh token is rejected", () => {
  let refreshSvc: OAuthRefreshTokenService;

  const usedToken = {
    id: "token-1",
    tokenHash: "doesnotmatter",
    familyId: "family-1",
    tenantId: "tenant-1",
    userId: "user-1",
    sessionId: "sess-1",
    clientId: null,
    scope: null,
    usedAt: new Date(Date.now() - 5000), // already marked as used
    revokedAt: undefined,
    expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000),
    session: { revokedAt: undefined },
    user: { email: "user@example.com" },
  };

  const mockTokenRepo = {
    findOne: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(usedToken),
    save: jest.fn(),
    update: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({ affected: 2 }),
  };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    mockTokenRepo.findOne.mockResolvedValue(usedToken);

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        OAuthRefreshTokenService,
        { provide: getRepositoryToken(OAuthRefreshToken), useValue: mockTokenRepo },
      ],
    }).compile();

    refreshSvc = module.get(OAuthRefreshTokenService);
  });

  it("throws UnauthorizedException when the same token is used twice", async () => {
    await expect(
      refreshSvc.rotateRefreshToken({
        tenantId: "tenant-1",
        token: "any-raw-token",
      }),
    ).rejects.toThrow(UnauthorizedException);
  });

  it("revokes the entire token family when reuse is detected", async () => {
    await expect(
      refreshSvc.rotateRefreshToken({
        tenantId: "tenant-1",
        token: "any-raw-token",
      }),
    ).rejects.toThrow();

    expect(mockTokenRepo.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ familyId: "family-1" }),
      expect.objectContaining({ revokedReason: "family_revoked_reuse_detection" }),
    );
  });
});

import { Injectable, Logger, NotFoundException } from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository, IsNull, LessThan, In } from "typeorm";
import { Session, OAuthRefreshToken } from "@repo/database";
import * as geoip from "geoip-lite";
import { UAParser } from "ua-parser-js";
import { OAuthRefreshTokenService } from "@/modules/oauth/services/oauth-refresh-token.service";

export interface ActiveSessionDto {
  id: string;
  deviceInfo: {
    browser?: string;
    os?: string;
    device?: string;
    type?: string; // mobile, tablet, desktop
  };
  location?: {
    city?: string;
    country?: string;
    timezone?: string;
  };
  ipAddress?: string;
  lastActivity: Date;
  createdAt: Date;
  isCurrent: boolean; // Is this the current session?
  tokenFamily: {
    familyId: string;
    tokensInFamily: number;
    lastUsed: Date;
  };
}

/**
 * SessionManagementService
 *
 * Manages user sessions:
 * - List active sessions
 * - Revoke individual sessions
 * - Logout all devices
 * - Session analytics
 */
@Injectable()
export class SessionManagementService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(SessionManagementService.name);

  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Session)
    private readonly sessionRepository: Repository<Session>,
    @InjectRepository(OAuthRefreshToken)
    private readonly refreshTokenRepository: Repository<OAuthRefreshToken>,
    private readonly oauthRefreshTokenService: OAuthRefreshTokenService,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Get all active sessions for a user
   *
   * Shows:
   * - Device information (browser, OS)
   * - Location (from IP)
   * - Last activity
   * - Current session indicator
   */
  async getActiveSessions(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    currentSessionId?: string,
  ): Promise<ActiveSessionDto[]> {
    // Get all active sessions
    const sessions = await this.sessionRepository.find({
      where: {
        userId,
        tenantId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
      order: {
        lastActivity: "DESC",
      },
    });

    // Get token families for each session
    const activeSessions: ActiveSessionDto[] = [];

    for (const session of sessions) {
      // Get refresh tokens for this session
      const tokens = await this.refreshTokenRepository.find({
        where: {
          sessionId: session.id,
          tenantId,
          revokedAt: IsNull(),
        },
        order: {
          createdAt: "DESC",
        },
      });

      if (tokens.length === 0) {
        // Session has no active tokens, skip
        continue;
      }

      // Get family info
      const familyId = tokens?.[0]?.familyId!;
      const lastUsed = tokens?.[0]?.createdAt!;

      // Parse device info
      const deviceInfo = this.parseUserAgent(session.userAgent);

      // Get location from IP
      const location = this.getLocationFromIP(session.ipAddress);

      activeSessions.push({
        id: session.id,
        deviceInfo,
        location,
        ipAddress: session.ipAddress,
        lastActivity: session.lastActivity,
        createdAt: session.createdAt,
        isCurrent: session.id === currentSessionId,
        tokenFamily: {
          familyId,
          tokensInFamily: tokens.length,
          lastUsed,
        },
      });
    }

    return activeSessions;
  }

  /**
   * Get active session count for a user
   */
  async getActiveSessionCount(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<number> {
    const count = await this.sessionRepository.count({
      where: {
        userId,
        tenantId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
    });

    return count;
  }

  /**
   * Revoke a specific session
   *
   * Also revokes all refresh tokens for that session
   */
  async revokeSession(
    sessionId: string,
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    reason: string = "user_revoked",
  ): Promise<void> {
    // Verify session belongs to user
    const session = await this.sessionRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        id: sessionId,
        userId,
        tenantId,
      },
    });

    if (!session) {
      throw new NotFoundException("Session not found");
    }

    if (session.revokedAt) {
      // Already revoked
      return;
    }

    // Revoke session
    await this.sessionRepository.update(
      { id: sessionId },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: reason,
      },
    );

    // Revoke all refresh tokens for this session
    await this.oauthRefreshTokenService.revokeSessionTokens(
      sessionId,
      tenantId,
      reason,
    );

    this.logger.log("Session revoked", {
      sessionId,
      userId,
      tenantId,
      reason,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Revoke all sessions except current one
   *
   * "Logout all other devices"
   */
  async revokeAllOtherSessions(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    currentSessionId: string,
  ): Promise<number> {
    // Get all sessions except current
    const sessions = await this.sessionRepository.find({
      where: {
        userId,
        tenantId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
    });

    let revokedCount = 0;

    for (const session of sessions) {
      if (session.id !== currentSessionId) {
        await this.revokeSession(
          session.id,
          userId,
          tenantId,
          "user_logout_other_devices",
        );
        revokedCount++;
      }
    }

    this.logger.log("Revoked all other sessions", {
      userId,
      tenantId,
      revokedCount,
      keptSession: currentSessionId,
    });

    return revokedCount;
  }

  /**
   * Revoke all sessions for a user
   *
   * "Logout all devices"
   */
  async revokeAllUserSessions(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    reason: string = "user_logout_all",
  ): Promise<number> {
    // Revoke all sessions
    const result = await this.sessionRepository.update(
      {
        userId,
        tenantId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: reason,
        refreshTokenHash: null as unknown as string,
      },
    );

    // Revoke all refresh tokens
    await this.oauthRefreshTokenService.revokeAllUserTokens(
      userId,
      tenantId,
      reason,
    );

    const revokedCount = result.affected || 0;

    this.logger.log("Revoked all user sessions", {
      userId,
      tenantId,
      revokedCount,
      reason,
    });

    return revokedCount;
  }

  /**
   * Get session analytics for a user
   */
  async getSessionAnalytics(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<{
    totalSessions: number;
    activeSessions: number;
    revokedSessions: number;
    deviceBreakdown: Record<string, number>;
    locationBreakdown: Record<string, number>;
    lastActivity: Date | null;
  }> {
    const allSessions = await this.sessionRepository.find({
      where: { userId, tenantId },
    });

    const activeSessions = allSessions.filter((s) => !s.revokedAt);
    const revokedSessions = allSessions.filter((s) => s.revokedAt);

    // Device breakdown
    const deviceBreakdown: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const session of activeSessions) {
      const device = this.parseUserAgent(session.userAgent);
      const key = device.os || "Unknown";
      deviceBreakdown[key] = (deviceBreakdown[key] || 0) + 1;
    }

    // Location breakdown
    const locationBreakdown: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const session of activeSessions) {
      const location = this.getLocationFromIP(session.ipAddress);
      const key = location?.country || "Unknown";
      locationBreakdown[key] = (locationBreakdown[key] || 0) + 1;
    }

    // Last activity
    const lastActivity =
      activeSessions.length > 0
        ? activeSessions.reduce((latest, session) => {
            return session.lastActivity > (latest as any)
              ? session.lastActivity
              : latest;
          }, activeSessions?.[0]?.lastActivity)
        : null;

    return {
      totalSessions: allSessions.length,
      activeSessions: activeSessions.length,
      revokedSessions: revokedSessions.length,
      deviceBreakdown,
      locationBreakdown,
      lastActivity: lastActivity!,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Cleanup expired sessions
   *
   * Soft-deletes sessions that have passed their expiry date and haven't
   * been revoked yet, and revokes their associated refresh tokens.
   */
  async cleanupExpiredSessions(): Promise<{
    sessionsCleanedUp: number;
    tokensRevoked: number;
  }> {
    const now = new Date();

    const expired = await this.sessionRepository.find({
      where: {
        expiresAt: LessThan(now),
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
        deletedAt: IsNull(),
      },
      select: { id: true },
    });

    if (expired.length === 0) {
      return { sessionsCleanedUp: 0, tokensRevoked: 0 };
    }

    const ids = expired.map((s) => s.id);
    let tokensRevoked = 0;

    await this.sessionRepository.manager.transaction(async (manager) => {
      await manager.softDelete(Session, ids);

      const result = await manager.update(
        OAuthRefreshToken,
        { sessionId: In(ids), revokedAt: IsNull() },
        {
          revokedAt: now,
          revokedReason: "session_expired_cleanup",
        },
      );
      tokensRevoked = result.affected ?? 0;
    });

    this.logger.log("Expired session cleanup complete", {
      sessionsCleanedUp: ids.length,
      tokensRevoked,
    });

    return { sessionsCleanedUp: ids.length, tokensRevoked };
  }

  /**
   * Parse user agent string
   */
  private parseUserAgent(userAgent?: string): {
    browser?: string;
    os?: string;
    device?: string;
    type?: string;
  } {
    if (!userAgent) {
      return {};
    }

    const parser = new UAParser(userAgent);
    const result = parser.getResult();

    return {
      browser: result.browser.name,
      os: `${result.os.name} ${result.os.version}`.trim(),
      device: result.device.model || result.device.type,
      type: result.device.type || "desktop",
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get location from IP address
   */
  private getLocationFromIP(ipAddress?: string):
    | {
        city?: string;
        country?: string;
        timezone?: string;
      }
    | undefined {
    if (!ipAddress) {
      return undefined;
    }

    const geo = geoip.lookup(ipAddress);

    if (!geo) {
      return undefined;
    }

    return {
      city: geo.city,
      country: geo.country,
      timezone: geo.timezone,
    };
  }
}

import {

import { ApiTags, ApiOperation, ApiResponse } from "@nestjs/swagger";
import { Protected } from "../../common/decorators/protected.decorator";
import { SessionManagementService } from "./session-management.service";

@ApiTags("Sessions")
@Controller("sessions")
export class SessionController {
  constructor(
    private readonly sessionManagementService: SessionManagementService,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Get all active sessions for current user
   */
  @Get("active")
  @Protected()
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: "Get active sessions",
    description: "List all active sessions/devices for the current user",
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: "List of active sessions",
  })
  async getActiveSessions(@Req() req: any) {
    const userId = req.user.sub;
    const tenantId = req.tenantId;
    const currentSessionId = req.user.sessionId;

    return this.sessionManagementService.getActiveSessions(
      userId,
      tenantId,
      currentSessionId,
    );
  }

  /**
   * Get session analytics
   */
  @Get("analytics")
  @Protected()
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Get session analytics" })
  async getSessionAnalytics(@Req() req: any) {
    const userId = req.user.sub;
    const tenantId = req.tenantId;

    return this.sessionManagementService.getSessionAnalytics(userId, tenantId);
  }

  /**
   * Revoke a specific session
   */
  @Delete(":sessionId")
  @Protected()
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: "Revoke a session",
    description: "Logout from a specific device/session",
  })
  async revokeSession(@Param("sessionId") sessionId: string, @Req() req: any) {
    const userId = req.user.sub;
    const tenantId = req.tenantId;

    await this.sessionManagementService.revokeSession(
      sessionId,
      userId,
      tenantId,
      "user_revoked_via_api",
    );

    return { message: "Session revoked successfully" };
  }

  /**
   * Revoke all other sessions (logout all devices except current)
   */
  @Delete("all/other")
  @Protected()
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: "Logout all other devices",
    description: "Revoke all sessions except the current one",
  })
  async revokeAllOtherSessions(@Req() req: any) {
    const userId = req.user.sub;
    const tenantId = req.tenantId;
    const currentSessionId = req.user.sessionId;

    const revokedCount =
      await this.sessionManagementService.revokeAllOtherSessions(
        userId,
        tenantId,
        currentSessionId,
      );

    return {
      message: "All other sessions revoked",
      revokedCount,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Revoke all sessions (logout all devices including current)
   */
  @Delete("all")
  @Protected()
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: "Logout all devices",
    description: "Revoke all sessions including the current one",
  })
  async revokeAllSessions(@Req() req: any) {

    const tenantId = req.tenantId;

    const revokedCount =
      await this.sessionManagementService.revokeAllUserSessions(
        userId,
        tenantId,
        "user_logout_all_via_api",
      );

    return {
      message: "All sessions revoked",
      revokedCount,
    };
  }
}

import {
  Controller,
  Get,
  Post,
  Body,
  Query,
  Req,
  Res,
  UseGuards,
  Param,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
  Delete,
  UnauthorizedException,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { AuthGuard } from "@nestjs/passport";
import { JwtService } from "@nestjs/jwt";
import { ConfigService } from "@nestjs/config";
import { ApiTags, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiQuery } from "@nestjs/swagger";
import { type Request, type Response } from "express";
import { SocialAuthService, SocialProfile } from "./social-auth.service";
import { Protected } from "../../common/decorators/protected.decorator";

@ApiTags("Social Authentication")
@Controller("auth/social")
export class SocialAuthController {
  constructor(
    private readonly socialAuthService: SocialAuthService,
    private readonly jwtService: JwtService,
    private readonly configService: ConfigService,
  ) {}

  // ============================================================
  // GOOGLE OAUTH
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Initiate Google OAuth flow
   *
   * GET /auth/social/google/login?tenant_id=xxx&return_url=https://app.example.com
   */
  @Get("google/login")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Login with Google" })
  @ApiQuery({ name: "tenant_id", required: true })
  @ApiQuery({ name: "return_url", required: false })
  googleLogin(@Req() req: Request, @Res() res: Response) {
    const tenantId = (req.query.tenant_id as string) || req.tenantId!;
    const returnUrl = (req.query.return_url as string) || "";
    const state = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ tenantId, returnUrl })).toString("base64url");

    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      client_id: this.configService.getOrThrow("INTERNAL_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"),
      redirect_uri: this.configService.getOrThrow("INTERNAL_GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL"),
      response_type: "code",
      scope: "openid email profile",
      access_type: "offline",
      state,
    });
    return res.redirect(`https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?${params.toString()}`);
  }

  /**
   * Google OAuth callback
   *
   * GET /auth/social/google/callback?code=xxx&state=xxx
   */
  @Get("google/callback")
  @UseGuards(AuthGuard("google"))
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Google OAuth callback" })
  async googleCallback(@Req() req: any, @Res() res: Response) {
    return this.handleSocialCallback(req, res);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // GITHUB OAUTH
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Initiate GitHub OAuth flow
   */
  @Get("github/login")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Login with GitHub" })
  @ApiQuery({ name: "tenant_id", required: true })
  @ApiQuery({ name: "return_url", required: false })
  githubLogin(@Req() req: Request, @Res() res: Response) {
    const tenantId = (req.query.tenant_id as string) || req.tenantId!;
    const returnUrl = (req.query.return_url as string) || "";
    const state = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ tenantId, returnUrl })).toString("base64url");

    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      client_id: this.configService.getOrThrow("INTERNAL_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID"),
      redirect_uri: this.configService.getOrThrow("INTERNAL_GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL"),
      scope: "user:email",
      state,
    });
    return res.redirect(`https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize?${params.toString()}`);
  }

  /**

   */
  @Get("github/callback")
  @UseGuards(AuthGuard("github"))
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "GitHub OAuth callback" })
  async githubCallback(@Req() req: any, @Res() res: Response) {
    return this.handleSocialCallback(req, res);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // MICROSOFT OAUTH
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Initiate Microsoft OAuth flow
   */
  @Get("microsoft/login")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Login with Microsoft" })
  @ApiQuery({ name: "tenant_id", required: true })
  @ApiQuery({ name: "return_url", required: false })
  microsoftLogin(@Req() req: Request, @Res() res: Response) {
    const tenantId = (req.query.tenant_id as string) || req.tenantId!;
    const returnUrl = (req.query.return_url as string) || "";
    const state = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ tenantId, returnUrl })).toString("base64url");

    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      client_id: this.configService.getOrThrow("INTERNAL_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID"),
      redirect_uri: this.configService.getOrThrow("INTERNAL_MICROSOFT_CALLBACK_URL"),
      response_type: "code",

      response_mode: "query",

  /**
   * Microsoft OAuth callback
   */
  @Get("microsoft/callback")
  @UseGuards(AuthGuard("microsoft"))
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Microsoft OAuth callback" })
  async microsoftCallback(@Req() req: any, @Res() res: Response) {
    return this.handleSocialCallback(req, res);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // SHARED CALLBACK HANDLER
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Handle OAuth callback for all providers — state-relay (Approach C)
   */
  private async handleSocialCallback(req: any, res: Response) {
    const profile: SocialProfile = req.user;
    const strategy = profile.provider;

    // Detect link mode (authenticated user linking a social account)
    const rawState = (req.query as any).state as string | undefined;
    if (rawState) {
      let parsedState: any = {};
      try {
        parsedState = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(rawState, "base64url").toString());
      } catch {
        // Not our state format — fall through to normal flow
      }

      if (parsedState.mode === "link" && parsedState.userId) {
        const rawProfile = (req as any).user;
        await this.socialAuthService.handleLinkCallback({
          userId: parsedState.userId,
          tenantId: parsedState.tenantId,
          profile: {
            provider: strategy,
            providerId:
              rawProfile.id || rawProfile.sub || rawProfile.providerId,
            email:
              rawProfile.email || rawProfile.emails?.[0]?.value,
            displayName:
              rawProfile.displayName ||
              rawProfile.name ||
              rawProfile.login ||
              rawProfile.username,
            avatarUrl:
              rawProfile.photos?.[0]?.value ||
              rawProfile.avatar_url ||
              rawProfile.picture,
            accessToken: rawProfile.accessToken || "",
          },
        });
        const adminPortalUrl = this.configService.get<string>(
          "ADMIN_PORTAL_URL",
          "http://localhost:3000",
        );
        return res.redirect(
          `${adminPortalUrl}/u/auth/callback?mode=link&provider=${strategy}`,
        );
      }
    }

    // Decode our base64url state from query param
    let tenantId: string;
    let returnUrl: string;
    try {
      const stateRaw = req.query.state as string;
      const stateObj = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(stateRaw, "base64url").toString());
      tenantId = stateObj.tenantId;
      returnUrl = stateObj.returnUrl || "";
    } catch {
      return res.redirect("/error?message=Invalid+state+parameter");
    }

    if (!tenantId) {
      return res.redirect("/error?message=Missing+tenant+ID");
    }

    // Validate returnUrl to prevent open redirect
    const portalUrl = this.configService.get("PORTAL_URL") || "http://localhost:3000";
    const allowedOrigins = [portalUrl, "http://localhost:3000", "http://localhost:3001"];
    const isSafeReturn = !returnUrl || allowedOrigins.some((o) => returnUrl.startsWith(o));
    const safeReturnUrl = isSafeReturn ? returnUrl : portalUrl;

    try {
      const result = await this.socialAuthService.handleCallback({
        tenantId,
        profile,
        ipAddress: req.ip,
        userAgent: req.headers["user-agent"] || "unknown",
      });

      if (result.type === "link_required") {
        return res.redirect(
          `${safeReturnUrl}/u/link-required?email=${encodeURIComponent(result.email)}&provider=${result.provider}`,
        );
      }

      // Set refresh cookie (same pattern as regular login)
      res.cookie("refreshToken", result.refreshToken, {
        httpOnly: true,
        secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
        sameSite: "strict",
        domain: req.hostname,
        maxAge: 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
        path: "/",
      });

      // Create short-lived completion token (60s, one-time use by the portal)
      const completionToken = this.jwtService.sign(
        { accessToken: result.accessToken, type: "social_completion" },
        { secret: this.configService.get("JWT_SECRET"), expiresIn: "60s" },
      );

      return res.redirect(`${safeReturnUrl}/u/auth/callback?ct=${completionToken}`);
    } catch (error: any) {
      return res.redirect(`${safeReturnUrl}/u/login?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}`);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // CLAIM SESSION (Approach C relay)
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Claim social session using completion token
   *
   * POST /auth/social/claim-session { ct: completionToken }
   * Returns { accessToken } — refresh token is already in httpOnly cookie
   */
  @Post("claim-session")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Claim social session using completion token" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: "Access token returned" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 401, description: "Invalid or expired completion token" })
  async claimSession(@Body() body: { ct: string }) {
    try {
      const payload = this.jwtService.verify(body.ct, {
        secret: this.configService.get("JWT_SECRET"),
      });

      if (payload.type !== "social_completion") {
        throw new Error("Invalid token type");
      }

      return { status: 200, data: { accessToken: payload.accessToken } };
    } catch {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid or expired completion token");
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ACCOUNT LINKING
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Confirm account linking
   *
   * GET /auth/social/link/confirm?token=xxx
   */
  @Get("link/confirm")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Confirm account linking" })
  @ApiQuery({ name: "token", required: true })
  async confirmLinking(@Query("token") token: string, @Res() res: Response) {
    try {
      const result = await this.socialAuthService.confirmLinking(token);

      // Redirect to success page
      const successUrl = new URL(
        `${process.env.INTERNAL_PORTAL_URL}/link-success`,
      );
      successUrl.searchParams.set("message", result.message);

      return res.redirect(successUrl.toString());
    } catch (error: any) {
      return res.redirect(
        `/error?message=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}`,
      );
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ACCOUNT LINKING (authenticated users)
  // ============================================================

  @Post("link/token")
  @Protected()
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  async getLinkToken(@Req() req: any) {
    const { userId, tenantId } = req.user;
    const result = await this.socialAuthService.createLinkToken(
      userId,
      tenantId,
    );
    return { status: 200, data: result };
  }

  @Get("link/google")
  async linkGoogle(
    @Query("lt") linkToken: string,
    @Res() res: Response,
  ) {
    const payload = this.socialAuthService.verifyLinkToken(linkToken);
    const state = Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify({
        mode: "link",
        userId: payload.userId,
        tenantId: payload.tenantId,
      }),
    ).toString("base64url");
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      client_id: this.configService.getOrThrow<string>("INTERNAL_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"),
      redirect_uri: `${this.configService.get<string>("AUTH_SERVICE_URL", "http://localhost:3001")}/auth/social/google/callback`,
      response_type: "code",
      scope: "email profile",
      state,
    });
    return res.redirect(
      `https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?${params}`,
    );
  }

  @Get("link/github")
  async linkGithub(
    @Query("lt") linkToken: string,
    @Res() res: Response,
  ) {
    const payload = this.socialAuthService.verifyLinkToken(linkToken);
    const state = Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify({
        mode: "link",
        userId: payload.userId,
        tenantId: payload.tenantId,
      }),
    ).toString("base64url");
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      client_id: this.configService.getOrThrow<string>("INTERNAL_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID"),
      redirect_uri: `${this.configService.get<string>("AUTH_SERVICE_URL", "http://localhost:3001")}/auth/social/github/callback`,
      response_type: "code",
      scope: "user:email",
      state,
    });
    return res.redirect(
      `https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize?${params}`,
    );
  }

  @Get("link/microsoft")
  async linkMicrosoft(
    @Query("lt") linkToken: string,
    @Res() res: Response,
  ) {
    const payload = this.socialAuthService.verifyLinkToken(linkToken);
    const state = Buffer.from(
      JSON.stringify({
        mode: "link",
        userId: payload.userId,
        tenantId: payload.tenantId,
      }),
    ).toString("base64url");
    const msTenant = this.configService.get<string>(
      "MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID",
      "common",
    );
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      client_id: this.configService.getOrThrow<string>("INTERNAL_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID"),
      redirect_uri: `${this.configService.get<string>("AUTH_SERVICE_URL", "http://localhost:3001")}/auth/social/microsoft/callback`,
      response_type: "code",
      scope: "openid email profile",
      state,
    });
    return res.redirect(
      `https://login.microsoftonline.com/${msTenant}/oauth2/v2.0/authorize?${params}`,
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // MANAGE CONNECTIONS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Get user's social connections
   *
   * GET /auth/social/connections
   */
  @Get("connections")
  @Protected()
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Get connected social accounts" })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: "List of connected social accounts",
  })
  async getConnections(@Req() req: any) {
    const userId = req.user.sub;
    const tenantId = req.tenantId;

    return this.socialAuthService.getUserConnections(userId, tenantId);
  }

  /**
   * Unlink social account
   *
   * DELETE /auth/social/connections/:provider
   */
  @Delete("connections/:provider")
  @Protected()
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Unlink social account" })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: "Social account unlinked",
  })
  async unlinkAccount(@Req() req: any, @Param("provider") provider: string) {
    const userId = req.user.sub;
    const tenantId = req.tenantId;

    return this.socialAuthService.unlinkAccount(userId, tenantId, provider);
  }
}

import {
  Injectable,
  Logger,
  UnauthorizedException,
  ConflictException,
  NotFoundException,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository } from "typeorm";
import { ConfigService } from "@nestjs/config";
import { JwtService } from "@nestjs/jwt";
import {
  User,
  UserSocialConnection,
  TenantSocialProvider,
  SocialLinkRequest,
  Session,
  SecurityEventType,
} from "@repo/database";
import { SecurityEventService } from "@/common/service/security-event.service";
import { TokenEncryptionService } from "../auth/oauth-token-encryption.service";
import * as crypto from "crypto";
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from "uuid";
import { SessionService } from "@/common/service/session.service";
import { OAuthRefreshTokenService } from "@/modules/oauth/services/oauth-refresh-token.service";

export interface SocialProfile {
  provider: "google" | "github" | "microsoft" | "apple" | "linkedin";
  providerId: string;
  email: string;
  emailVerified?: boolean;
  displayName?: string;
  firstName?: string;
  lastName?: string;
  avatarUrl?: string;
  accessToken: string;
  refreshToken?: string;
  expiresIn?: number;
  scopes?: string;
  raw?: any; // Raw provider response
}

/**
 * SocialAuthService
 *
 * Main service for social authentication
 *
 * Features:
 * - Login with Google/GitHub/Microsoft/etc.
 * - Auto-create users on first login
 * - Account linking (explicit with verification)
 * - Token storage (encrypted)
 * - Multi-tenant support
 */
@Injectable()
export class SocialAuthService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(SocialAuthService.name);

  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private readonly userRepository: Repository<User>,
    @InjectRepository(UserSocialConnection)
    private readonly socialConnectionRepository: Repository<UserSocialConnection>,
    @InjectRepository(TenantSocialProvider)
    private readonly tenantProviderRepository: Repository<TenantSocialProvider>,
    @InjectRepository(SocialLinkRequest)
    private readonly linkRequestRepository: Repository<SocialLinkRequest>,
    private readonly securityEventService: SecurityEventService,
    private readonly tokenEncryptionService: TokenEncryptionService,
    private readonly sessionService: SessionService,
    private readonly oauthRefreshTokenService: OAuthRefreshTokenService,
    private readonly jwtService: JwtService,
    private readonly configService: ConfigService,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Handle social login callback
   *
   * This is called after user approves OAuth at provider
   *
   * Flow:
   * 1. Check if social connection exists
   * 2. If YES: Login user
   * 3. If NO: Check if email exists
   *    a. If email exists: Initiate account linking
   *    b. If email doesn't exist: Create new user
   */
  async handleCallback(params: {
    tenantId: string;
    profile: SocialProfile;
    ipAddress: string;
    userAgent: string;
  }): Promise<
    | { type: "success"; accessToken: string; refreshToken: string; user: any }
    | {
        type: "link_required";
        email: string;
        provider: string;
        message: string;
      }
  > {
    const { tenantId, profile, ipAddress, userAgent } = params;

    this.logger.log("Handling social login callback", {
      tenantId,
      provider: profile.provider,
      email: profile.email,
    });

    // Step 1: Check if social connection exists
    const existingConnection = await this.socialConnectionRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        provider: profile.provider,
        providerId: profile.providerId,
      },
      relations: ["user"],
    });

    if (existingConnection) {
      // User exists, login
      return this.loginWithSocialConnection(
        existingConnection,
        profile,
        ipAddress,
        userAgent,
      );
    }

    // Step 2: Check if user with this email exists
    const existingUser = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        email: profile.email,
      },
    });

    if (existingUser) {
      // Email exists, require account linking
      this.logger.log("User exists with email, requiring account linking", {
        userId: existingUser.id,
        email: profile.email,
        provider: profile.provider,
      });

      // Create link request (user needs to confirm via email)
      await this.createLinkRequest(existingUser, profile, ipAddress, userAgent);

      return {
        type: "link_required",
        email: profile.email,
        provider: profile.provider,
        message:
          "An account with this email already exists. Please check your email to link accounts.",
      };
    }

    // Step 3: No existing user, create new account
    return this.createUserWithSocialConnection(
      tenantId,
      profile,
      ipAddress,
      userAgent,
    );
  }

  /**
   * Login user with existing social connection
   */
  private async loginWithSocialConnection(
    connection: UserSocialConnection,
    profile: SocialProfile,
    ipAddress: string,
    userAgent: string,
  ): Promise<{
    type: "success";
    accessToken: string;
    refreshToken: string;
    user: any;
  }> {
    const user = connection.user;

    this.logger.log("Logging in user with social connection", {
      userId: user.id,
      provider: profile.provider,
    });

    // Update connection tokens
    const encryptedTokens = this.tokenEncryptionService.encryptTokens({
      accessToken: profile.accessToken,
      refreshToken: profile.refreshToken,
    });

    await this.socialConnectionRepository.update(connection.id, {
      accessToken: encryptedTokens.accessToken,
      refreshToken: encryptedTokens.refreshToken,
      tokenExpiresAt: profile.expiresIn
        ? new Date(Date.now() + profile.expiresIn * 1000)
        : undefined,
      lastUsedAt: new Date(),
      // Update profile data
      email: profile.email,
      displayName: profile.displayName,
      avatarUrl: profile.avatarUrl,
    });

    // Create session
    const session = await this.sessionService.createSession({
      userId: user.id,
      tenantId: connection.tenantId,
      email: user.email,
      ipAddress,
      userAgent,
    });

    // Create refresh token
    const { token: refreshToken } =
      await this.oauthRefreshTokenService.createRefreshToken({
        tenantId: connection.tenantId,
        userId: user.id,
        sessionId: session.id,
        ipAddress,
        userAgent,
      });

    // Generate access token
    const accessToken = this.jwtService.sign(
      {
        sub: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        tenantId: connection.tenantId,
        sessionId: session.id,
      },
      {
        secret: this.configService.get("JWT_SECRET"),
        expiresIn: "15m",
      },
    );

    // Update user last login
    await this.userRepository.update(user.id, {
      lastLoginAt: new Date(),
      lastLoginIp: ipAddress,
    });

    // Log security event
    this.securityEventService.log({
      tenantId: connection.tenantId,
      userId: user.id,
      actorEmail: user.email,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.SOCIAL_LOGIN_SUCCESS,
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress,
      userAgent,
      resourceId: session.id,
      resourceType: "session",
      metadata: {
        provider: profile.provider,
        sessionId: session.id,
      },
    });

    this.logger.log("Social login successful", {
      userId: user.id,
      provider: profile.provider,
    });

    return {
      type: "success",
      accessToken,
      refreshToken,
      user: {
        id: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        firstName: user.firstName,
        lastName: user.lastName,
        displayName: user.displayName,
        avatarUrl: user.avatarUrl || profile.avatarUrl,
        emailVerified: user.emailVerified,
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Create new user with social connection
   */
  private async createUserWithSocialConnection(
    tenantId: string,
    profile: SocialProfile,
    ipAddress: string,
    userAgent: string,
  ): Promise<{
    type: "success";
    accessToken: string;
    refreshToken: string;
    user: any;
  }> {
    this.logger.log("Creating new user with social connection", {
      tenantId,
      provider: profile.provider,
      email: profile.email,
    });

    // Create user
    const user = await this.userRepository.save({
      tenantId,
      email: profile.email,
      emailVerified: profile.emailVerified ?? true, // Trust provider verification
      firstName: profile.firstName || profile.displayName?.split(" ")[0],
      lastName:
        profile.lastName || profile.displayName?.split(" ").slice(1).join(" "),
      displayName: profile.displayName,
      avatarUrl: profile.avatarUrl,
      primaryAuthMethod: profile.provider,
      passwordHash: undefined, // No password for social users
      status: "active",
    });

    // Encrypt tokens
    const encryptedTokens = this.tokenEncryptionService.encryptTokens({
      accessToken: profile.accessToken,
      refreshToken: profile.refreshToken,
    });

    // Create social connection
    await this.socialConnectionRepository.save({
      tenantId,
      userId: user.id,
      provider: profile.provider,
      providerId: profile.providerId,
      email: profile.email,
      displayName: profile.displayName,
      avatarUrl: profile.avatarUrl,
      accessToken: encryptedTokens.accessToken,
      refreshToken: encryptedTokens.refreshToken,
      tokenExpiresAt: profile.expiresIn
        ? new Date(Date.now() + profile.expiresIn * 1000)
        : undefined,
      scopes: profile.scopes,
      metadata: profile.raw,
      primary: true,
      lastUsedAt: new Date(),
    });

    // Create session
    const session = await this.sessionService.createSession({
      userId: user.id,
      tenantId,
      email: user.email,
      ipAddress,
      userAgent,
    });

    // Create refresh token
    const { token: refreshToken } =
      await this.oauthRefreshTokenService.createRefreshToken({
        tenantId,
        userId: user.id,
        sessionId: session.id,
        ipAddress,
        userAgent,
      });

    // Generate access token
    const accessToken = this.jwtService.sign(
      {
        sub: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        tenantId,
        sessionId: session.id,
      },
      {
        secret: this.configService.get("JWT_SECRET"),
        expiresIn: "15m",
      },
    );

    // Log security event
    this.securityEventService.log({
      tenantId,
      userId: user.id,
      actorEmail: user.email,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.SOCIAL_USER_CREATED,
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress,
      userAgent,
      resourceId: session.id,
      resourceType: "session",
      metadata: {
        provider: profile.provider,
        sessionId: session.id,
      },
    });

    this.logger.log("New user created with social connection", {
      userId: user.id,
      provider: profile.provider,
    });

    return {
      type: "success",
      accessToken,
      refreshToken,
      user: {
        id: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        firstName: user.firstName,
        lastName: user.lastName,
        displayName: user.displayName,
        avatarUrl: user.avatarUrl,
        emailVerified: user.emailVerified,
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Create account linking request
   *
   * Sends email to user to confirm linking
   */
  private async createLinkRequest(
    user: User,
    profile: SocialProfile,
    ipAddress: string,
    userAgent: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    // Generate verification token
    const token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex");

    // Encrypt tokens for storage
    const encryptedTokens = this.tokenEncryptionService.encryptTokens({
      accessToken: profile.accessToken,
      refreshToken: profile.refreshToken,
    });

    // Create link request
    await this.linkRequestRepository.save({
      tenantId: user.tenantId,
      userId: user.id,
      provider: profile.provider,
      providerId: profile.providerId,
      providerEmail: profile.email,
      token,
      profileData: {
        displayName: profile.displayName,
        avatarUrl: profile.avatarUrl,
        accessToken: encryptedTokens.accessToken!,
        refreshToken: encryptedTokens.refreshToken,
        tokenExpiresAt: profile.expiresIn
          ? new Date(Date.now() + profile.expiresIn * 1000)
          : undefined,
        scopes: profile.scopes,
        metadata: profile.raw,
      },
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 60 * 1000), // 1 hour
      ipAddress,
      userAgent,
    });

    // TODO: Send email with link
    // await this.emailService.sendAccountLinkRequest({
    //   to: user.email,
    //   provider: profile.provider,
    //   linkUrl: `https://${tenant}.auth.scrolloop.com/auth/link/confirm?token=${token}`,
    // });

    this.logger.log("Account link request created", {
      userId: user.id,
      provider: profile.provider,
      token,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Confirm account linking
   *
   * User clicks link in email to confirm
   */
  async confirmLinking(token: string): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    message: string;
  }> {
    this.logger.log("Confirming account linking", { token });

    // Find link request
    const linkRequest = await this.linkRequestRepository.findOne({
      where: { token, completed: false },
      relations: ["user"],
    });

    if (!linkRequest) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid or expired linking token");
    }

    if (linkRequest.isExpired) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Linking token has expired");
    }

    // Create social connection
    await this.socialConnectionRepository.save({
      tenantId: linkRequest.tenantId,
      userId: linkRequest.userId,
      provider: linkRequest.provider,
      providerId: linkRequest.providerId,
      email: linkRequest.providerEmail,
      displayName: linkRequest.profileData.displayName,
      avatarUrl: linkRequest.profileData.avatarUrl,
      accessToken: linkRequest.profileData.accessToken,
      refreshToken: linkRequest.profileData.refreshToken,
      tokenExpiresAt: linkRequest.profileData.tokenExpiresAt,
      scopes: linkRequest.profileData.scopes,
      metadata: linkRequest.profileData.metadata,
      primary: false,
      lastUsedAt: new Date(),
    });

    // Mark request as completed
    await this.linkRequestRepository.update(linkRequest.id, {
      completed: true,
      completedAt: new Date(),
    });

    // Log security event
    this.securityEventService.log({
      tenantId: linkRequest.tenantId,
      userId: linkRequest.userId,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.SOCIAL_ACCOUNT_LINKED,
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: linkRequest.ipAddress ?? "",
      userAgent: linkRequest.userAgent ?? "",
      metadata: {
        provider: linkRequest.provider,
      },
    });

    this.logger.log("Account linking confirmed", {
      userId: linkRequest.userId,
      provider: linkRequest.provider,
    });

    return {
      success: true,
      message: `${linkRequest.provider} account linked successfully`,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Unlink social account
   */
  async unlinkAccount(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    provider: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    this.logger.log("Unlinking social account", {
      userId,
      tenantId,
      provider,
    });

    // Find connection
    const connection = await this.socialConnectionRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        userId,
        tenantId,
        provider: provider as any,
      },
    });

    if (!connection) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Social connection not found");
    }

    // Check if user has password or other auth method
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: userId, tenantId },
      select: ["passwordHash"],
    });

    const otherConnections = await this.socialConnectionRepository.count({
      where: {
        userId,
        tenantId,
      },
    });

    if (!user?.passwordHash && otherConnections <= 1) {
      throw new ConflictException(
        "Cannot unlink last authentication method. Set a password first.",
      );
    }

    // Delete connection
    await this.socialConnectionRepository.delete(connection.id);

    // Log security event
    this.securityEventService.log({
      tenantId,
      userId,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.SOCIAL_ACCOUNT_UNLINKED,
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
      userAgent: "system",
      metadata: {
        provider,
      },
    });

    this.logger.log("Social account unlinked", {
      userId,
      provider,
    });

    return {
      success: true,
      message: `${provider} account unlinked successfully`,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get user's social connections
   */
  async getUserConnections(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<UserSocialConnection[]> {
    return this.socialConnectionRepository.find({
      where: {
        userId,
        tenantId,
      },
      select: [
        "id",
        "provider",
        "email",
        "displayName",
        "avatarUrl",
        "primary",
        "lastUsedAt",
        "createdAt",
      ],
      order: {
        primary: "DESC",
        lastUsedAt: "DESC",
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Create a short-lived link token for authenticated social account linking.
   * The token encodes userId + tenantId and expires in 60 seconds.
   */
  async createLinkToken(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<{ linkToken: string }> {
    const linkToken = this.jwtService.sign(
      { userId, tenantId, mode: "link" },
      { expiresIn: "60s" },
    );
    return { linkToken };
  }

  /**
   * Verify and decode a link token. Throws UnauthorizedException if invalid/expired.
   */
  verifyLinkToken(token: string): { userId: string; tenantId: string } {
    try {
      return this.jwtService.verify(token) as {
        userId: string;
        tenantId: string;
      };
    } catch {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid or expired link token");
    }
  }

  /**
   * Directly link a social account to an already-authenticated user.
   * Called when the OAuth callback detects state.mode === "link".
   */
  async handleLinkCallback(params: {
    userId: string;
    tenantId: string;
    profile: SocialProfile;
  }): Promise<{ provider: string }> {
    const { userId, tenantId, profile } = params;

    // Idempotent — if already linked, succeed silently
    const existing = await this.socialConnectionRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        userId,
        tenantId,
        provider: profile.provider,
        providerId: profile.providerId,
      },
    });
    if (existing) {
      return { provider: profile.provider };
    }

    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: userId, tenantId },
    });
    if (!user) throw new NotFoundException("User not found");

    const connection = this.socialConnectionRepository.create({
      userId,
      tenantId,
      provider: profile.provider,
      providerId: profile.providerId,
      email: profile.email,
      displayName: profile.displayName,
      avatarUrl: profile.avatarUrl,
      primary: false,
    });
    await this.socialConnectionRepository.save(connection);

    this.logger.log(`Linked ${profile.provider} account for user ${userId}`);
    return { provider: profile.provider };
  }
}

import { Injectable, Logger } from "@nestjs/common";
import { PassportStrategy } from "@nestjs/passport";
import { Strategy, Profile } from "passport-github2";
import { ConfigService } from "@nestjs/config";
import { SocialProfile } from "../social-auth.service";

/**
 * GitHubStrategy
 *
 * Passport strategy for GitHub OAuth
 *
 * Scopes:
 * - user:email: Get user's email addresses
 *
 * Note: GitHub doesn't use OIDC, just OAuth 2.0
 */
@Injectable()
export class GitHubStrategy extends PassportStrategy(Strategy, "github") {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(GitHubStrategy.name);

  constructor(private configService: ConfigService) {
    super({
      clientID: configService.getOrThrow<string>("INTERNAL_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID"),
      clientSecret: configService.getOrThrow<string>(
        "INTERNAL_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET",
      ),
      callbackURL: configService.getOrThrow<string>(
        "INTERNAL_GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL",
      ),
      scope: ["user:email"],
      passReqToCallback: true,
    });

    this.logger.log("GitHubStrategy initialized");
  }

  async validate(
    req: any,
    accessToken: string,
    refreshToken: string | undefined,
    profile: Profile,
    done: (error: any, user?: any) => void,
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.logger.debug("GitHub OAuth callback received", {
        profileId: profile.id,
        username: profile.username,
      });

      // GitHub can return multiple emails
      const primaryEmail: any =
        profile.emails?.find((e: any) => e.primary) || profile.emails?.[0];
      const email = primaryEmail?.value;

      if (!email) {
        return done(new Error("Email not provided by GitHub"), undefined);
      }

      // Map to SocialProfile
      const socialProfile: SocialProfile = {
        provider: "github",
        providerId: profile.id,
        email,
        emailVerified: primaryEmail?.verified ?? false,
        displayName: profile.displayName || profile.username,
        firstName: profile.name?.givenName,
        lastName: profile.name?.familyName,
        avatarUrl: profile.photos?.[0]?.value || (profile as any).avatar_url,
        accessToken,
        refreshToken,
        scopes: "user:email",
        raw: (profile as any)._json,
      };

      done(null, socialProfile);
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error("GitHub validation error", {
        error: error.message,
        stack: error.stack,
      });
      done(error, undefined);
    }
  }
}

import { Injectable, Logger } from "@nestjs/common";

/**
 * GoogleStrategy
 *
 * Passport strategy for Google OAuth 2.0
 *
 * Scopes:
 * - openid: Required for OIDC
 * - email: Get user's email
 * - profile: Get user's profile (name, picture)
 */
@Injectable()
export class GoogleStrategy extends PassportStrategy(Strategy, "google") {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(GoogleStrategy.name);

  constructor(private configService: ConfigService) {
    super({
      clientID: configService.getOrThrow<string>("INTERNAL_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"),
      clientSecret: configService.getOrThrow<string>(
        "INTERNAL_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET",
      ),
      callbackURL: configService.getOrThrow<string>(
        "INTERNAL_GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL",
      ),
      scope: ["openid", "email", "profile"],
      passReqToCallback: true,
      state: false, // We manage state ourselves (base64url JSON)
    });

    this.logger.log("GoogleStrategy initialized");
  }

  /**
   * Validate callback
   *
   * Called after user approves OAuth at Google
   *
   * @param req Express request
   * @param accessToken Google access token
   * @param refreshToken Google refresh token (might be undefined)
   * @param profile User profile from Google
   * @param done Callback
   */
  async validate(
    req: any,
    accessToken: string,
    refreshToken: string | undefined,
    profile: Profile,
    done: VerifyCallback,
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.logger.debug("Google OAuth callback received", {
        profileId: profile.id,
        email: profile.emails?.[0]?.value,
      });

      // Extract data from Google profile
      const email = profile.emails?.[0]?.value;
      const emailVerified = profile.emails?.[0]?.verified ?? false;

      if (!email) {
        return done(new Error("Email not provided by Google"), undefined);
      }

      // Map to SocialProfile
      const socialProfile: SocialProfile = {
        provider: "google",
        providerId: profile.id,
        email,
        emailVerified,
        displayName: profile.displayName,
        firstName: profile.name?.givenName,
        lastName: profile.name?.familyName,
        avatarUrl: profile.photos?.[0]?.value,
        accessToken,
        refreshToken,
        scopes: "openid email profile",
        raw: profile._json,
      };

      // Attach to request for controller
      done(null, socialProfile);
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error("Google validation error", {
        error: error.message,
        stack: error.stack,
      });
      done(error, undefined);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * FileStorageService
 *
 * Disk-based file storage adapter.
 * Swap the `store()` implementation for S3/MinIO when needed.
 */
import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';

@Injectable()
export class FileStorageService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(FileStorageService.name);

  /** Absolute path to the uploads directory */
  private readonly uploadDir: string;

  /** Public base URL for serving stored files */
  private readonly publicBaseUrl: string;

  constructor() {
    this.uploadDir = process.env.UPLOAD_DIR ?? path.join(process.cwd(), 'uploads');
    this.publicBaseUrl =
      (process.env.PUBLIC_BASE_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4000').replace(/\/$/, '');

    if (!fs.existsSync(this.uploadDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(this.uploadDir, { recursive: true });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Persist a buffer to disk and return its public URL.
   * @param buffer  Raw file bytes.
   * @param mimeType  MIME type used to derive extension.
   * @param prefix  Optional path prefix (e.g. 'logos').
   */
  async store(
    buffer: Buffer,
    mimeType: string,
    prefix = 'uploads',
  ): Promise<string> {
    const ext = this.extensionFor(mimeType);
    const filename = `${prefix}-${crypto.randomUUID()}${ext}`;
    const filePath = path.join(this.uploadDir, filename);

    await fs.promises.writeFile(filePath, buffer);
    this.logger.debug(`Stored file: ${filePath}`);

    return `${this.publicBaseUrl}/uploads/${filename}`;
  }

  private extensionFor(mimeType: string): string {
    switch (mimeType) {
      case 'image/png':
        return '.png';
      case 'image/jpeg':
      case 'image/jpg':
        return '.jpg';
      case 'image/svg+xml':
        return '.svg';
      default:
        return '';
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Tenant Branding Controller
 *
 * GET  /tenants/current/branding        – return branding (or defaults)
 * PUT  /tenants/current/branding        – upsert branding, write audit event
 * POST /tenants/current/branding/logo   – upload logo (multipart/form-data)
 */

import {
  Controller,
  Get,
  Put,
  Post,
  Body,
  Param,
  Req,
  BadRequestException,
  UnsupportedMediaTypeException,
  PayloadTooLargeException,
  UseInterceptors,
  UploadedFile,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { FileInterceptor } from '@nestjs/platform-express';
import { TenantBrandingService } from './tenant-branding.service';
import { Protected } from '@/common/decorators/protected.decorator';
import {
  BrandingResponse,
  LogoUploadResponse,
  TenantBrandingDto,
} from './dto/tenant-branding.dto';
import { SecurityEventService } from '@/common/service/security-event.service';
import { SecurityEventType } from '@repo/database';

const LOGO_MAX_BYTES = 500 * 1024; // 500 KB
const ALLOWED_MIME = new Set(['image/png', 'image/svg+xml', 'image/jpeg']);

@Controller('tenants/current/branding')
@Protected()
export class TenantBrandingController {
  constructor(
    private readonly brandingService: TenantBrandingService,
    private readonly securityEvents: SecurityEventService,
  ) {}

  /** GET /tenants/current/branding */
  @Get()
  async getBranding(@Req() req: any): Promise<BrandingResponse> {
    const tenantId: string = req.tenantId!;
    return this.brandingService.getBranding(tenantId);
  }

  /** PUT /tenants/current/branding */
  @Put()
  async updateBranding(
    @Req() req: any,
    @Body() dto: TenantBrandingDto,
  ): Promise<BrandingResponse> {
    const tenantId: string = req.tenantId!;
    const userId: string = req.user?.sub;

    const result = await this.brandingService.upsertBranding(tenantId, dto);

    this.securityEvents.log({
      tenantId,
      userId,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.BRANDING_UPDATED,
      severity: 'info',
      ipAddress: req.ip ?? '0.0.0.0',
      userAgent: req.headers['user-agent'] ?? 'unknown',
      actorEmail: req.user?.email,
      resourceId: tenantId,
      resourceType: 'tenant_branding',
      metadata: {
        primaryColor: dto.primaryColor,
        fontFamily: dto.fontFamily,
        headerWeight: dto.headerWeight,
        backgroundStyle: dto.backgroundStyle,
      },
    });

    return result;
  }

  /** POST /tenants/current/branding/logo */
  @Post('logo')
  @UseInterceptors(
    FileInterceptor('logo', {
      limits: { fileSize: LOGO_MAX_BYTES },
      fileFilter: (_req, file, cb) => {
        if (ALLOWED_MIME.has(file.mimetype)) {
          cb(null, true);
        } else {
          cb(
            new UnsupportedMediaTypeException(
              'Logo must be image/png, image/jpeg, or image/svg+xml',
            ),
            false,
          );
        }
      },
    }),
  )
  async uploadLogo(
    @Req() req: any,
    @UploadedFile() file: Express.Multer.File | undefined,
  ): Promise<LogoUploadResponse> {
    if (!file) {
      throw new BadRequestException('No file uploaded. Use field name "logo".');
    }

    if (file.size > LOGO_MAX_BYTES) {
      throw new PayloadTooLargeException('Logo must be 500 KB or smaller');
    }

    const tenantId: string = req.tenantId!;
    const logoUrl = await this.brandingService.storeLogo(
      tenantId,
      file.buffer,
      file.mimetype,
    );

    this.securityEvents.log({
      tenantId,
      userId: req.user?.sub,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.BRANDING_UPDATED,
      severity: 'info',
      ipAddress: req.ip ?? '0.0.0.0',
      userAgent: req.headers['user-agent'] ?? 'unknown',
      actorEmail: req.user?.email,
      resourceId: tenantId,
      resourceType: 'tenant_branding',
      metadata: { logoUploaded: true, mimeType: file.mimetype, sizeBytes: file.size },
    });

    return { logoUrl };
  }
}

/**
 * Public branding endpoint — no authentication required.
 * Used by the hosted login page to fetch branding by tenant slug.
 *
 * GET /tenants/:slug/branding/public
 */
@Controller('tenants')
export class PublicBrandingController {
  constructor(private readonly brandingService: TenantBrandingService) {}

  @Get(':slug/branding/public')
  getBrandingPublic(@Param('slug') slug: string): Promise<BrandingResponse> {
    return this.brandingService.getBrandingBySlug(slug);
  }
}

import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { getRepositoryToken } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';

import { FileStorageService } from './file-storage.service';
import { TenantBranding } from '@repo/database';

// ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function makeBrandingRow(overrides: Partial<TenantBranding> = {}): TenantBranding {
  return Object.assign(new TenantBranding(), {
    id: 'row-uuid',
    tenantId: 'tenant-uuid',
    primaryColor: '#6366f1',
    fontFamily: 'Inter',
    headerWeight: 'bold' as const,
    backgroundStyle: 'solid' as const,
    createdAt: new Date(),
    updatedAt: new Date(),
    ...overrides,
  });
}

describe('TenantBrandingService', () => {
  let service: TenantBrandingService;
  let repo: jest.Mocked<Repository<TenantBranding>>;
  let fileStorage: jest.Mocked<FileStorageService>;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    const mockRepo: Partial<jest.Mocked<Repository<TenantBranding>>> = {
      findOne: jest.fn(),
      create: jest.fn(),
      save: jest.fn(),
      createQueryBuilder: jest.fn(),
    };

    const mockFileStorage: Partial<jest.Mocked<FileStorageService>> = {
      store: jest.fn(),
    };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        TenantBrandingService,
        { provide: getRepositoryToken(TenantBranding), useValue: mockRepo },
        { provide: FileStorageService, useValue: mockFileStorage },
      ],
    }).compile();

    service = module.get(TenantBrandingService);
    repo = module.get(getRepositoryToken(TenantBranding));
    fileStorage = module.get(FileStorageService);
  });

  // ── getBranding ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  describe('getBranding', () => {
    it('returns defaults when no row exists', async () => {
      repo.findOne.mockResolvedValue(null);
      const result = await service.getBranding('tenant-uuid');
      expect(result.primaryColor).toBe('#6366f1');
      expect(result.fontFamily).toBe('Inter');
      expect(result.headerWeight).toBe('bold');
      expect(result.backgroundStyle).toBe('solid');
      expect(result.logoUrl).toBeUndefined();
    });

    it('returns stored row values', async () => {
      repo.findOne.mockResolvedValue(
        makeBrandingRow({ primaryColor: '#ff0000', logoUrl: 'https://cdn.example.com/logo.png' }),
      );
      const result = await service.getBranding('tenant-uuid');
      expect(result.primaryColor).toBe('#ff0000');
      expect(result.logoUrl).toBe('https://cdn.example.com/logo.png');
    });
  });

  // ── upsertBranding (save round-trip) ────────────────────────

  describe('upsertBranding', () => {
    it('creates a new row when none exists and returns the saved values', async () => {
      repo.findOne.mockResolvedValue(null);
      const newRow = makeBrandingRow({ primaryColor: '#123456' });
      repo.create.mockReturnValue(newRow);
      repo.save.mockResolvedValue(newRow);

      const result = await service.upsertBranding('tenant-uuid', {
        primaryColor: '#123456',
        fontFamily: 'Poppins',
        headerWeight: 'regular',
        backgroundStyle: 'gradient',
      });

      expect(repo.create).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(repo.save).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(result.primaryColor).toBe('#123456');
    });

    it('merges updates into an existing row', async () => {
      const existing = makeBrandingRow({ primaryColor: '#aabbcc' });
      repo.findOne.mockResolvedValue(existing);
      repo.save.mockImplementation(async (row) => row as TenantBranding);

      const result = await service.upsertBranding('tenant-uuid', {
        primaryColor: '#112233',
      });

      expect(result.primaryColor).toBe('#112233');
      // Other fields unchanged
      expect(result.fontFamily).toBe('Inter');
    });

    it('only saves fields that are explicitly provided', async () => {
      const existing = makeBrandingRow({
        primaryColor: '#aabbcc',
        fontFamily: 'Roboto',
      });
      repo.findOne.mockResolvedValue(existing);
      repo.save.mockImplementation(async (row) => row as TenantBranding);

      const result = await service.upsertBranding('tenant-uuid', {
        headerWeight: 'regular',
      });

      expect(result.fontFamily).toBe('Roboto');   // unchanged
      expect(result.headerWeight).toBe('regular'); // updated
    });
  });

  // ── storeLogo ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  describe('storeLogo', () => {
    it('stores file and returns public URL', async () => {
      const publicUrl = 'http://localhost:4000/uploads/logo-tenant-uuid-abc.png';
      fileStorage.store.mockResolvedValue(publicUrl);
      const existing = makeBrandingRow();
      repo.findOne.mockResolvedValue(existing);
      repo.save.mockImplementation(async (row) => row as TenantBranding);

      const url = await service.storeLogo(
        'tenant-uuid',
        Buffer.from('fake-png'),
        'image/png',
      );

      expect(url).toBe(publicUrl);
      expect(fileStorage.store).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.any(Buffer),
        'image/png',
        'logo-tenant-uuid',
      );
    });

    it('creates branding row if it does not exist before storing logo', async () => {
      fileStorage.store.mockResolvedValue('http://localhost:4000/uploads/logo.png');
      repo.findOne.mockResolvedValue(null);
      const newRow = makeBrandingRow();
      repo.create.mockReturnValue(newRow);
      repo.save.mockImplementation(async (row) => row as TenantBranding);

      await service.storeLogo('tenant-uuid', Buffer.from('data'), 'image/jpeg');

      expect(repo.create).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(repo.save).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
});

/**
 * TenantBrandingService
 *
 * Manages the tenant_branding table (one row per tenant).
 */
import { Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { TenantBranding } from '@repo/database';
import { BrandingResponse, TenantBrandingDto } from './dto/tenant-branding.dto';
import { FileStorageService } from './file-storage.service';

const DEFAULTS: Omit<BrandingResponse, 'logoUrl'> = {
  primaryColor: '#6366f1',
  fontFamily: 'Inter',
  headerWeight: 'bold',
  backgroundStyle: 'solid',
};

@Injectable()
export class TenantBrandingService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(TenantBranding)
    private readonly repo: Repository<TenantBranding>,

    private readonly fileStorage: FileStorageService,
  ) {}

  /** Return the tenant's branding or sensible defaults if no row exists. */
  async getBranding(tenantId: string): Promise<BrandingResponse> {
    const row = await this.repo.findOne({ where: { tenantId } });
    return this.toResponse(row);
  }

  /**
   * Upsert a branding row.
   * Creates a new row if one does not yet exist, merges otherwise.
   */
  async upsertBranding(
    tenantId: string,
    dto: TenantBrandingDto,
  ): Promise<BrandingResponse> {
    let row = await this.repo.findOne({ where: { tenantId } });

    if (!row) {
      row = this.repo.create({
        tenantId,
        primaryColor: DEFAULTS.primaryColor,
        fontFamily: DEFAULTS.fontFamily,
        headerWeight: DEFAULTS.headerWeight,
        backgroundStyle: DEFAULTS.backgroundStyle,
      });
    }

    if (dto.primaryColor !== undefined) row.primaryColor = dto.primaryColor;
    if (dto.logoUrl !== undefined) row.logoUrl = dto.logoUrl;
    if (dto.fontFamily !== undefined) row.fontFamily = dto.fontFamily;
    if (dto.headerWeight !== undefined) row.headerWeight = dto.headerWeight;
    if (dto.backgroundStyle !== undefined) row.backgroundStyle = dto.backgroundStyle;

    await this.repo.save(row);
    return this.toResponse(row);
  }

  /**
   * Store an uploaded logo and update logoUrl in the branding row.
   * Returns the public URL.
   */
  async storeLogo(
    tenantId: string,
    buffer: Buffer,
    mimeType: string,
  ): Promise<string> {
    const logoUrl = await this.fileStorage.store(buffer, mimeType, `logo-${tenantId}`);

    // Ensure branding row exists
    let row = await this.repo.findOne({ where: { tenantId } });
    if (!row) {
      row = this.repo.create({
        tenantId,
        primaryColor: DEFAULTS.primaryColor,
        fontFamily: DEFAULTS.fontFamily,
        headerWeight: DEFAULTS.headerWeight,
        backgroundStyle: DEFAULTS.backgroundStyle,
      });
    }

    row.logoUrl = logoUrl;
    await this.repo.save(row);
    return logoUrl;
  }

  /** Fetch branding by tenant slug (public – for hosted login page). */
  async getBrandingBySlug(slug: string): Promise<BrandingResponse> {
    const row = await this.repo
      .createQueryBuilder('b')
      .innerJoin('b.tenant', 't')
      .where('t.slug = :slug', { slug })
      .getOne();

    return this.toResponse(row ?? null);
  }

  private toResponse(row: TenantBranding | null): BrandingResponse {
    if (!row) return { ...DEFAULTS };
    return {
      primaryColor: row.primaryColor,
      logoUrl: row.logoUrl,
      fontFamily: row.fontFamily,
      headerWeight: row.headerWeight,
      backgroundStyle: row.backgroundStyle,
    };
  }
}

// apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/tenant.service.ts
import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  Inject,
  BadRequestException,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository } from "typeorm";
import { Tenant } from "@repo/database";
import { CACHE_MANAGER } from "@nestjs/cache-manager";
import { type Cache } from "cache-manager";
import { TenantBrandingDto } from "./dto/tenant-branding.dto";

@Injectable()
export class TenantService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Tenant)
    private tenantRepository: Repository<Tenant>,

    @Inject(CACHE_MANAGER)
    private cacheManager: Cache,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Find tenant by slug (subdomain)
   * Cached for 5 minutes
   */
  async findBySlug(slug: string): Promise<Tenant | null> {
    const cacheKey = `tenant:slug:${slug}`;

    // Check cache
    const cached = await this.cacheManager.get<Tenant>(cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
      return cached;
    }

    // Query database
    const tenant = await this.tenantRepository.findOne({
      where: { slug, active: true },
    });

    // Cache for 5 minutes
    if (tenant) {
      await this.cacheManager.set(cacheKey, tenant, 300000);
    }

    return tenant;
  }

  /**
   * Find tenant by custom domain
   * Cached for 5 minutes
   */
  async findByCustomDomain(domain: string): Promise<Tenant | null> {
    const cacheKey = `tenant:domain:${domain}`;

    // Check cache
    const cached = await this.cacheManager.get<Tenant>(cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
      return cached;
    }

    // Query database
    const tenant = await this.tenantRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        customDomain: domain,
        customDomainVerified: true,
        active: true,
      },
    });

    // Cache for 5 minutes
    if (tenant) {
      await this.cacheManager.set(cacheKey, tenant, 300000);
    }

    return tenant;
  }

  /**
   * Find tenant by ID
   * Cached for 10 minutes
   */
  async findById(id: string): Promise<Tenant | null> {
    const cacheKey = `tenant:id:${id}`;

    const cached = await this.cacheManager.get<Tenant>(cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
      return cached;
    }
    try {
      const tenant = await this.tenantRepository.findOne({
        where: { id, active: true },
      });

      if (tenant) {
        await this.cacheManager.set(cacheKey, tenant, 600000);
      }

      return tenant;
    } catch (e) {
      throw new BadRequestException("Tenant Not found");
    }
  }

  /**
   * Invalidate all caches for a tenant
   */
  async invalidateCache(tenantId: string): Promise<void> {
    const tenant = await this.tenantRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: tenantId },
    });

    if (!tenant) return;

    await this.cacheManager.del(`tenant:id:${tenantId}`);
    await this.cacheManager.del(`tenant:slug:${tenant.slug}`);

    if (tenant.customDomain) {
      await this.cacheManager.del(`tenant:domain:${tenant.customDomain}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create tenant (for platform admin)
   */
  async create(data: {
    slug: string;
    name: string;
    environment?: string;
  }): Promise<Tenant> {
    const tenant = this.tenantRepository.create({
      slug: data.slug.toLowerCase(),
      name: data.name,
      environment: data.environment || "production",
      active: true,
    });

    return this.tenantRepository.save(tenant);
  }

  /**
   * Set custom domain
   */
  async setCustomDomain(tenantId: string, domain: string): Promise<Tenant> {
    const tenant = await this.tenantRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: tenantId },
    });

    if (!tenant) {
      throw new NotFoundException("Tenant not found");
    }

    tenant.customDomain = domain;
    tenant.customDomainVerified = false; // Require verification

    await this.tenantRepository.save(tenant);
    await this.invalidateCache(tenantId);

    return tenant;
  }

  /**
   * Verify custom domain
   */
  async verifyCustomDomain(tenantId: string): Promise<Tenant> {
    const tenant = await this.tenantRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: tenantId },
    });

    if (!tenant) {
      throw new NotFoundException("Tenant not found");
    }

    tenant.customDomainVerified = true;

    await this.tenantRepository.save(tenant);
    await this.invalidateCache(tenantId);

    return tenant;
  }

  /**
   * Get tenant by ID
   */
  async getTenantById(tenantId: string): Promise<Tenant | null> {
    return this.tenantRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: tenantId },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Update tenant branding
   */
  async updateBranding(
    tenantId: string,
    branding: Partial<TenantBrandingDto>,
  ): Promise<Tenant> {
    const tenant = await this.getTenantById(tenantId);

    if (!tenant) {
      throw new Error('Tenant not found');
    }

    // Merge with existing branding
    const updatedBranding = {
      ...tenant.branding,
      ...branding,
    };

    // Update tenant
    await this.tenantRepository.update(
      { id: tenantId },
      { branding: updatedBranding },
    );

    // Return updated tenant
    const updatedTenant = await this.getTenantById(tenantId);
    return updatedTenant!;
  }

  /**
   * Get tenant branding (public - no auth required)
   */
  async getBrandingBySlug(slug: string): Promise<TenantBrandingDto | null> {
    const tenant = await this.tenantRepository.findOne({
      where: { slug },
      select: ['branding'],
    });

    return tenant?.branding || null;
  }

  /**
   * Get tenant branding by domain (for custom domains)
   */
  async getBrandingByDomain(domain: string): Promise<TenantBrandingDto | null> {
    const tenant = await this.tenantRepository.findOne({
      where: { customDomain: domain },
      select: ['branding'],
    });

    return tenant?.branding || null;
  }
}

   * Revoke a specific session
   * Anyone authenticated can revoke their own sessions
   */
  @Delete("me/sessions/:sessionId")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Revoke a specific session" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: "Session revoked" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 404, description: "Session not found" })
  async revokeSession(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Param("sessionId") sessionId: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    await this.userService.revokeSession(tenantId, req.user.sub, sessionId);
    return { message: "Session revoked successfully" };
  }

  /**
   * Revoke all sessions except current
   * Anyone authenticated can revoke all their sessions
   */
  @Delete("me/sessions")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Revoke all sessions except current" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: "Sessions revoked" })
  async revokeAllSessions(@Request() req: any) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    await this.userService.revokeAllSessions(tenantId, req.user.sub);
    return { message: "All other sessions revoked successfully" };
  }

  /**

   * Anyone authenticated can view their own security events
   */
  @Get("me/security-events")
