import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  UnauthorizedException,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository, MoreThan, IsNull, In } from "typeorm";
import {
  User,
  Session,
  SecurityEventType,
  SecurityEvent,
} from "@repo/database";
import { SecurityEventService } from "@/common/service/security-event.service";
import { PasswordService } from "@repo/security";

/**
 * User Service
 *
 * Handles all user management business logic:
 * - User CRUD operations
 * - Password management
 * - Session management
 * - Security event tracking
 */
@Injectable()
export class UserService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private readonly userRepository: Repository<User>,
    @InjectRepository(Session)
    private readonly sessionRepository: Repository<Session>,
    @InjectRepository(SecurityEvent)
    private readonly securityEventRepository: Repository<SecurityEvent>,
    private readonly securityEventService: SecurityEventService,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Find user by ID
   */
  async findById(tenantId: string, id: string): Promise<User> {
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      relations: ["tenant"],
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw new NotFoundException("User not found");
    }

    return user;
  }

  /**
   * Find user by email
   */
  async findByEmail(tenantId: string, email: string): Promise<User | null> {
    const where: any = { email };
    if (tenantId) {
      where.tenantId = tenantId;
    }

    return this.userRepository.findOne({
      where,
      relations: ["tenant", "mfaSettings"],
    });
  }

  /**
   * Update user profile
   */
  async update(
    tenantId: string,
    userId: string,
    data: {
      firstName?: string;
      lastName?: string;
      displayName?: string;
      phone?: string;
      avatarUrl?: string;
      timezone?: string;
      language?: string;
    },
  ) {
    const user = await this.findById(tenantId, userId);

    Object.assign(user, data);
    await this.userRepository.save(user);

    // Log profile update
    this.securityEventService.log({
      userId,
      tenantId: user.tenantId,
      actorEmail: user.email,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.USER_UPDATED,
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
      userAgent: "system",
      metadata: { fields: Object.keys(data) },
    });

    return user;
  }

  /**
   * Change password
   */
  async changePassword(
    tenantId: string,
    userId: string,
    currentPassword: string,
    newPassword: string,
  ) {
    // Get user with password hash
    const user = await this.userRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("user")
      .addSelect("user.passwordHash")
      .addSelect("user.passwordHistory")
      .where("user.id = :id", { id: userId })
      .where("user.tenant_id = :tenantId", { tenantId })
      .getOne();

    if (!user) {
      throw new NotFoundException("User not found");
    }

    if (user.passwordHash) {
      // Verify current password
      const isValid = await PasswordService.verify(
        user.passwordHash,
        currentPassword,
      );

      if (!isValid) {
        this.securityEventService.log({
          userId,
          tenantId: user.tenantId,
          actorEmail: user.email,
          eventType: SecurityEventType.PASSWORD_CHANGE_FAILED,
          severity: "warning",
          ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
          userAgent: "system",
          metadata: { reason: "invalid_current_password" },
        });

        throw new UnauthorizedException("Current password is incorrect");
      }
    }

    // Validate new password strength
    const validation = PasswordService.validateStrength(newPassword);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      throw new BadRequestException({
        message: "New password does not meet security requirements",
        errors: validation.errors,
        score: validation.score,
      });
    }

    // Check password history
    const passwordHistory = user.passwordHistory || [];
    for (const oldHash of passwordHistory) {
      const isReused = await PasswordService.verify(oldHash, newPassword);
      if (isReused) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          "Password has been used recently. Please choose a different password.",
        );
      }
    }

    // Hash new password
    const newHash = await PasswordService.hash(newPassword);

    // Update password and history
    const updatedHistory = [
      ...(user.passwordHash ? [user.passwordHash] : []),
      ...passwordHistory,
    ].slice(0, 5);

    await this.userRepository.update(userId, {
      passwordHash: newHash,
      passwordHistory: updatedHistory,
      passwordChangedAt: new Date(),
      forcePasswordChange: false,
    });

    // Log password change
    this.securityEventService.log({
      userId,
      tenantId: user.tenantId,
      actorEmail: user.email,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.PASSWORD_CHANGED,
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
      userAgent: "system",
    });

    // Revoke all sessions except current (force re-login on other devices)
    await this.sessionRepository.update(
      { userId, revokedAt: IsNull() },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: "password_changed",
      },
    );
  }

  /**
   * Get active sessions for user
   */
  async getActiveSessions(tenantId: string, userId: string) {
    const sessions = await this.sessionRepository.find({
      where: {
        userId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
        tenantId,
        expiresAt: MoreThan(new Date()),
      },
      order: {
        lastActivity: "DESC",
      },
    });

    return sessions.map((session) => ({
      id: session.id,
      deviceInfo: session.deviceInfo,
      ipAddress: session.ipAddress,
      location: session.location,
      lastActivity: session.lastActivity,
      createdAt: session.createdAt,
    }));
  }

  /**
   * Revoke a specific session
   */
  async revokeSession(tenantId: string, userId: string, sessionId: string) {
    const session = await this.sessionRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: sessionId, userId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!session) {
      throw new NotFoundException("Session not found");
    }

    await this.sessionRepository.update(sessionId, {
      revokedAt: new Date(),
      revokedReason: "manual_revocation",
    });

    this.securityEventService.log({
      userId,
      tenantId,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.SESSION_REVOKED,
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
      userAgent: "system",
      resourceId: sessionId,
      resourceType: "session",
      metadata: { sessionId },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Revoke all sessions for user
   */
  async revokeAllSessions(tenantId: string, userId: string) {
    await this.sessionRepository.update(
      { userId, revokedAt: IsNull(), tenantId },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: "user_request",
      },
    );

    this.securityEventService.log({
      userId,
      tenantId,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.ALL_SESSIONS_REVOKED,
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
      userAgent: "system",
    });
  }

  /**
   * Get security events for user
   */
  async getSecurityEvents(
    tenantId: string,
    userId: string,
    limit: number = 50,
  ) {
    const events = await this.securityEventRepository.find({
      where: { userId, tenantId },
      order: { createdAt: "DESC" },
      take: limit,
    });

    return events.map((event) => ({
      id: event.id,
      eventType: event.eventType,
      severity: event.severity,
      ipAddress: event.ipAddress,
      location: event.location,
      metadata: event.metadata,
      createdAt: event.createdAt,
    }));
  }

  /**
   * Delete account (soft delete)
   */
  async deleteAccount(tenantId: string, userId: string, password: string) {
    // Get user with password hash
    const user = await this.userRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("user")
      .addSelect("user.passwordHash")
      .where("user.id = :id", { id: userId })
      .where("user.tenant_id = :id", { id: tenantId })
      .getOne();

    if (!user) {
      throw new NotFoundException("User not found");
    }

    // Verify password
    const isValid = await PasswordService.verify(
      user.passwordHash ?? "",
      password,
    );

    if (!isValid) {
      this.securityEventService.log({
        userId,
        tenantId: user.tenantId,
        actorEmail: user.email,
        eventType: SecurityEventType.USER_DELETION_FAILED,
        severity: "warning",
        ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
        userAgent: "system",
        metadata: { reason: "invalid_password" },
      });

      throw new UnauthorizedException("Password is incorrect");
    }

    // Soft delete user
    await this.userRepository.softDelete(userId);

    // Revoke all sessions
    await this.sessionRepository.update(
      { userId, revokedAt: IsNull() },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: "account_deleted",
      },
    );

    // Log account deletion
    this.securityEventService.log({
      userId,
      tenantId: user.tenantId,
      actorEmail: user.email,
      eventType: SecurityEventType.USER_DELETED,
      severity: "critical",
      ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
      userAgent: "system",
    });
  }

  /**
   * Check if account is locked
   */
  async isAccountLocked(tenantId: string, userId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const user = await this.findById(tenantId, userId);

    if (!user.lockedUntil) {
      return false;
    }

    return user.lockedUntil > new Date();
  }

  /**
   * Increment failed login attempts
   */
  async incrementFailedAttempts(tenantId: string, userId: string) {
    const user = await this.findById(tenantId, userId);

    const newAttempts = user.failedLoginAttempts + 1;

    const update: any = {
      failedLoginAttempts: newAttempts,
    };

    // Lock account after 5 failed attempts
    if (newAttempts >= 5) {
      update.lockedUntil = new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1000); // 15 minutes

      this.securityEventService.log({
        userId,
        tenantId: user.tenantId,
        actorEmail: user.email,
        eventType: SecurityEventType.USER_LOCKED,
        severity: "critical",
        ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
        userAgent: "system",
        metadata: { attempts: newAttempts },
      });
    }

    await this.userRepository.update(userId, update);
  }

  /**
   * Reset failed login attempts
   */
  async resetFailedAttempts(tenantId: string, userId: string) {
    await this.userRepository.update(userId, {
      failedLoginAttempts: 0,
      lockedUntil: undefined,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Update last login timestamp
   */
  async updateLastLogin(tenantId: string, userId: string, ip: string) {
    await this.userRepository.update(userId, {
      lastLoginAt: new Date(),
      lastLoginIp: ip,
      failedLoginAttempts: 0,
      lockedUntil: undefined,
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ADD THIS METHOD TO UserService CLASS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * List users with pagination, filtering, and search
   *
   * @param tenantId - Tenant ID to filter users
   * @param options - Pagination and filtering options
   * @returns Paginated list of users
   *
   * @example
   * // Simple pagination
   * const result = await userService.listUsers(tenantId, { page: 1, limit: 20 });
   *
   * @example
   * // With search
   * const result = await userService.listUsers(tenantId, {
   *   page: 1,
   *   limit: 20,
   *   search: 'john',
   * });
   *
   * @example
   * // With filters
   * const result = await userService.listUsers(tenantId, {
   *   page: 1,
   *   limit: 20,
   *   emailVerified: true,
   *   isActive: true,
   *   sortBy: 'createdAt',
   *   sortOrder: 'DESC',
   * });
   */
  async listUsers(
    tenantId: string,
    options: ListUsersOptions = {},
  ): Promise<PaginatedUsersResponse> {
    // Default values
    const page = Math.max(1, options.page || 1);
    const limit = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, options.limit || 20)); // Max 100 per page
    const sortBy = options.sortBy || "createdAt";
    const sortOrder = options.sortOrder || "DESC";
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

    // Validate sortBy field
    const allowedSortFields = [
      "createdAt",
      "updatedAt",
      "email",
      "firstName",
      "lastName",
      "lastLoginAt",
    ];

    if (!allowedSortFields.includes(sortBy)) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Invalid sort field. Allowed: ${allowedSortFields.join(", ")}`,
      );
    }

    // Build query
    const queryBuilder = this.userRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("user")
      .leftJoinAndSelect("user.tenant", "tenant")
      .where("user.tenantId = :tenantId", { tenantId });

    // Apply search filter
    if (options.search) {
      const searchTerm = `%${options.search}%`;
      queryBuilder.andWhere(
        "(user.email ILIKE :search OR user.firstName ILIKE :search OR user.lastName ILIKE :search OR user.displayName ILIKE :search)",
        { search: searchTerm },
      );
    }

    // Apply isActive filter
    if (options.isActive !== undefined) {
      queryBuilder.andWhere("user.isActive = :isActive", {
        isActive: options.isActive,
      });
    }

    // Apply emailVerified filter
    if (options.emailVerified !== undefined) {
      queryBuilder.andWhere("user.emailVerified = :emailVerified", {
        emailVerified: options.emailVerified,
      });
    }

    // Apply date range filters
    if (options.createdAfter) {
      queryBuilder.andWhere("user.createdAt >= :createdAfter", {
        createdAfter: options.createdAfter,
      });
    }

    if (options.createdBefore) {
      queryBuilder.andWhere("user.createdAt <= :createdBefore", {
        createdBefore: options.createdBefore,
      });
    }

    if (options.role) {
      queryBuilder
        .leftJoin("user.userRoles", "userRole")
        .leftJoin("userRole.role", "role")
        .andWhere("role.name = :role", { role: options.role });
    }

    // Apply sorting
    queryBuilder.orderBy(`user.${sortBy}`, sortOrder);

    // Get total count
    const total = await queryBuilder.getCount();

    // Get paginated results
    const users = await queryBuilder.skip(skip).take(limit).getMany();

    // Calculate pagination metadata
    const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / limit);
    const hasNextPage = page < totalPages;
    const hasPreviousPage = page > 1;

    // Format response
    const formattedUsers = users.map((user) => ({
      id: user.id,
      email: user.email,
      firstName: user.firstName,
      lastName: user.lastName,
      displayName: user.displayName,
      emailVerified: user.emailVerified,
      isActive: user.isActive,
      lastLoginAt: user.lastLoginAt,
      createdAt: user.createdAt,
      updatedAt: user.updatedAt,
      tenant: user.tenant
        ? {
            id: user.tenant.id,
            name: user.tenant.name,
            slug: user.tenant.slug,
          }
        : undefined,
    }));

    return {
      users: formattedUsers,
      pagination: {
        page,
        limit,
        total,
        totalPages,
        hasNextPage,
        hasPreviousPage,
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get user statistics for admin dashboard
   */
  async getUserStats(tenantId: string): Promise<{
    total: number;
    active: number;
    inactive: number;
    verified: number;
    unverified: number;
    recentLogins: number; // Last 7 days
  }> {
    const total = await this.userRepository.count({
      where: { tenantId },
    });

    const active = await this.userRepository.count({
      where: { tenantId, isActive: true },
    });

    const verified = await this.userRepository.count({
      where: { tenantId, emailVerified: true },
    });

    const sevenDaysAgo = new Date();
    sevenDaysAgo.setDate(sevenDaysAgo.getDate() - 7);

    const recentLogins = await this.userRepository.count({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        lastLoginAt: MoreThan(sevenDaysAgo),
      },
    });

    return {
      total,
      active,
      inactive: total - active,
      verified,
      unverified: total - verified,
      recentLogins,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Bulk activate/deactivate users
   */
  async bulkUpdateActiveStatus(
    tenantId: string,
    userIds: string[],
    isActive: boolean,
    adminUserId: string,
  ): Promise<{ updated: number }> {
    if (userIds.length === 0) {
      return { updated: 0 };
    }

    // Verify all users belong to tenant
    const users = await this.userRepository.find({
      where: {
        id: In(userIds),
        tenantId,
      },
    });

    if (users.length !== userIds.length) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        "Some users not found or belong to different tenant",
      );
    }

    // Update all users
    const result = await this.userRepository.update(
      {
        id: In(userIds),
        tenantId,
      },
      { isActive },
    );

    // Log security event for each user
    for (const user of users) {
      this.securityEventService.log({
        userId: user.id,
        tenantId,
        actorEmail: user.email,
        eventType: isActive
          ? SecurityEventType.USER_ACTIVATED
          : SecurityEventType.USER_DEACTIVATED,
        severity: "info",
        ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
        userAgent: "system",
        metadata: { performedBy: adminUserId },
      });
    }

    console.log(
      `✅ Bulk ${isActive ? "activated" : "deactivated"} ${users.length} users`,
    );

    return { updated: result.affected || 0 };
  }

  /**
   * Export users to CSV format
   */
  async exportUsers(
    tenantId: string,
    options: ListUsersOptions = {},
  ): Promise<string> {
    // Get all users (no pagination)
    const result = await this.listUsers(tenantId, {
      ...options,
      limit: 10000, // Max export limit
    });

    // Generate CSV
    const headers = [
      "ID",
      "Email",
      "First Name",
      "Last Name",
      "Display Name",
      "Email Verified",
      "Active",
      "Last Login",
      "Created At",
    ];

    const rows = result.users.map((user) => [
      user.id,
      user.email,
      user.firstName || "",
      user.lastName || "",
      user.displayName || "",
      user.emailVerified ? "Yes" : "No",
      user.isActive ? "Yes" : "No",
      user.lastLoginAt ? user.lastLoginAt.toISOString() : "Never",
      user.createdAt.toISOString(),
    ]);

    // CSV format
    const csv = [
      headers.join(","),
      ...rows.map((row) =>
        row.map((cell) => `"${String(cell).replace(/"/g, '""')}"`).join(","),
      ),
    ].join("\n");

    return csv;
  }
}

/**
 * Pagination options for listing users
 */
export interface ListUsersOptions {
  page?: number;
  limit?: number;
  sortBy?: string;
  sortOrder?: "ASC" | "DESC";
  search?: string;
  isActive?: boolean;
  emailVerified?: boolean;
  role?: string;
  createdAfter?: Date;
  createdBefore?: Date;
}

/**
 * Paginated response for listing users
 */
export interface PaginatedUsersResponse {
  users: Array<{
    id: string;
    email: string;
    firstName?: string;
    lastName?: string;
    displayName?: string;
    emailVerified: boolean;
    isActive: boolean;
    lastLoginAt?: Date;
    createdAt: Date;
    updatedAt: Date;
    tenant?: {
      id: string;
      name: string;
      slug: string;
    };
  }>;
  pagination: {
    page: number;
    limit: number;
    total: number;
    totalPages: number;
    hasNextPage: boolean;
    hasPreviousPage: boolean;
  };
}

<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';

import request from 'supertest';
import { App } from 'supertest/types';
import { AppModule } from './../src/app.module';

describe('AppController (e2e)', () => {
  let app: INestApplication<App>;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    const moduleFixture: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      imports: [AppModule],
    }).compile();

    app = moduleFixture.createNestApplication();
    await app.init();
  });

  it('/ (GET)', () => {
    return request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/')
      .expect(200)
      .expect('Hello World!');
  });
});

#!/bin/bash
# test-mfa-complete.sh
# Complete MFA integration test script

# Colors
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Configuration
API_URL="http://localhost:4000"
TENANT_ID="d9717e9f-64d1-4f7a-8baa-31d2a91d45a7"
EMAIL="test2@example.com"
PASSWORD="SecureP@ssw0rd123!"

echo -e "${BLUE}🔐 Fort Knox MFA Integration Test${NC}"
echo "====================================="
echo ""

# Variables to store between steps
ACCESS_TOKEN=""
TEMP_TOKEN=""
MFA_CODE=""
BACKUP_CODE=""

# ============================================================
# TEST 1: Register User (if needed)
# ============================================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Test 1: Register User${NC}"
echo "---"

response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$API_URL/auth/register" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID" \
  -d "{
    \"email\": \"$EMAIL\",
    \"password\": \"$PASSWORD\",
    \"firstName\": \"Test\",
    \"lastName\": \"User\"
  }")

http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)
body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

if [ "$http_code" -eq 201 ] || [ "$http_code" -eq 409 ]; then
  echo -e "${GREEN}✅ User exists or created successfully${NC}"
else
  echo -e "${RED}❌ Failed to create user (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
  echo "$body"
fi

echo ""
sleep 1

# ============================================================
# TEST 2: Login (No MFA yet)
# ============================================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Test 2: Login without MFA${NC}"
echo "---"

response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$API_URL/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID" \
  -d "{
    \"email\": \"$EMAIL\",
    \"password\": \"$PASSWORD\"
  }")

http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)
body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')
echo $response


if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ]; then
  ACCESS_TOKEN=$(echo "$body" | jq -r '.data.accessToken')
  echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Login successful (no MFA)${NC}"
  echo "Access Token: ${ACCESS_TOKEN:0:20}..."
else
  echo -e "${RED}❌ Login failed (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
  echo "$body"
  exit 1
fi

echo ""
sleep 1

# ============================================================
# TEST 3: Setup TOTP
# ============================================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Test 3: Setup TOTP (MFA)${NC}"
echo "---"

response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$API_URL/mfa/setup/totp" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID")

http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)
body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

if [ "$http_code" -eq 201 ]; then
  SECRET=$(echo "$body" | jq -r '.data.secret')
  QR_CODE=$(echo "$body" | jq -r '.data.qrCode')
  BACKUP_CODES=$(echo "$body" | jq -r '.backupCodes[]' | head -1)

  echo -e "${GREEN}✅ TOTP setup successful${NC}"
  echo "Secret: $SECRET"
  echo "Backup Code (first): $BACKUP_CODES"
  echo ""
  echo -e "${BLUE}📱 SCAN THIS QR CODE WITH GOOGLE AUTHENTICATOR:${NC}"
  echo "Open the QR code in your browser:"
  echo "$QR_CODE"
  echo ""

  BACKUP_CODE=$BACKUP_CODES

  echo -e "${YELLOW}Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app:${NC}"
  read -p "MFA Code: " MFA_CODE
else
  echo -e "${RED}❌ TOTP setup failed (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
  echo "$body"
  exit 1
fi

echo ""
sleep 1

# ============================================================
# TEST 4: Verify and Enable TOTP
# ============================================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Test 4: Verify and Enable TOTP${NC}"
echo "---"

response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$API_URL/mfa/verify/totp" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{
    \"token\": \"$MFA_CODE\"
  }")

http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)
body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ]; then
  echo -e "${GREEN}✅ TOTP verified and enabled!${NC}"
  echo "Backup codes saved from previous step"
else
  echo -e "${RED}❌ TOTP verification failed (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
  echo "$body"
  exit 1
fi

echo ""
sleep 1

# ============================================================
# TEST 5: Logout
# ============================================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Test 5: Logout${NC}"
echo "---"

response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$API_URL/auth/logout" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID")

http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)

if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ]; then
  echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Logged out successfully${NC}"
else
  echo -e "${RED}❌ Logout failed (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
fi

echo ""
sleep 2

# ============================================================
# TEST 6: Login with MFA Required
# ============================================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Test 6: Login (MFA Required)${NC}"
echo "---"

response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$API_URL/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID" \
  -d "{
    \"email\": \"$EMAIL\",
    \"password\": \"$PASSWORD\"
  }")

http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)
body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ]; then
  MFA_REQUIRED=$(echo "$body" | jq -r '.data.mfaRequired')

  if [ "$MFA_REQUIRED" = "true" ]; then
    TEMP_TOKEN=$(echo "$body" | jq -r '.data.tempToken')
    echo -e "${GREEN}✅ MFA required (as expected)${NC}"
    echo "Temp Token: ${TEMP_TOKEN:0:20}..."
  else
    echo -e "${RED}❌ MFA not required (unexpected)${NC}"
    exit 1
  fi
else
  echo -e "${RED}❌ Login failed (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
  echo "$body"
  exit 1
fi

echo ""
echo -e "${YELLOW}Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app:${NC}"
read -p "MFA Code: " MFA_CODE
echo ""

# ============================================================
# TEST 7: Verify MFA Code
# ============================================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Test 7: Verify MFA Code${NC}"
echo "---"

response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$API_URL/auth/mfa/verify" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID" \
  -d "{
    \"tempToken\": \"$TEMP_TOKEN\",
    \"code\": \"$MFA_CODE\"
  }")

http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)
body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ]; then
  NEW_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(echo "$body" | jq -r '.data.accessToken')
  NEW_REFRESH_TOKEN=$(echo "$body" | jq -r '.data.refreshToken')

  echo -e "${GREEN}✅ MFA verified successfully!${NC}"
  echo "New Access Token: ${NEW_ACCESS_TOKEN:0:20}..."
  echo "New Refresh Token: ${NEW_REFRESH_TOKEN:0:20}..."

  ACCESS_TOKEN=$NEW_ACCESS_TOKEN
else
  echo -e "${RED}❌ MFA verification failed (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
  echo "$body"
  exit 1
fi

echo ""
sleep 1

# ============================================================
# TEST 8: Check MFA Status
# ============================================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Test 8: Check MFA Status${NC}"
echo "---"

response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X GET "$API_URL/mfa/status" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID")

http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)
body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ]; then
  echo -e "${GREEN}✅ MFA status retrieved${NC}"
  echo "$body" | jq '.'
else
  echo -e "${RED}❌ Failed to get MFA status (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
fi

echo ""
sleep 1

# ============================================================
# TEST 9: Test Backup Code (Optional)
# ============================================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Test 9: Test Backup Code (Optional)${NC}"
echo "---"
read -p "Do you want to test backup code? (y/n): " TEST_BACKUP

if [ "$TEST_BACKUP" = "y" ]; then
  # Logout first
  curl -s -X POST "$API_URL/auth/logout" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
    -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID" > /dev/null

  # Login to get temp token
  response=$(curl -s -X POST "$API_URL/auth/login" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID" \
    -d "{
      \"email\": \"$EMAIL\",
      \"password\": \"$PASSWORD\"
    }")

  TEMP_TOKEN=$(echo "$response" | jq -r '.data.tempToken')

  # Verify with backup code
  response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$API_URL/auth/mfa/verify-backup" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID" \
    -d "{
      \"tempToken\": \"$TEMP_TOKEN\",
      \"code\": \"$BACKUP_CODE\"
    }")

  http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)
  body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

  if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Backup code verified successfully!${NC}"
    echo "$body" | jq '.'
  else
    echo -e "${RED}❌ Backup code verification failed (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
    echo "$body"
  fi
else
  echo "Skipped backup code test"
fi

echo ""
echo "====================================="
echo -e "${GREEN}🎉 All MFA Tests Completed!${NC}"
echo "====================================="
echo ""
echo "Summary:"
echo "✅ User registration/login"
echo "✅ TOTP setup with QR code"
echo "✅ TOTP verification and enablement"
echo "✅ Login with MFA required"
echo "✅ MFA code verification"
echo "✅ MFA status check"
if [ "$TEST_BACKUP" = "y" ]; then
  echo "✅ Backup code verification"
fi
echo ""
echo -e "${BLUE}Your MFA is now fully functional!${NC}"

#!/usr/bin/env node

const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");

/**
 * Code Consolidator Script
 * Recursively scans directories and consolidates all code files into a single text file
 */

class CodeConsolidator {
  constructor() {
    // Common code file extensions
    this.codeExtensions = new Set([
      ".js",
      ".jsx",
      ".ts",
      ".tsx",
      ".py",
      ".java",
      ".c",
      ".cpp",
      ".cc",
      ".cxx",
      ".cs",
      ".php",
      ".rb",
      ".go",
      ".rs",
      ".swift",
      ".kt",
      ".scala",
      ".r",
      ".m",
      ".mm",
      ".html",
      ".htm",
      ".css",
      ".scss",
      ".sass",
      ".less",
      ".xml",
      ".json",
      ".yaml",
      ".yml",
      ".toml",
      ".sh",
      ".bash",
      ".zsh",
      ".fish",
      ".ps1",
      ".bat",
      ".sql",
      ".graphql",
      ".proto",
      ".thrift",
      ".dockerfile",
      ".makefile",
      ".cmake",
      ".vue",
      ".svelte",
      ".dart",
      ".lua",
      ".pl",
      ".pm",
    ]);

    // Files to exclude
    this.excludeFiles = new Set([
      "package-lock.json",
      "yarn.lock",
      ".DS_Store",
      "Thumbs.db",
      ".env",
      ".env.local",
      ".env.production",
      ".env.development",
    ]);

    // Directories to exclude
    this.excludeDirs = new Set([
      "node_modules",
      ".git",
      ".svn",
      ".hg",
      "dist",
      "build",
      "target",
      "bin",
      "obj",
      "__pycache__",
      ".pytest_cache",
      "venv",
      "env",
      ".venv",
      ".env",
      "vendor",
      ".idea",
      ".vscode",
      ".vs",
      "coverage",
      ".nyc_output",
      ".cache",
    ]);

    this.stats = {
      filesProcessed: 0,
      totalLines: 0,
      skippedFiles: 0,
      errors: 0,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Check if file should be processed based on extension
   */
  isCodeFile(filePath) {
    const ext = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
    const basename = path.basename(filePath).toLowerCase();

    // Special files without extensions
    const specialFiles = [
      "dockerfile",
      "makefile",
      "jenkinsfile",
      "readme",
      "license",
      "changelog",
    ];
    if (specialFiles.some((name) => basename.includes(name))) {
      return true;
    }

    return this.codeExtensions.has(ext);
  }

  /**
   * Check if file/directory should be excluded
   */
  shouldExclude(itemPath, isDirectory = false) {
    const basename = path.basename(itemPath);

    if (isDirectory) {
      return this.excludeDirs.has(basename) || basename.startsWith(".");
    }

    return (
      this.excludeFiles.has(basename) ||
      (basename.startsWith(".") && !this.isCodeFile(itemPath))
    );
  }

  /**
   * Get file size in a readable format
   */
  getFileSize(filePath) {
    try {
      const stats = fs.statSync(filePath);
      const bytes = stats.size;

      if (bytes === 0) return "0 B";
      const k = 1024;
      const sizes = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"];
      const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
      return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2)) + " " + sizes[i];
    } catch (error) {
      return "Unknown";
    }
  }

  /**
   * Process a single file and add its content to the output
   */
  processFile(filePath, outputStream) {
    try {
      const relativePath = path.relative(process.cwd(), filePath);
      const fileSize = this.getFileSize(filePath);
      const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8");
      const lineCount = content.split("\n").length;

      // Write file header
      outputStream.write("\n" + "=".repeat(80) + "\n");
      outputStream.write(`FILE: ${relativePath}\n`);
      outputStream.write(`SIZE: ${fileSize} | LINES: ${lineCount}\n`);
      outputStream.write("=".repeat(80) + "\n\n");

      // Write file content
      outputStream.write(content);
      outputStream.write("\n\n");

      this.stats.filesProcessed++;
      this.stats.totalLines += lineCount;

      console.log(`✓ Processed: ${relativePath} (${lineCount} lines)`);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`✗ Error processing ${filePath}: ${error.message}`);
      this.stats.errors++;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Recursively scan directory and process all code files
   */
  scanDirectory(dirPath, outputStream) {
    try {
      const items = fs.readdirSync(dirPath);

      for (const item of items) {
        const itemPath = path.join(dirPath, item);
        const stats = fs.statSync(itemPath);

        if (stats.isDirectory()) {
          if (!this.shouldExclude(itemPath, true)) {
            this.scanDirectory(itemPath, outputStream);
          } else {
            console.log(
              `⏭ Skipping directory: ${path.relative(process.cwd(), itemPath)}`,
            );
          }
        } else if (stats.isFile()) {
          if (
            this.isCodeFile(itemPath) &&
            !this.shouldExclude(itemPath, false)
          ) {
            this.processFile(itemPath, outputStream);
          } else {
            this.stats.skippedFiles++;
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`✗ Error scanning directory ${dirPath}: ${error.message}`);
      this.stats.errors++;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Main consolidation function
   */
  consolidate(inputPath = ".", outputPath = "consolidated-code.txt") {
    console.log("🚀 Starting code consolidation...\n");
    console.log(`Input: ${path.resolve(inputPath)}`);
    console.log(`Output: ${path.resolve(outputPath)}\n`);

    const outputStream = fs.createWriteStream(outputPath);

    // Write header
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    outputStream.write(`CODE CONSOLIDATION REPORT\n`);
    outputStream.write(`Generated: ${timestamp}\n`);
    outputStream.write(`Input Directory: ${path.resolve(inputPath)}\n`);
    outputStream.write(`${"=".repeat(80)}\n\n`);

    try {
      const inputStats = fs.statSync(inputPath);

      if (inputStats.isDirectory()) {
        this.scanDirectory(inputPath, outputStream);
      } else if (inputStats.isFile()) {
        this.processFile(inputPath, outputStream);
      } else {
        throw new Error("Input path is neither a file nor a directory");
      }

      // Write footer with statistics
      outputStream.write("\n" + "=".repeat(80) + "\n");
      outputStream.write("CONSOLIDATION SUMMARY\n");
      outputStream.write("=".repeat(80) + "\n");
      outputStream.write(`Files Processed: ${this.stats.filesProcessed}\n`);
      outputStream.write(
        `Total Lines: ${this.stats.totalLines.toLocaleString()}\n`,
      );
      outputStream.write(`Files Skipped: ${this.stats.skippedFiles}\n`);
      outputStream.write(`Errors: ${this.stats.errors}\n`);
      outputStream.write(`Generated: ${timestamp}\n`);

      outputStream.end();

      console.log("\n✅ Consolidation completed successfully!");
      console.log(`📊 Statistics:`);
      console.log(`   • Files processed: ${this.stats.filesProcessed}`);
      console.log(
        `   • Total lines: ${this.stats.totalLines.toLocaleString()}`,
      );
      console.log(`   • Files skipped: ${this.stats.skippedFiles}`);
      console.log(`   • Errors: ${this.stats.errors}`);
      console.log(`📁 Output saved to: ${path.resolve(outputPath)}`);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`💥 Fatal error: ${error.message}`);
      outputStream.destroy();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Add custom file extensions
   */
  addExtensions(extensions) {
    extensions.forEach((ext) => {
      if (!ext.startsWith(".")) ext = "." + ext;
      this.codeExtensions.add(ext.toLowerCase());
    });
  }

  /**
   * Add custom exclude patterns
   */
  addExcludes(files = [], dirs = []) {
    files.forEach((file) => this.excludeFiles.add(file));
    dirs.forEach((dir) => this.excludeDirs.add(dir));
  }
}

// CLI Usage
if (require.main === module) {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
  const consolidator = new CodeConsolidator();

  // Parse command line arguments
  let inputPath = ".";
  let outputPath = "consolidated-code.txt";
  let customExtensions = [];
  let excludeFiles = [];
  let excludeDirs = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
    switch (args[i]) {
      case "--input":
      case "-i":
        inputPath = args[++i];
        break;
      case "--output":
      case "-o":
        outputPath = args[++i];
        break;
      case "--extensions":
      case "-e":
        customExtensions = args[++i].split(",");
        break;
      case "--exclude-files":
        excludeFiles = args[++i].split(",");
        break;
      case "--exclude-dirs":
        excludeDirs = args[++i].split(",");
        break;
      case "--help":
      case "-h":
        console.log(`
Code Consolidator - Merge all code files into one text file

Usage: node consolidate.js [options]

Options:
  -i, --input <path>          Input directory or file (default: current directory)
  -o, --output <path>         Output file path (default: consolidated-code.txt)
  -e, --extensions <list>     Additional file extensions (comma-separated)
  --exclude-files <list>      Additional files to exclude (comma-separated)
  --exclude-dirs <list>       Additional directories to exclude (comma-separated)
  -h, --help                  Show this help

Examples:
  node consolidate.js
  node consolidate.js -i ./src -o output.txt
  node consolidate.js -e "md,txt" --exclude-dirs "temp,cache"
                `);
        process.exit(0);
    }
  }

  // Apply custom settings
  if (customExtensions.length) consolidator.addExtensions(customExtensions);
  if (excludeFiles.length || excludeDirs.length)
    consolidator.addExcludes(excludeFiles, excludeDirs);

  // Run consolidation
  consolidator.consolidate(inputPath, outputPath);
}

module.exports = CodeConsolidator;

# @repo/database

**Fort Knox Database Package** - TypeORM entities and migrations for the authentication system.

## 📦 What's Included

### Entities (7 Core Tables)

1. **Tenant** - Multi-tenant organizations
2. **User** - User accounts with comprehensive security
3. **Session** - Active sessions with device tracking
4. **MfaSettings** - Multi-factor authentication settings
5. **SecurityEvent** - Security audit log
6. **Role** - RBAC roles
7. **Permission** - RBAC permissions

### Features

✅ **Multi-Tenancy** - Complete tenant isolation  
✅ **Soft Deletes** - All entities support soft deletion  
✅ **Timestamps** - Auto-managed created/updated dates  
✅ **UUID Primary Keys** - Better for distributed systems  
✅ **JSONB Fields** - Flexible metadata storage  
✅ **Comprehensive Indexes** - Optimized for performance  
✅ **Foreign Key Constraints** - Data integrity  
✅ **Database Comments** - Self-documenting schema

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

### 1. Installation

```bash
cd packages/database
npm install
```

### 2. Environment Variables

Create `.env` file in your auth-service:

```env
DATABASE_HOST=localhost
DATABASE_PORT=5432
DATABASE_USER=fortknox
DATABASE_PASSWORD=fortknox_dev_password
DATABASE_NAME=fortknox_auth
DATABASE_LOGGING=true
DATABASE_POOL_MAX=20
DATABASE_POOL_MIN=2
```

### 3. Run Migration

```bash
# Build the package first
npm run build

# Run migration
npm run migration:run
```

## 📚 Usage

### In Your NestJS Application

#### app.module.ts

```typescript
import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { TypeOrmModule } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { dataSourceOptions } from '@repo/database';

@Module({
  imports: [
    TypeOrmModule.forRoot(dataSourceOptions),
    // ... other modules
  ],
})
export class AppModule {}
```

#### Using Entities in Modules

```typescript
import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { TypeOrmModule } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { User, Tenant } from '@repo/database';
import { UserService } from './user.service';

@Module({
  imports: [
    TypeOrmModule.forFeature([User, Tenant]),
  ],
  providers: [UserService],
  exports: [UserService],
})
export class UserModule {}
```

#### Using in Services

```typescript
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { User } from '@repo/database';

@Injectable()
export class UserService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private readonly userRepository: Repository<User>,
  ) {}

  async findByEmail(email: string, tenantId: string): Promise<User | null> {
    return this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: { email, tenantId },
      relations: ['tenant', 'mfaSettings'],
    });
  }

  async create(userData: Partial<User>): Promise<User> {
    const user = this.userRepository.create(userData);
    return this.userRepository.save(user);
  }

  async updateLastLogin(userId: string, ip: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.userRepository.update(userId, {
      lastLoginAt: new Date(),
      lastLoginIp: ip,
      failedLoginAttempts: 0,
    });
  }
}
```

## 🗄️ Database Schema

### Entity Relationships

```
Tenant (1) ──── (M) User
                  │
                  ├─── (1) MfaSettings
                  ├─── (M) Session
                  └─── (M) SecurityEvent

Tenant (1) ──── (M) Role ──── (M) Permission
```

### Key Tables

#### Tenants

```sql
tenants (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  name varchar(255),
  subdomain varchar(100) UNIQUE,
  custom_domain varchar(255),
  status enum('active', 'trial', 'suspended', 'cancelled'),
  plan enum('free', 'starter', 'professional', 'enterprise'),
  settings jsonb,
  ...
)
```

#### Users

```sql
users (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id uuid REFERENCES tenants(id),
  email varchar(255),
  password_hash varchar(255),
  email_verified boolean,
  status enum('active', 'inactive', 'suspended', 'deleted'),
  password_history jsonb,
  failed_login_attempts int,
  locked_until timestamp,
  ...
)
```

#### Sessions

```sql
sessions (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id uuid REFERENCES users(id),
  token_hash varchar(255) UNIQUE,
  device_info jsonb,
  ip_address varchar(45),
  expires_at timestamp,
  ...
)
```

```typescript
const user = await userRepository.findOne({
```

```typescript
const user = userRepository.create({
  email: 'user@example.com',
  passwordHash: hashedPassword,
  tenantId: tenant.id,
  mfaSettings: {
    totpEnabled: false,
    backupCodes: [],
  },

await userRepository.save(user);
```

### Get Active Sessions for User

```typescript
const activeSessions = await sessionRepository.find({
  where: {
    userId,
    isActive: true,
    expiresAt: MoreThan(new Date()),
  },
  order: {
    lastActivity: 'DESC',
  },
});
```

### Log Security Event

```typescript
await securityEventRepository.save({
  userId,
  tenantId,
  eventType: 'LOGIN_SUCCESS',
  severity: 'info',
  ipAddress: req.ip,
  userAgent: req.headers['user-agent'],
  metadata: { method: 'password' },
});
```

### Get User's Permissions

```typescript
const user = await userRepository.findOne({
  where: { id: userId },
  relations: ['roles', 'roles.permissions'],
});

const permissions = user.roles
  .flatMap((role) => role.permissions)
  .map((perm) => `${perm.resource}:${perm.action}`);
```

---

## 🔒 Security Features

### Password History

The `password_history` JSONB field stores the last 5 password hashes to prevent reuse:

```typescript
// Check password history
const isReused = await Promise.all(
  user.passwordHistory.map((oldHash) => 
    PasswordService.verify(oldHash, newPassword)
  )
).then((results) => results.some((r) => r));

if (isReused) {
  throw new Error('Password has been used recently');
}

// Update password with history
user.passwordHistory = [
  user.passwordHash,
  ...user.passwordHistory,
].slice(0, 5);
user.passwordHash = newHash;
```

### Account Lockout

```typescript
// Increment failed attempts
user.failedLoginAttempts += 1;

if (user.failedLoginAttempts >= 5) {
  // Lock for 15 minutes
  user.lockedUntil = new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1000);
}

await userRepository.save(user);
```

### Session Expiration

Sessions automatically expire based on `expires_at`:

```typescript
// Check if session is valid
const isValid = 
  session.isActive && 
  !session.revokedAt && 
  session.expiresAt > new Date();
```

## 📊 Performance Tips

### Indexes

All critical fields are indexed:
- User email + tenantId (unique)
- Session tokenHash (unique)
- All foreign keys
- Frequently queried fields (status, email_verified, etc.)

### Query Optimization

```typescript
// ✅ Good - Select only needed fields
const user = await userRepository.findOne({
  where: { id: userId },
  select: ['id', 'email', 'status'],
});

// ✅ Good - Use query builder for complex queries
const users = await userRepository
  .createQueryBuilder('user')
  .where('user.tenant_id = :tenantId', { tenantId })
  .andWhere('user.status = :status', { status: 'active' })
  .andWhere('user.last_login_at > :date', { 
    date: new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) 
  })
  .getMany();

// ❌ Bad - Loading all relations unnecessarily
const user = await userRepository.findOne({
  where: { id: userId },
  relations: ['tenant', 'sessions', 'mfaSettings', 'securityEvents'],
});
```

## 🚨 Important Notes

### DO NOT Use in Production:
- ❌ `synchronize: true`
- ❌ `dropSchema: true`
- ❌ Hardcoded credentials

### ALWAYS Use:
- ✅ Migrations for schema changes
- ✅ Environment variables for config
- ✅ Connection pooling
- ✅ Query parameter binding (prevents SQL injection)

## 📝 Entity Field Reference

### User Entity

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `email` | varchar(255) | User email (unique per tenant) |
| `passwordHash` | varchar(255) | Argon2id password hash |
| `passwordHistory` | jsonb | Last 5 password hashes |
| `status` | enum | active, inactive, suspended, deleted |
| `emailVerified` | boolean | Email verification status |
| `failedLoginAttempts` | int | Failed login counter |
| `lockedUntil` | timestamp | Account lockout expiration |
| `lastLoginAt` | timestamp | Last successful login |
| `metadata` | jsonb | Additional user data |

### Session Entity

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `tokenHash` | varchar(255) | Hashed session token (unique) |
| `deviceInfo` | jsonb | Browser, OS, device fingerprint |
| `ipAddress` | varchar(45) | IP address |
| `expiresAt` | timestamp | Session expiration |
| `lastActivity` | timestamp | Last activity timestamp |
| `revokedAt` | timestamp | Manual revocation time |

import "reflect-metadata";
import { DataSource, DataSourceOptions } from "typeorm";
import * as path from "path";

// Import all entities explicitly
import { Tenant } from "./entities/tenant.entity";
import { User } from "./entities/user.entity";
import { Session } from "./entities/session.entity";
import { MfaSettings } from "./entities/mfa-settings.entity";
import { WebAuthnCredential } from "./entities/webauthn-credential.entity";
import { SecurityEvent } from "./entities/security-event.entity";
import { Role } from "./entities/role.entity";
import { Permission } from "./entities/permission.entity";
import { OAuthClient } from "./entities/oauth-client.entity";
import { OAuthAuthorizationCode } from "./entities/oauth-authorization-code.entity";
import { OAuthAccessToken } from "./entities/oauth-access-token.entity";
import { OAuthRefreshToken } from "./entities/oauth-refresh-token.entity";
import { OAuthConsent } from "./entities/oauth-consent.entity";
import { RolePermission } from "./entities/role-permission.entity";
import { UserRole } from "./entities/user-role.entity";
import { SocialLinkRequest } from "./entities/social-link-request.entity";
import { TenantSocialProvider } from "./entities/tenant-social-providers.entity";
import { UserSocialConnection } from "./entities/user-social-connections.entity";
import { TenantBranding } from "./entities/tenant-branding.entity";

/**
 * TypeORM DataSource Configuration
 *
 * This file is used by TypeORM CLI for migrations
 * and can also be imported by the NestJS application
 */

const isProduction = process.env.NODE_ENV === "production";
const useSSL = process.env.DB_SSL === "true";

export const dataSourceOptions: DataSourceOptions = {
  type: "postgres",
  host: process.env.DATABASE_HOST || "localhost",
  port: parseInt(process.env.DATABASE_PORT || "5432", 10),
  username: process.env.DATABASE_USER || "postgres",
  password: process.env.DATABASE_PASSWORD || "",
  database: process.env.DATABASE_NAME || "postgres",

  // Entities - explicit import for reliability
  entities: [
    Tenant,
    Session,
    MfaSettings,
    WebAuthnCredential,
    SecurityEvent,
    Role,
    Permission,
    OAuthClient,
    OAuthAuthorizationCode,
    OAuthAccessToken,
    OAuthRefreshToken,
    OAuthConsent,
    RolePermission,
    SocialLinkRequest,
    TenantSocialProvider,
    UserSocialConnection,
    UserRole,
    User,
    TenantBranding,
  ],

  // Migrations
  migrations: [path.join(__dirname, "migrations", "*.{ts,js}")],

  // Migration settings
  migrationsTableName: "migrations",
  migrationsRun: false, // Don't auto-run migrations

  // Logging
  logging: process.env.DATABASE_LOGGING === "true",
  logger: "advanced-console",

  // Connection pool
  extra: {
    max: parseInt(process.env.DATABASE_POOL_MAX || "20", 10),
    min: parseInt(process.env.DATABASE_POOL_MIN || "2", 10),
    idleTimeoutMillis: 30000,
    connectionTimeoutMillis: 2000,
  },

  // SSL (for production or cloud databases like Supabase)
  ssl: useSSL
    ? {
        rejectUnauthorized: false, // Supabase requires this
      }
    : false,

  // Schema
  schema: process.env.DATABASE_SCHEMA || "public",

  // Synchronize (NEVER use in production!)
  synchronize: false,
};

// Create and export DataSource
const AppDataSource = new DataSource(dataSourceOptions);

export default AppDataSource;

import {
  PrimaryGeneratedColumn,
  CreateDateColumn,
  UpdateDateColumn,
  DeleteDateColumn,
  BaseEntity as TypeORMBaseEntity,
} from "typeorm";

/**
 * Base Entity
 *
 * All entities extend this to get common fields:
 * - id (UUID primary key)
 * - createdAt (auto-generated timestamp)
 * - updatedAt (auto-updated timestamp)
 * - deletedAt (soft delete timestamp)
 */
export abstract class BaseEntity extends TypeORMBaseEntity {
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn("uuid")
  id!: string;

  @CreateDateColumn({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    name: "created_at",
  })
  createdAt!: Date;

  @UpdateDateColumn({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    name: "updated_at",
  })
  updatedAt!: Date;

  @DeleteDateColumn({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    name: "deleted_at",
    nullable: true,
  })
  deletedAt?: Date;
}

import { Entity, Column, ManyToOne, JoinColumn, Index } from "typeorm";
import { BaseEntity } from "./base.entity";
import { Tenant } from "./tenant.entity";
import { OAuthClient } from "./oauth-client.entity";
import { User } from "./user.entity";
import { Session } from "./session.entity";

/**
 * OAuth2 Access Token
 * Short-lived token for API access
 */
@Entity("oauth_access_tokens")
@Index(["tenantId", "tokenHash"], { unique: true })
@Index(["tenantId"])
@Index(["tokenHash"])
@Index(["clientId"])
@Index(["userId"])
@Index(["sessionId"])
@Index(["expiresAt"])
@Index(["revokedAt"])
export class OAuthAccessToken extends BaseEntity {
  // ============================================================
  // RELATIONSHIPS
  // ============================================================

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "tenant_id" })
  tenantId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => Tenant, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "tenant_id" })
  tenant!: Tenant;

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "client_id" })
  clientId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => OAuthClient, (client) => client.accessTokens, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "client_id" })
  client!: OAuthClient;

  @Column({ type: "uuid", nullable: true, name: "user_id" })
  userId?: string; // NULL for client_credentials grant

  @ManyToOne(() => User, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "user_id" })
  user?: User;

  @Column({ type: "uuid", nullable: true, name: "session_id" })
  sessionId?: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => Session, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "session_id" })
  session?: Session;

  // ============================================================
  // TOKEN
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 255,
    unique: true,
    name: "token_hash",
    comment: "SHA-256 hash of access token (JTI claim)",
  })
  tokenHash!: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 20,
    default: "Bearer",
    name: "token_type",
    comment: "Token type (always Bearer)",
  })
  tokenType!: string;

  // ============================================================
  // OAUTH2 PARAMETERS
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "text",
    nullable: true,
    comment: "Granted scopes (space-separated)",
  })
  scope?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "text",
    nullable: true,
    comment: "Audience (client_id or resource server)",
  })
  audience?: string;

  // ============================================================
  // EXPIRY & REVOCATION
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    name: "expires_at",
    comment: "When this token expires (typically 15 minutes)",
  })
  expiresAt!: Date;

  @Column({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    nullable: true,
    name: "revoked_at",
    comment: "When this token was revoked",
  })
  revokedAt?: Date;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 100,
    nullable: true,
    name: "revoked_reason",
    comment: "Why this token was revoked",
  })
  revokedReason?: string;

  // ============================================================
  // USAGE TRACKING
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    nullable: true,
    name: "last_used_at",
    comment: "Last time this token was used",
  })
  lastUsedAt?: Date;

  @Column({
    type: "integer",
    default: 0,
    name: "use_count",
    comment: "Number of times this token was used",
  })
  useCount!: number;

  // ============================================================
  // METADATA
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "inet",
    nullable: true,
    name: "ip_address",
    comment: "IP address when token was issued",
  })
  ipAddress?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "text",
    nullable: true,
    name: "user_agent",
    comment: "User agent when token was issued",
  })
  userAgent?: string;

  // ============================================================
  // HELPERS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Check if token is expired
   */
  get isExpired(): boolean {
    return this.expiresAt < new Date();
  }

  /**
   * Check if token is revoked
   */
  get isRevoked(): boolean {
    return !!this.revokedAt;
  }

  /**
   * Check if token is valid (not expired, not revoked)
   */
  get isValid(): boolean {
    return !this.isExpired && !this.isRevoked;
  }

  /**
   * Check if token is for a user (vs M2M)
   */
  get isUserToken(): boolean {
    return !!this.userId;
  }

  /**
   * Check if token is for M2M
   */
  get isM2MToken(): boolean {
    return !this.userId;
  }

  /**
   * Get scopes as array
   */
  get scopes(): string[] {
    return this.scope ? this.scope.split(" ") : [];
  }

  /**
   * Check if token has specific scope
   */
  hasScope(scope: string): boolean {
    return this.scopes.includes(scope);
  }
}

import { Entity, Column, ManyToOne, JoinColumn, Index } from "typeorm";
import { BaseEntity } from "./base.entity";
import { Tenant } from "./tenant.entity";
import { OAuthClient } from "./oauth-client.entity";
import { User } from "./user.entity";

/**
 * OAuth2 Authorization Code
 * Temporary code exchanged for access/refresh tokens
 */
@Entity("oauth_authorization_codes")
@Index(["tenantId", "codeHash"], { unique: true })
@Index(["tenantId"])
@Index(["codeHash"])
@Index(["clientId"])
@Index(["userId"])
@Index(["expiresAt"])
export class OAuthAuthorizationCode extends BaseEntity {
  // ============================================================
  // RELATIONSHIPS
  // ============================================================

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "tenant_id" })
  tenantId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => Tenant, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "tenant_id" })
  tenant!: Tenant;

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "client_id" })
  clientId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => OAuthClient, (client) => client.authorizationCodes, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "client_id" })
  client!: OAuthClient;

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "user_id" })
  userId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => User, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "user_id" })
  user!: User;

  // ============================================================
  // CODE
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 255,
    unique: true,
    name: "code_hash",
    comment: "SHA-256 hash of authorization code",
  })
  codeHash!: string;

  // ============================================================
  // PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange)
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 255,
    nullable: true,
    name: "code_challenge",
    comment: "PKCE code challenge",
  })
  codeChallenge?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 10,
    nullable: true,
    name: "code_challenge_method",
    comment: "PKCE challenge method: S256 or plain",
  })
  codeChallengeMethod?: "S256" | "plain";

  // ============================================================
  // OAUTH2 PARAMETERS
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 500,
    name: "redirect_uri",
    comment: "Redirect URI used in authorization request",
  })
  redirectUri!: string;

  @Column({
    type: "text",
    nullable: true,
    comment: "Requested scopes (space-separated)",
  })
  scope?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 500,
    nullable: true,
    comment: "OAuth2 state parameter for CSRF protection",
  })
  state?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 255,
    nullable: true,
    comment: "OIDC nonce parameter for replay protection",
  })
  nonce?: string;

  // ============================================================
  // USAGE TRACKING
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    nullable: true,
    name: "used_at",
    comment: "When this code was exchanged for tokens",
  })
  usedAt?: Date;

  @Column({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    name: "expires_at",
    comment: "When this code expires (typically 10 minutes)",
  })
  expiresAt!: Date;

  // ============================================================
  // METADATA
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "inet",
    nullable: true,
    name: "ip_address",
    comment: "IP address of authorization request",
  })
  ipAddress?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "text",
    nullable: true,
    name: "user_agent",
    comment: "User agent of authorization request",
  })
  userAgent?: string;

  // ============================================================
  // HELPERS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Check if code is expired
   */
  get isExpired(): boolean {
    return this.expiresAt < new Date();
  }

  /**
   * Check if code has been used
   */
  get isUsed(): boolean {
    return !!this.usedAt;
  }

  /**
   * Check if code is valid (not expired, not used)
   */
  get isValid(): boolean {
    return !this.isExpired && !this.isUsed;
  }

  /**
   * Check if PKCE is enabled
   */
  get hasPKCE(): boolean {
    return !!this.codeChallenge;
  }
}

import {
  Entity,
  Column,
  ManyToOne,
  JoinColumn,
  Index,
  OneToMany,
} from "typeorm";
import { BaseEntity } from "./base.entity";
import { Tenant } from "./tenant.entity";
import { OAuthAuthorizationCode } from "./oauth-authorization-code.entity";
import { OAuthAccessToken } from "./oauth-access-token.entity";
import { OAuthRefreshToken } from "./oauth-refresh-token.entity";
import { OAuthConsent } from "./oauth-consent.entity";

export type ClientType = "confidential" | "public";
export type ApplicationType = "web" | "native" | "spa";
export type SubjectType = "public" | "pairwise";
export type TokenEndpointAuthMethod =
  | "client_secret_basic"
  | "client_secret_post"
  | "none";

/**
 * OAuth2 Client (Registered Application)
 * Represents third-party or first-party applications that can authenticate users
 */
@Entity("oauth_clients")
@Index(["tenantId", "clientId"], { unique: true })
@Index(["tenantId"])
@Index(["clientId"])
@Index(["isActive"])
@Index(["isFirstParty"])
export class OAuthClient extends BaseEntity {
  // ============================================================
  // RELATIONSHIPS
  // ============================================================

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "tenant_id" })
  tenantId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => Tenant, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "tenant_id" })
  tenant!: Tenant;

  @OneToMany(() => OAuthAuthorizationCode, (code) => code.client)
  authorizationCodes!: OAuthAuthorizationCode[];

  @OneToMany(() => OAuthAccessToken, (token) => token.client)
  accessTokens!: OAuthAccessToken[];

  @OneToMany(() => OAuthRefreshToken, (token) => token.client)
  refreshTokens!: OAuthRefreshToken[];

  @OneToMany(() => OAuthConsent, (consent) => consent.client)
  consents!: OAuthConsent[];

  // ============================================================
  // CLIENT IDENTIFICATION
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 255,
    unique: true,
    name: "client_id",
    comment: "Unique client identifier (e.g., app_abc123)",
  })
  clientId!: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 255,
    nullable: true,
    name: "client_secret_hash",
    comment: "Hashed client secret (NULL for public clients)",
    select: false, // Don't select by default
  })
  clientSecretHash?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 20,
    name: "client_type",
    comment: "confidential (has secret) | public (no secret, PKCE required)",
  })
  clientType!: ClientType;

  // ============================================================
  // CLIENT METADATA
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 255,
    comment: "Human-readable application name",
  })
  name!: string;

  @Column({
    type: "text",
    nullable: true,
    comment: "Application description",
  })
  description?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 500,
    nullable: true,
    name: "logo_url",
    comment: "URL to application logo",
  })
  logoUrl?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 500,
    nullable: true,
    name: "website_url",
    comment: "Application website URL",
  })
  websiteUrl?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 500,
    nullable: true,
    name: "privacy_policy_url",
    comment: "Privacy policy URL",
  })
  privacyPolicyUrl?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 500,
    nullable: true,
    name: "terms_of_service_url",
    comment: "Terms of service URL",
  })
  termsOfServiceUrl?: string;

  // ============================================================
  // OAUTH2 CONFIGURATION
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "simple-array",
    name: "grant_types",
    comment: "Allowed OAuth2 grant types",
  })
  grantTypes!: string[]; // ['authorization_code', 'refresh_token', 'client_credentials']

  @Column({
    type: "simple-array",
    name: "redirect_uris",

  })
  redirectUris!: string[]; // ['https://app.example.com/callback', 'http://localhost:3000/callback']

  @Column({

    comment: "Allowed redirect URIs after logout",
  })
  postLogoutRedirectUris?: string[];

  @Column({
    type: "simple-array",
    nullable: true,
    name: "allowed_origins",
    comment: "Allowed CORS origins",
  })
  allowedOrigins?: string[];

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 50,
    default: "client_secret_basic",

  tokenEndpointAuthMethod!: TokenEndpointAuthMethod;

  // ============================================================

  @Column({

    name: "allowed_scopes",
    comment: "Scopes this client can request",
  })
  allowedScopes?: string[]; // ['openid', 'profile', 'email', 'users:read']

  @Column({
    type: "simple-array",
    nullable: true,
    name: "default_scopes",
    comment: "Default scopes if none specified",
  })
  defaultScopes?: string[];

  // ============================================================
  // TOKEN SETTINGS
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "integer",
    default: 900,
    name: "access_token_ttl",
    comment: "Access token lifetime in seconds (default: 15 minutes)",
  })
  accessTokenTtl!: number;

  @Column({
    type: "integer",
    default: 604800,
    name: "refresh_token_ttl",
    comment: "Refresh token lifetime in seconds (default: 7 days)",
  })
  refreshTokenTtl!: number;

  @Column({
    type: "integer",
    default: 3600,
    name: "id_token_ttl",
    comment: "ID token lifetime in seconds (default: 1 hour)",
  })
  idTokenTtl!: number;

  @Column({
    type: "integer",
    default: 600,
    name: "authorization_code_ttl",
    comment: "Authorization code lifetime in seconds (default: 10 minutes)",
  })
  authorizationCodeTtl!: number;

  @Column({
    type: "boolean",
    default: true,
    name: "rotate_refresh_tokens",
    comment: "Whether to rotate refresh tokens on use",
  })
  rotateRefreshTokens!: boolean;

  // ============================================================
  // OIDC CONFIGURATION
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 20,
    default: "web",
    name: "application_type",
    comment: "OIDC application type",
  })
  applicationType!: ApplicationType;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 20,
    default: "public",
    name: "subject_type",
    comment: "OIDC subject identifier type",
  })
  subjectType!: SubjectType;

  // ============================================================
  // CONSENT & TRUST
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "boolean",
    default: false,
    name: "require_consent",
    comment: "Whether to show consent screen (always true for third-party)",
  })
  requireConsent!: boolean;

  @Column({
    type: "boolean",
    default: false,
    name: "is_first_party",
    comment: "Whether this is a first-party client (Fort Knox owned)",
  })
  isFirstParty!: boolean;

  @Column({
    type: "boolean",
    default: true,
    name: "is_active",
    comment: "Whether this client is active",
  })
  isActive!: boolean;

  // ============================================================
  // METADATA
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "jsonb",
    nullable: true,
    comment: "Additional metadata (custom claims, etc.)",
  })
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 255,
    nullable: true,
    name: "created_by",
    comment: "User ID who created this client",
  })
  createdBy?: string;

  // ============================================================
  // HELPERS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Check if client is public (no secret)
   */
  get isPublic(): boolean {
    return this.clientType === "public";
  }

  /**
   * Check if client is confidential (has secret)
   */
  get isConfidential(): boolean {
    return this.clientType === "confidential";
  }

  /**
   * Check if grant type is allowed
   */
  isGrantTypeAllowed(grantType: string): boolean {
    return this.grantTypes.includes(grantType);
  }

  /**
   * Check if redirect URI is allowed
   */
  isRedirectUriAllowed(redirectUri: string): boolean {
    return this.redirectUris.includes(redirectUri);
  }

  /**
   * Check if scope is allowed
   */
  isScopeAllowed(scope: string): boolean {
    if (!this.allowedScopes) return true; // No restrictions
    return this.allowedScopes.includes(scope);
  }
}

/**
 * OAuth2 Consent
 * User consent for third-party applications
 */
@Entity("oauth_consents")
@Index(["tenantId", "userId", "clientId"], { unique: true })
@Index(["tenantId"])
@Index(["clientId"])
@Index(["userId"])
@Index(["expiresAt"])
@Index(["revokedAt"])
export class OAuthConsent extends BaseEntity {
  // ============================================================
  // RELATIONSHIPS
  // ============================================================

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "tenant_id" })
  tenantId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => Tenant, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "tenant_id" })
  tenant!: Tenant;

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "client_id" })
  clientId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => OAuthClient, (client) => client.consents, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "client_id" })
  client!: OAuthClient;

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "user_id" })
  userId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => User, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "user_id" })
  user!: User;

  // ============================================================
  // CONSENT
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "simple-array",
    name: "granted_scopes",
    comment: "Scopes the user consented to",
  })
  grantedScopes!: string[];

  // ============================================================
  // EXPIRY & REVOCATION
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    nullable: true,
    name: "expires_at",
    comment: "When this consent expires (NULL = permanent)",
  })
  expiresAt?: Date;

  @Column({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    nullable: true,
    name: "revoked_at",
    comment: "When this consent was revoked",
  })
  revokedAt?: Date;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 100,
    nullable: true,
    name: "revoked_reason",
    comment: "Why this consent was revoked",
  })
  revokedReason?: string;

  // ============================================================
  // METADATA
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "inet",
    nullable: true,
    name: "ip_address",
    comment: "IP address when consent was granted",
  })
  ipAddress?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "text",
    nullable: true,
    name: "user_agent",
    comment: "User agent when consent was granted",
  })
  userAgent?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "boolean",
    default: false,
    name: "remember_consent",
    comment: "Whether user chose to remember this consent",
  })
  rememberConsent!: boolean;

  // ============================================================
  // HELPERS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Check if consent is expired
   */
  get isExpired(): boolean {
    if (!this.expiresAt) return false; // Permanent consent
    return this.expiresAt < new Date();
  }

  /**
   * Check if consent is revoked
   */
  get isRevoked(): boolean {
    return !!this.revokedAt;
  }

  /**
   * Check if consent is valid (not expired, not revoked)
   */
  get isValid(): boolean {
    return !this.isExpired && !this.isRevoked;
  }

  /**
   * Check if user consented to specific scope
   */
  hasScope(scope: string): boolean {
    return this.grantedScopes.includes(scope);
  }

  /**
   * Check if user consented to all requested scopes
   */
  hasAllScopes(scopes: string[]): boolean {
    return scopes.every((scope) => this.hasScope(scope));
  }

  /**
   * Check if consent is permanent
   */
  get isPermanent(): boolean {
    return !this.expiresAt;
  }
}

  usedAt?: Date;

  @Column({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    nullable: true,
    name: "revoked_at",

  })
  revokedReason?: string;

  @Column({

    name: "expires_at",
    comment: "When this token expires (typically 7 days)",
  })
  expiresAt!: Date;

  // ============================================================

  @Column({

  })
  ipAddress?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "text",
    nullable: true,
    name: "user_agent",
    comment: "User agent when token was issued",
  })
  userAgent?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 100,
    nullable: true,
    name: "device_id",
    comment: "Device identifier",
  })
  deviceId?: string;

  // ============================================================
  // HELPERS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Check if token is expired
   */
  get isExpired(): boolean {
    return this.expiresAt < new Date();
  }

  /**
   * Check if token is revoked
   */
  get isRevoked(): boolean {
    return !!this.revokedAt;
  }

  /**
   * Check if token has been used (for reuse detection)
   */
  get isUsed(): boolean {
    return !!this.usedAt;
  }

  /**
   * Check if token is valid (not expired, not revoked, not used)
   */
  get isValid(): boolean {
    return !this.isExpired && !this.isRevoked && !this.isUsed;
  }

  /**
   * Get scopes as array
   */
  get scopes(): string[] {
    return this.scope ? this.scope.split(" ") : [];
  }

  /**
   * Check if token has specific scope
   */
  hasScope(scope: string): boolean {
    return this.scopes.includes(scope);
  }

  /**
   * Check if this is the root token in family
   */
  get isRootToken(): boolean {
    return !this.parentTokenId;
  }
}
