/**
 * Fort Knox SDK - Core Client
 *
 * The session runtime - owns tokens, knows when to refresh
 * Works in any environment (browser, Node, Next.js)
 */

import type {
  FortKnoxConfig,
  Transport,
  TransportRequest,
  TransportResponse,
  AuthState,
  LoginCredentials,
  LoginResponse,
  User,
  AuthError,
  AuthEvent,
  AuthEventListener,
  LoginIntentResponse,
} from "./types";
import { AuthError as AuthErrorClass } from "./types";
import { createFetchTransport } from "./transport";
import {
  createAuthState,
  setAccessToken,
  clearAccessToken,
  isTokenExpired,
  queueRequest,
  flushPendingRequests,
  rejectPendingRequests,
} from "./state";

export class FortKnoxClient {
  private config: Required<FortKnoxConfig>;
  private state: AuthState;
  private transport: Transport;
  private listeners: AuthEventListener[] = [];
  private initPromise?: Promise<void>;

  constructor(config: FortKnoxConfig) {
    this.config = {
      debug: false,
      refreshMargin: 30,
      maxRefreshRetries: 3,
      onTokenRefreshed: () => {},
      onLogout: () => {},
      onError: () => {},
      ...config, // ← Spread config FIRST
      transport: config.transport || createFetchTransport(), // ← Then set transport
    };

    this.state = createAuthState();
    this.transport = this.config.transport;
    this.initPromise = this.tryRestoreSession();

    this.log("FortKnox client initialized", {
      baseURL: this.config.baseURL,
      tenant: this.config.tenant,
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // PUBLIC API - AUTHENTICATION
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Login with email and password
   */
  async login(credentials: LoginCredentials): Promise<LoginResponse> {
    this.log("Login attempt", { email: credentials.email });

    const response = await this.request({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/auth/login`,
      method: "POST",
      body: credentials,
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw this.createError(response);
    }

    const data = response.data?.data;

    // Handle MFA challenge
    if (data.mfaRequired) {
      this.log("MFA required");
      return data;
    }

    // Set access token
    if (data.accessToken) {
      setAccessToken(this.state, data.accessToken);
      this.emit({ type: "token_refreshed", accessToken: data.accessToken });
      this.config.onTokenRefreshed(data.accessToken);
    }

    this.log("Login successful", { email: data.user?.email });

    return data;
  }

  async loginIntent(email: string): Promise<LoginIntentResponse> {
    this.log("Login Intent request", { email });
    const response = await this.request({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/auth/login-intent`,
      method: "POST",
      body: { email },
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw this.createError(response);
    }

    return response.data?.data;
  }

  /**
   * Request password reset OTP
   */
  async forgotPassword(email: string): Promise<void> {
    this.log("Forgot password request", { email });
    const response = await this.transport({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/auth/forgot-password`,
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "X-Tenant-ID": this.config.tenant,
      },
      body: { email },
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw this.createError(response);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Reset password with OTP
   */
  async resetPassword(otp: string, password: string): Promise<void> {
    this.log("Reset password with OTP");
    const response = await this.transport({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/auth/reset-password`,
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "X-Tenant-ID": this.config.tenant,
      },
      body: { otp, password },
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw this.createError(response);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Verify TOTP code during MFA login step.
   * tempToken is the short-lived token returned by /auth/login when mfaRequired=true.
   */
  async verifyMfaLogin(tempToken: string, code: string): Promise<void> {
    const response = await this.transport({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/auth/mfa/verify`,
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "X-Tenant-ID": this.config.tenant,
      },
      body: { tempToken, code },
      credentials: "include",
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw this.createError(response);
    }

    const accessToken =
      response.data?.data?.data?.accessToken ||
      response.data?.data?.accessToken ||
      response.data?.accessToken;
    if (!accessToken) {
      throw new AuthErrorClass(
        "UNKNOWN_ERROR",
        "No access token in MFA verify response",
      );
    }

    setAccessToken(this.state, accessToken);
    this.emit({ type: "token_refreshed", accessToken });
    this.config.onTokenRefreshed(accessToken);
  }

  /**
   * Initiate social login — redirects the browser to the OAuth provider
   */
  initiateSocialLogin(provider: string): void {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") {
      throw new Error(
        "initiateSocialLogin is only available in browser environments",
      );
    }
    const returnUrl = encodeURIComponent(window.location.origin);
    window.location.href = `${this.config.baseURL}/auth/social/${provider}/login?tenant_id=${this.config.tenant}&return_url=${returnUrl}`;
  }

  /**
   * Claim a social session using the completion token from /u/auth/callback?ct=...
   */
  async claimSocialSession(completionToken: string): Promise<void> {
    const response = await this.transport({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/auth/social/claim-session`,
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "X-Tenant-ID": this.config.tenant,
      },
      body: { ct: completionToken },
      credentials: "include",
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw this.createError(response);
    }

    const accessToken =
      response.data?.data?.accessToken || response.data?.accessToken;
    if (!accessToken) {
      throw new AuthErrorClass(
        "UNKNOWN_ERROR",
        "No access token in claim-session response",
      );
    }

    setAccessToken(this.state, accessToken);
    this.emit({ type: "token_refreshed", accessToken });
    this.config.onTokenRefreshed(accessToken);
  }

  /**
   * Send a magic link sign-in email
   */
  async sendMagicLink(email: string): Promise<void> {
    const response = await this.transport({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/auth/magic-link/send`,
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "X-Tenant-ID": this.config.tenant,
      },
      body: { email },
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw this.createError(response);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Verify a magic link token and establish session
   */
  async verifyMagicLink(token: string): Promise<void> {
    const response = await this.transport({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/auth/magic-link/verify`,
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "X-Tenant-ID": this.config.tenant,
      },
      body: { token },
      credentials: "include",
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw this.createError(response);
    }

    const accessToken =
      response.data?.data?.data?.accessToken ||
      response.data?.data?.accessToken ||
      response.data?.accessToken;
    if (!accessToken) {
      throw new AuthErrorClass(
        "UNKNOWN_ERROR",
        "No access token in magic-link verify response",
      );
    }

    setAccessToken(this.state, accessToken);
    this.emit({ type: "token_refreshed", accessToken });
    this.config.onTokenRefreshed(accessToken);
  }

  /**
   * Start WebAuthn (passkey) authentication.
   * Returns the raw server response which includes both WebAuthn options and
   * the opaque `sessionNonce` required by `finishPasskeyLogin`.
   */
  async startPasskeyLogin(email: string): Promise<any> {
    const response = await this.request({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/auth/webauthn/login/start`,
      method: "POST",
      body: { email },
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw this.createError(response);
    }

    return response.data?.data || response.data;
  }

  /**
   * Finish WebAuthn (passkey) authentication with the browser assertion.
   *
   * @param sessionNonce - Opaque nonce returned by `startPasskeyLogin()`; the
   *   server uses it to retrieve the single-use challenge from Redis.
   */
  async finishPasskeyLogin(
    email: string,
    assertion: any,
    sessionNonce: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const response = await this.request({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/auth/webauthn/login/finish`,
      method: "POST",
      body: { email, response: assertion, sessionNonce },
      credentials: "include",
    } as any);

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw this.createError(response);
    }

    const accessToken =
      response.data?.data?.accessToken || response.data?.accessToken;
    if (!accessToken) {
      throw new AuthErrorClass(
        "UNKNOWN_ERROR",
        "No access token in passkey login response",
      );
    }

    setAccessToken(this.state, accessToken);
    this.emit({ type: "token_refreshed", accessToken });
    this.config.onTokenRefreshed(accessToken);
  }

  /**
   * Complete passkey authentication in one step (browser-side orchestration).
   *
   * 1. Fetches WebAuthn options + sessionNonce from the server.
   * 2. Calls `startAuthentication(options)` from `@simplewebauthn/browser`.
   * 3. Verifies the assertion with the server and establishes a session.
   *
   * Throws `AuthError` with code `PASSKEY_AUTH_CANCELLED` if the user cancels
   * or if the browser does not support WebAuthn.
   */
  async authenticateWithPasskey(email: string): Promise<void> {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") {
      throw new AuthErrorClass(
        "PASSKEY_NOT_SUPPORTED",
        "authenticateWithPasskey is only available in browser environments",
      );
    }

    // Step 1: Get options + nonce from server
    const serverData = await this.startPasskeyLogin(email);
    const { sessionNonce, ...optionsJSON } = serverData;

    // Step 2: Invoke the browser's native WebAuthn API
    let assertion: any;
    try {
      const { startAuthentication } = await import(
        "@simplewebauthn/browser" as any
      );
      assertion = await startAuthentication({ optionsJSON });
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err?.name === "NotAllowedError" || err?.name === "AbortError") {
        throw new AuthErrorClass(
          "PASSKEY_AUTH_CANCELLED",
          "Passkey authentication was cancelled",
        );
      }
      if (err?.name === "NotSupportedError" || err?.name === "SecurityError") {
        throw new AuthErrorClass(
          "PASSKEY_NOT_SUPPORTED",
          "This browser or device does not support passkeys",
        );
      }
      throw err;
    }

    // Step 3: Verify with server (establishes session, sets access token)
    await this.finishPasskeyLogin(email, assertion, sessionNonce);
  }

  // ── Passkey Registration & Management ──────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Register a new passkey credential.
   *
   * 1. Fetches WebAuthn registration options from the server.
   * 2. Calls `startRegistration(options)` from `@simplewebauthn/browser`
   *    to invoke the device's authenticator.
   * 3. Returns the browser's `RegistrationResponseJSON` for use with
   *    `finishPasskeyRegistration()`.
   *
   * Throws `AuthError` with code `PASSKEY_REGISTRATION_CANCELLED` if the
   * user dismisses the prompt or if the browser API is unavailable.
   */
  async startPasskeyRegistration(): Promise<any> {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") {
      throw new AuthErrorClass(
        "PASSKEY_NOT_SUPPORTED",
        "startPasskeyRegistration is only available in browser environments",
      );
    }

    // Step 1: Fetch registration options from server
    const optionsResponse = await this.request({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/mfa/webauthn/register/start`,
      method: "POST",
    });
    if (!optionsResponse.ok) throw this.createError(optionsResponse);
    const optionsJSON = optionsResponse.data?.data || optionsResponse.data;

    // Step 2: Invoke the browser's native WebAuthn API
    try {
      const { startRegistration } = await import(
        "@simplewebauthn/browser" as any
      );
      return await startRegistration({ optionsJSON });
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err?.name === "NotAllowedError" || err?.name === "AbortError") {
        throw new AuthErrorClass(
          "PASSKEY_REGISTRATION_CANCELLED",
          "Passkey registration was cancelled",
        );
      }
      if (err?.name === "NotSupportedError" || err?.name === "SecurityError") {
        throw new AuthErrorClass(
          "PASSKEY_REGISTRATION_CANCELLED",
          "This browser or device does not support passkeys",
        );
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }

  /** Finish WebAuthn passkey registration — verifies and stores the credential */
  async finishPasskeyRegistration(
    registrationResponse: any,
    deviceName?: string,
  ): Promise<{ credentialId: string }> {
    const response = await this.request({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/mfa/webauthn/register/finish`,
      method: "POST",
      body: { response: registrationResponse, deviceName },
    });
    if (!response.ok) throw this.createError(response);
    const data = response.data?.data || response.data;
    if (!data?.credentialId) {
      throw new AuthErrorClass(
        "UNKNOWN_ERROR",
        "No credentialId in registration response",
      );
    }
    return data as { credentialId: string };
  }

  /** List all registered passkeys for the current user */
  async listPasskeys(): Promise<
    Array<{
      id: string;
      deviceName?: string;
      createdAt: string;
      lastUsedAt?: string;
      transports: string[];
    }>
  > {
    const response = await this.request({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/mfa/webauthn/credentials`,
      method: "GET",
    });
    if (!response.ok) throw this.createError(response);
    return response.data?.data?.credentials || response.data?.credentials || [];
  }

  /** Delete a registered passkey by credential ID */
  async deletePasskey(credentialId: string): Promise<void> {
    const response = await this.request({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/mfa/webauthn/credentials/${credentialId}`,
      method: "DELETE",
    });
    if (!response.ok) throw this.createError(response);
  }

  // ── Social Connections & Account Linking ───────────────────────────

  /** Get all linked social accounts for the current user */
  async getSocialConnections(): Promise<
    Array<{
      id: string;
      provider: string;
      email: string;
      displayName: string;
      avatarUrl?: string;
      primary: boolean;
      lastUsedAt?: string;
      createdAt: string;
    }>
  > {
    const response = await this.request({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/social/connections`,
      method: "GET",
    });
    if (!response.ok) throw this.createError(response);
    return response.data?.data?.connections || response.data?.connections || [];
  }

  /** Unlink a social account from the current user */
  async unlinkSocialAccount(provider: string): Promise<void> {
    const response = await this.request({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/social/connections/${provider}`,
      method: "DELETE",
    });
    if (!response.ok) throw this.createError(response);
  }

  /**
   * Initiate social account linking for an already-authenticated user.
   * Fetches a short-lived link token then navigates the browser to the
   * OAuth flow so the backend can associate the callback with this user.
   */
  async initiateSocialLinking(provider: string): Promise<void> {
    const response = await this.request({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/social/link/token`,
      method: "POST",
    });
    if (!response.ok) throw this.createError(response);
    const linkToken =
      response.data?.data?.linkToken || response.data?.linkToken;
    if (!linkToken) {
      throw new AuthErrorClass("UNKNOWN_ERROR", "No link token in response");
    }
    // Full page navigation — OAuth requires a browser redirect, not fetch
    if (typeof window === "undefined") {
      throw new AuthErrorClass(
        "UNKNOWN_ERROR",
        "initiateSocialLinking is only available in browser environments",
      );
    }
    window.location.href = `${this.config.baseURL}/social/link/${provider}?lt=${linkToken}`;
  }

  /**
   * Logout - clear session
   */
  async logout(): Promise<void> {
    this.log("Logout");

    try {
      // Call logout endpoint (clears refresh cookie)
      await this.request({
        url: `${this.config.baseURL}/auth/logout`,
        method: "POST",
      });
    } catch (error) {
      // Logout even if API call fails
      this.log("Logout API call failed", error);
    } finally {
      this.clearSession();
    }
  }

  /**
   * ⭐ NEW: Try to restore session from refresh cookie
   */
  private async tryRestoreSession(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.log("Attempting to restore session from refresh cookie");

      // Try to refresh - uses httpOnly cookie
      await this.refreshOnce();

      this.log("Session restored successfully");
    } catch (error) {
      // No valid refresh cookie — this is expected on first load or after magic-link
      // landing before a session has been established. Do not surface to console.
      this.log("No valid session to restore", error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * ⭐ NEW: Wait for initialization to complete
   */
  async waitForInit(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.initPromise) {
      await this.initPromise;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get the configured base URL
   */
  getBaseURL(): string {
    return this.config.baseURL;
  }

  /**
   * Get current user
   */
  async getCurrentUser(): Promise<User> {
    await this.waitForInit(); // ← Add this line
    this.log("Get current user");

    const response = await this.request({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/users/me`,
      method: "GET",
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw this.createError(response);
    }

    return response.data?.data;
  }

  /**
   * Check if user is authenticated
   */
  isAuthenticated(): boolean {
    return (
      !!this.state.accessToken &&
      !isTokenExpired(this.state, this.config.refreshMargin)
    );
  }

  /**
   * Get current access token, silently refreshing if expired.
   *
   * Serialized: concurrent calls while a refresh is in-flight all await the
   * same this.state.refreshPromise rather than issuing duplicate requests.
   */
  async getAccessToken(): Promise<string | undefined> {
    if (isTokenExpired(this.state, this.config.refreshMargin)) {
      try {
        await this.refresh();
      } catch {
        return undefined;
      }
    }
    return this.state.accessToken;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // REQUEST PIPELINE - THE CORE LOGIC
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Make an authenticated request
   * Handles 401s with automatic refresh
   */
  async request(req: TransportRequest): Promise<TransportResponse> {
    // If currently refreshing, queue this request
    if (this.state.isRefreshing) {
      this.log("Request queued (refresh in progress)", req.url);
      return this.queueRequestDuringRefresh(req);
    }

    // Add auth headers
    const requestWithAuth = this.addAuthHeaders(req);

    // Make request
    const response = await this.transport(requestWithAuth);

    // If 401 and we have a token, try to refresh
    if (response.status === 401 && this.state.accessToken) {
      this.log("Got 401, attempting refresh", req.url);

      try {
        await this.refresh();

        // Retry original request with new token
        const retryRequest = this.addAuthHeaders(req);
        const retryResponse = await this.transport(retryRequest);

        if (retryResponse.status === 401) {
          // Still 401 after refresh - session is dead
          this.log("Still 401 after refresh - session expired");
          this.clearSession();
          throw new AuthErrorClass(
            "SESSION_EXPIRED",
            "Your session has expired. Please log in again.",
          );
        }

        return retryResponse;
      } catch (error) {
        // Refresh failed
        this.log("Refresh failed", error);
        this.clearSession();
        throw error;
      }
    }

    return response;
  }

  /**
   * Add authorization and tenant headers to request
   */
  private addAuthHeaders(req: TransportRequest): TransportRequest {
    const headers = {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "X-Tenant-ID": this.config.tenant,
      Authorization: "", // Placeholder
      ...req.headers,
    };

    // Add access token if available
    if (this.state.accessToken) {
      headers["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${this.state.accessToken}`;
    }

    return {
      ...req,
      headers,
      credentials: "include", // Always send cookies
    };
  }

  // ============================================================
  // TOKEN REFRESH - THE CRITICAL PART
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Refresh access token using refresh token cookie
   * Concurrency-safe - only one refresh at a time
   */
  private async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    // If already refreshing, wait for that refresh
    if (this.state.isRefreshing && this.state.refreshPromise) {
      this.log("Refresh already in progress, waiting...");
      return this.state.refreshPromise;
    }

    this.state.isRefreshing = true;
    this.log("Starting token refresh");

    this.state.refreshPromise = this.refreshWithRetry();

    try {
      await this.state.refreshPromise;
    } finally {
      this.state.isRefreshing = false;
      this.state.refreshPromise = undefined;

      // Process queued requests
      this.processQueuedRequests();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Refresh with exponential backoff retry
   */
  private async refreshWithRetry(): Promise<void> {
    let attempt = 0;
    let lastError: any;

    while (attempt < this.config.maxRefreshRetries) {
      try {
        await this.refreshOnce();
        this.log("Token refresh successful");
        return;
      } catch (error) {
        lastError = error;
        attempt++;

        if (attempt < this.config.maxRefreshRetries) {
          const delay = Math.pow(2, attempt) * 1000; // 2s, 4s, 8s
          this.log(
            `Refresh attempt ${attempt} failed, retrying in ${delay}ms`,
            error,
          );
          await this.sleep(delay);
        }
      }
    }

    // All retries failed
    this.log("All refresh attempts failed", lastError);
    throw new AuthErrorClass(
      "REFRESH_FAILED",
      "Failed to refresh token",
      lastError,
    );
  }

  /**
   * Single refresh attempt
   * NO refresh token is passed - httpOnly cookie handles it
   */
  private async refreshOnce(): Promise<void> {
    const response = await this.transport({
      url: `${this.config.baseURL}/auth/refresh`,
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "X-Tenant-ID": this.config.tenant,
      },
      credentials: "include", // This sends the refresh cookie
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new AuthErrorClass(
        "REFRESH_FAILED",
        "Refresh failed",
        response.data,
      );
    }

    // Update access token
    const newToken = response.data?.data?.accessToken;
    if (!newToken) {
      throw new AuthErrorClass(
        "REFRESH_FAILED",
        "No access token in refresh response",
      );
    }

    setAccessToken(this.state, newToken);
    this.emit({ type: "token_refreshed", accessToken: newToken });
    this.config.onTokenRefreshed(newToken);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // REQUEST QUEUING
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Queue a request during token refresh
   */
  private queueRequestDuringRefresh(
    req: TransportRequest,
  ): Promise<TransportResponse> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      queueRequest(this.state, {
        request: req,
        resolve,
        reject,
      });
    });
  }

  /**
   * Process all queued requests after refresh completes
   */
  private processQueuedRequests(): void {
    const count = this.state.pendingRequests.length;
    if (count === 0) return;

    this.log(`Processing ${count} queued requests`);

    flushPendingRequests(this.state, async (pendingReq) => {
      try {
        const response = await this.request(pendingReq.request);
        pendingReq.resolve(response);
      } catch (error) {
        pendingReq.reject(error);
      }
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // SESSION MANAGEMENT
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Clear local session state
   */
  private clearSession(): void {
    this.log("Clearing session");

    clearAccessToken(this.state);
    rejectPendingRequests(
      this.state,
      new AuthErrorClass("SESSION_EXPIRED", "Session expired"),
    );

    this.emit({ type: "logout" });
    this.emit({ type: "session_expired" });
    this.config.onLogout();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // EVENTS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Subscribe to auth events
   */
  on(listener: AuthEventListener): () => void {
    this.listeners.push(listener);

    // Return unsubscribe function
    return () => {
      const index = this.listeners.indexOf(listener);
      if (index > -1) {
        this.listeners.splice(index, 1);
      }
    };
  }

  /**
   * Emit event to all listeners
   */
  private emit(event: AuthEvent): void {
    this.listeners.forEach((listener) => {
      try {
        listener(event);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Error in auth event listener:", error);
      }
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // UTILITIES
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Create AuthError from response
   */
  private createError(response: TransportResponse): AuthError {
    const data = response.data;

    const code = data?.code || this.statusToErrorCode(response.status);
    const message = data?.message || response.statusText || "Request failed";

    const error = new AuthErrorClass(code, message, data);

    this.emit({ type: "error", error });
    this.config.onError(error);

    return error;
  }

  /**
   * Map HTTP status to error code
   */
  private statusToErrorCode(status: number): any {
    switch (status) {
      case 401:
        return "UNAUTHORIZED";
      case 403:
        return "FORBIDDEN";
      case 404:
        return "USER_NOT_FOUND";
      case 429:
        return "RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED";
      default:
        return "UNKNOWN_ERROR";
    }
  }

  /**
   * Sleep utility for retry backoff
   */
  private sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  }

  /**
   * Debug logging
   */
  private log(...args: any[]): void {
    if (this.config.debug) {
      console.log("[FortKnox]", ...args);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Fort Knox SDK - State Manager
 * 
 * Manages the in-memory auth state
 * Never persisted, never exposed
 */

import type { AuthState, PendingRequest } from './types';

/**
 * Creates a new auth state
 * All state lives in memory only
 */
export function createAuthState(): AuthState {
  return {
    accessToken: undefined,
    accessTokenExp: undefined,
    isRefreshing: false,
    refreshPromise: undefined,
    pendingRequests: [],
  };
}

// Access token is intentionally stored in module memory only.
// It is never written to localStorage, sessionStorage, or any
// JS-accessible cookie. Loss of the token on page refresh is
// intentional — the httpOnly refresh token cookie is used to
// silently re-issue a new access token via getAccessToken().

/**
 * Set access token and parse expiration
 */
export function setAccessToken(state: AuthState, token: string): void {
  state.accessToken = token;
  state.accessTokenExp = parseTokenExpiry(token);
}

/**
 * Clear access token
 */
export function clearAccessToken(state: AuthState): void {
  state.accessToken = undefined;
  state.accessTokenExp = undefined;
}

/**
 * Check if token is expired or about to expire
 * @param margin - Seconds before expiry to consider token expired (default: 30)
 */
export function isTokenExpired(state: AuthState, margin: number = 30): boolean {
  if (!state.accessToken || !state.accessTokenExp) {
    return true;
  }

  const now = Date.now();
  const expiryWithMargin = state.accessTokenExp - (margin * 1000);
  
  return now >= expiryWithMargin;
}

/**
 * Add request to pending queue
 */
export function queueRequest(
  state: AuthState,
  request: PendingRequest,
): void {
  state.pendingRequests.push(request);
}

/**
 * Process all pending requests
 */
export function flushPendingRequests(
  state: AuthState,
  handler: (request: PendingRequest) => void,
): void {
  const requests = [...state.pendingRequests];
  state.pendingRequests = [];
  
  requests.forEach(handler);
}

/**
 * Reject all pending requests
 */
export function rejectPendingRequests(
  state: AuthState,
  error: any,
): void {
  const requests = [...state.pendingRequests];
  state.pendingRequests = [];
  
  requests.forEach((req) => req.reject(error));
}

/**
 * Parse JWT to get expiration timestamp
 */
function parseTokenExpiry(token: string): number | undefined {
  try {
    // JWT format: header.payload.signature
    const parts = token.split('.');
    if (parts.length !== 3) return undefined;

    // Decode payload (base64url)
    const payload = JSON.parse(atob(parts[1]!.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/')));
    
    // exp is in seconds, convert to milliseconds
    return payload.exp ? payload.exp * 1000 : undefined;
  } catch (error) {
    return undefined;
  }
}

/**
 * Fort Knox SDK - Default Transport
 * 
 * Uses the Fetch API (works in browsers and Node 18+)
 */

import type { Transport, TransportRequest, TransportResponse } from './types';

/**
 * Creates a fetch-based transport
 * Works in browsers and Node.js 18+
 */
export function createFetchTransport(): Transport {
  return async (request: TransportRequest): Promise<TransportResponse> => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(request.url, {
        method: request.method,
        headers: request.headers,
        body: request.body ? JSON.stringify(request.body) : undefined,
        credentials: request.credentials || 'include',
      });

      // Parse response body
      let data: any;
      const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type');
      
      if (contentType?.includes('application/json')) {
        data = await response.json();
      } else {
        data = await response.text();
      }

      // Convert Headers to plain object
      const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
      response.headers.forEach((value, key) => {
        headers[key] = value;
      });

      return {
        ok: response.ok,
        status: response.status,
        statusText: response.statusText,
        headers,
        data,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      // Network error or fetch failure
      throw new Error(`Network request failed: ${error}`);
    }
  };
}

/**
 * Fort Knox SDK - Next.js Module
 * 
 * SSR-safe client that works in:
 * - Server Components
 * - API Routes
 * - Middleware
 * - Client Components (use /react instead)
 */

import { FortKnoxClient } from '../core/client';
import type { FortKnoxConfig, Transport, TransportRequest, TransportResponse } from '../core/types';

/**
 * Create a Next.js server-side client
 * Injects cookies from request into fetch calls
 */
export function createServerClient(
  config: Omit<FortKnoxConfig, 'transport'>,
  cookies?: Record<string, string>,
): FortKnoxClient {
  // Create custom transport that includes cookies
  const transport: Transport = async (req: TransportRequest): Promise<TransportResponse> => {
    const headers = {
      ...req.headers,
    };

    // Inject cookies if provided
    if (cookies) {
      const cookieHeader = Object.entries(cookies)
        .map(([key, value]) => `${key}=${value}`)
        .join('; ');
      
      if (cookieHeader) {
        headers['Cookie'] = cookieHeader;
      }
    }

    const response = await fetch(req.url, {
      method: req.method,
      headers,
      body: req.body ? JSON.stringify(req.body) : undefined,
      credentials: 'include',
    });

    let data: any;
    const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type');
    
    if (contentType?.includes('application/json')) {
      data = await response.json();
    } else {
      data = await response.text();
    }

    const responseHeaders: Record<string, string> = {};
    response.headers.forEach((value, key) => {
      responseHeaders[key] = value;
    });

    return {
      ok: response.ok,
      status: response.status,
      statusText: response.statusText,
      headers: responseHeaders,
      data,
    };
  };

  return new FortKnoxClient({
    ...config,
    transport,
  });
}

/**
 * Helper to get cookies from Next.js request
 */
export function getCookiesFromRequest(req: Request): Record<string, string> {
  const cookieHeader = req.headers.get('cookie');
  if (!cookieHeader) return {};

  const cookies: Record<string, string> = {};
  
  cookieHeader.split(';').forEach((cookie) => {
    const [key, value] = cookie.trim().split('=');
    if (key && value) {
      cookies[key] = value;
    }
  });

  return cookies;
}

/**
 * Create client from Next.js request
 * Usage in API routes or Server Components
 */
export function getFortKnoxClient(
  baseURL: string,
  tenant: string,
  req: Request,
): FortKnoxClient {
  const cookies = getCookiesFromRequest(req);
  
  return createServerClient(
    {
      baseURL,
      tenant,
    },
    cookies,
  );
}

// Re-export core
export { FortKnoxClient } from '../core/client';
export type * from '../core/types';

/**
 * Fort Knox SDK - Node.js Module
 * 
 * For server-to-server communication:
 * - Backend services
 * - CRON jobs
 * - Webhooks
 * - Microservices
 * 
 * Uses client credentials flow (no cookies)
 */

import { FortKnoxClient } from '../core/client';
import type { FortKnoxConfig, Transport, TransportRequest, TransportResponse } from '../core/types';

interface NodeClientConfig extends Omit<FortKnoxConfig, 'transport'> {
  /**
   * Client ID for machine-to-machine auth
   */
  clientId?: string;
  
  /**
   * Client secret for machine-to-machine auth
   */
  clientSecret?: string;
  
  /**
   * API key for service authentication
   */
  apiKey?: string;
}

/**
 * Create a Node.js client for server-to-server communication
 */
export function createNodeClient(config: NodeClientConfig): FortKnoxClient {
  // Create custom transport with auth credentials
  const transport: Transport = async (req: TransportRequest): Promise<TransportResponse> => {
    const headers = {
      ...req.headers,
    };

    // Add API key if provided
    if (config.apiKey) {
      headers['X-API-Key'] = config.apiKey;
    }

    // Add client credentials if provided
    if (config.clientId && config.clientSecret) {
      const auth = Buffer.from(`${config.clientId}:${config.clientSecret}`).toString('base64');
      headers['Authorization'] = `Basic ${auth}`;
    }

    const response = await fetch(req.url, {
      method: req.method,
      headers,
      body: req.body ? JSON.stringify(req.body) : undefined,
    });

    let data: any;
    const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type');
    
    if (contentType?.includes('application/json')) {
      data = await response.json();
    } else {
      data = await response.text();
    }

    const responseHeaders: Record<string, string> = {};
    response.headers.forEach((value, key) => {
      responseHeaders[key] = value;
    });

    return {
      ok: response.ok,
      status: response.status,
      statusText: response.statusText,
      headers: responseHeaders,
      data,
    };
  };

  return new FortKnoxClient({
    baseURL: config.baseURL,
    tenant: config.tenant,
    debug: config.debug,
    transport,
  });
}

// Re-export core
export { FortKnoxClient } from '../core/client';
export type * from '../core/types';

"use client";

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from "react";

// ============================================================
// CONTEXT
// ============================================================

interface AuthContextValue {
  // State
  user: User | null;
  isLoading: boolean;
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  error: Error | null;

  // Actions
  login: (credentials: LoginCredentials) => Promise<void>;
  loginIntent: (params: { email: string }) => Promise<any>;
  logout: () => Promise<void>;
  refreshUser: () => Promise<void>;
  forgotPassword: (email: string) => Promise<void>;
  resetPassword: (otp: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;

  // MFA
  verifyMfaLogin: (tempToken: string, code: string) => Promise<void>;

  // New auth methods
  initiateSocialLogin: (provider: string) => void;
  claimSocialSession: (ct: string) => Promise<void>;
  sendMagicLink: (email: string) => Promise<void>;
  verifyMagicLink: (token: string) => Promise<void>;
  startPasskeyLogin: (email: string) => Promise<any>;
  finishPasskeyLogin: (email: string, assertion: any, sessionNonce: string) => Promise<void>;
  authenticateWithPasskey: (email: string) => Promise<void>;

  // Passkey management
  startPasskeyRegistration: () => Promise<any>;
  finishPasskeyRegistration: (response: any, deviceName?: string) => Promise<{ credentialId: string }>;
  listPasskeys: () => Promise<any[]>;
  deletePasskey: (credentialId: string) => Promise<void>;

  // Social account linking
  getSocialConnections: () => Promise<any[]>;
  unlinkSocialAccount: (provider: string) => Promise<void>;
  initiateSocialLinking: (provider: string) => Promise<void>;

  // Client
  client: FortKnoxClient;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextValue>(undefined as any);

// ============================================================
// PROVIDER
// ============================================================

interface AuthProviderProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  client: FortKnoxClient;
}

export function FortKnoxProvider({ children, client }: AuthProviderProps) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null);

  // Initialize - check if user is logged in
  useEffect(() => {
    const initialize = async () => {
      try {
        setIsLoading(true);

        // Wait for SDK to restore session from cookie
        await client.waitForInit();

        console.log({ client });

        // If we have a token now, get the user
        if (client.isAuthenticated()) {
          const currentUser = await client.getCurrentUser();
          setUser(currentUser);
        } else {
          setUser(null);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to restore session:", err);
        setUser(null);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    initialize();
  }, [client]);

  // Listen to auth events
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = client.on((event: AuthEvent) => {
      switch (event.type) {
        case "logout":
        case "session_expired":
          setUser(null);
          break;

        case "error":
          setError(event.error);
          break;
      }
    });

    return unsubscribe;
  }, [client]);

  // Login
  const login = async (credentials: LoginCredentials) => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      setIsLoading(true);

      const result = await client.login(credentials);

      if (result.mfaRequired) {
        throw new Error("MFA_REQUIRED");
      }

      setUser(result.user);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const loginIntent = async ({ email }: { email: string }) => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      return await client.loginIntent(email);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    }
  };

  // Logout
  const logout = async () => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      await client.logout();
      setUser(null);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    }
  };

  // Refresh user data
  const refreshUser = async () => {
    try {
      const currentUser = await client.getCurrentUser();
      setUser(currentUser);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      setUser(null);
    }
  };

  const forgotPassword = async (email: string) => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      await client.forgotPassword(email);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    }
  };

  const resetPassword = async (otp: string, password: string) => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      await client.resetPassword(otp, password);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    }
  };

  const verifyMfaLogin = async (tempToken: string, code: string) => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      setIsLoading(true);
      await client.verifyMfaLogin(tempToken, code);
      const currentUser = await client.getCurrentUser();
      setUser(currentUser);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const initiateSocialLogin = (provider: string) => {
    client.initiateSocialLogin(provider);
  };

  const claimSocialSession = async (ct: string) => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      setIsLoading(true);
      await client.claimSocialSession(ct);
      const currentUser = await client.getCurrentUser();
      setUser(currentUser);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const sendMagicLink = async (email: string) => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      await client.sendMagicLink(email);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    }
  };

  const verifyMagicLink = async (token: string) => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      setIsLoading(true);
      await client.verifyMagicLink(token);
      const currentUser = await client.getCurrentUser();
      setUser(currentUser);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const startPasskeyLogin = async (email: string): Promise<any> => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      return await client.startPasskeyLogin(email);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    }
  };

  const finishPasskeyLogin = async (email: string, assertion: any, sessionNonce: string): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      setIsLoading(true);
      await client.finishPasskeyLogin(email, assertion, sessionNonce);
      const currentUser = await client.getCurrentUser();
      setUser(currentUser);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const authenticateWithPasskey = async (email: string): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      setIsLoading(true);
      await client.authenticateWithPasskey(email);
      const currentUser = await client.getCurrentUser();
      setUser(currentUser);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const startPasskeyRegistration = async (): Promise<any> => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      return await client.startPasskeyRegistration();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    }
  };

  const finishPasskeyRegistration = async (
    registrationResponse: any,
    deviceName?: string,
  ): Promise<{ credentialId: string }> => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      return await client.finishPasskeyRegistration(registrationResponse, deviceName);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    }
  };

  const listPasskeys = async (): Promise<any[]> => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      return await client.listPasskeys();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    }
  };

  const deletePasskey = async (credentialId: string): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      return await client.deletePasskey(credentialId);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    }
  };

  const getSocialConnections = async (): Promise<any[]> => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      return await client.getSocialConnections();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    }
  };

  const unlinkSocialAccount = async (provider: string): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      return await client.unlinkSocialAccount(provider);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    }
  };

  const initiateSocialLinking = async (provider: string): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      return await client.initiateSocialLinking(provider);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err as Error);
      throw err;
    }
  };

  const value: AuthContextValue = {
    user,
    isLoading,
    isAuthenticated: !!user,
    error,
    login,
    logout,
    refreshUser,
    forgotPassword,
    resetPassword,
    client,
    loginIntent,
    verifyMfaLogin,
    initiateSocialLogin,
    claimSocialSession,
    sendMagicLink,
    verifyMagicLink,
    startPasskeyLogin,
    finishPasskeyLogin,
    authenticateWithPasskey,
    startPasskeyRegistration,
    finishPasskeyRegistration,
    listPasskeys,
    deletePasskey,
    getSocialConnections,
    unlinkSocialAccount,
    initiateSocialLinking,
  };

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
}

// ============================================================
// HOOK
// ============================================================

/**
 * Hook to access auth context
 */
export function useAuth(): AuthContextValue {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);

  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error("useAuth must be used within FortKnoxProvider");
  }

  return context as AuthContextValue;
}

/**
 * Hook to access user only
 */
export function useUser() {
  const { user, isLoading, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();

  return {
    user,
    isLoading,
    isAuthenticated,
  };
}

/**
 * Hook to access session state
 */
export function useSession() {
  const { isAuthenticated, isLoading, client } = useAuth();
  const [accessToken, setAccessToken] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    client.getAccessToken().then((token) => {
      if (!cancelled) setAccessToken(token);
    }).catch(() => {
      if (!cancelled) setAccessToken(undefined);
    });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [client, isAuthenticated]);

  return {
    isAuthenticated,
    isLoading,
    accessToken,
  };
}

/**
 * Fort Knox SDK - Web Module
 * 
 * Browser-specific helpers
 * Adds OAuth redirects, social login, etc.
 */

import { FortKnoxClient } from '../core/client';
import type { FortKnoxConfig } from '../core/types';

/**
 * Create a browser-optimized Fort Knox client
 */
export function createWebClient(config: Omit<FortKnoxConfig, 'transport'>): FortKnoxClient {
  return new FortKnoxClient({
    ...config,
    // Browser always uses fetch with credentials
    transport: undefined, // Uses default fetch transport
  });
}

/**
 * Auto-detect tenant from subdomain
 * Example: acme.auth.scrolloop.com -> tenant: "acme"
 */
export function getTenantFromSubdomain(): string | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  
  const hostname = window.location.hostname;
  const parts = hostname.split('.');
  
  // Need at least 3 parts: subdomain.domain.tld
  if (parts.length < 3) return null;
  
  return parts[0] || null;
}

/**
 * OAuth helper - get social login URL
 */
export function getSocialLoginUrl(
  baseURL: string,
  provider: 'google' | 'github' | 'microsoft',
  options?: {
    tenant?: string;
    redirectUri?: string;
  },
): string {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  
  if (options?.tenant) {
    params.append('tenantId', options.tenant);
  }
  
  if (options?.redirectUri) {
    params.append('returnUrl', options.redirectUri);
  } else if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    params.append('returnUrl', window.location.origin + '/auth/callback');
  }
  
  return `${baseURL}/auth/social/${provider}/login?${params.toString()}`;
}

/**
 * Redirect to social login
 */
export function redirectToSocialLogin(
  baseURL: string,
  provider: 'google' | 'github' | 'microsoft',
  options?: {
    tenant?: string;
    redirectUri?: string;
  },
): void {
  const url = getSocialLoginUrl(baseURL, provider, options);
  window.location.href = url;
}

/**
 * Handle OAuth callback
 * Extracts tokens from URL and stores them
 */
// @ts-expect-error
export function handleOAuthCallback(client: FortKnoxClient): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const accessToken = params.get('access_token');
  
  if (accessToken) {
    // Token will be in cookie, client will handle it automatically
    // Remove tokens from URL for security
    window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }
}

// Re-export core types and client
export { FortKnoxClient } from '../core/client';
export type * from '../core/types';

import { createCipheriv, createDecipheriv, randomBytes, scrypt } from "crypto";
import { promisify } from "util";

const scryptAsync = promisify(scrypt);

/**
 * AES-256-GCM Encryption Service
 *
 * Provides field-level encryption for sensitive data.
 * Uses AES-256-GCM which provides both confidentiality and authenticity.
 */

export interface EncryptionResult {
  encrypted: string; // Base64 encoded
  iv: string; // Base64 encoded initialization vector
  authTag: string; // Base64 encoded authentication tag
}

export class EncryptionService {
  private static readonly ALGORITHM = "aes-256-gcm";
  private static readonly IV_LENGTH = 16; // 128 bits
  private static readonly SALT_LENGTH = 32; // 256 bits
  private static readonly KEY_LENGTH = 32; // 256 bits
  private static readonly AUTH_TAG_LENGTH = 16; // 128 bits

  /**
   * Derive encryption key from master key
   * @param masterKey - Master encryption key
   * @param salt - Salt for key derivation
   * @returns Derived key
   */
  private static async deriveKey(
    masterKey: string,
    salt: Buffer,
  ): Promise<Buffer> {
    return (await scryptAsync(masterKey, salt, this.KEY_LENGTH)) as Buffer;
  }

  /**
   * Encrypt data using AES-256-GCM
   * @param plaintext - Data to encrypt
   * @param masterKey - Master encryption key
   * @param additionalData - Optional authenticated additional data (AAD)
   * @returns Encryption result with IV and auth tag
   */
  static async encrypt(
    plaintext: string,
    masterKey: string,
    additionalData?: string,
  ): Promise<EncryptionResult> {
    // Generate random IV and salt
    const iv = randomBytes(this.IV_LENGTH);
    const salt = randomBytes(this.SALT_LENGTH);

    // Derive encryption key
    const key = await this.deriveKey(masterKey, salt);

    // Create cipher
    const cipher = createCipheriv(this.ALGORITHM, key, iv);

    // Add authenticated additional data if provided
    if (additionalData) {
      cipher.setAAD(Buffer.from(additionalData, "utf8"));
    }

    // Encrypt
    let encrypted = cipher.update(plaintext, "utf8", "base64");
    encrypted += cipher.final("base64");

    // Get authentication tag
    const authTag = cipher.getAuthTag();

    // Combine salt + iv + encrypted data for storage
    const combined = Buffer.concat([
      salt,
      iv,
      Buffer.from(encrypted, "base64"),
    ]);

    return {
      encrypted: combined.toString("base64"),
      iv: iv.toString("base64"),
      authTag: authTag.toString("base64"),
    };
  }

  /**
   * Decrypt data using AES-256-GCM
   * @param encryptedData - Encrypted data object
   * @param masterKey - Master encryption key
   * @param additionalData - Optional authenticated additional data (AAD)
   * @returns Decrypted plaintext
   */
  static async decrypt(
    encryptedData: EncryptionResult | string,
    masterKey: string,
    additionalData?: string,
  ): Promise<string> {
    let encrypted: string;
    let authTag: Buffer;
    let combined: Buffer;

    if (typeof encryptedData === "string") {
      // Legacy format: just the encrypted string
      combined = Buffer.from(encryptedData, "base64");
    } else {
      // New format: object with encrypted, iv, authTag
      combined = Buffer.from(encryptedData.encrypted, "base64");
      authTag = Buffer.from(encryptedData.authTag, "base64");
    }

    // Extract salt, iv, and encrypted data
    const salt = combined.subarray(0, this.SALT_LENGTH);
    const iv = combined.subarray(
      this.SALT_LENGTH,
      this.SALT_LENGTH + this.IV_LENGTH,
    );
    const encryptedBuffer = combined.subarray(
      this.SALT_LENGTH + this.IV_LENGTH,
    );

    // Derive decryption key
    const key = await this.deriveKey(masterKey, salt);

    // Create decipher
    const decipher = createDecipheriv(this.ALGORITHM, key, iv);

    // Set authentication tag
    if (typeof encryptedData !== "string" && authTag!) {
      decipher.setAuthTag(authTag);
    }

    // Add authenticated additional data if provided
    if (additionalData) {
      decipher.setAAD(Buffer.from(additionalData, "utf8"));
    }

    // Decrypt
    let decrypted = decipher.update(encryptedBuffer);
    decrypted = Buffer.concat([decrypted, decipher.final()]);

    return decrypted.toString("utf8");
  }

  /**
   * Encrypt a JSON object
   * @param obj - Object to encrypt
   * @param masterKey - Master encryption key
   * @returns Encrypted result
   */
  static async encryptObject<T>(
    obj: T,
    masterKey: string,
  ): Promise<EncryptionResult> {
    const plaintext = JSON.stringify(obj);
    return this.encrypt(plaintext, masterKey);
  }

  /**
   * Decrypt to JSON object
   * @param encryptedData - Encrypted data
   * @param masterKey - Master encryption key
   * @returns Decrypted object
   */
  static async decryptObject<T>(
    encryptedData: EncryptionResult | string,
    masterKey: string,
  ): Promise<T> {
    const plaintext = await this.decrypt(encryptedData, masterKey);
    return JSON.parse(plaintext);
  }

  /**
   * Generate a secure random key
   * @param length - Key length in bytes (default: 32 for AES-256)
   * @returns Base64 encoded random key
   */
  static generateKey(length: number = this.KEY_LENGTH): string {
    return randomBytes(length).toString("base64");
  }

  /**
   * Hash data using SHA-256
   * @param data - Data to hash
   * @returns Hex encoded hash
   */
  static hash(data: string): string {
    const crypto = require("crypto");
    return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(data).digest("hex");
  }

  /**
   * Generate HMAC signature
   * @param data - Data to sign
   * @param secret - Secret key
   * @returns Hex encoded HMAC
   */
  static hmac(data: string, secret: string): string {
    const crypto = require("crypto");
    return crypto.createHmac("sha256", secret).update(data).digest("hex");
  }

  /**
   * Verify HMAC signature
   * @param data - Original data
   * @param signature - HMAC signature to verify
   * @param secret - Secret key
   * @returns True if signature is valid
   */
  static verifyHmac(data: string, signature: string, secret: string): boolean {
    const expected = this.hmac(data, secret);

    // Use timing-safe comparison to prevent timing attacks
    if (expected.length !== signature.length) {
      return false;
    }

    let result = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < expected.length; i++) {
      result |= expected.charCodeAt(i) ^ signature.charCodeAt(i);
    }

    return result === 0;
  }
}

import * as argon2 from "argon2";

/**
 * Password hashing service using Argon2id (OWASP recommended)
 *
 * Argon2id is the winner of the Password Hashing Competition and provides
 * better security than bcrypt against GPU attacks and side-channel attacks.
 */

export interface PasswordHashOptions {
  memoryCost?: number; // Memory cost in KiB (default: 65536 = 64 MB)
  timeCost?: number; // Time cost (iterations, default: 3)
  parallelism?: number; // Parallelism factor (default: 4)
}

export class PasswordService {
  private static readonly DEFAULT_OPTIONS: PasswordHashOptions = {
    memoryCost: 65536, // 64 MB
    timeCost: 3, // 3 iterations
    parallelism: 4, // 4 threads
  };

  /**
   * Hash a password using Argon2id
   * @param password - Plain text password
   * @param options - Hashing options (optional)
   * @returns Hashed password string
   */
  static async hash(
    password: string,
    options: PasswordHashOptions = {},
  ): Promise<string> {
    const opts = { ...this.DEFAULT_OPTIONS, ...options };

    return argon2.hash(password, {
      type: argon2.argon2id, // Use Argon2id variant
      memoryCost: opts.memoryCost,
      timeCost: opts.timeCost,
      parallelism: opts.parallelism,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Verify a password against a hash
   * @param hash - Stored password hash
   * @param password - Plain text password to verify
   * @returns True if password matches, false otherwise
   */
  static async verify(hash: string, password: string): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      return await argon2.verify(hash, password);
    } catch (error) {
      // Invalid hash format
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Check if a hash needs rehashing (parameters changed)
   * @param hash - Stored password hash
   * @param options - Current hashing options
   * @returns True if hash needs to be updated
   */
  static async needsRehash(
    hash: string,
    options: PasswordHashOptions = {},
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const opts = { ...this.DEFAULT_OPTIONS, ...options };

    return argon2.needsRehash(hash, {
      // type: argon2.argon2id,
      memoryCost: opts.memoryCost,
      timeCost: opts.timeCost,
      parallelism: opts.parallelism,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Validate password strength
   * @param password - Password to validate
   * @returns Object with validation results
   */
  static validateStrength(password: string): {
    isValid: boolean;
    score: number;
    errors: string[];
  } {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    let score = 0;

    // Minimum length check
    if (password.length < 8) {
      errors.push("Password must be at least 8 characters long");
    } else if (password.length >= 8 && password.length < 12) {
      score += 1;
    } else if (password.length >= 12) {
      score += 2;
    }

    // Uppercase check
    if (!/[A-Z]/.test(password)) {
      errors.push("Password must contain at least one uppercase letter");
    } else {
      score += 1;
    }

    // Lowercase check
    if (!/[a-z]/.test(password)) {
      errors.push("Password must contain at least one lowercase letter");
    } else {
      score += 1;
    }

    // Number check
    if (!/\d/.test(password)) {
      errors.push("Password must contain at least one number");
    } else {
      score += 1;
    }

    // Special character check
    if (!/[!@#$%^&*()_+\-=\[\]{};':"\\|,.<>\/?]/.test(password)) {
      errors.push("Password must contain at least one special character");
    } else {
      score += 1;
    }

    // Common patterns check
    const commonPatterns = [
      "password",
      "12345",
      "qwerty",
      "admin",
      "letmein",
      "welcome",
    ];
    if (
      commonPatterns.some((pattern) => password.toLowerCase().includes(pattern))
    ) {
      errors.push("Password contains common patterns");
      score -= 2;
    }

    // Sequential characters check
    if (/(.)\1{2,}/.test(password)) {
      errors.push("Password contains repeated characters");
      score -= 1;
    }

    score = Math.max(0, score); // Ensure score doesn't go below 0

    return {
      isValid: errors.length === 0 && score >= 4,
      score: Math.min(5, score), // Cap at 5
      errors,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Generate a random password
   * @param length - Password length (default: 16)
   * @returns Random secure password
   */
  static generate(length: number = 16): string {
    const uppercase = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ";
    const lowercase = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz";
    const numbers = "0123456789";
    const special = "!@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{}|;:,.<>?";
    const all = uppercase + lowercase + numbers + special;

    let password = "";

    // Ensure at least one of each character type
    password += uppercase[Math.floor(Math.random() * uppercase.length)];
    password += lowercase[Math.floor(Math.random() * lowercase.length)];
    password += numbers[Math.floor(Math.random() * numbers.length)];
    password += special[Math.floor(Math.random() * special.length)];

    // Fill the rest randomly
    for (let i = password.length; i < length; i++) {
      password += all[Math.floor(Math.random() * all.length)];
    }

    // Shuffle the password
    return password
      .split("")
      .sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5)
      .join("");
  }
}

import { Redis } from "ioredis";

/**
 * Sliding Window Rate Limiter
 *
 * Implements a distributed rate limiter using Redis sorted sets.
 * More accurate than fixed window and prevents burst attacks.
 */

export interface RateLimitConfig {
  maxRequests: number; // Maximum requests allowed
  windowMs: number; // Time window in milliseconds
  keyPrefix?: string; // Redis key prefix
}

export interface RateLimitResult {
  allowed: boolean;
  remaining: number;
  resetAt: Date;
  retryAfter?: number; // Seconds until next attempt
}

export class SlidingWindowRateLimiter {
  private redis: Redis;

  constructor(redis: Redis) {
    this.redis = redis;
  }

  /**
   * Check if request is allowed under rate limit
   * @param identifier - Unique identifier (IP, user ID, etc.)
   * @param config - Rate limit configuration
   * @returns Rate limit result
   */
  async isAllowed(
    identifier: string,
    config: RateLimitConfig,
  ): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
    const key = `${config.keyPrefix || "rate_limit"}:${identifier}`;
    const now = Date.now();
    const windowStart = now - config.windowMs;

    // Use Redis pipeline for atomic operations
    const pipeline = this.redis.pipeline();

    // Remove old entries outside the window
    pipeline.zremrangebyscore(key, 0, windowStart);

    // Count requests in current window
    pipeline.zcard(key);

    // Add current request
    pipeline.zadd(key, now, `${now}-${Math.random()}`);

    // Set expiry on the key
    pipeline.expire(key, Math.ceil(config.windowMs / 1000));

    const results = await pipeline.exec();

    if (!results) {
      throw new Error("Redis pipeline execution failed");
    }

    // Get count from the second command (zcard)
    const count = ((results[1] as any)[1] as number) || 0;

    const allowed = count < config.maxRequests;
    const remaining = Math.max(0, config.maxRequests - count - 1);

    let retryAfter: number | undefined;
    if (!allowed) {
      // Get the oldest request timestamp
      const oldest = await this.redis.zrange(key, 0, 0, "WITHSCORES");
      if (oldest.length >= 2) {
        const oldestTimestamp = parseInt(oldest[1] as string);
        const resetTime = oldestTimestamp + config.windowMs;
        retryAfter = Math.ceil((resetTime - now) / 1000);
      }
    }

    return {
      allowed,
      remaining,
      resetAt: new Date(now + config.windowMs),
      retryAfter,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Reset rate limit for an identifier
   * @param identifier - Unique identifier
   * @param keyPrefix - Redis key prefix
   */
  async reset(
    identifier: string,
    keyPrefix: string = "rate_limit",
  ): Promise<void> {
    const key = `${keyPrefix}:${identifier}`;
    await this.redis.del(key);
  }

  /**
   * Get current usage for an identifier
   * @param identifier - Unique identifier
   * @param config - Rate limit configuration
   * @returns Current request count
   */
  async getUsage(identifier: string, config: RateLimitConfig): Promise<number> {
    const key = `${config.keyPrefix || "rate_limit"}:${identifier}`;
    const now = Date.now();
    const windowStart = now - config.windowMs;

    await this.redis.zremrangebyscore(key, 0, windowStart);
    return await this.redis.zcard(key);
  }
}

/**
 * Token Bucket Rate Limiter
 *
 * Allows bursts of traffic while maintaining average rate.
 * Useful for API rate limiting with some flexibility.
 */
export class TokenBucketRateLimiter {
  private redis: Redis;

  constructor(redis: Redis) {
    this.redis = redis;
  }

  /**
   * Check if request is allowed and consume token
   * @param identifier - Unique identifier
   * @param bucketSize - Maximum tokens in bucket
   * @param refillRate - Tokens added per second
   * @param cost - Tokens consumed per request (default: 1)
   * @returns Rate limit result
   */
  async consume(
    identifier: string,
    bucketSize: number,
    refillRate: number,
    cost: number = 1,
  ): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
    const key = `token_bucket:${identifier}`;
    const now = Date.now();

    const data = await this.redis.get(key);
    let tokens = bucketSize;
    let lastRefill = now;

    if (data) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(data);
      tokens = parsed.tokens;
      lastRefill = parsed.lastRefill;

      // Calculate tokens to add based on time elapsed
      const timePassed = (now - lastRefill) / 1000; // seconds
      const tokensToAdd = timePassed * refillRate;
      tokens = Math.min(bucketSize, tokens + tokensToAdd);
    }

    const allowed = tokens >= cost;
    let remaining = tokens;

    if (allowed) {
      remaining = tokens - cost;
      await this.redis.setex(
        key,
        Math.ceil(bucketSize / refillRate) + 60, // TTL
        JSON.stringify({
          tokens: remaining,
          lastRefill: now,
        }),
      );
    }

    const resetAt = new Date(
      now + ((bucketSize - remaining) / refillRate) * 1000,
    );
    const retryAfter = allowed
      ? undefined
      : Math.ceil((cost - tokens) / refillRate);

    return {
      allowed,
      remaining: Math.floor(remaining),
      resetAt,
      retryAfter,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Reset token bucket for an identifier
   * @param identifier - Unique identifier
   */
  async reset(identifier: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.redis.del(`token_bucket:${identifier}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Distributed Leaky Bucket Rate Limiter
 *
 * Processes requests at a constant rate, queuing excess requests.
 * Best for smoothing out traffic spikes.
 */
export class LeakyBucketRateLimiter {
  private redis: Redis;

  constructor(redis: Redis) {
    this.redis = redis;
  }

  /**
   * Check if request can be processed
   * @param identifier - Unique identifier
   * @param capacity - Maximum bucket capacity
   * @param leakRate - Requests processed per second
   * @returns Rate limit result
   */
  async isAllowed(
    identifier: string,
    capacity: number,
    leakRate: number,
  ): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
    const key = `leaky_bucket:${identifier}`;
    const now = Date.now();

    const data = await this.redis.get(key);
    let level = 0;
    let lastLeak = now;

    if (data) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(data);
      level = parsed.level;
      lastLeak = parsed.lastLeak;

      // Calculate how much leaked since last check
      const timePassed = (now - lastLeak) / 1000; // seconds
      const leaked = timePassed * leakRate;
      level = Math.max(0, level - leaked);
    }

    const allowed = level < capacity;

    if (allowed) {
      level += 1;
      await this.redis.setex(
        key,
        Math.ceil(capacity / leakRate) + 60, // TTL
        JSON.stringify({
          level,
          lastLeak: now,
        }),
      );
    }

    const remaining = Math.floor(capacity - level);
    const resetAt = new Date(now + (level / leakRate) * 1000);
    const retryAfter = allowed
      ? undefined
      : Math.ceil((level - capacity + 1) / leakRate);

    return {
      allowed,
      remaining,
      resetAt,
      retryAfter,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Reset leaky bucket for an identifier
   * @param identifier - Unique identifier
   */
  async reset(identifier: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.redis.del(`leaky_bucket:${identifier}`);
  }
}

// Color helpers for terminal output
const colors = {
  green: "\x1b[32m",
  red: "\x1b[31m",
  yellow: "\x1b[33m",
  blue: "\x1b[34m",
  reset: "\x1b[0m",
};

function log(message: string, color: keyof typeof colors = "reset") {
  console.log(`${colors[color]}${message}${colors.reset}`);
}

function logSuccess(message: string) {
  log(`✅ ${message}`, "green");
}

function logError(message: string) {
  log(`❌ ${message}`, "red");
}

function logInfo(message: string) {
  log(`ℹ️  ${message}`, "blue");
}

function logWarning(message: string) {
  log(`⚠️  ${message}`, "yellow");
}

// Test runner
class TestRunner {
  private passed = 0;
  private failed = 0;
  private testSuite = "";

  suite(name: string) {
    this.testSuite = name;
    log(`\n📦 ${name}`, "blue");
    log("─".repeat(60), "blue");
  }

  async test(name: string, fn: () => Promise<void> | void) {
    try {
      await fn();
      this.passed++;
      logSuccess(name);
    } catch (error) {
      this.failed++;
      logError(name);
      console.error(
        `   Error: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : error}`,
      );
    }
  }

  summary() {
    log("\n" + "═".repeat(60), "blue");
    log("📊 TEST SUMMARY", "blue");
    log("═".repeat(60), "blue");
    logSuccess(`Passed: ${this.passed}`);
    if (this.failed > 0) {
      logError(`Failed: ${this.failed}`);
    } else {
      log(`Failed: ${this.failed}`, "green");
    }
    log(`Total: ${this.passed + this.failed}`, "blue");

    if (this.failed === 0) {
      log("\n🎉 All tests passed!", "green");
    } else {
      log("\n💥 Some tests failed!", "red");
    }
  }
}

// Assert helpers
function assert(condition: boolean, message: string) {
  if (!condition) {
    throw new Error(message);
  }
}

function assertEqual<T>(actual: T, expected: T, message?: string) {
  if (actual !== expected) {
    throw new Error(message || `Expected ${expected}, but got ${actual}`);
  }
}

function assertNotEqual<T>(actual: T, notExpected: T, message?: string) {
  if (actual === notExpected) {
    throw new Error(message || `Expected value to not be ${notExpected}`);
  }
}

    const duration = Date.now() - startTime;

    logInfo(`   Verification took ${duration}ms`);

    assert(duration < 2000, "Verification should complete within 2 seconds");
  });

  await runner.test("should validate password strength quickly", () => {
    const password = "TestPassword123!";
    const startTime = Date.now();

    for (let i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
      PasswordService.validateStrength(password);
    }

    const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
    logInfo(`   1000 validations took ${duration}ms`);

    assert(duration < 100, "Validation should be very fast");
  });

  // ========================================
  // Edge Cases Tests
  // ========================================

  runner.suite("Edge Cases");

  await runner.test("should handle very long passwords", async () => {
    const password = "A".repeat(1000) + "1!aB";
    const hash = await PasswordService.hash(password);
    const isValid = await PasswordService.verify(hash, password);

    assertEqual(isValid, true, "Should handle very long passwords");
  });

  await runner.test("should handle unicode characters", async () => {
    const password = "Pässwörd123!你好";
    const hash = await PasswordService.hash(password);
    const isValid = await PasswordService.verify(hash, password);

    assertEqual(isValid, true, "Should handle unicode characters");
  });

  await runner.test(
    "should handle special characters in password",
    async () => {
      const password = "P@$$w0rd!#$%^&*()_+-=[]{}|;:,.<>?/~`";
      const hash = await PasswordService.hash(password);
      const isValid = await PasswordService.verify(hash, password);

      assertEqual(isValid, true, "Should handle all special characters");
    },
  );

  await runner.test("should handle password with spaces", async () => {
    const password = "My Secure Password 123!";
    const hash = await PasswordService.hash(password);
    const isValid = await PasswordService.verify(hash, password);

    assertEqual(isValid, true, "Should handle passwords with spaces");
  });

  // ========================================
  // Security Tests
  // ========================================

  runner.suite("Security Tests");

  await runner.test("should use timing-safe comparison", async () => {
    const password = "TestPassword123!";
    const hash = await PasswordService.hash(password);

    // Multiple verification attempts should take similar time
    const times: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const start = Date.now();
      await PasswordService.verify(hash, "WrongPassword123!");
      times.push(Date.now() - start);
    }

    const avgTime = times.reduce((a, b) => a + b) / times.length;
    const maxDeviation = Math.max(...times.map((t) => Math.abs(t - avgTime)));

    logInfo(`   Avg verification time: ${avgTime.toFixed(2)}ms`);
    logInfo(`   Max deviation: ${maxDeviation.toFixed(2)}ms`);

    // Timing should be relatively consistent (within 50ms)
    assert(maxDeviation < 50, "Verification timing should be consistent");
  });

  await runner.test(
    "should not leak password through hash comparison",
    async () => {
      const password1 = "TestPassword123!";
      const password2 = "TestPassword456!";

      const hash1 = await PasswordService.hash(password1);
      const hash2 = await PasswordService.hash(password2);

      // Hashes should not reveal password similarity
      assertNotEqual(
        hash1,
        hash2,
        "Different passwords should have different hashes",
      );

      // Even with similar passwords
      const similarHash1 = await PasswordService.hash("TestPassword123!");
      const similarHash2 = await PasswordService.hash("TestPassword123@");

      assertNotEqual(
        similarHash1,
        similarHash2,
        "Similar passwords should have different hashes",
      );
    },
  );

  // Print summary
  runner.summary();
}

// ============================================================================
// RUN TESTS
// ============================================================================

log("\n🚀 Starting PasswordService Test Suite\n", "blue");

runTests()
  .then(() => {
    process.exit(0);
  })
  .catch((error) => {
    logError(`\nFatal error: ${error}`);
    process.exit(1);
  });

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

const UI_DIR = path.resolve("./src/components/ui");
const INDEX_FILE = path.join(UI_DIR, "../index.ts");

// Get all .ts/.tsx files except index.ts
const files = fs
  .readdirSync(UI_DIR)
  .filter(
    (file) =>
      file !== "index.ts" && (file.endsWith(".ts") || file.endsWith(".tsx")),
  );

// Generate export lines
const exports =
  files
    .map((file) => {
      const name = file.replace(/\.tsx?$/, "");
      return `export * from "./ui/${name}";`;
    })
    .join("\n") + "\n";

// Write to index.ts
fs.writeFileSync(INDEX_FILE, exports);

console.log(`✅ UI barrel generated: components/ui/index.ts`);

export function Card({
  className,
  title,
  children,
  href,
}: {
  className?: string;
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  href: string;
}): JSX.Element {

      rel="noopener noreferrer"
      target="_blank"
    >
      <h2>
        {title} <span>-&gt;</span>
      </h2>
      <p>{children}</p>
    </a>
  );
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";

export function ThemeProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    React.useEffect(() => {
        const stored = localStorage.getItem("theme");
        const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
        const theme = stored || (prefersDark ? "dark" : "light");

        document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", theme === "dark");
    }, []);

    return children;
}
